instruction: Go to the supply depot and collect 10 power units. Distribute them evenly among charging station 1, charging station 2 and charging station 3. Once all power units are placed, return to the monitoring center.
Proceed to the distribution hub to pick up 6 containers of medical supplies. Deliver two containers to each of three emergency stations (1-3) before returning to base.

Collect 12 battery modules from the storage unit and distribute them to four charging docks, North charging dock, East charging dock, South charging dock, West charding dock, ensuring each dock receives equal amounts. When ready, proceed to the maintenance bay.

Retrieve 8 coolant canisters from the refrigeration unit. Deliver two canisters each to four industrial cooling towers (1-4). If any tower has reached capacity, redistribute the excess before proceeding to the central control room.
Collect 10 crates of vegetables from barn 4, evenly distribute them to market stalls Alpha, Beta, Gamma, and Delta, then report to the town square for further tasks.

Collect nine sealed soil-sample tubes from the geology outpost, then distribute two tubes to Station Alpha, three tubes to Station Beta, and four tubes to Station Gamma in that exact order. After the final hand-off at Station Gamma, wait half an hour for preliminary readings to finish before proceeding to the command tent.

Retrieve eight folding solar panels from the depot and bring four to Position A of the hilltop array. Wait exactly one hour for the technicians to secure them, then take the remaining four panels to Position B of the same array.

Pick up nine emergency medical packs at the field hospital and deliver six packs to the north triage point followed by three packs to the east triage point. After unloading at the east point, wait ten minutes for confirmation, then report to the sanitation station.

Collect ten water canisters from the desert well, drop five at Camp Alpha, two at Camp Gamma, and three at Camp Beta, visiting Gamma before Beta even though it receives fewer canisters. End the route at the observation tower.

Bring one diagnostic toolkit from the equipment storage to the wind-turbine site, then wait exactly two hours for the maintenance crew to finish using it. Afterwards, collect the used oil filters from the same site and deliver them to the recycling center before heading to the rest area.

Collect one packet of heirloom tomato seeds from Seed Bank A, one of chili pepper seeds from Seed Bank B, and one of basil seeds from Seed Bank C, in that sequence. Deliver all three packets together to the greenhouse, wait for the horticulturist to accept them, then return to Seed Bank A for sanitization.

Load twenty bolts, fifteen gears, and ten drive belts from the central warehouse. Deliver half of each type—ten bolts, seven gears, five belts—to the western workshop first, then the remaining quantities to the eastern workshop. After unloading at the eastern workshop, wait five minutes for inventory verification.

Pick up three sealed barrels of antifreeze from the chemical shed and wait two minutes to verify the seals. Deliver the barrels to the cooling tower, wait for them to be unloaded, then collect any empty barrels at the tower and take those to the disposal site.

Collect six rescue drones from the drone hangar, deliver them to the charging bay, and wait until all batteries have been installed. Once the drones are fully powered, take them to the launch pad and then return to the hangar.

Load twelve weather-sensor pods from the mobile IT van and deploy one pod each to twelve perimeter markers in clockwise order, starting at Marker North and ending at Marker North-West. After installing the final pod, wait fifteen minutes for system synchronization before moving to the data hub.

Travel to the greenhouse storage and gather six sacks of fertilizer. Deliver three sacks to the North Field irrigation hub, two sacks to the Orchard entrance, and one sack to the South Pasture gate. Wait at the South Pasture gate for 7 minutes for confirmation. After delivery is confirmed, proceed to the equipment garage and stand by for further tasks.
Begin at the maintenance depot and pick up two toolboxes and a spool of insulated wire.
Travel to Windmill Station 3 and deliver one toolbox to the on-site technician. Wait until the technician removes the toolbox from the robot.
Proceed to the solar panel array and deliver the spool of insulated wire to the maintenance crew. Wait for 10 minutes while they inspect the delivery.
After the wait, head to the livestock barn, deliver the remaining toolbox to the barn supervisor, then return to the maintenance depot and await further instructions.

Drive to the solar panel field control shed to pick up four spools of insulated wire. Transport two spools to the wind turbine tower near the north boundary. Wait until the maintenance team unloads the wire. Then, deliver the remaining two spools to the power station by the irrigation canal, and return to the central operations garage.

instruction.location: wind turbine tower near the north boundary
wind turbine tower near the north boundary
power station by the irrigation canal
power station by the irrigation canal

instruction: Travel to the greenhouse supply shed and pick up eight seed dispersal kits. Deliver two kits each to the North field, South field, East field, and West field. After all deliveries are complete, return to the supply shed and wait for 10 minutes to be reloaded with fertilizer packs.

Proceed to the solar array maintenance shed and pick up three boxes of replacement solar panels. Deliver one box each to the South Hill solar field, the East Ridge solar field, and the West Valley solar field. At each site, wait until the on-site technician confirms the box has been unloaded before moving to the next location. Once all deliveries are complete, return any remaining empty crates from the last site to the maintenance shed.

Proceed to the orchard supply tent and pick up five fresh water tanks. Deliver three tanks to the north field irrigation station and wait 20 minutes for the farm crew to install them. Then take the remaining two tanks to the south field pump house. Once the tanks are unloaded, return to the orchard supply tent for further instructions.

Drive to the irrigation supply depot and pick up two large water pumps and six reels of irrigation hose. Deliver one water pump and three reels of hose to the North Orchard pump station. Wait until a supervisor inspects the equipment and gives clearance to unload. After unloading there, proceed to the South Field reservoir and deliver the remaining pump and hoses. Wait for 10 minutes at the reservoir in case additional assistance is needed. Finally, return to the irrigation supply depot and report task completion.

Drive to the maintenance garage and pick up two replacement hydraulic hoses. Proceed to the Orchard Irrigation Control Station and deliver one hose. Wait until the station attendant confirms receipt by removing the hose. Continue to the Vineyard Pump House and deliver the second hose. After delivery, return to the maintenance garage for further assignment.

Start at the storage barn and pick up a pallet containing six bags of fertilizer. Drive to Greenhouse 4 and deliver two bags. After unloading, wait for the greenhouse technician to inspect and sign off before proceeding. Next, go to the field composting area and drop off the remaining four bags. Wait for 10 minutes to ensure safe placement before returning to the storage barn.

Proceed to the equipment storage barn and load three large water tanks onto the robot. Transport two tanks directly to the upper meadow grazing area and wait while they are unloaded by the field hands. Deliver the final tank to the east orchard pump station. Once delivery is complete, stand by at the pump station for 15 minutes in case further assistance is required, then return to the maintenance depot.

Start at the greenhouse storage area and collect four trays of vegetable seedlings and a box of soil sensors. Travel to the eastern test plot and deliver the seedlings to the planting crew. Wait until the planting crew unloads all trays. Afterward, proceed to the center monitoring station to drop off the soil sensor box. Finally, return to the greenhouse storage area and await further assignments.

Drive to the vineyard storage shed and collect five crates of harvested grapes. Transport three crates to the winery pressing room and wait until they are unloaded by staff. Deliver the remaining two crates to the fermentation cellar. After drop-off, proceed to the solar panel field and check if maintenance supplies are ready for pickup; if not, wait for 10 minutes before returning to the operations hub.

Travel to the equipment garage and pick up two replacement water pumps. Deliver the pumps to the irrigation control station at the eastern field. Wait until a technician removes the old equipment and loads the faulty pumps onto your payload area. Return the faulty pumps to the repair workshop near the main entrance, then proceed to the charging station for a 20-minute recharge.

instruction.location: irrigation control station at the eastern field
irrigation control station at the eastern field

repair workshop near the main entrance

instruction: Begin at Workshop 2 and pick up the maintenance tool kit and a replacement hydraulic pump. Drive to the wind turbine service pad and deliver both items to the designated technician. Wait until the technician removes the hydraulic pump from the robot, then stand by for 15 minutes while the tool kit is in use. Once the technician places the tool kit back onto the robot, return it to Workshop 2 and place it in the equipment locker.

Start at the tractor garage and collect three empty fuel canisters. Navigate to the west field fuel depot and refill all canisters. Then, drive to the southern harvesting area and deliver the filled fuel canisters to the harvester crew. Wait until all canisters are unloaded by the crew. Once unloaded, proceed to the main operations office to pick up a weatherproof data tablet for field logging, and deliver the tablet to the foreman at the northern observation tower. Finally, return to the tractor garage and await the next task.

weatherproof data tablet for field logging

instruction: Start at the maintenance bay and pick up a box containing replacement sensor modules and a tool kit. Travel to the vineyard drone charging station in the eastern vineyard and deliver the tool kit to the technician present. Wait until the technician loads two depleted drone batteries onto the robot. Next, proceed to the solar array maintenance platform and drop off the replacement sensor modules. Remain at the platform for 15 minutes in standby mode, in case further transport of malfunctioning components is needed. Afterward, return to the maintenance bay and transfer the depleted drone batteries to the designated recycling bin.

instruction.location: vineyard drone charging station in the eastern vineyard
vineyard drone charging station in the eastern vineyard
vineyard drone charging station in the eastern vineyard

instruction: Begin at the seed storage shed and collect three sacks of corn seeds. Travel across the north gravel path to the tractor fueling depot. Deliver one sack of corn seeds to the attendant at the fueling depot. Continue to the hillside greenhouse, located on the west slope, and deliver the remaining two sacks of corn seeds to the storage area inside. Wait at the greenhouse for 10 minutes in case additional seed transfer is requested. Once the waiting period has elapsed, navigate back to the seed storage shed and park at the designated unloading bay.

instruction.location: hillside greenhouse, located on the west slope

instruction: Proceed to the north field storage shed and collect six irrigation hoses and four bags of fertilizer. Transport all items to the greenhouse loading area and wait there until all items are unloaded by the staff. Once unloaded, travel to the orchard gate and pick up any empty crates left beside the entrance. Take the empty crates to the composting station, drop them off, and then head back to the charging station near the garage to recharge.

Begin at the processing warehouse and pick up three crates of freshly harvested strawberries. Travel to the farm manager’s office in the north building and deliver one crate to the receptionist. Next, continue to the refrigeration unit behind the packing shed and leave the remaining two crates inside. Wait at the refrigeration unit for 10 minutes to confirm that the crates are properly stored and signed in, then proceed to the parking area near the equipment shed and stand by for further assignment.

instruction: Head to the machinery workshop and collect three sealed containers of lubricating oil. Transport these containers to the tractor fleet parking zone and deliver one container to each of the three designated maintenance pits. After all containers are delivered, wait for 10 minutes to allow the mechanics to complete oil refills. Once the waiting period is over, move to the solar array field and pick up any discarded packaging materials scattered near the southern maintenance hut. Deliver all collected packaging materials to the recycling center adjacent to the east gate before returning to your docking station behind the maintenance room.

instruction: Start at the Farm Storage Shed and pick up three bags of fertilizer and a box of irrigation valves. Drive to the Greenhouse Complex and deliver the box of irrigation valves. Wait for 5 minutes to be unloaded. Proceed to Field Plot 7 and deliver the three bags of fertilizer. Wait until the field supervisor removes all fertilizer bags, then return to the Storage Shed for your next task.

Proceed to the irrigation shed and pick up two rolls of drip tape along with a set of replacement sprinkler heads. Drive to the east vineyard block and deliver the supplies to the irrigation maintenance crew. Wait for up to 10 minutes while the crew inspects and removes the items from the robot. Once unloaded, continue to the equipment calibration shelter to collect a box containing sensor calibration tools. Transport the box to greenhouse 2 and hand it over to the technical staff awaiting within. Afterwards, head to the shade structure near the central orchard and remain on standby for further instructions.

instruction.location: shade structure near the central orchard

instruction: Start at the machinery garage and pick up two sealed cases of irrigation nozzles. Drive to the eastern pasture fence line and deliver one case to the tool crate beside Gate 2. Wait there for 15 minutes to allow the maintenance crew to retrieve the nozzles. When the wait is over, proceed to the southern pumping station with the remaining case of nozzles and place it on the supply platform. Once the delivery is complete, return to the machinery garage and park near Bay 3 for further assignments.

instruction.location: eastern pasture fence line tool crate beside Gate 2

instruction: Travel to the machine shop and pick up four sealed toolboxes. Take two toolboxes to the solar panel maintenance area and wait until the site supervisor confirms they are unloaded. Then deliver the remaining two toolboxes to the wind turbine control shelter. After all toolboxes have been delivered, wait at the shelter for 10 minutes in case additional equipment needs to be loaded. Finally, return to the machine shop.

Start at the maintenance garage and collect four solar panel cleaning kits. Proceed to the west orchard and deliver two cleaning kits to the field crew supervisor near the irrigation control station. Then, travel to the south greenhouse to drop off the remaining two kits at the climate monitoring room. After completing the deliveries, wait at the climate monitoring room for 15 minutes to assist with any additional supply requests. Once finished, return to the maintenance garage for your next assignment.

instruction: Begin at the greenhouse loading bay and pick up three trays of young tomato seedlings. Transport the first tray to the central planting plot and deliver it to the marker labeled "Plot A1." Then proceed to the east field entrance and drop off the second tray near Shed 4 for the planting team. Wait beside Shed 4 for 10 minutes to confirm receipt by the team leader. After the waiting period, take the final tray to the irrigation control room and place it on the seedling shelf. Finally, return to the greenhouse loading bay and await new instructions.

instruction: Begin at the greenhouse entrance and collect six irrigation filters from the supply rack. Deliver three filters to the central field irrigation control station, then proceed to the east crop plot and deliver the remaining three filters. After all filters have been delivered, move to the compost processing area and wait for 15 minutes to be loaded with any recyclable materials. Once loaded, transport the recyclables to the recycling bay and wait until they are fully unloaded before returning to the greenhouse entrance.

Begin at the supply depot and pick up three sealed fertilizer canisters. Travel to Crop Field B and deliver two canisters to the storage shed near the north entrance. Wait until the field supervisor confirms receipt of the fertilizer. Next, proceed to the machinery shed at the eastern perimeter fence and deliver the remaining canister to the equipment operator. After completing both deliveries, wait at the machinery shed for 10 minutes in case additional tools or materials are needed for ongoing repairs. Once the waiting period is over, return to the supply depot to await your next task.

instruction: Begin at the greenhouse loading bay and retrieve four pallets of seedling trays. Deliver two pallets to the planting crew stationed near Irrigation Sector A. Wait until the crew leader signals that all trays have been offloaded. Next, carry the remaining two pallets to the compost yard beside the utility barn for temporary storage. After unloading, proceed to the maintenance area and wait for 12 minutes for the maintenance team to perform a routine sensor calibration before returning to the greenhouse loading bay.

Wait until the technician removes one crate for immediate use. Take the remaining crate to the storage tent at Standpipe Junction and place it inside. Proceed to the main control tent and wait for 8 minutes while receiving new task updates, then navigate back to the equipment shed.

Begin at the equipment shed next to the north vineyard and pick up three sealed buckets of irrigation solution. Transport the buckets to the main greenhouse entrance and wait until the horticulture team offloads all buckets from the robot. Deliver one canister each to the North Field pond, the Central Orchard reservoir, and the Greenhouse water inlet. At each drop-off location, wait for the local quality inspector to verify receipt of the canister before proceeding. After the last delivery, return to the irrigation control station with any leftover canisters and report completion to the station supervisor.

Start at the machinery garage and pick up two boxes of replacement hydraulic hoses from the equipment shelf. Travel to the west vineyard maintenance shed and deliver one box of hoses. Wait for a technician to inspect and retrieve the box before proceeding. Next, head to the southern tractor depot, deliver the second box of hoses, and wait for 10 minutes to be loaded with any used hoses returned for recycling. Begin at the packaging facility and pick up three crates of freshly harvested tomatoes. Drive to the farm market stall and deliver one crate. instruction: Start at the equipment storage shed and pick up three bags of fertilizer. Drive to the South Orchard compost area and deliver one bag, waiting for the groundskeeper to unload it. Then continue to the Vineyard edge and deliver the second bag to the vineyard supervisor. Transport the final bag to the Crop Research Plot, wait for 10 minutes while the bag is unloaded and inspected, then return to the equipment storage shed for the next task.

Start at the central workshop and collect three containers of lubricating oil. Deliver one container to the eastern tractor depot and wait 15 minutes for the maintenance crew to refill the tractors. Next, bring the second container to the main greenhouse storage room and wait until the greenhouse manager takes it off the robot. Finally, deliver the last container to the compost processing shed. instruction: Begin at the Main Equipment Depot and retrieve a crate containing twelve sensor modules designated for quality assurance testing. Transport the crate to the Calibration Lab, where you must deliver five sensor modules, waiting there for the calibration specialist to prepare and verify the modules for installation, which will take 10 minutes. Once the preparation is complete, proceed to the Assembly Line 2 with four more sensor modules and remain onsite until the assembly supervisor confirms that the modules have been correctly integrated into the machinery. After successful confirmation, deliver the remaining three sensor modules to the Field Testing Dock. Wait for the field engineer to finalize the acceptance of the modules before returning to the Main Equipment Depot to complete your cycle and prepare for the next round of tasks.

object.description: crate containing sensor modules for quality assurance testing

instruction: Begin at Storage Warehouse Delta and load seven crates of harvested tomatoes. Proceed to Packing Station 1 to unload and wait until workers have removed exactly three crates before transporting the remaining four crates to Distribution Hub Beta. Once at Distribution Hub Beta, wait for two minutes while staff check and accept the crates, then return to Storage Warehouse Delta. If upon your return any empty tomato crates are ready for collection, load them and immediately deliver these empty crates to the field collection point adjacent to Greenhouse South, where you will wait until all empty crates have been offloaded before ending the task.

instruction.location: field collection point adjacent to Greenhouse South
field collection point adjacent to Greenhouse South

instruction: Begin by collecting four sacks of seed from the packing warehouse. Bring the entire load to the eastern field edge and wait until the field manager confirms the unloading of the first sack. Once the first sack has been removed, transport two sacks to the central field station and remain there for three minutes to allow station workers to prepare for the next transfer. After the waiting period, take the final sack to the northern irrigation hub; only after the sack has been removed by the technician should you return to the packing warehouse for your next assignment.

Begin at the logistics hub near the western storage silos and pick up six 5-kg sacks of fertilizer. Distribute these sacks among Greenhouse A, Crop Field B, and Vineyard C such that Greenhouse A receives two sacks, Crop Field B receives two sacks, and Vineyard C receives the remaining two sacks; after each delivery, pause for 5 minutes at the respective destination to allow on-site staff to remove each sack before proceeding to the next location. Only after all sacks have been delivered and confirmed removed from your payload area at each site, return to the logistics hub, and wait there for 20 minutes in case additional cargo becomes available for transport.

instruction.location: logistics hub near the western storage silos
logistics hub near the western storage silos
logistics hub near the western storage silos

instruction: Start by moving to Packing Station East and wait for the station supervisor to confirm that a crate of harvested blueberries is ready to be loaded onto the robot. After the crate is secured, transport it directly to Cooling Room 3 and wait until the cooling technician completes unloading. Next, remain in Cooling Room 3 for 8 minutes to allow temperature stabilization before proceeding to the Maintenance Dock. Upon arrival at the Maintenance Dock, unload and pick up an empty container; however, only proceed to Compost Yard A if the empty container has been confirmed loaded. Once at Compost Yard A, wait for the waste manager to remove the empty container, then return immediately to Packing Station East for further instructions, ensuring all required waiting and confirmation steps are completed in sequence.

Begin at the Central Storage Depot and load twelve bags of hybrid wheat seed onto your payload platform. Proceed to the North Field Entrance and deliver four seed bags to the planting crew, then wait until each bag is confirmed as unloaded before departing. Next, take another four seed bags to the East Terrace Plot, and once all four bags have been delivered and acknowledged by the field supervisor, remain at the East Terrace Plot for 5 minutes to allow the planting machinery to be serviced. Afterward, transport the remaining four seed bags to the South Slope Access Point, where you must wait for the agronomist to inspect and approve the seed bags before completing the delivery. Once all deliveries and required waiting periods are fulfilled, return directly to the Central Storage Depot for further instructions.

Begin your route at Maintenance Bay 3, where you must wait for the technician to confirm that a sealed container of replacement hydraulic oil is ready for transport. As soon as the container is available, travel directly to Tractor 12, which is stationed at Field Access Point C, and deliver the container to the on-site mechanic. Remain at Field Access Point C for five minutes while the mechanic verifies the integrity of the hydraulic oil before you proceed. If the mechanic confirms successful receipt of the hydraulic oil, continue to Water Pump Station 7 at the eastern perimeter and wait until the pump operator removes all empty supply containers from your cargo bay before proceeding to the machine shed for your next task assignment. If the technician at Maintenance Bay 3 fails to provide the container, do not leave Maintenance Bay 3 but instead await further instructions from the supervisor.

instruction: Start by picking up four empty chemical mixing tanks at Storage Dock A and transport them one by one to Mixing Plant 2, making sure that after each tank is delivered, you wait until the Mixing Plant 2 technician signals that the tank is loaded with fertilizer slurry. Once all four tanks have been filled, distribute three of the slurry tanks—one to Field Zone North, one to Field Zone East, and one to Field Zone South—delivering them in that order and waiting at each field until the local team has removed the tank from your payload. The remaining fourth tank should be delivered to the Emergency Response Shed; after arrival there, wait for three minutes for inspection before returning to Storage Dock A for further assignments.

instruction: Start your route at the equipment maintenance bay and collect six replacement hydraulic filters. Deliver two hydraulic filters to the main irrigation pump house on the south field edge, then continue to the eastern grain silo to drop off another two hydraulic filters. Take the final two hydraulic filters to the remote valley outpost workshop and wait for the workshop technician to remove the previous filters before completing the delivery there. After all filters have been distributed and the removal at the workshop is confirmed, return to the equipment maintenance bay and wait for three minutes before taking on any new tasks.

instruction.location: main irrigation pump house on the south field edge
main irrigation pump house on the south field edge

instruction: Begin at the central storage depot and collect a shipment consisting of eleven crates of assorted fertilizer. Evenly distribute these crates among the north field distribution point, the south greenhouse loading dock, and the eastern orchard gate by transporting batches of crates one location at a time, making sure that the north field and south greenhouse each receive four crates, while the eastern orchard gate receives the remaining three crates. After completing the drop-off at each location, wait for local staff to remove all crates at that site before proceeding to the next destination. Once the entire shipment has been delivered and confirmed, wait for 8 minutes in the maintenance bay near the workshop before returning to the depot for further instructions.

Begin at the central materials depot and load eight sealed bags of fertilizer. Travel to Orchard Plot A and deliver three bags, then pause for 4 minutes to allow field technicians to manually remove each bag. After all three bags have been unloaded, proceed to Greenhouse 2 and drop off two more bags, waiting for confirmation by the greenhouse supervisor before leaving. Deliver the remaining three bags to Irrigation Station North; however, if staff at Irrigation Station North are not present to receive the delivery, wait in standby for 8 minutes before returning to the central materials depot.

Start at the Seed Warehouse and acquire a pallet loaded with 17 bags of soybean seeds. Transport the pallet to the Main Loading Dock and remain there for 4 minutes while the crew inspects and tags the shipment for distribution. Once the inspection is confirmed complete, divide the 17 seed bags for delivery: bring 6 bags to the East Field Storage Shed, take 6 more bags to the South Equipment Barn, and deliver the remaining 5 bags to the North Irrigation Depot, ensuring each location receives its specified quota without omission. After all bags are handed over, return to the Seed Warehouse and wait for the next assignment.

object.description: pallet loaded with bags of soybean seeds
pallet loaded with bags of soybean seeds

instruction: Start by moving to the main seed storage shed and collecting eight fertilizer pods. Evenly distribute these pods by delivering three pods to the west cornfield depot, three more to the south soybean staging area, and the remaining two pods to the north wheat plot, ensuring that each drop-off location receives its assigned number of pods. After each completed delivery, wait 15 minutes at the location to allow field personnel to confirm receipt and secure the pods before proceeding to the next site. After all pods have been delivered and confirmed, return directly to the equipment maintenance bay for further task assignments.

Collect nine fertilizer containers from the Supply Shed and deliver three containers each to Crop Plot East, Crop Plot North, and Crop Plot West, ensuring that if there happens to be a remainder, the final container is allocated to Crop Plot North. After you have completed the deliveries to all plots, remain at Crop Plot West for twelve minutes to supervise initial distribution by the field crew, and only proceed back to the Supply Shed after the field crew at Crop Plot West confirms that the containers have been fully emptied.

Starting from the loading dock, collect a batch of seven freshly packed produce crates and ensure all crates are secured. Transport three crates to the southern market stall and wait there for four minutes to allow the market staff to unload them completely; after the unloading is confirmed, continue by taking two crates to the packaging facility’s receiving bay, where you must wait until staff signal that the bay is clear for drop-off. With the remaining two crates, proceed directly to the cold storage unit at the western end and deposit them on the labeled intake shelf. After all crates have been successfully delivered to their respective destinations, return to the loading dock, ensuring the cart is empty before awaiting your next assignment.

instruction.location: cold storage unit at the western end labeled intake shelf
cold storage unit at the western end labeled intake shelf

instruction: Start your mission at the maintenance bay, where you must collect six replacement air filters designated for scheduled equipment upkeep. Deliver two air filters to Pump Station Alpha and wait until the station technician confirms removal before proceeding. Next, transport another two air filters to the ventilation shaft access point in the South Field, but before unloading, remain idle for 3 minutes to allow environmental stabilization protocols to complete. Once the time has elapsed, wait for the environmental crew to remove both air filters from your platform. For the remaining two air filters, bring them to the machinery shed at the Western Perimeter, and only depart after the shed supervisor acknowledges receipt. After all deliveries are finalized, make your way back to the maintenance bay to stand by for the next assignment.

instruction.location: ventilation shaft access point in the South Field
ventilation shaft access point in the South Field

instruction: Begin at the supply depot and collect six irrigation hoses labeled for distribution. First, head to the east apple orchard and deliver two hoses to the maintenance post, then wait there for 8 minutes to ensure that the orchard crew receives the equipment. Next, proceed to the southern vineyard storage tent and leave another two hoses in the designated equipment bin; after placing the hoses, pause for 12 minutes to give staff time to log the drop-off. Once both drop-offs are complete and the waiting periods have elapsed, take the remaining two hoses to the central irrigation control hub, and deliver them to Bay 3. Only after verifying that all six hoses have been distributed and the waiting times at the orchard and vineyard have been observed, return to the supply depot and await further instructions.

instruction.location: southern vineyard storage tent designated equipment bin

instruction: Start at the Central Grain Storage Facility and collect a batch of fourteen empty sampling containers intended for the morning harvest analysis. First, bring five of the containers to the Cornfield North and wait for the agronomist to load them with soil samples, a process that will take seven minutes per batch. After the samples are loaded, proceed to Wheatfield East with five more containers, again waiting seven minutes as the field technician fills them. With the remaining four sampling containers, travel to Soy Plot B and wait an additional seven minutes for the technician to complete loading. Only after all containers at each location have been filled and secured should you return to the Central Grain Storage Facility, where you will deposit the samples into the analysis intake locker before notifying the facility manager that the morning collection is complete.

instruction: Begin at the Seed Storage Facility and collect twelve sealed seed canisters for distribution. Transport four seed canisters to Planter Robot Dock Alpha and wait there until the attendant confirms that the seed canisters have been fully loaded onto the dock's robot unit. Next, deliver another four seed canisters to Planter Robot Dock Bravo and wait for payload removal to be completed. Any remaining seed canisters, which may total four or fewer depending on prior unloading, must be brought to Planter Robot Dock Charlie. At Dock Charlie, remain on-site for seven minutes while maintenance staff inspect your cargo area for residual seed material before you move on. Only after all delivery confirmations from Docks Alpha, Bravo, and Charlie have been received, proceed to the Logistics Bay to report task completion and await further instructions.

Begin at the central loading dock and acquire four sealed crates of vegetable seedlings. Transport two crates to the hydroponic bay and wait there for 3 minutes as the farm technicians prepare the planting apparatus. Once the hydroponic bay technicians have removed their two crates, immediately deliver the third crate to the greenhouse annex, waiting for confirmation of crate acceptance. After receiving confirmation at the greenhouse annex, proceed with the final crate to the western field entrance, and remain there until a field supervisor collects the last crate, at which point you may leave the field and return to the central loading dock for your next assignment.

Start at the Harvest Control Center and collect a set of six soil sampling containers. For the first phase, travel to Field Plot A and deliver two soil sampling containers, waiting until the field technician at Plot A has removed them completely before proceeding. Next, head to Field Plot B with two more soil sampling containers, again waiting for complete removal by the technician at Plot B. Then, transport the final two soil sampling containers to Field Plot C and ensure they are unloaded by the local staff. After the last container has been removed at Field Plot C, proceed to the Equipment Cleaning Bay and remain there for a 12-minute decontamination period before returning directly to the Harvest Control Center, ensuring that the sequence of container drop-offs and waiting periods is followed exactly before beginning the decontamination wait.

Begin at the chemical storage depot and pick up nine sealed pesticide canisters, ensuring each canister is clearly labeled for inventory tracking. Transport three pesticide canisters to the greenhouse complex and wait until the greenhouse supervisor has prepared the sprayer units for refilling; after the canisters are accepted, head to the central orchard pump station to deliver another three canisters. Once the staff at the pump station confirms the canisters are safely received, proceed to the vineyard maintenance shed with the final three canisters, but pause outside the shed for five minutes before entering to allow for ongoing equipment sanitization to finish. Only after this five-minute wait, deliver the canisters to the vineyard staff, then return directly to the chemical storage depot to log the completion of all deliveries.

Begin at the parts warehouse and load nine replacement hydraulic filters, making sure all filters are securely stowed before departing. Next, proceed to Maintenance Bay 1 and deliver three hydraulic filters, waiting until maintenance staff completely remove all three filters from your payload compartment prior to moving on. After completing the first drop-off, travel to Maintenance Bay 2 to deliver another three hydraulic filters, pausing there as well until all filters have been confirmed as unloaded. Any remaining hydraulic filters should be taken to Maintenance Bay 3; if there are fewer than three filters left, deliver all of the remainder to Maintenance Bay 3 and wait for the staff to finish the removal process. Once deliveries to all bays are complete and your payload area is empty, stay docked at Maintenance Bay 3 for 10 minutes to allow for potential spare parts collection requests before returning to the parts warehouse.

Commence at the machine workshop and load a toolkit case intended for calibration tasks. Move to Wind Turbine 1 located along the northern ridge and wait until the technician signals that the toolkit case is ready for removal. Once the toolkit case has been fully offloaded, proceed to Solar Array Hub A in the eastern field; remain at Solar Array Hub A for exactly 10 minutes to allow engineers time to prepare diagnostic tools that require pickup. As soon as the diagnostic tools are ready, collect them and drive to the control lab inside the operations center near the main gate. Wait there until all diagnostic tools have been removed by lab personnel. After completing this sequence, return without delay to the machine workshop and await further instructions from the maintenance coordinator.

instruction: Start by retrieving four sealed crates of grain from the central storage warehouse and transport them to the north silo complex. Distribute the crates evenly across Silo A, Silo B, and Silo C—depositing one crate into each, and deliver the remaining crate to Silo D to ensure all silos receive at least one. After every crate drop-off, wait for 2 minutes at each silo while the receiving mechanism secures the payload, proceeding to the next silo only after confirmation. Once the final crate has been unloaded at Silo D, return directly to the central storage warehouse and remain there until dispatched for another collection task.

Commence your route at the main storage warehouse and load nine sacks of fertilizer onto your cart. Travel first to Greenhouse A and deliver three sacks of fertilizer, ensuring they are received by the head grower; before departing, wait for confirmation that all three sacks have been safely stored inside. Next, proceed to Crop Field Delta and offload another three sacks of fertilizer, verifying that the field supervisor acknowledges the delivery; if any sacks remain undelivered, wait an additional 5 minutes for the supervisor’s authorization before leaving. Finally, bring the remaining three sacks of fertilizer to the Orchard Utility Shed, and wait until the facility manager confirms receipt and removes the sacks from your cart. Only after all deliveries have been completed and receipts verified at each destination should you return to the main storage warehouse and park at Loading Bay 2, awaiting your next assignment.

Begin at Supply Warehouse North and load eight battery packs intended for field equipment recharge. Take three battery packs to the Western Soil Monitoring Station and remain onsite until the staff have removed those battery packs from your cargo bay. After the transfer is confirmed, deliver another three battery packs to the Eastern Surveillance Tower and wait for payload removal verification. The last two battery packs must be brought to the Central Maintenance Shed, where you must stay for five minutes so the maintenance supervisor can log and inspect the delivery. Once all battery packs have been distributed and confirmation of acceptance from every facility has been received, proceed directly to the Refueling Depot and wait there for ten minutes before initiating any new assignments.

instruction: Start at the equipment storage depot and load nine spare irrigation valves onto the robot. First, head to South Orchard Row 12 and deliver three irrigation valves, ensuring that the orchard manager has removed all three before departing. Next, travel to Field Shed B and distribute another three irrigation valves; wait at Field Shed B until the on-site technician confirms the valves have been collected. Proceed to the Main Reservoir Pump House and deliver the final three irrigation valves, then wait for six minutes to allow the maintenance crew to finish installation prep. After the waiting period at the Pump House, return promptly to the equipment storage depot to complete the round.

Begin at the equipment dispatch point adjacent to the maintenance garage, then proceed to the seed storage silo to pick up five bags of fertilizer pellets. Distribute the fertilizer pellets among three crop fields as follows: deliver two bags to Field Alpha and wait until all fertilizer has been removed, transport two bags to Field Beta and again wait for unloading to complete, and finally take the remaining one bag to Field Gamma. After every drop-off, make sure each bag is completely unloaded before departing for the next field. Once all fertilizer deliveries are complete, drive to the machine wash station near the western orchard and remain there for 7 minutes to allow equipment cleaning before the next assignment.

instruction: Start at the Central Packing Facility and retrieve a container holding 31 high-precision circuit modules. Transport the container first to the Electronic Assembly Line and stay for 8 minutes while assembly technicians inspect and unload exactly 12 modules; depart only after removal is complete. Next, deliver 10 modules to the Maintenance Bay on the south side and remain there until the maintenance supervisor removes all modules intended for that location. With the remaining 9 modules, proceed to the Quality Control Laboratory; after arrival, wait for 5 minutes to allow the inspection system to verify and accept the delivery. Following the final transfer, return to the Central Packing Facility and await further deployment instructions.

instruction: Start by navigating to the harvest storage dock adjacent to the southern field edge and retrieve a crate of packaged apples labeled 'Batch 14'. Next, proceed to Distribution Point 1 at the west parking bay and wait for staff to prepare the reception area for the delivery; after the area is ready, unload exactly 10 apples from the crate for local distribution. Following a mandatory wait of 7 minutes to finalize documentation at Distribution Point 1, continue to Distribution Point 2 located by the maintenance garage at the northern end of the property where you must deliver 12 apples, pausing again for 5 minutes to allow refrigeration staff to secure the apple shipment. Any apples remaining in the crate after these first two deliveries must be taken to Distribution Point 3 at the eastern market entrance, where you will deliver all remaining apples and wait for all apples to be removed before returning the emptied crate to the harvest storage dock to complete the mission.

instruction: Begin at the Seed Storage Facility by collecting a shipment of fifteen fertilizer canisters. Distribute the canisters in batches so that Greenhouse 1 receives five canisters on the first trip, Greenhouse 2 receives another five on the second trip, and Greenhouse 3 receives the remaining five on the final trip, making sure to return to the Seed Storage Facility between each delivery to reaffirm batch pickup. At each greenhouse stop, after placing the designated batch of five canisters, wait for the local operations manager to signal that the fertilizer canisters have been fully removed before proceeding. Once all three greenhouses have received their allocations and confirmed complete removal, travel to the Maintenance Bay and remain stationary for 180 seconds to allow for a scheduled system diagnostic before re-entering service.

Start by proceeding to Seed Storage Barn 2 and waiting until two seed pallets are prepared by the inventory manager. Once both pallets are ready, transport the first pallet to Cornfield Loading Zone and wait while a field technician offloads it. Afterward, continue to Wheatfield Access Point to deliver the second pallet and wait for the removal confirmation. Then, remain at Wheatfield Access Point for 5 minutes to allow for equipment reset before heading to Main Equipment Shed where you are to load a soil moisture sensor kit. Only if the soil moisture sensor kit is successfully loaded, proceed to Orchard Block C, and wait at the site until the sensor installation crew removes the kit. Upon completion of all drop-offs and confirmations, return directly to Seed Storage Barn 2 for the next assignment.

Start at the loading dock of Warehouse B and secure a crate containing sensitive irrigation sensors. Transport the crate without delay to Quality Control Lab A, and wait at the lab entrance until the technicians have confirmed receipt of the irrigation sensors and cleared your cargo bay. Once unloaded, proceed with the empty robot to Storage Silo Three in the northern field complex and wait there for 7 minutes, allowing the inventory team to prepare a shipment consisting of nine sealed fertilizer bags. Next, distribute these nine fertilizer bags evenly among Feedlot One, Feedlot Two, and Feedlot Three; deliver three bags to each feedlot, making a direct trip to each destination in turn and ensuring that you wait at every location until the full batch of three fertilizer bags has been fully offloaded at each spot. After all fertilizer bags have been distributed to the three feedlots, return to Warehouse B and remain at the loading dock until further scheduling instructions are issued.

instruction: Start at the south loading dock and retrieve twelve fertilizer containers labeled for field application. Evenly distribute the containers by delivering four containers each to the east greenhouse, the north wheat field storage shed, and the west maintenance barn, in that order. At each location, wait for the staff to remove all four fertilizer containers before proceeding to the next; only continue to the subsequent location once the current drop-off is fully unloaded. After the last delivery at the west maintenance barn has been confirmed and all fertilizer containers have been removed, remain at the barn for 5 minutes to allow the quality control supervisor to inspect the delivery, then return to the south loading dock to complete your task route.

instruction: Begin at the machinery workshop and collect a set of twelve replacement hydraulic filters, ensuring all filters are properly secured before departure. Move to Harvester Bay 1 and deliver four hydraulic filters, then wait until the maintenance crew has confirmed receipt and installation is underway. Next, proceed to Harvester Bay 2 and provide another four hydraulic filters, but before leaving, remain for 5 minutes to allow the maintenance crew to verify the compatibility of the delivered filters. Continue to Harvester Bay 3 with the final four filters, making sure to wait until all previous spare filters at Harvester Bay 3 have been removed before placing the new batch. Only after every filter has been delivered to its respective bay and all confirmations or wait periods have been satisfied should you return to the machinery workshop to complete the assignment.

Start by traveling to Storage Bay 2 to collect a pallet containing twenty seed bags. Distribute the seed bags among three planting zones: first, deliver seven seed bags to Field Sector Alpha, and wait until agricultural staff have removed all the bags. Then, bring another seven seed bags to Plot Bravo, waiting again until the unloading is complete. Finally, transport the remaining six seed bags to Greenhouse Annex, where you must remain until greenhouse personnel confirm receipt of every bag. After all deliveries are completed, proceed to Maintenance Dock B, wait exactly fifteen minutes for a scheduled diagnostic check, and only then return to Storage Bay 2 to complete your route.

Start at Tool Storage Bay A and collect five replacement hydraulic filters labeled 'Model X12'. Transport the filters to Maintenance Station Alpha, Maintenance Station Beta, and Maintenance Station Gamma, allocating one filter to each station in that order. After dropping off a filter and confirming its removal at both Maintenance Station Alpha and Maintenance Station Beta, proceed to Maintenance Station Delta with the two remaining filters and distribute them both there, instructing the technician to record their receipt. Wait for 7 minutes upon arrival at Maintenance Station Delta to allow technicians to complete initial filter installations, then return to Tool Storage Bay A for subsequent missions.

Begin at the central maintenance bay and pick up a single diagnostic toolkit along with eight replacement hydraulic filters. Proceed to Field Equipment Station Alpha, and deliver three hydraulic filters, waiting until the station operator removes all three filters before moving on. After this task, continue to Irrigation Hub Bravo to deliver another three hydraulic filters, but only unload them if the station has signaled it is ready for restock; if there is no readiness signal, wait for five minutes and check again before proceeding. Once both Field Equipment Station Alpha and Irrigation Hub Bravo have received their filters, bring the remaining two hydraulic filters to Storage Locker 7 in the northeast quadrant, and do not leave until a technician has transferred the filters from your payload. After all filter deliveries are complete, carry the diagnostic toolkit to Vehicle Hangar C, wait for the hangar supervisor to confirm that the toolkit is ready to be received, and finally return to the central maintenance bay to await your final inspection before ending your route.

instruction: Start at Field Maintenance Shed and collect the fuel canister labeled 'Fuel Canister Alpha.' Transport Fuel Canister Alpha to Tractor Station 1 and wait until the maintenance crew completes refueling and removes Fuel Canister Alpha from the robot. Once the canister is removed, proceed to Fertilizer Depot to retrieve three small fertilizer sacks, then make individual trips: deliver one fertilizer sack to Greenhouse A, another to Greenhouse B, and the third to Greenhouse C, pausing for two minutes at each greenhouse to allow for application setup by staff before leaving for the next destination. After all three sacks have been delivered and the wait times fulfilled, report back to Field Maintenance Shed to log completion of the supply run.

Start at the north equipment depot and collect seven containers of fertilizer. Distribute the fertilizer containers by delivering three to Orchard Plot Alpha, two to Greenhouse Beta, and two to Vineyard Gamma, making sure that Orchard Plot Alpha receives any remaining containers if the total amount is not evenly divisible. After each delivery, wait at the respective plot for 2 minutes to give agronomy staff time to unload and confirm receipt of the containers. Once all fertilizer containers have been delivered and receipt confirmed at every location, return to the north equipment depot and await further dispatch instructions.

Begin at the Crop Storage Shed and collect twelve fresh produce crates, ensuring that all crates are present before departing. Deliver five crates to the Farmers' Market Drop-off Zone, waiting until each crate is individually removed by the vendor staff; then transport four crates to the Refrigerated Processing Facility, pausing for 10 minutes after arrival to allow for temperature acclimation before the staff starts unloading, ensuring all crates are removed before proceeding. Finally, take the remaining three crates to the Quality Inspection Lab—wait for the arrival of the laboratory technician before unloading, and only depart once the last crate has been collected and the technician verbally confirms receipt. After all deliveries have been completed and verified at each location, return promptly to the Crop Storage Shed to conclude your mission.

Start at the fertilizer supply depot and retrieve a total of nine nutrient solution canisters labeled for different crop zones. Transport and deliver four canisters to the hydroponic tomato field, waiting at the field until the field supervisor confirms the canisters have been fully transferred. After the supervisor's confirmation, proceed to the high-density lettuce plot and deposit another three canisters, again waiting for the staff acknowledgment of receipt. Finally, take the remaining two canisters to the rooftop herb garden, and remain at this final location for 10 minutes to allow the irrigation system technician to integrate the canisters into the automated system before returning to the fertilizer supply depot for your next task assignment.

instruction: Prepare for the morning cycle by starting at Grain Silo A and collecting a supply hopper filled with 47 kilograms of processed wheat grain. You must then distribute the wheat across three poultry feeding stations: Feeding Station West, Feeding Station Central, and Feeding Station East. Deliver exactly 15 kilograms of grain to Feeding Station West, followed by a mandatory 6-minute pause to allow feeding to begin and the staff to inspect the dispenser. Afterward, deliver another 15 kilograms of processed wheat to Feeding Station Central, waiting for 4 minutes at that site for the station's auger to complete intake verification. Afterwards, carry another three actuators to Maintenance Bay 2, but wait twelve minutes for mechanical preparations to finish before offloading, ensuring all actuators are installed before leaving. For the final three actuators, proceed to Maintenance Bay 3, where you must wait until the previous day’s old actuators have been cleared—this clearance is expected to take up to eight minutes—before handing over the new units. Once all actuators have been delivered and technician confirmations at each bay have been received, return directly to the Main Parts Warehouse and log the actuator transfer completion in the maintenance system before ending your route.

Start at the Seed Storage Facility and collect a total of seventeen nutrient packs, verifying that all seventeen packs are loaded securely before departing. Travel first to Greenhouse A to deliver six nutrient packs, waiting until greenhouse staff confirm all six nutrient packs have been unloaded before proceeding. Next, move to Greenhouse B with another six nutrient packs; after delivery, remain on-site for 7 minutes to allow staff to start their automated nutrient dispersal system. Finally, bring the remaining five nutrient packs to Greenhouse C, but pause at the entrance until all previously stored nutrient packs at Greenhouse C have been cleared out and relocated by staff. Only once deliveries to all greenhouses have been completed, including meeting every waiting or clearance requirement, should you return to the Seed Storage Facility and await further dispatch instructions there.

Start at the Central Supply Depot and retrieve nine sealed pesticide canisters, ensuring all canisters are secured before moving on. First, travel to Orchard Zone One and unload three pesticide canisters, waiting for the zone supervisor to fully remove each canister before continuing. After completing delivery at Orchard Zone One, proceed to Orchard Zone Two and deliver another three pesticide canisters, but pause for eight minutes upon arrival to allow the air circulation system to activate before any unloading begins; only after this wait should the canisters be released and the removal process by staff allowed. Once all canisters are accepted at Orchard Zone Two, transport the final three pesticide canisters to Orchard Zone Three, remain until all canisters have been taken by the local team, and then return to the Central Supply Depot, verifying that each orchard zone receives the correct number of canisters and all prerequisite waiting periods and staff removals have been completed at each stop before returning.

Begin at the Packing Shed and retrieve a full rack containing twelve trays of ripe tomatoes along with a spare wheel for the forklift. Next, divide the twelve trays of tomatoes as evenly as possible among the Greenhouse Sorting Area, the Market Loading Dock, and the Cafeteria Kitchen; deliver four trays to each destination, but if any remainder trays exist, deliver the extra tray first to the Market Loading Dock, then to the Cafeteria Kitchen, ensuring that no location receives more than one extra tray. After dropping all tomatoes, proceed without delay to the Maintenance Bay and deliver the spare forklift wheel to the technician; only once the wheel is confirmed received, wait at the Maintenance Bay for five minutes to accommodate possible urgent requests for additional spare parts from the staff. Upon completion of this pause, return directly to the Packing Shed for further instructions, ensuring that every location receives the correct number of tomato trays and that the spare wheel is delivered before any waiting occurs in the Maintenance Bay.

Start at Warehouse Sector 5 and pick up twelve pesticide canisters, then travel to Crop Field Alpha and deliver five canisters, pausing for three minutes to allow farmhands to transfer the canisters to onsite storage. Once the transfer at Crop Field Alpha is complete, head to Vineyard Block C and deliver four more canisters; wait at Vineyard Block C until you receive a signal from the supervisor that all four canisters have been removed before proceeding further. Carry the remaining three pesticide canisters to Equipment Maintenance Bay, but if the maintenance crew is unavailable upon arrival, wait for ten minutes in standby mode before returning to Warehouse Sector 5 to complete the cycle.

Initiate the task by proceeding to the Central Storage Depot to collect a total of nine sealed fertilizer barrels. These barrels must be distributed among Irrigation Point Alpha, Irrigation Point Beta, and Irrigation Point Gamma such that each location receives three barrels—deliver the barrels sequentially, starting with Irrigation Point Alpha. After each delivery of three fertilizer barrels, remain at the respective location for two minutes to enable system calibration and acknowledgment from the local control terminal before departing for the next Irrigation Point. Once the final three barrels have been delivered to Irrigation Point Gamma and the final two-minute wait has been completed, travel to the Equipment Cleaning Station at the main service hub and remain there until a technician confirms that all fertilizer residue has been removed from your delivery apparatus, at which point the task concludes.

Equipment Cleaning Station at the main service hub

instruction: Initiate your route at Storage Hangar Zulu and collect eight sealed pouches of plant micronutrient solution. Navigate to Orchard Sector 1 and dispense three pouches to the automated fertilization terminal, waiting at the terminal until all three pouches are removed by the dispensing system. Afterwards, continue to Irrigation Hub Bravo and deposit another three pouches on the supply rack, remaining present until confirmation is received that these pouches have been taken by the hub operator. With the remaining two pouches onboard, drive to Greenhouse Laboratory Theta and deliver both directly to the lab's chemical intake station, ensuring both are fully received by laboratory staff before departing. After all deliveries are completed and each site has acknowledged receipt, wait precisely 10 minutes at Greenhouse Laboratory Theta to allow for system calibration, after which you will return to Storage Hangar Zulu to finalize your cycle.

instruction: Start at the Main Seed Vault and pick up four marked seed crates required for distribution. Proceed first to Greenhouse A and deliver one seed crate, then wait until the greenhouse technician signals that the crate has been successfully unloaded. Afterward, continue to Irrigation Control Center where you must deliver two seed crates; remain on site until both crates have been fully removed and the irrigation supervisor provides confirmation. Before proceeding to the final delivery, wait at the Irrigation Control Center for 90 seconds to allow for inventory update synchronization. After the wait, travel to the South Field Trial Plot and deliver the remaining seed crate. Ensure that the trial plot manager has acknowledged receipt of the seed crate before returning to the Main Seed Vault to complete the route.

Begin at Seed Storage Bay and collect the crate labeled 'Hybrid Wheat Seeds.' Transport Hybrid Wheat Seeds to Sowing Platform Alpha and remain onsite until the platform operator confirms removal of the crate. Following successful drop-off, wait for three minutes to allow calibration of sowing machinery before retrieving four empty collection baskets from Platform Alpha. Next, distribute the baskets: deliver two baskets to Harvest Dock East, one to Sorting Zone Delta, and one to Crop Research Station; ensure that you pause at Harvest Dock East for one minute during each drop-off to facilitate staff handover before departing to subsequent locations. After all baskets are delivered and corresponding pauses completed, return to Seed Storage Bay to log the full task sequence and standby for further instructions.

Start your route at the Maintenance Bay and collect a set of fifteen engine filters, verifying that all filters are secure before departure. Visit Tractor Shed 1 first, deliver five filters, and remain on site until a mechanic removes each filter from your payload, ensuring this occurs before moving on. Once the filters have been successfully transferred at Tractor Shed 1, proceed to Tractor Shed 2, where you will hand off another five engine filters; wait for confirmation from the maintenance crew that they have received and logged every filter before continuing. Take the final five filters to Tractor Shed 3, and only after the on-site engineer confirms all filters are received and removed should you initiate a mandatory downtime period of ten minutes for recalibration. Following this waiting period, return to the Maintenance Bay to complete the mission, making certain you do not skip any location or waiting steps along the route—even if a Tractor Shed is temporarily unattended, remain at that location until the required personnel arrive for the transfer.

Begin at the Seed Vault and pick up a pallet containing twenty-seven seed trays for distribution to various planting zones. Transport an initial batch of nine seed trays to Planting Zone Alpha, and stay until field staff confirm all nine trays have been removed from the robot for setup. Next, head to Planting Zone Beta with another nine seed trays, but wait outside the gate for five minutes to allow irrigation equipment to clear the unloading area before you proceed to offload the trays, ensuring staff have retrieved all of them before continuing. For the remaining nine seed trays, deliver them to Planting Zone Gamma, and remain on-site until you receive confirmation that the planting beds in Zone Gamma are fully prepared, a process that should not exceed seven minutes. After all twenty-seven seed trays have been distributed evenly across the three planting zones and staff confirmations at each zone have been received, return to the Seed Vault to await further instructions.

Begin at the Tool Storage Facility and collect eight orange safety cones, confirming that all cones are securely fastened before departure. Next, travel to Loading Dock 7 and deliver three orange safety cones, waiting on site until the dock supervisor has removed all three cones from the carrier. Once the cones are fully unloaded, continue to Warehouse Entrance B where you will distribute another three orange safety cones; remain at Warehouse Entrance B until the facility attendant has taken all three cones and confirmed clearance. Transport the remaining two orange safety cones to the North Perimeter Gate, making sure not to leave the area until both cones have been retrieved by security staff. Once all eight cones have been successfully delivered and acknowledgments received at each location, proceed directly to the Charging Station Hub, pause your route there for 5 minutes to allow for battery diagnostics, and only afterward return to the Tool Storage Facility to finalize the task.

Begin at the Parts Storage Warehouse and secure eight hydraulic pump assemblies for delivery. Transport three hydraulic pump assemblies to the Vehicle Maintenance Bay, and wait until the mechanics there have fully removed all three hydraulic pump assemblies from the loading compartment. After unload confirmation, drive to the Eastern Loading Dock and deliver another three hydraulic pump assemblies, pausing at the site for four minutes to allow the incoming crew to verify and safely store the delivered equipment. Once the waiting period at the Eastern Loading Dock concludes, proceed with the final two hydraulic pump assemblies to the Agricultural Equipment Shed. Do not attempt drop-off at the Agricultural Equipment Shed until the shed supervisor has marked that their storage rack has enough space available for the hydraulic pump assemblies; only after this clearance is granted should you complete the delivery and return directly to the Parts Storage Warehouse for your next assignment.

object.description: storage rack space for hydraulic pump assemblies

instruction: Start your route at Storage Facility B and pick up nine sealed chemical drums. Deliver three drums to Processing Plant South first, waiting at the unloading area for six minutes to allow chemical safety checks before departing. Take the next three drums to Manufacturing Bay Seven, and after dropping them off, wait for a notification from plant staff confirming successful integration of the drums into the production line. Transport the final three drums to Laboratory Annex One, but before releasing them, you must wait for the lab manager to prepare the secure containment area—do not leave the site until this step is explicitly confirmed. After all drums are delivered and all waiting periods or confirmations at each destination are completed, immediately return to Storage Facility B and remain on standby for five minutes to await any emergency retrieval instructions that may be issued.

object.description: secure containment area prepared by lab manager

instruction: Start at Maintenance Bay One and collect a total of thirteen equipment toolkits intended for deployment across the field zones. Proceed to Field Zone Delta first and deliver five toolkits, waiting for the maintenance supervisor to signal that the entire shipment has been unloaded and logged. Afterward, travel to Field Zone Echo and offload four toolkits; remain at the unloading point for three minutes while safety inspectors complete a mandatory on-site check before you receive a go-ahead to leave. Next, transport the final four toolkits to Field Zone Foxtrot, and submit these toolkits only after the zone manager confirms Foxtrot is ready to receive new tools, which may require waiting until earlier deliveries to Delta and Echo are officially registered. If, during the route, you encounter locked entrances or blocked access at any zone, immediately return any undelivered toolkits to Maintenance Bay One before concluding your mission, ensuring each field zone receives its allocated quantity barring access restrictions.

Start at the Chemical Storage Area and collect nine sealed boxes of crop protection reagents. Distribute these boxes in the following manner: first, deliver three boxes to the West Soybean Plot Shed, waiting at the shed until the field technician has finished loading the reagent sprayers before leaving. After completion at the West Soybean Plot Shed, proceed to the Central Equipment Hub and transfer another three boxes, but do not depart until two minutes have passed, allowing the hub operators to perform safety checks on the chemical manifest. Next, carry two boxes to the South Cornfield Workshop, making sure you wait until a supervisor confirms receipt and proper storage of the boxes. For the last remaining box, bring it to the North Grain Silo Annex; before drop-off, ensure a staff member at the annex has completed the prior inventory check, after which you may leave the box. Once all deliveries are successfully completed and confirmed at each site, return immediately to the Chemical Storage Area to await further instructions.

instruction: Begin at Grain Storage Silo 1 and collect a shipment of fifteen labeled seed bags and a case of calibration weights used for machinery settings. Your goal is to distribute the fifteen seed bags equally among the East Corn Plot, South Wheat Plot, and the North Research Field: deliver five seed bags to each plot, but if there are any leftover bags, allocate the first extra bag to the North Research Field and the next to the East Corn Plot, ensuring no plot receives more than one extra. After finishing all seed deliveries, proceed immediately to the Central Equipment Depot and transfer the case of calibration weights to the instrumentation technician, waiting until the technician confirms receipt before proceeding. Once the transfer is acknowledged, remain at the Central Equipment Depot for 6 minutes to provide logistical support in case of urgent requests for spare equipment, and only after this waiting period has elapsed, return to Grain Storage Silo 1 to await subsequent assignments.

Start at the grain storage facility and load a shipment of twenty fertilizer drums onto your payload platform. Proceed first to Field Alpha to offload eight fertilizer drums, ensuring each drum is accounted for before you leave. Once Field Alpha has received its allocation, move on to Field Beta and transfer another seven fertilizer drums; after placing these drums, wait at Field Beta for five full minutes to allow field staff to prepare the application systems. Only after this waiting period, head to Field Gamma with the remaining five fertilizer drums, and distribute them there. Ensure all drums at each field have been confirmed as delivered before proceeding to the next location. After the last delivery at Field Gamma, return promptly to the grain storage facility and await further deployment instructions.

Begin your operation by moving to the Seed Supply Warehouse to acquire a single crate containing 24 standard greenhouse starter trays. Next, proceed to Greenhouse 1 and deliver 7 starter trays, awaiting confirmation from the greenhouse supervisor that all trays have been unloaded before continuing. After this, transfer 8 starter trays to Greenhouse 2; upon arrival, wait for precisely five minutes to allow on-site staff to stage the trays for planting, only then proceed onward. The remaining 9 starter trays must be taken to Greenhouse 3, but do not deposit them until the automated irrigation system confirms readiness for seeding, which may require a wait on location. Once the full delivery is complete and final confirmation is received at Greenhouse 3, return directly to the Seed Supply Warehouse, placing the empty crate onto the designated return shelf for inventory tracking, ensuring the cycle is ready for the next sequence of greenhouse tray deliveries.

object.description: crate containing standard greenhouse starter trays
automated irrigation system readiness for seeding

instruction: Begin at the North Orchard Storage Shed and load twelve boxes of freshly harvested apples. Your first stop is Market Depot C, where you must deliver five boxes and wait for the produce inspector to confirm inventory before proceeding. Next, transport four boxes to the Juice Processing Center, but you must remain at the facility for four minutes to allow quality assessment before the boxes can be unloaded. Deliver the remaining three boxes to the School Cafeteria Receiving Dock, and ensure the cafeteria manager is present to authorize the receipt before departing. Once all apple boxes have been distributed and every required confirmation or waiting interval is complete, return directly to the North Orchard Storage Shed and wait there for six minutes in case of any last-minute shipping updates or additional dispatch requests from farm management.

Begin your route at the Seed Vault Warehouse and retrieve twelve sealed containers of premium wheat seeds. Evenly distribute the containers among the North Test Plot, the Central Planter Field, and the East Ridge Demonstration Plots, allocating four containers to each site. For the Central Planter Field, after you arrive, wait for the field manager to confirm the arrival by scanning each container before proceeding; only after the scan is complete should you move on. At the East Ridge Demonstration Plots, leave the containers but also remain on-site for five minutes to allow the research team to review the seed integrity. Continue by collecting three empty soil sample tubes from the East Ridge site and transport all three to the Soil Analysis Laboratory at the Main Facility, but do not begin this segment until the seed delivery period at the East Ridge is fully concluded. After the laboratory staff confirms removal of all soil tubes, navigate back to the Seed Vault Warehouse to indicate task completion.
