instruction: Begin by collecting twenty pesticide canisters from Supply Zone Delta, ensuring all canisters are properly sealed and accounted for. Transport the entire batch to Field Sector East, and once on site, distribute the pesticide canisters among Spraying Drone Pad A, Spraying Drone Pad B, and Spraying Drone Pad C by allocating six canisters to each pad and delivering the two remaining canisters to Spraying Drone Pad C to account for the irregularity in distribution. At each pad, wait until ground crews confirm they have prepared the drones with the received canisters before proceeding to the next delivery location. After all canisters have been distributed and confirmed at every pad, stay at Spraying Drone Pad C for a period of five minutes to allow for system diagnostics to be performed on the robotic delivery system before returning to Supply Zone Delta to complete your assignment.

Starting at Maintenance Bay Gamma, pick up eight sensor calibration kits and head to Drone Hangar 1, but do not deliver the calibration kits until all faulty drone reports are received from Hangar Control. Once the reports are confirmed, deliver three calibration kits to Drone Hangar 1, wait exactly two minutes for technicians to install them, and then proceed to Drone Hangar 2 with three more calibration kits, pausing for another two minutes to allow further installations. Afterward, transport the remaining two calibration kits to Drone Hangar 3. Only after the last set of calibration kits are delivered and Hangar 3 technicians confirm receipt, go to Refuse Disposal Zone Zeta, where you must remain for five minutes to complete decontamination procedures. Finally, return to Maintenance Bay Gamma, but ensure the return trip only commences after decontamination is fully finished and clearance is granted by Zone Zeta staff.

object.description: faulty drone reports from Hangar Control

instruction: Begin at Storage Facility Delta and pick up six sealed fertilizer containers and four pesticide sprayers, then proceed directly to Greenhouse 12. Wait for the greenhouse manager to confirm that all four pesticide sprayers are fully prepared and loaded onto the system before continuing. Next, evenly distribute the six fertilizer containers between Crop Field Alpha, Orchard Bravo, and Vegetable Plot Charlie, such that Crop Field Alpha and Orchard Bravo each receive two fertilizer containers, while Vegetable Plot Charlie receives the remaining two. At each destination, wait until the local supervisor removes the correct number of fertilizer containers from the robot before moving on to the next field. After all fertilizer and sprayers have been delivered, proceed to Equipment Wash Station Omega and remain there for seven minutes to complete the cleaning cycle, ensuring no return to Storage Facility Delta until the wash cycle is finished and the station attendant provides explicit release clearance.

Start at the Central Storage Depot and collect a total of sixteen fertilizer pallets. Allocate these pallets among the South Crop Field Loading Dock, the Northwest Vine Nursery, and the East Orchard Entrance, distributing five pallets at both the South Crop Field and Northeast Vine Nursery, and the remaining six pallets at the East Orchard Entrance to account for the division remainder. Once you have delivered pallets at the South Crop Field Loading Dock, wait on-site for two minutes to allow the dock foreman to sign off on the delivery; do not leave until this time elapses. After the final drop-off at the East Orchard Entrance, immediately proceed to the Equipment Sanitization Bay and remain there until all delivery containers from your previous payloads are collected and sanitized, which will be confirmed by the sanitation crew. Only once sanitization is complete should you return to the Central Storage Depot to await your next assignment.

Begin your mission at Supply Dock Echo by picking up five crates of precision irrigation nozzles after confirming they are ready for transport. Proceed immediately to Crop Field Gamma and unload two crates at the maintenance outpost, then stay until both crates are collected by the field technician. Once the technician has retrieved the nozzles, take the next two crates to Vineyard West Equipment Shed, pausing here for exactly five minutes before unloading to give the shed team time to prepare the storage rack. After the five-minute wait, hand over both crates and verify their removal by the equipment crew. Finally, transport the remaining single crate to Greenhouse Omega, but do not deliver it until all prior crate deliveries have been acknowledged; upon confirmation, wait for the greenhouse engineer to remove the last crate, then return directly to Supply Dock Echo for stand-down instructions.

instruction.location: maintenance outpost at Crop Field Gamma

instruction: Begin at the Field Maintenance Garage and pick up four water filtration modules. Transport one module to each of the following: the Northwest Irrigation Control Hub, the Central Pumping Station, and the South Canal Monitoring Post, ensuring that each location receives exactly one module. The fourth filtration module should be delivered to the East Reservoir Outflow after all previous modules have been dropped off. Upon arrival at each location, wait until the maintenance crew signals that the module is ready for installation before proceeding to the next destination. Once the last filtration module has been delivered to the East Reservoir Outflow and the readiness confirmed, wait at the outflow site for five minutes to monitor for emergency technician requests before returning directly to the Field Maintenance Garage.

Begin by proceeding to the Fertilizer Depot and retrieve three sealed fertilizer barrels marked 'Nutrient Plus Formula.' Next, transport all three barrels to Field Zone A and wait at the unloading area until the field technician confirms removal of the first barrel. Immediately after the first barrel is accepted at Field Zone A, deliver the second barrel to Field Zone B, but pause for four minutes at Field Zone B to allow integration into the soil enrichment system before moving on. The third barrel must then be taken to Field Zone C; however, only drop off this last barrel after Field Zone B has completed its four-minute integration pause. Once all barrels are distributed to their respective fields and the time-gating at Field Zone B is fulfilled, return to the Fertilizer Depot to notify staff that the fertilizer delivery circuit has been completed, and remain there for further allocation tasks.

instruction: Begin at Loading Dock 5 and collect a shipment consisting of seven irrigation drone batteries and five hydraulic pump filters, ensuring both sets of payloads are securely stowed. Proceed first to Maintenance Bay Aurora, where you must wait until the technician confirms all five hydraulic pump filters have been removed from the robot. Once the removal is complete, deliver the seven irrigation drone batteries evenly across three drop points: place two batteries at Drone Launch Pad X-ray, three batteries at Drone Hub Echo, and the remaining two batteries at Drone Supply Depot Sierra, in that sequence. At each location, pause for exactly ninety seconds following delivery to allow for inspection and sign-off by authorized staff before advancing to the next site. After distributing the batteries and completing all waiting periods, report immediately to Secure Storage Vault Theta and remain there until the vault supervisor certifies that the payload bay is empty and clean, which may take several minutes; only upon receiving this clearance should you return to Loading Dock 5 to complete your assignment.

object.description: vault supervisor payload bay empty and clean certification

instruction: Start at Assembly Line Dock A, where you must load eight manufacturing toolkits labeled for redistribution. Your objective is to deliver these toolkits to three locations: Quality Control Lab, Finished Products Warehouse, and the Central Maintenance Bay. Allocate three toolkits to the Quality Control Lab, three to the Finished Products Warehouse, and the remaining two to the Central Maintenance Bay, making sure that no location receives more than its assigned amount. For each delivery, wait until the receiving supervisor at each location has removed all toolkits before moving to the next destination. Once all toolkits have been handed over, proceed to the Battery Charging Station and wait for 5 minutes to allow diagnostic systems to run safety checks on your power supply before returning to Assembly Line Dock A to complete the route.

Start your route at Supply Depot Gamma by collecting a total of nine sealed nutrient bins, verifying that all bins are accounted for before proceeding. Make your way to Hydroponics Greenhouse West and deliver three nutrient bins; after the delivery, wait for five minutes to ensure greenhouse staff have emptied the bins and confirmed the contents, as this is necessary before any further action. Once you receive confirmation from the staff at Hydroponics Greenhouse West, continue to Seedling Nursery Delta with another three nutrient bins, and wait at Nursery Delta until you receive an all-clear signal indicating all bins have been transferred into storage. With the remaining three nutrient bins, proceed to Fertilizer Processing Plant Omega and wait on site for two minutes, even if personnel are present immediately, to allow for safety checks before leaving. Only after all nine bins have been delivered and each respective waiting period is fulfilled should you return to Supply Depot Gamma to finalize your delivery cycle.

Begin your mission at Storage Depot Alpha and load eleven sealed nutrient crates earmarked for three separate greenhouse facilities: Greenhouse North, Greenhouse Central, and Greenhouse South. First, transport five nutrient crates to Greenhouse North, offload them, and wait until the staff at Greenhouse North confirm that their temperature sensors have stabilized after receiving the delivery, which may require a brief delay. Once cleared, proceed to Greenhouse Central, deliver four crates, and remain on-site for two minutes to allow environmental systems to adjust to the inventory change. The final two crates must be taken to Greenhouse South, but deliver these only if all previous deliveries to Greenhouse North and Greenhouse Central have been successfully completed and acknowledged by their respective facility managers; otherwise, return any undelivered crates directly to Storage Depot Alpha. After all greenhouse facilities have received their allocated portions and proper confirmations are obtained, end the mission at Storage Depot Alpha.

Begin at Charging Station 4 and ensure your battery is fully topped up, then collect twelve calibration sensor kits from Maintenance Bay A. Your task is to distribute these sensor kits across three designated test plots: Test Plot Red, Test Plot Blue, and Test Plot Yellow. First, take five calibration sensor kits to Test Plot Red and wait at Test Plot Red until their technical supervisor verifies the correct installation of each kit—a process that might take several minutes and must be completed before you proceed. Once approval is received, move to Test Plot Blue and deliver four calibration sensor kits; after you have placed the kits, remain on-site for exactly four minutes to ensure that their server confirms full remote connectivity. Following this interval, proceed to Test Plot Yellow with the remaining three sensor kits and offload them only if both previous deliveries to Test Plot Red and Test Plot Blue have been fully acknowledged by their on-site leads. If at any point a delivery confirmation is declined or cannot be obtained, return all remaining undelivered sensor kits directly to Maintenance Bay A instead of proceeding. After successful distribution and acknowledgment at all test plots, go to Charging Station 4 and await the next dispatch.

Begin at Machinery Depot and wait until the operator signals that the three maintenance supply crates are fully prepared for pickup. Once the crates are ready, deliver the first crate to Irrigation Pump Station 1 and wait while the maintenance crew unloads it; after the crate has been removed, proceed immediately to Solar Panel Field Dock to drop off the second crate and remain there until the field technician completes the removal. Next, transfer the final crate to Greenhouse Entry Gate, and after it has been offloaded, wait an additional 10 minutes at Greenhouse Entry Gate to accommodate equipment sanitation protocols. Only after this waiting period should you navigate to Spare Parts Shed to collect a diagnostics scanner; if the diagnostics scanner is present and successfully loaded, continue to Livestock Monitoring Tower, where you must remain until the scanner has been received and installation confirmed by the livestock technician. Conclude the route by returning to Machinery Depot for debrief and storage.

Begin your operation at Equipment Garage Central, where you must retrieve a shipment of nine heavy-duty tiller blades. Transport all nine tiller blades to Machining Station Alpha and remain at the designated offloading point until the blades have been inspected and accepted by the machining supervisor. Once this initial delivery is confirmed complete, proceed to Parts Storage Depot 2 to pick up a batch of twelve precision bearings. Your next objective is to distribute the twelve precision bearings evenly across three different assembly lines: Assembly Line Greenhouse, Assembly Line Orchard, and Assembly Line Vineyard. For each assembly line, deliver four precision bearings; after each delivery, wait at the respective assembly line until all bearings have been successfully transferred to the line's inventory racks, and ensure that this process is completed at each location before moving to the next. After all assembly lines have received their designated bearings, return to Equipment Garage Central and wait for a period of five minutes before taking further action, allowing maintenance staff to inspect your cargo bay for residual parts or safety concerns.

Gather twelve maintenance toolkits from Workshop Bay Alpha, making sure each toolkit is fully stocked and logged before departure. Once collected, transport all toolkits to Equipment Shed Bravo and distribute them by placing four toolkits each at Robot Service Station 1, Robot Service Station 2, and Robot Service Station 3; if any station is undergoing repair and unavailable upon arrival, hold its toolkit allocation in Equipment Shed Bravo until the station becomes accessible, and only deliver to that station once repairs are confirmed completed. At every station, wait until the local technician signals that the delivered toolkits are unpacked and ready for use, then move on to the next station or return to Equipment Shed Bravo if awaiting access. Once all twelve toolkits have been placed and acknowledged at their respective destinations, remain at Equipment Shed Bravo for a three-minute interval to facilitate an inventory reconciliation process before returning to Workshop Bay Alpha to close out the maintenance delivery route.

Collect fifteen harvest sensor units from Storage Facility Gamma, verifying that the calibration check for each unit has passed prior to departure. Deliver the sensor units to Orchard Block East, Vineyard Strip North, and Grain Plot West by allocating five sensor units to each field location; if there are any leftover sensor units due to an unexpected calibration failure, take any remaining sensors to Storage Facility Delta for further inspection. For each delivery at the field locations, wait in place until the on-site installation crew confirms the removal and readiness of the deployed sensor units before proceeding to the next location. Once all sensor units are either distributed or returned for inspection, pause at Grain Plot West for five minutes to monitor any immediate deployment issues before navigating back to Storage Facility Gamma to await your next allocation task.

Start your route at Seed Warehouse 5, where you will collect a total of eleven labeled fertilizer canisters intended for redistribution across several crop beds. Distribute the fertilizer canisters as evenly as possible by delivering four canisters to Vegetable Plot Alpha, four canisters to Fruit Orchard Beta, and the remaining three canisters to Herb Section Gamma, specifically ensuring that each location receives its assigned number before moving to the next. After completing the delivery at each crop area, wait for two minutes to allow the respective field managers to remove the fertilizer canisters and confirm successful receipt. If removal is not acknowledged within the two-minute interval at any site, repeat the waiting period up to two times before proceeding. Once all canisters have been delivered and acknowledged, make your way to the Central Maintenance Bay and remain stationed there for ten minutes in case any urgent redistribution requests arise due to unexpected demand from the field managers.

Begin at Docking Station 5 and verify that a shipment consisting of twenty sensor calibration modules is prepared for transport. Divide these modules among the following locations: deliver seven modules to the Quality Assurance Lab, eight modules to the Field Testing Zone, and the remaining five modules to the Remote Monitoring Hut. Transport the first seven modules to the Quality Assurance Lab, then wait until a technician confirms the modules have been removed before proceeding. After the Quality Assurance delivery is complete, transfer the next eight modules to the Field Testing Zone; following arrival, remain for three minutes to give field engineers time to unload and log the modules. Once this unloading period has elapsed, proceed to the Remote Monitoring Hut with the final five modules and wait until the on-site specialist acknowledges full receipt and removal. Only after all deliveries are completed and confirmed at every location, return directly to Docking Station 5 and wait for two minutes to allow the logistics supervisor to sign off your delivery manifest.

Begin your operation at the Parts Storage Facility where you will retrieve a batch of fifteen high-capacity spare batteries labeled for field equipment maintenance. Navigate first to Tractor Depot A to deliver six spare batteries, waiting until the maintenance supervisor has removed all six batteries before advancing. After confirmation of battery pickup at Tractor Depot A, proceed to Irrigation Pump Station 3 and offload five of the remaining batteries, staying on site until the pump technician has collected all five spare batteries. With the last four batteries, continue to Drone Charging Area 2; after arrival, wait for exactly three minutes to give the drone technicians adequate time for battery removal, but if any batteries are left after this period, extend the waiting time by an additional three minutes only once. If all batteries have still not been collected, log the discrepancy before departing. Once every location has received and acknowledged its assigned batch of batteries, transport any empty containers back to the Parts Storage Facility, and then proceed directly to the Clean Room for a mandatory five-minute decontamination hold before concluding your assignment.

instruction: Commence your mission at the Central Agro Supply Warehouse, ensuring that a collection of twelve sealed soil nutrient cartridges is ready for distribution. Allocate four cartridges to Greenhouse Alpha, another four cartridges to Crop Field Beta, and the remaining four cartridges to Vineyard Delta. First, deliver four cartridges to Greenhouse Alpha, then remain there until the greenhouse manager has acknowledged and removed the delivered cartridges. Only after confirmation at Greenhouse Alpha should you proceed to Crop Field Beta, where you must wait for two minutes upon arrival to allow the field crew to finish preparations before they can accept and remove the next four cartridges. When the transfer at Crop Field Beta is complete, bring the last four cartridges to Vineyard Delta, and remain on site until the vineyard technician explicitly signals that all cartridges have been received and removed. After successful delivery and confirmation at all three locations, immediately return to the Central Agro Supply Warehouse and hold position for three minutes to await inspection and sign-off by the distribution supervisor before concluding your route.

Start your route at the North Equipment Garage and verify that six pallets of biodegradable planting trays are fully prepared for outbound transfer. Divide these six pallets so that two pallets are delivered to Seeding Line A, another two to Fertilizer Shed South, and the final two to Orchard Entry Gate. Begin by moving the first two pallets to Seeding Line A, where you must wait until the trays are completely removed by the processing team. After confirmation of removal at Seeding Line A, proceed directly to Fertilizer Shed South with the next two pallets, remaining onsite until the fertilizer technician has finished unloading. Once you receive an unload signal at Fertilizer Shed South, wait an extra five minutes to allow the technician to perform a quality inspection on the delivered trays. Next, transport the last two pallets to Orchard Entry Gate; upon arrival, pause your operation for three minutes before unloading to ensure that the orchard staff are assembled and ready. Only after the waiting period should you allow the removal of trays, and once offloading is complete, return immediately to North Equipment Garage to provide a status update to dispatch staff and to recharge for the next operational cycle.

Start at the Grain Storage Facility and pick up a set of nine pest monitoring sensors packaged for deployment. Proceed to the North Wheat Field first and install three pest monitoring sensors, waiting until the field technician at North Wheat Field finishes calibrating each before moving on. Next, drive over to South Corn Plot and deliver another three pest monitoring sensors, and again, wait for the on-site agronomist to complete a check of the sensors' placement before proceeding. Finally, travel to Vineyard East and deploy the remaining three pest monitoring sensors, ensuring that after all sensors have been placed you remain at Vineyard East for ten minutes to provide support in case any calibration issues arise, only heading back to the Grain Storage Facility once this support interval expires.

object.description: pest monitoring sensor packaged for deployment

instruction: Begin at the Central Machine Depot and collect a diagnostic toolkit, two replacement power cells, and four sensor calibration pods. Head first to Wind Turbine Station Alpha and deliver one power cell and one calibration pod; wait on-site until the maintenance supervisor has removed both items, then after a five-minute interval to allow system rebooting, travel to Solar Array Field Bravo. At Solar Array Field Bravo, distribute two calibration pods and the second power cell, ensuring that each item is received individually by the designated technician. Once all deliveries at this site are confirmed, proceed to Geothermal Substation Charlie with the remaining diagnostic toolkit and final calibration pod, but only unload these items once verification from substation personnel is provided. After these steps are complete, remain at Geothermal Substation Charlie for ten minutes to monitor system stability, and finally return to the Central Machine Depot for end-of-mission checks.

Begin at the Maintenance Hub by confirming that two replacement hydraulic actuators are ready for pickup. Once confirmation is received, transport the first actuator to Harvester Bay 3 and wait five minutes while the harbor crew inspects and installs the actuator. When installation is complete, proceed to Silo Access Point 2 with the second actuator, but deliver it only if the Silo Engineer is present; if the Silo Engineer is not found, wait for up to fifteen minutes for their arrival before returning the actuator to the Maintenance Hub for safekeeping. Regardless of delivery outcome at Silo Access Point 2, after either successful handover or the waiting period, navigate to the Charging Station Alpha and remain docked there for twenty minutes of system diagnostics before accepting new assignments.

Start at Storage Depot A and retrieve nine sealed fertilizer bags from the designated pallet. Distribute the fertilizer bags so that three are delivered to Field Station North, two to Field Station East, and the remaining four to Field Station South, explicitly ensuring that if all four bags cannot be accepted at Field Station South, redirect any excess to the Adjacent Overflow Shed before progressing. For each delivery, remain at the respective field station until the field supervisor confirms that the current batch has been safely unloaded. After every batch delivery is completed, pause for ninety seconds at each drop-off location to allow safety checks before proceeding to the next station. Only after delivery of all nine fertilizer bags and completion of the required waiting periods at each site, return to Storage Depot A for post-task inspection.

Start at the Central Warehouse and load six bags of slow-release fertilizer. Evenly distribute these by first taking two bags to Orchard Access Point A, then proceed to Vineyard Loading Dock to deliver another two bags, and finally take the remaining two to the Southern Vegetable Plot shed; if any single location is temporarily unattended and cannot accept its allocation, wait at that site for three minutes before retrying the delivery. After all six bags have been delivered to their designated locations and receipt is confirmed with each local supervisor, return to the Central Warehouse and remain on standby for the next task assignment.

Begin at the Grain Elevator Control Room and collect a batch of 11 sample jars from the central sorting table, then transport the whole set to the Loading Dock B. At the dock, evenly allocate the sample jars among the three quality assessment labs: deliver 4 jars to Lab A in the east processing wing, 4 jars to Lab B in the main operations annex, and the remaining 3 jars to Lab C located adjacent to storage silo 7, ensuring that each lab receives their full share before proceeding to the next. Once the last samples have been dropped off in Lab C, wait at the lab's entryway for 7 minutes in case of urgent requests or return samples. When the waiting period is over, head directly to the supervisor's office inside the administration building to report task completion before taking on new duties.

instruction: Begin your route at Workshop Delta and pick up six sealed coolant canisters once the loading crew signals that all canisters are secured. Head to Generator Station A and unload two coolant canisters, but remain at the loading area until both canisters are collected by the generator technician. After confirmation of the pickup, proceed to Pump House Beta with the next two canisters, and upon arrival, wait for three minutes before unloading as the maintenance team sets up their receiving platform; ensure both canisters are handed over and removed by the staff. The final two coolant canisters are to be transported to Substation Zeta, where you must first wait until the substation supervisor is present to authorize the transfer before unloading. Once all six coolant canisters have been delivered and removed from the robot, return to Workshop Delta for mission debriefing.

Travel to Warehouse 2 and collect a case containing 23 soil sample vials, verifying readiness before proceeding. Then, allocate the vials by first transporting and delivering eight vials to the Field Testing Tent, confirming that the field technician has removed the vials before leaving. Next, head to Laboratory Annex and deliver another eight vials; again, do not depart until the lab technician has retrieved the delivery. Transfer the remaining seven vials to the Storage Vault, and wait for the vault operator to finish unloading all vials. Once every destination has received its assigned vials, remain at the Storage Vault for three minutes to allow security staff to conduct a routine contents check before you proceed to Charging Station C for recharge preparations.

Begin at Main Parts Depot and retrieve six engine filter cartridges for routine tractor maintenance. Proceed first to Tractor Barn Alpha and deliver two cartridges to Mechanic Bay 1, waiting until both cartridges have been acknowledged and removed by the maintenance crew. Afterwards, move to Tractor Barn Beta and deposit another two cartridges at Mechanic Bay 2, remaining in position until all filters are collected by the technicians there. Once these steps are completed, drive to Tractor Barn Gamma with the final two cartridges and transfer them to Mechanic Bay 3, again waiting until the maintenance personnel at Gamma confirm full receipt. After all cartridges have been distributed and verified as removed from the robot, remain at Tractor Barn Gamma for a period of five minutes to allow for post-delivery processing, and only after this interval return to Main Parts Depot to complete your operational round.

Once the mandated waiting period has lapsed, move the boxes into the workshop and stay until workshop staff removes both boxes and signals task completion, after which you may return to the warehouse loading dock and stand by for subsequent assignments.

instruction: Begin at the grain storage facility and pick up nine sealed grain sample boxes. Transport three grain sample boxes to Laboratory A, and wait there for lab staff to collect all three before proceeding. Next, deliver another three grain sample boxes to Laboratory B, once again waiting until lab personnel have fully unloaded them. Take the remaining three grain sample boxes to Laboratory C and stay until all the samples have been removed. After completing deliveries to all three laboratories and confirming that every grain sample box has been received, travel to the equipment wash station and wait for five minutes to allow for mandatory cleaning procedures before returning to the grain storage facility.

Start at the Loading Dock and collect a total of nineteen harvested apple crates. Deliver these crates to three destinations by allocating six crates to Cold Storage Room A, seven crates to Packing Station 2, and six crates to the Quality Inspection Area; since all destinations are in different parts of the facility, ensure each location receives the correct amount and no crates are left behind. For each stop, wait at the delivery zone until all crates designated for that location have been fully unloaded before departing. After the final delivery at the Quality Inspection Area, proceed directly to the Sanitation Bay, and remain there for 10 minutes to complete mandatory decontamination procedures before returning to the Loading Dock for your next assignment.

Begin at the central loading bay and pick up seven sealed sample containers of harvested grain. Proceed to Grain Silo A and transfer two sealed sample containers, waiting until the storage supervisor removes both containers before continuing. Next, go to Quality Control Lab 1 and deliver three more sealed sample containers, ensuring that the laboratory technician confirms receipt and storage of all three. Once the Quality Control Lab transfer is complete, proceed to Shipping Dock C with the final two sealed sample containers; after arrival, wait for five minutes to allow the export team to inspect and remove the containers. Only after inspections are complete at Shipping Dock C, return to the central loading bay and set the robot to standby for further assignments.

instruction: Start at the maintenance bay adjacent to Storage Hangar 2 and collect five diagnostic toolkits. Head first to Greenhouse Alpha and deliver two toolkits to the horticulture crew, waiting at Greenhouse Alpha until both toolkits have been removed from your payload section. Afterwards, continue to Hydroponic Control Shed and supply one diagnostic toolkit for equipment calibration, but remain at the shed for precisely three minutes after the toolkit is unloaded to allow for system initialization. Once the three-minute wait at Hydroponic Control Shed concludes, move to Field Operations Hut and hand over one toolkit, but only proceed if the previous three-minute waiting period has elapsed. Deliver the final diagnostic toolkit to the Central Weather Station, ensuring that all toolkits have reached their destinations before returning to Storage Hangar 2, where you must remain stationary for five minutes prior to receiving subsequent dispatch commands.

instruction: Begin at Charging Station 3 and collect twelve sealed fertilizer sacks from Supply Depot South. Deliver three sacks each to Field Zone East, Field Zone West, and Field Zone North, confirming at each site that the fertilizer sacks have been removed before proceeding. With the remaining three sacks, proceed to Field Zone Central, and after delivering these final sacks, wait at Field Zone Central for exactly 5 minutes to allow for soil moisture assessment before returning directly to Charging Station 3 for recharge.

Start at the Packaging Zone, collect a total of 17 crates of harvested tomatoes, and prepare to distribute them to three different cold storage rooms—Cold Storage A, Cold Storage B, and Cold Storage C. Allocate 6 crates to Cold Storage A, 6 crates to Cold Storage B, and deliver the remaining 5 crates to Cold Storage C, ensuring each trip delivers crates exclusively to a single storage room per run. After unloading at any cold storage room, wait three minutes for the refrigeration staff to verify and acknowledge receipt of that shipment before proceeding with the next batch; repeat these collection and delivery cycles until all 17 crates are fully distributed as specified. Once all deliveries and verifications are completed, navigate to the Maintenance Corner in the Utility Wing and await further loading instructions near Spare Part Locker 4.

instruction.location: Maintenance Corner in the Utility Wing

instruction: Begin at the Seed Warehouse and collect a shipment consisting of fourteen sealed grain bags. Transport these grain bags to the Grain Distribution Dock and wait for the dock supervisor to prepare the payload for distribution. Once the shipment is ready, divide the grain bags evenly among three silos: Silo East, Silo Central, and Silo West. Deliver four grain bags to each silo one by one, making a separate stop at each silo and waiting until a technician removes the bags each time. After distributing four bags to each silo, transport the remaining two grain bags to Silo Central for storage. Following the final delivery, return to the Grain Distribution Dock, remain stationary for five minutes to allow supervisors to verify records, and then proceed to the Seed Warehouse for standby instructions.

Start at Storage Bay 2 where three replacement hydraulic pumps and two containers of coolant fluid are staged for dispatch. Pick up the hydraulic pumps and transport them to Workshop Alpha, leaving one pump at this location for the senior technician; once the delivery is acknowledged, proceed to Workshop Bravo and deliver the second pump, waiting until the maintenance chief confirms installation is ready before you depart. Take the final hydraulic pump to Workshop Charlie, but only deposit it after the crew at Workshop Bravo has removed their unit. Then, return to Storage Bay 2 and collect both containers of coolant fluid; first, drive to the Greenhouse Cooling Station and unload one coolant container, remaining for four minutes to allow the staff to connect the container safely, and finally, head to Machinery Bay 1 to drop off the last coolant container to the shift supervisor before concluding your route.

Begin at the Central Maintenance Bay and load four hydraulic fluid canisters onto your cargo deck, verifying that each canister is securely fastened. Proceed first to Harvester Station Alpha and deliver one canister, pausing for 5 minutes to give the technicians ample time to remove the empty container before making the drop-off. Afterwards, travel to Tractor Depot West to distribute the second canister; wait until the depot supervisor signals that the depot fluid reservoir has been fully refilled and the canister can be detached. For the third and fourth canisters, drive consecutively to Irrigation Control Shed North and then to Planter Assembly South, delivering one canister at each site and confirming each recipient’s readiness before release. Once all fluid canisters have been delivered and verified, relocate to the Washdown Pad to await further instructions, remaining in place for 10 minutes to allow cleaning crews to complete decontamination procedures on your chassis.

instruction: Begin your route at Loading Dock B and retrieve six pallets of irrigation hose reels. Deliver two pallets to Greenhouse Zone 1 and wait three minutes while the facility manager inspects and unloads the hose reels; if unloading is not confirmed in that time, continue waiting in similar three-minute intervals until the process is complete. After completing unloading at Greenhouse Zone 1, proceed to Greenhouse Zone 2 and repeat the same delivery and waiting procedure with another two pallets and inspection period. Finally, take the remaining two pallets to Outdoor Pump Station C, but only deliver them if confirmation has been received that both previous greenhouses accepted their delivery—if not, remain at Outdoor Pump Station C and await remote instruction for up to fifteen minutes before returning to Loading Dock B for further orders.

Start by traveling to the Seed Inventory Shed and collect a total of thirteen seed bags required for planting. Then, distribute the seed bags across Field Alpha, Field Beta, and Field Gamma by delivering four bags each to Field Alpha and Field Beta, and the remaining five bags to Field Gamma to accommodate the differing plot sizes. At each field, wait for the local planting supervisor to confirm that their respective seed bag supply is ready to be unloaded before proceeding to the next field. After all seed bags have been delivered and confirmations received, move to the Irrigation Pumping Station and remain there for 15 minutes to allow field crew to flush and refill the main water lines. Once this waiting period has elapsed, continue to the Equipment Sanitization Dock, collect any empty containers that were used for seed transportation, and transfer these empty containers back to the Seed Inventory Shed. Make sure not to leave the area until the shed supervisor has verified all empty containers are returned and accounted for.

instruction: Begin at the Maintenance Depot and pick up the set of four diagnostic toolkits prepared for seasonal tractor checks. Next, proceed to Tractor Bay 2 to distribute the second toolkit, again waiting for acknowledgment from the receiving mechanic before advancing. After the first two bays, travel to Tractor Bay 3 but pause for precisely 180 seconds at the service waiting area before delivering the third toolkit, as the maintenance crew there requires time to complete prior tasks. Once the timer expires and after the toolkit is handed over with confirmation, continue to Tractor Bay 4 to deliver the final toolkit. instruction: Begin your route at the East Maintenance Garage and collect a shipment of nine spare harvester blades from the tool rack. Your first stop is the North Wheat Field Service Point, where you will deliver three blades; pause there for five minutes to allow maintenance crew to install the blades. Following the waiting period, proceed to the Central Grain Silo Loading Dock and distribute another three blades, then remain until the site supervisor removes the blades from your payload. Finally, bring the last three blades to the South Machinery Bay, waiting until the technician confirms all blades are received and the bay inventory has been updated. Only after all deliveries and acknowledgements are complete should you return to the East Maintenance Garage to signal task completion.

Begin at the Distribution Warehouse and collect a shipment consisting of ten fertilizer sacks and three irrigation control units. Make your first delivery by bringing four fertilizer sacks and one irrigation control unit to Greenhouse 3, waiting for three minutes after arrival to allow the staff to verify and accept the equipment. Once the handoff at Greenhouse 3 is complete, proceed to Orchard Station with three more fertilizer sacks and one irrigation control unit, where you must also wait three minutes for staff inspection and confirmation. Deliver the remaining three fertilizer sacks and the final irrigation control unit to the Experimental Hydroponics Lab, this time waiting five minutes while the receiving technician inspects the delivery. Only after all deliveries have been fully accepted at their respective locations may you return to the Distribution Warehouse to register the completion of this multi-stage distribution cycle.

instruction: Start at the fertilizer storage facility and load yourself with a shipment of forty-seven fertilizer sacks. Transport the fertilizer sacks by first delivering fifteen sacks to Wheat Field A, then fifteen sacks to Corn Plot 3, and finally fifteen sacks to Soybean Paddock 2, allocating the remaining two sacks to Wheat Field A to ensure the total shipment is fully distributed. Following the drop-off of the last fertilizer sack at Soybean Paddock 2, wait at Soybean Paddock 2 for ten minutes to allow field specialists to inspect the delivery. After this wait, proceed to the central service depot, but only do so if confirmation is received from the Soybean Paddock 2 supervisor that the delivery inspection is complete. Start at the Main Tool Depot and retrieve four inspection drones along with the precision spray nozzle attachment. Head first to Maintenance Bay A, where you must wait for the senior technician to confirm the readiness of the nozzle attachment before departing. Then, deliver one inspection drone to each of the following locations, in this order: the West Grain Storage Hangar, the Central Irrigation Control Room, and the South Field Service Post, leaving one drone at each site and awaiting confirmation from staff at every stop that the drone has been successfully activated before moving to the next destination. Carry the remaining inspection drone to the East Fertilizer Mixing Station and wait for ten minutes to allow the operations crew to install and test the device. After this period, return directly to the Main Tool Depot and stand by until summoned for additional route assignments.

Begin by traveling to the Equipment Storage Bay and collect a single diagnostic toolkit. Bring the diagnostic toolkit to Maintenance Station 1 and wait there until a technician signals that the toolkit is ready for transfer. Once confirmation is received, deliver the diagnostic toolkit to Maintenance Station 2, but pause there for exactly four minutes to allow for equipment testing before proceeding further. After the waiting period, if the toolkit has not yet been collected by staff at Maintenance Station 2, remain onsite until the toolkit is removed. Once the toolkit has been offloaded at Maintenance Station 2, make your way to the Refueling Platform and remain there until further instructions are given.

Begin the task by proceeding to the Fertilizer Storage Shed and loading nine bags of mineral fertilizer. Once all nine fertilizer bags are secured, travel to Field Alpha and distribute three bags, remaining at the location until the field manager confirms all bags have been removed from your platform. Following the successful delivery at Field Alpha, continue to Field Bravo with another three fertilizer bags, and wait at Field Bravo until every bag is unloaded by the field crew. With the final three bags, make your way to Field Charlie, deliver the bags to the on-site agronomist, and stay at Field Charlie for five minutes to allow for documentation and inspection. Once the inspection is completed and the waiting period has elapsed, return directly to the Fertilizer Storage Shed to receive new dispatch instructions from the operations coordinator.

Begin at the Machine Maintenance Bay, where you are to collect a batch of ten replacement hydraulic filters intended for three tractor units. Navigate promptly to Tractor Bay Alpha and deliver three filters there, remaining at the bay until the lead technician signals that the filters have been removed and verified. Once this confirmation is received, proceed to Tractor Bay Bravo to distribute another three filters, but before the handover, wait for sixty seconds to allow ongoing maintenance work to be paused. After the minute has elapsed and once the filters are unloaded at Bravo, move to Tractor Bay Charlie and supply the remaining four filters; ensure any surplus filter is noted, as Bay Charlie requires an extra due to an earlier parts recall. Wait at Tractor Bay Charlie until the maintenance supervisor certifies the complete removal of all delivered filters, then immediately return to the Machine Maintenance Bay to log the task’s end.

Begin by proceeding to the Seed Depot to collect twelve trays of hybrid maize seeds. Divide these trays among the following destinations: transport five trays to the East Greenhouse loading dock, four trays to the Central Nursery receiving bay, and the remaining three trays to the West Plot entrance. After each delivery, wait for a staff member to remove the trays, ensuring that each location receives only its designated quantity before moving on. Once all twelve trays have been delivered and acknowledged, travel to the Main Workshop, and remain there for three minutes to allow for routine maintenance inspections before accepting your next assignment.

Start your task at the Central Warehouse Dock and retrieve fourteen fresh produce crates labeled for dispatch. instruction: Start at the Maintenance Depot and collect twelve lubricant canisters scheduled for preventive servicing. Divide the canisters evenly by delivering four canisters each to Conveyor Belt Area A, Press Line B, and Packaging Station C; if there is any leftover canister after distribution, bring the extra canister to Quality Control Lab for sampling. After each delivery at Area A, Line B, and Station C, wait two minutes for the maintenance supervisor to verify the drop-off before proceeding to the next area. Only after all initial deliveries and supervisor verifications are complete should you proceed to collect any empty lubricant containers from each of those three locations. instruction: Begin at the Main Maintenance Garage and wait until the engine diagnostic package is ready. Once the diagnostic package is prepared, transport it directly to Tractor Bay 4 and remain until the tractor technician collects and removes the package. After receiving confirmation of the removal, proceed immediately to Storage Yard A and collect six replacement hydraulic hoses. Distribute these hoses by delivering two hoses each to Greenhouse Loading Dock, Field Equipment Shed, and Processing Facility Receiving Area, ensuring that any remainder hoses are left at Processing Facility Receiving Area if the total number is not evenly divisible. After completing all drop-offs, wait at the Processing Facility Receiving Area for 10 minutes to allow staff to conduct an inventory check before returning to the Main Maintenance Garage to report task completion.

Commence your route at the Equipment Loading Dock, where you must acquire a total of seven irrigation hose reels, then travel directly to the Eastern Vineyard. Distribute three irrigation hose reels to the vineyard crew and wait until they confirm all three reels have been removed from your robot. With four reels remaining, proceed to the Southern Greenhouse Complex and deliver another three irrigation hose reels to the greenhouse staff, again waiting until all items are fully unloaded. After these deliveries, take the final irrigation hose reel to the West Farm Utility Shed; upon arrival, remain for four minutes to allow the maintenance team to conduct their inspection and transport procedures. Once all hose reels have been successfully delivered and accounted for at each location, return your vehicle to the Equipment Loading Dock and wait there for further instructions.

Start at the Equipment Loading Dock and collect a total of eight fertilizer containers labeled for immediate distribution. Transport three containers first to Silo One at the western storage ring, deliver them, and wait at Silo One until all three containers have been fully offloaded by the receiving supervisor. Next, bring another three fertilizer containers to Silo Two, which is situated next to the eastern service road, and remain there until the drop-off is complete and the containers are acknowledged as received. Once both silos have been restocked, take the remaining two fertilizer containers to the Emergency Supply Shed located between Greenhouse Block A and Greenhouse Block B. After confirming successful transfer at the Emergency Supply Shed, wait for 5 minutes to allow for any unforeseen loading issues; then, proceed immediately to the Vehicle Charging Station at the central junction and stand by for further deployment instructions.

instruction: Start at the West Storage Depot and load eight sacks of premium fertilizer onto your platform. Deliver three sacks to the North Orchard Shed and wait until each sack is removed by the orchard manager. Once the North Shed delivery is complete, proceed to the Central Greenhouse Annex with another three sacks, but before you allow the greenhouse staff to remove the sacks, wait outside the annex for four minutes to allow for safety checks. With the two remaining fertilizer sacks, continue to the South Vegetable Plots Distribution Area, and wait there until both sacks are unloaded by the supervisor. After confirming that all eight sacks have been completely distributed among the three locations, return promptly to the West Storage Depot to report task completion.

Commence your shift at the tool storage depot and retrieve a set of six precision irrigation nozzles labeled for the north sector upgrades. Proceed to the east greenhouse loading dock and transfer two irrigation nozzles to the horticulture supervisor, waiting until both nozzles are confirmed as unloaded before continuing. Next, carry the remaining four nozzles to the pump calibration laboratory, where you will deliver three nozzles to the technician and wait for five minutes to allow for an initial calibration check. Leave the last nozzle on the laboratory intake bench, then return directly to the tool storage depot and remain there until all delivery confirmations are received from both the horticulture supervisor and the laboratory technician.

instruction: Start by navigating to Water Pump Station Delta and load four high-capacity filtration cartridges into the robot's compartment, making sure to check that each cartridge is securely stowed before departing. Deliver one cartridge to Irrigation Node East, and wait until the technician at Irrigation Node East completes removal before heading to the next location. Next, transport two cartridges to Irrigation Node South; if at any point the maintenance personnel at Irrigation Node South are delayed, wait for six minutes before reattempting delivery and offload both cartridges only when they are ready to receive them. For the last remaining cartridge, continue to Irrigation Node West, but do not initiate removal until you have received confirmation from the supervisory control room that the operating schedule permits it—if confirmation is not received within five minutes of arrival, return the cartridge to Water Pump Station Delta. Once all intended deliveries are either completed or returned due to scheduling conflicts, proceed to Service Dock Beta for a post-route diagnostic check and remain there until the service technician authorizes departure, after which the robot should return to its original starting position at Water Pump Station Delta.

Begin at the packing facility next to Warehouse 8 and retrieve a sealed pallet containing fourteen packages of organic seeds. Transport the pallet to the east loading dock at Silo Complex Alpha and unload exactly five packages there, waiting until the receiving clerk signals that all packages have been properly checked in. After this confirmation, continue to the greenhouse equipment yard and offload another five packages, ensuring that the greenhouse supervisor confirms payload removal before proceeding. Move on to Distribution Point Charlie with the remaining four seed packages, and deliver them to the designated drop zone for horticulture staff. After the staff remove the packages, remain at Distribution Point Charlie for ten minutes to allow for a mandatory record-keeping interval before returning to the packing facility to await further deployment orders.

object.description: sealed pallet containing packages of organic seeds

instruction.location: east loading dock at Silo Complex Alpha
east loading dock at Silo Complex Alpha

instruction: Begin at the Grain Processing Facility by retrieving nine seed packets from Storage Room A, ensuring each packet is accounted for before departure. Proceed first to Silo Alpha and distribute three seed packets, waiting onsite until the silo manager confirms the packets have been successfully removed. Once receipt is confirmed, travel to Greenhouse Beta and deliver another three seed packets, remaining at the greenhouse until removal by the greenhouse technician is explicitly acknowledged. Next, head to Field Station Gamma with the final three seed packets, awaiting the field supervisor’s confirmation of packet removal. After all deliveries are completed and removal of each batch is verified at every location, return to Storage Room A and remain stationary for 6 minutes, allowing inventory personnel sufficient time to log your completed drops before taking on a new job.

Start by navigating to Warehouse C and retrieve a crate containing 37 sealed fertilizer pouches. Distribute these pouches across three field storage stations: deliver 13 pouches to North Field Bay and wait until all 13 are unloaded by the receiving attendant, then proceed to South Field Bay to drop off another 12 pouches and remain there until they are removed. The remaining 12 pouches must be transported to West Field Depot; after unloading, wait for a full 7 minutes to give the depot staff sufficient time to verify the delivery and sign off on the received quantity. Only after finishing the waiting period and confirming all pouches have been delivered should you continue to Maintenance Shed B to await further supply transfer instructions.

Start at Dock Bay 3 and collect two water filtration units from the delivery pallet. Bring both water filtration units to the Equipment Calibration Room adjacent to the processing plant and wait until both are confirmed to be calibrated by the technician; this may require standing by for up to 5 minutes. After both units are ready, deliver the first water filtration unit to the South Field Pump House, and once the unit has been removed at the Pump House, proceed to transport the second water filtration unit to the North Irrigation Control Shed. Only after both units have been successfully delivered to their respective destinations, return to Dock Bay 3 and wait for 2 minutes in case additional water filtration units require transportation.

instruction.location: Equipment Calibration Room adjacent to the processing plant
Equipment Calibration Room adjacent to the processing plant
Equipment Calibration Room adjacent to the processing plant

instruction: Begin by collecting nine sealed crates of seed packets from Storage Room Delta. Transit immediately to Field Plot 1 and deliver three crates there, waiting at Field Plot 1 until each crate has been fully offloaded by the field technician. Afterward, proceed to Field Plot 2 and deposit another three crates of seed packets, but remain on site for five minutes to allow the planting crew to confirm the delivery and scan the crate barcodes—do not leave before the time elapses, even if the unloading is complete. The last three crates should be brought to Greenhouse Entry Dock; if Greenhouse Entry Dock is not ready to receive all three crates, leave as many as can be accepted and transport any remaining crates back to Storage Room Delta for secure holding. Once the seed packet deliveries and all necessary waiting intervals are finalized, return to Storage Room Delta and await further instructions from the supervisor.

object.num: as many as can be accepted

instruction: Start at Field Storage Shed and collect 14 trays of freshly harvested tomatoes, ensuring all trays are properly secured before departing. Transport the tomatoes first to Packing Station East and deliver 5 trays to the supervisor; wait until the supervisor finishes unloading the 5 trays before continuing. Next, travel to Quality Sorting Zone where 5 additional trays must be handed over; remain in place until the sorting lead completes the removal process. Afterwards, bring the final 4 trays to Cold Room 3 for storage—if the cold room is still being sanitized upon arrival, wait for 6 minutes before the storage clerk removes the trays. Once all tomatoes have been delivered, remain in Cold Room 3 for a further 5 minutes to verify proper logging of the transferred produce, then return directly to Field Storage Shed and prepare for the next assignment.

Begin at Loading Dock C and move to the Refrigerated Storage Area to pick up nine crates of perishable produce once the crates are labeled for transport. Distribute these crates evenly by delivering three crates each to Market Distribution Point 1, Market Distribution Point 2, and Market Distribution Point 3; if a location cannot accept a full set due to capacity limits at the time of arrival, wait at that location for two minutes before attempting delivery again, repeating this waiting cycle until the full allocation is accepted. After all nine crates are successfully delivered to their respective destinations, proceed directly to Loading Dock C and wait there for five minutes so that post-delivery sanitation protocols can be completed before your next assignment.

Start by going to the Parts Warehouse adjacent to the main assembly plant and pick up four sensor calibration kits. Proceed to Machine Station One in the north wing and deliver one calibration kit, remaining on site until the maintenance supervisor confirms the kit has been received and ready to install. Following this, head to Machine Station Two located in the central production hall and drop off another calibration kit, waiting there for three minutes to allow the technician to review the delivery documentation. Next, transport a kit to Machine Station Three at the southern end of the facility, and pause until the kit is physically removed from your platform by the on-duty engineer. The final kit should be delivered to Machine Station Four near the east exit, but only proceed to this location after all prior deliveries have been verified as complete; once the last delivery is made, return immediately to the Parts Warehouse for system check-in and assignment update.

instruction: Start at the Seed Supply House and collect eight seed crates designated for distribution to three distinct fields: distribute three seed crates to Wheat Plot Epsilon, four seed crates to Corn Field Zeta, and deliver the remaining single seed crate to Barley Test Strip Theta. Following each delivery, wait until all crates are confirmed removed by the respective field supervisor before proceeding to the next location. Only after all crates have been fully delivered and unloaded at every destination, travel to Maintenance Bay Gamma and wait there for 10 minutes to undergo routine diagnostics before you may accept new delivery tasks.

Begin at Maintenance Bay Alpha and pick up nine replacement hydraulic hoses, confirming that all hoses are undamaged and properly secured before departure. Proceed first to Greenhouse Block One and deliver three hoses to the on-site repair technician, waiting for a signal that each hose has been successfully integrated into the irrigation system before moving on. Next, continue to Equipment Shed Two and deposit four hoses, remaining there until a technician confirms that the old hoses have been fully removed and the replacements are staged for installation. With the final two hoses, make your way to Tractor Depot Omega, where you must wait exactly three minutes after arrival to allow the depot staff to clear the service area, and then deliver the hoses onto the designated bench. Only after every drop-off is complete and all confirmations have been received, return to Maintenance Bay Alpha and stay there for five minutes to ensure the service log is reviewed by onsite personnel before the task cycle concludes.

Start by navigating to Storage Depot A and collect seven crates of irrigation valves. First, proceed to Nursery Shed 1 and deliver two of the crates, making sure to wait until the nursery manager verifies that both crates have been offloaded before you continue. Next, head to Field Pump Station B with three more crates and remain at the location for five minutes while the crew completes their inventory check and removes the crates from your cart. Lastly, transport the remaining two crates of irrigation valves to Greenhouse Sector D; however, if the greenhouse supervisor is not present when you arrive, hold your position for six minutes before attempting to complete the transfer. Do not return to Storage Depot A until every crate has been successfully received and acknowledged at its respective destination.

Start by collecting eight sealed seed crates from the supply warehouse. Proceed to Field Section Alpha first, where you must distribute three seed crates and wait for the local technician to finish inspection before unloading. After this, continue to Field Section Bravo, allocating another three seed crates, and remain on site for a 4-minute waiting period to allow the automated sowing machines to initialize. The remaining two seed crates must be delivered to the experimental test plot at Field Section Gamma, but only commence this final drop-off if the technician at Field Section Alpha has confirmed that all crates were successfully received. Upon completion of all distributions, return to the supply warehouse for system diagnostics.

instruction.location: experimental test plot at Field Section Gamma
experimental test plot at Field Section Gamma

instruction: Start by proceeding to Bulk Chemical Storage Facility A to pick up a cargo of fifteen sealed fertilizer drums. Distribute these fertilizer drums among four field depot sites: deliver four drums each to Field Depot North and Field Depot South, three drums to Field Depot East, and the remaining four drums to Field Depot West, making certain each depot receives the specified number. After each drop-off at a depot, wait until the depot supervisor confirms the removal of all fertilizer drums at that location before heading to the next destination. Once all fertilizer drums have been delivered and offloaded confirmations are received from every depot, travel to the Central Decontamination Bay and remain there for ten minutes to complete a mandatory decontamination protocol before returning to service or receiving additional assignments.

Start at the maintenance depot and collect nine replacement air filters needed for seasonal servicing. Transport three replacement air filters to Workshop A and wait until all three have been collected by the maintenance technician before proceeding. Next, bring another three replacement air filters to Workshop B, ensuring you remain at the drop-off point until all three filters are removed by Workshop B's staff. After completing the second delivery, carry the final three replacement air filters to Workshop C, wait until the technicians have retrieved these last filters, and then remain at Workshop C for two minutes to allow for any immediate supply requests before returning to the maintenance depot to report task completion.

Begin your route at Supply Depot Delta and collect twelve sealed fertilizer canisters for distribution. Your first destination is Field Plot A, where you must offload five canisters; wait up to five minutes for the field team to confirm successful storage before departing. Next, proceed to Field Plot B and deliver another five canisters, again waiting five minutes to ensure the goods are properly received. The remaining two canisters are to be taken to Greenhouse Station 3; only hand them over after you verify that both Field Plot A and Field Plot B teams have confirmed receipt of their deliveries. Once the Greenhouse Station 3 supervisor acknowledges arrival of the last pair of canisters, stay at Greenhouse Station 3 for a minimum of three minutes to synchronize operation logs with the station's control panel. After all steps are completed, promptly return to Supply Depot Delta for future tasks.

Begin at the packaging warehouse and pick up twelve sealed cartons of organic tomatoes. Transport four sealed cartons to Loading Bay 2, making sure to wait until the packaging supervisor confirms removal of all four cartons before you proceed. Following this, take another four sealed cartons to Refrigerated Storage Room 1, and wait there for eight minutes to allow the cooling system to stabilize and the storage manager to remove the cartons. Once both prior drop-offs are complete, carry the remaining four sealed cartons to Distribution Dock 5, and wait at Distribution Dock 5 until the shipping staff has fully unloaded the final four cartons. After all deliveries and checks are completed, return directly to the packaging warehouse to synchronize with the central logistics system.

Start at the Harvest Control Center and confirm that a shipment of seventeen harvested apple bins is ready in Dock Bay 2. Distribute these apple bins by delivering six to Processing Facility A, five to Packaging Station B, and the remaining six to Cold Storage Unit C, making sure to account for all seventeen bins. First, take six apple bins to Processing Facility A, wait until the facility manager confirms and removes all bins, and do not proceed until you receive this confirmation. Then, deliver five apple bins to Packaging Station B, waiting on-site for three minutes to allow the station crew to complete their setup before they are able to remove the bins; only after this waiting period should you facilitate the transfer and confirm all five bins have been received. Finally, transport the last six apple bins to Cold Storage Unit C, remaining there until the cold storage technician removes every bin and provides verbal acknowledgment of receipt. Once all apple bins have been properly distributed and receipt confirmed at each location, return to Dock Bay 2 at the Harvest Control Center and remain idle for five minutes to complete system logging and downtime before you shut down your route.

Begin at Storage Dock A and acquire a batch of 17 sensor modules, confirming each module is properly packaged for safe handling before leaving the dock. Travel first to Greenhouse Unit 1 and deliver six sensor modules; remain at Greenhouse Unit 1 until the installation supervisor verifies each module has arrived and is unboxed. Then, proceed to Greenhouse Unit 2 and distribute another six sensor modules, but wait at Greenhouse Unit 2 for four minutes to allow for preliminary on-site testing of these modules. Afterward, transport the final five sensor modules to Greenhouse Unit 3, but do not proceed with delivery until all outdated sensors at Greenhouse Unit 3 have been fully removed and accounted for by the greenhouse manager. Once every batch has been delivered and all waiting periods or conditions are satisfied at the respective greenhouses, return directly to Storage Dock A and await clearance from the logistics coordinator before concluding the assignment.

Start your route at Grain Storage Silo 1, where you must collect a total of fourteen sealed grain sample containers. Evenly distribute these containers among four quality control collection points: deliver three containers to Lab Station Alpha, three to Lab Station Beta, four to Testing Dock Gamma, and the remaining four containers to Warehouse Delta; if uneven distribution is necessary, allocate the extra container(s) to Warehouse Delta. After completing all four drop-offs, proceed to the Loading Bay and wait for five minutes to allow the logistics coordinator to process the collection receipts. Once the waiting period has concluded, head directly to Equipment Depot 7 to pick up a set of calibration weights, then deliver these weights to the Maintenance Control Room, but only do so after receiving confirmation from the coordinator at the Loading Bay that the receipt process is finished.

Start at Loading Dock 3 and retrieve four cases of processed seed packets, ensuring all four cases are accounted for before departing. Make the first delivery to Silo West, depositing one case and waiting there until the storage assistant confirms successful transfer. Next, continue to the Farmstead Workshop with two cases; on arrival, distribute one case to the lead technician and the second to the maintenance room, waiting until both have been removed from your payload before proceeding. Finally, take the remaining single case to Crop Plot Gamma, deliver it to the field manager, and wait alongside the delivery area for seven minutes while initial seeding preparations take place. Only after the full seven minutes have passed and all cases have been delivered, return directly to Loading Dock 3 to complete your route.

case of processed seed packets (to maintenance room)

instruction: First, make your way to the Central Tool Shed to retrieve nine replacement hose reels. Distribute these hose reels as follows: bring four hose reels to Greenhouse 2’s west entrance, three hose reels to the South Orchard maintenance alcove, and deliver the last two hose reels to the North Storage Platform. For each drop-off, wait at the location until the site technician has removed the hose reels and confirmed receipt before heading to the next destination. Once all nine hose reels are delivered and acknowledged, proceed to the Irrigation Control Center and wait there for fifteen minutes to allow the facilities manager to complete a system reset. Only after the allotted time at the Irrigation Control Center should you depart for your subsequent assignment, ensuring that all previous handoffs and waiting periods have been properly observed.

Start at the storage hangar and collect a crate containing twenty-three irrigation drone batteries. Travel first to Field Station West and deliver eight batteries, but do not continue until the maintenance technician at Field Station West has signaled that all batteries have been safely unloaded. Next, bring seven batteries to Field Station Central, waiting for the station engineer to confirm payload removal before proceeding. Then, take the remaining eight batteries to the solar array outpost, where you must wait until the solar array supervisor confirms receipt of all batteries. Once deliveries to all three locations are confirmed, remain at the solar array outpost for fifteen minutes to accommodate system testing, and then return to the storage hangar for the next assignment.

Start at Maintenance Bay A and retrieve the three spare battery units prepared for network relay towers. Transport one battery unit first to Relay Tower South, and after handing it over, remain nearby for four minutes to allow technicians to install and validate the battery. Next, proceed to Relay Tower East and wait until the previous battery has been safely removed by the service crew before delivering the second battery unit; only transfer the battery once you receive confirmation from the crew chief. Deliver the third battery to Relay Tower West, but if the weather station adjacent to Relay Tower West is still undergoing repairs upon your arrival, wait for up to ten minutes before attempting to drop off the battery. After all three batteries have been successfully delivered and acknowledged at their respective towers, return directly to Maintenance Bay A to report task completion.

object.description: spare battery units prepared for network relay towers

instruction: Begin by moving to the Chemical Storage Facility and waiting for the safety officer to finish prepping thirty pesticide canisters for transport. Once loaded, divide the canisters by delivering twelve to Spraying Station East, another twelve to Spraying Station West, and the final six to Spraying Station Central, explicitly verifying that the correct count is left at each spot. After each delivery, pause for 5 minutes at the station gate to allow for security clearance checks by station staff before traveling to the next destination. As soon as all canisters are delivered and the waiting periods are complete, proceed immediately to the Vehicle Charging Dock and remain there until notified that the next transport cycle is ready.

Start by proceeding to the Seed Storage Room and collect nine seed dispensers, ensuring all dispensers have been properly loaded and tagged for distribution. Next, deliver three seed dispensers each to Greenhouse 1, the West Test Plot, and the Experimental Vertical Farm; carry out the deliveries one location at a time, and after completing each handoff, wait until the designated agronomist at the current site provides verbal confirmation of receipt before continuing to the next destination. If any site reports that their receiving bay is full, pause for five minutes at the location before attempting to complete the transfer again; resume the delivery sequence in the original order once each transfer is acknowledged. After all seed dispensers are successfully distributed, head to the Equipment Cleaning Station, wait for seven minutes to complete post-operation sanitization, and then remain there until further instructions are issued.

Start at the Greenhouse Loading Dock and collect a shipment of nineteen fertilizer sacks. Proceed to Field Plot A and deliver six fertilizer sacks, then wait until the field supervisor indicates that all sacks have been offloaded before continuing. Next, travel to Field Plot B and unload another six fertilizer sacks, remaining by the drop-off point until workers have removed each sack. For Field Plot C, deliver the remaining seven fertilizer sacks—explicitly ensuring that this plot receives the extra sack to handle the shipment remainder. After all sacks have been distributed, proceed to the Equipment Cleaning Station and pause for seven minutes to allow for a decontamination process. Only after the decontamination period has elapsed, return to the Greenhouse Loading Dock to end the delivery sequence.

Begin at the main seed vault adjacent to Facility A and collect a total of seven sealed soybean sample canisters. Transport two canisters each to Laboratory 1 North, Laboratory 2 Central, and Laboratory 3 East, ensuring that no laboratory receives more than two canisters—deliver the remaining single canister to Laboratory 4 South to handle the leftover. After each drop-off, wait for the laboratory personnel at each location to confirm the removal of their assigned canisters before proceeding to the next destination. Once all deliveries are complete, proceed to the equipment sterilization zone near Loading Dock B, and remain there for 12 minutes to allow for mandatory decontamination procedures before returning to the main seed vault for further instructions.

instruction.location: main seed vault adjacent to Facility A
main seed vault adjacent to Facility A
equipment sterilization zone near Loading Dock B
