instruction: Begin at the Central Equipment Garage and retrieve a package of six replacement hydraulic filters. Distribute these filters among three sites as follows: deliver two filters to Maintenance Bay A for the tractor fleet, two filters to Maintenance Bay B for the harvester unit, and the final two filters to Workshop C for small equipment repairs, ensuring each site receives exactly two filters. After all deliveries are complete, navigate to Refueling Station E and wait exactly 10 minutes to allow the refueling crew to service your robot. Once this waiting period ends, proceed to the Parts Collection Dock and pick up a crate of engine belts, but only deliver this crate to Maintenance Bay A once you have confirmed that the site supervisor at Maintenance Bay A has finished installing the previously delivered hydraulic filters.

Begin at the Loading Bay and secure a crate containing twelve engine filters slated for preventive service. Navigate first to Tractor Shed West and deliver four engine filters; wait at Tractor Shed West until a technician provides confirmation that the vehicle fleet has received them. After this acknowledgment, continue to Combine Harvester Garage, where you must distribute another four engine filters. Remain at Combine Harvester Garage for 5 minutes to enable the maintenance crew to inventory and inspect the engine filters. Following this interval, proceed to Utility Vehicle Port to offload the last four engine filters, explicitly verifying that all filters have been accounted for. After all deliveries are complete and each recipient has acknowledged receipt, return directly to the Loading Bay to stand by until the next maintenance cycle is initiated.

Begin at the Central Maintenance Hub and proceed directly to Workshop Delta to collect eight diagnostic toolkits needed for upcoming harvest machine inspections. Deliver three diagnostic toolkits to Engine Repair Bay 1, two toolkits to Agricultural Drone Garage, and the remaining three toolkits to Crop Harvester Bay 4, ensuring that each location receives the assigned quantity in a single trip. After every toolkit drop-off, pause for two minutes at each destination to enable maintenance staff to verify and sign off on the equipment receipt before moving to the next. Once the final diagnostic toolkit delivery at Crop Harvester Bay 4 has been confirmed, and only after these acknowledgments, return to the Central Maintenance Hub, but pause for an additional five minutes at the hub to allow for post-delivery debriefing before concluding the operation.

Begin your route at the Central Grain Silo and load a total of eleven sealed grain containers onto your vehicle, verifying all container IDs before departure. Transport the first five containers to Field Station East and, upon arrival, wait for the station operator to signal that each individual container has been securely removed and accounted for. Only when the fifth container has been offloaded should you proceed to Crop Sorting Facility South, where you'll deliver another four grain containers; however, after arriving at the facility, you must remain stationary for two minutes before unloading, to allow for facility airlock cycling and contamination checks. The last two grain containers are destined for the Western Livestock Feed Area—do not leave Sorting Facility South with the remaining containers until all previous unloading and waiting procedures at that facility have concluded. Once the final two containers are delivered to the Livestock Feed Area and have been received by the feed supervisor, return directly to the Central Grain Silo without delay to conclude your delivery cycle.

Begin at Central Materials Depot and retrieve a pallet containing fifteen biofertilizer cartridges. Transport the full pallet to Silo 1 first, unload five biofertilizer cartridges, and remain on site until the warehouse operator confirms each cartridge has been removed from the robot. Next, proceed with the remaining ten cartridges to Field Maintenance Bay, where you will deliver another five cartridges and wait for two minutes to allow staff to complete an equipment calibration before any unloading begins. Once the two minutes have elapsed, wait until all five biofertilizer cartridges have been collected by the maintenance supervisor. After both deliveries are complete, take the final five cartridges to the South Greenhouse Loading Dock; pause there for eight minutes while greenhouse staff prepare their storage, then wait until the last cartridge is offloaded by the greenhouse team before returning the empty pallet to Central Materials Depot and awaiting further instructions.

Initiate at Field Plot 7 and collect nine sealed sacks of harvested soybeans, then make your way to Silo Alpha, Silo Beta, and Silo Gamma for grain distribution. Evenly allocate the sacks by delivering three sacks to each silo, ensuring only one silo receives a delivery per trip. After unloading at any silo, wait five minutes to allow the intake system to process the incoming sacks before beginning the next collection or delivery. Once all nine sacks are confirmed as delivered and processed at their respective silos, proceed directly to the Equipment Service Station and wait adjacent to the Fuel Dispenser until notified to initiate a refueling cycle.

Begin your mission at the Supply Depot and load seven sealed feed supplement bags. Navigate directly to Livestock Pen West and distribute three feed supplement bags, remaining at Livestock Pen West until a technician has removed all three bags from your payload. Proceed next to Dairy Processing Shed; before unloading, check if the shed supervisor has signaled that space is available for new inventory—if so, deliver two more feed supplement bags and wait until both have been taken by the supervisor. Should the Dairy Processing Shed not be ready, wait three minutes before attempting delivery again. Once both Livestock Pen West and Dairy Processing Shed have received their share of the feed supplement bags, transport the remaining two bags to Forage Storage Unit 3 at the north boundary and stay present until a warehouse worker has completed the transfer. After all feed supplement bags are delivered and confirmed removed, return to the Supply Depot, but before ending your route, remain at the depot for two minutes to allow the logistics officer to verify your cargo bay is empty.

instruction.location: Forage Storage Unit 3 at the north boundary
Forage Storage Unit 3 at the north boundary

instruction: Start at the Central Maintenance Depot and collect a batch of twelve sensor calibration modules. Allocate the modules evenly by delivering four each to Greenhouse One, Hydroponics Lab, and the Remote Weather Station; if there are any remaining modules after this first distribution, bring the surplus directly to the Experimental Diagnostics Suite. After depositing calibration modules at each intended site, wait for exactly three minutes to allow technical staff to verify installation and signal readiness to proceed before moving on to the next destination. Once all sensor modules have been distributed and verified, make a return trip to each of the three main sites to gather outdated calibration units, then transport these obsolete modules one batch at a time to the Electronics Recycling Center, waiting two minutes for each recycling process to finish before leaving for the subsequent site. After all outdated units are recycled, return to the Central Maintenance Depot and remain on standby for five minutes prior to awaiting further mission directives.

Begin by navigating to Dry Goods Warehouse North and await confirmation that the shipment of eighteen fertilizer bags is ready for collection. Once the fertilizer bags are loaded, proceed to distribute them across Irrigation Field West, Irrigation Field Central, and Irrigation Field East: deliver seven fertilizer bags to Irrigation Field West, five fertilizer bags to Irrigation Field Central, and allocate the remaining six bags to Irrigation Field East, ensuring precise quantities and that any remainder is assigned to the final destination. After completing each drop-off, pause for two minutes at the respective field to give farm staff time to verify and sign off on the delivery before moving to the next location. Once all fertilizer bags have been delivered and acknowledged, return directly to Dry Goods Warehouse North; however, only depart the final field after all bags have been officially unloaded. Complete the task by waiting at the warehouse for five minutes before the next assignment begins.

Start your route at Maintenance Bay Alpha and load a set of eight spare hydraulic actuators, ensuring each actuator is identified for its respective destination. Your first stop is the North Field Combine Station, where you must deliver three hydraulic actuators by waiting until the field mechanic signals that all three actuators have been removed from your cargo hold. Immediately after completion at the North Field Combine Station, proceed to the Central Grain Elevator for the delivery of two hydraulic actuators, pausing there until the elevator supervisor confirms both actuators have been taken out. Next, transport the remaining three actuators to Workshop Delta, where you must wait until all actuators are collected by the maintenance crew. After each destination’s transfer is fully complete, spend exactly five minutes at the current site before proceeding to the next, allowing for mandatory inspection and paperwork. Once the final delivery at Workshop Delta has concluded and the waiting period is over, return directly to Maintenance Bay Alpha for final clearance and debrief, awaiting technician approval before powering down.

Start your route at Grain Silo West and load four sacks of winter wheat into the cargo compartment. Make your first stop at Feed Distribution Barn North, where you will unload one sack of winter wheat for the livestock feed team and wait 3 minutes so the barn staff can verify the delivery. Next, continue to Millhouse Processing Center and deliver two sacks of winter wheat, but only after receiving confirmation from the millhouse supervisor that the main feeder conveyor is operational; if not, wait in place until you receive that confirmation before proceeding to unload. Finally, transport the remaining sack of winter wheat to Poultry Coop South, where you must wait for staff to remove the sack before returning to Grain Silo West to complete your circuit.

Initiate your task at Central Receiving Dock, where you must retrieve a load of twelve irrigation control modules. Your first destination is South Crop Plot 2, where you will offload five irrigation control modules, but only after Field Manager Li confirms readiness for installation. Wait until all five modules have been removed before continuing. Proceed next to Greenhouse West and deliver another four irrigation control modules, then remain at Greenhouse West for a precise period of six minutes to allow the greenhouse crew to update their inventory records. After the six-minute waiting interval, travel to North Equipment Shed with the remaining three irrigation control modules; once you arrive, wait for Technician Amari to finish removing all three modules from the robot. Following successful completion of the handoffs at every location, return directly to Central Receiving Dock and prepare for your next assignment.

Proceed to the Chemical Storage Depot and collect a shipment of nineteen pesticide canisters designated for application. Allocate these canisters by delivering six each to Crop Plot East and Crop Plot West, and distribute the remaining seven to Crop Plot Central to match each plot’s acreage. Prior to unloading at either Crop Plot East or Crop Plot West, wait for a notification from the local field crew confirming their sprayers are positioned and the area is secured; at Crop Plot Central, wait a full three minutes after arrival before transfer begins, ensuring sufficient aeration time. Following the final canister delivery and confirmation that canisters are secure at all three crop plots, proceed to the Waste Collection Facility and remain there for eight minutes while pesticide disposal valves are serviced by a specialist. Once that interval has elapsed, travel to the Water Treatment Station, collect all spent safety packaging previously used in pesticide transport, and deliver this material back to the Chemical Storage Depot, but do not leave the depot until the facility manager verifies receipt of all returned packaging materials.

instruction: Begin at the Vehicle Depot and pick up two replacement battery packs and a maintenance toolkit, making sure all items are secured before departure. Proceed first to Crop Field North to deliver one battery pack, where you must remain until the field supervisor swaps out the battery, a process that requires your robot to wait exactly ten minutes before moving on. Once the replacement at Crop Field North is complete, head to Irrigation Pump Station West to transfer the second battery pack, and stay in place until the chief engineer confirms through a visual signal that the swap has been safely performed. Afterward, deliver the maintenance toolkit to Harvest Equipment Shed Beta, but only if both battery packs have been successfully handed off; should either delivery be incomplete, bypass the shed and return the toolkit directly to the Vehicle Depot instead. If the maintenance toolkit is delivered to the Harvest Equipment Shed Beta, wait for the equipment manager to finish the scheduled inspection using the toolkit before departing for your next assignment.

object.description: chief engineer swap confirmation visual signal

instruction: Start at the Main Equipment Depot and verify that a shipment of ten mechanical spare part crates is prepared for dispatch at Loading Area Alpha. Distribute these ten crates by delivering three crates to Maintenance Bay 1, three crates to Repair Shed 2, and the remaining four crates to Engine Workshop 3, ensuring the entire order is accurately handled. First, transport three spare part crates to Maintenance Bay 1 and wait until the maintenance supervisor at Maintenance Bay 1 confirms and removes all crates before proceeding. Once all three crates have been received at Maintenance Bay 1, continue to Repair Shed 2 with another three crates, but if the pathway to Repair Shed 2 is currently blocked, wait on-site in a holding position for five minutes before attempting to deliver the crates again. Only after successful delivery and removal of all crates at Repair Shed 2 should you head to Engine Workshop 3 with the last four crates. Upon arrival at Engine Workshop 3, wait for the workshop foreman to remove all four crates and verbally confirm the delivery before departing. After all ten spare part crates have been confirmed delivered and unloaded at their respective destinations, return directly to Loading Area Alpha and remain there for eight minutes to finalize post-route diagnostics and report completion.

Commence at Greenhouse Loading Bay and wait for six crates of assorted seedling trays to be prepared for transportation. After the crates are ready, deliver two crates each to Field Plot North, Field Plot East, and Field Plot South, making certain that exactly two crates arrive at each destination and all locations sign off on receipt before moving on. For every drop-off, do not leave the site until the local agronomist has removed both crates from the robot. After completing all seedling deliveries, navigate directly to Maintenance Shed 7, where you are required to remain for a 10-minute equipment calibration interval to ensure all delivery mechanisms remain within specification before returning to Greenhouse Loading Bay to conclude your route.

Begin at the Central Spare Parts Warehouse and pick up a batch of fifteen hydraulic component kits intended for scheduled machine repairs. Proceed directly to Maintenance Station Alpha to deliver six hydraulic component kits and remain until the repair technician confirms all kits have been fully received and logged into inventory. After confirmation, travel to Maintenance Station Bravo with another five hydraulic component kits, waiting there until station personnel validate the receipt and installation checklist for each component kit; if Maintenance Station Bravo cannot accept all five kits due to limited storage capacity, immediately return any surplus kits to the Central Spare Parts Warehouse before continuing. With the remaining four hydraulic component kits, head over to Machinery Test Bay, but pause outside the bay for three minutes prior to entering in order to allow the test crew to clear the entry area; once three minutes have elapsed, deliver the kits to Machinery Test Bay and wait until all have been signed off as ready for use. Conclude your shift by returning to the Central Spare Parts Warehouse and await further dispatch instructions from the warehouse operations desk.

object.description: hydraulic component kit (surplus from Maintenance Station Bravo)

instruction: Start at the Seed Storage Facility and collect eighteen sacks of hybrid maize seed, confirming the payload is secured and ready for transport. Drive to North Plot and offload six sacks, waiting until the field supervisor verifies each sack has been taken before proceeding. Then, move to East Plot with the remaining twelve sacks; deliver seven sacks there, and pause for three minutes to allow the planting crew to reorganize equipment before completing the transfer of five more sacks. Following this, travel to South Plot with any remaining sacks, handing over all leftover bags—if an uneven number remains, distribute four sacks immediately and wait for five minutes before transferring any fifth and final sack. Once all deliveries are confirmed at South Plot, return to Seed Storage Facility without delay for debrief and reloading instructions.

Begin your route at the Central Equipment Shed to collect a pack of nine soil moisture sensors, verifying that all sensors are secured before departure. Head to the West Orchard Plot and deliver three sensors, waiting until the orchard technician has finished unloading all assigned sensors before proceeding. Next, continue to the Greenhouse Entrance and distribute another three sensors, but only enter the greenhouse if confirmation is received that the West Orchard technician has completed the sensor retrieval. Before delivering the final three sensors to the South Field Hub, pause for four minutes at the Greenhouse Entrance to allow the system calibration to complete, then proceed to the South Field Hub and wait for the agronomy team to remove the sensors. After all three sites have received their sensors and confirmed removal, return to the Central Equipment Shed to finalize the delivery sequence.

Begin at Storage Warehouse Alpha and retrieve twelve precision irrigation modules as well as eight pH monitoring probes, ensuring each module and probe is certified operational before departure. Proceed to Irrigation Control Deck 1 to deliver four irrigation modules, and wait until an operator at Irrigation Control Deck 1 has installed them all; following installation, remain at Irrigation Control Deck 1 for eight minutes while calibration tests are performed. Afterwards, transport four more irrigation modules to Irrigation Control Deck 2 and wait for the modules to be removed by technical staff. Bring the remaining four irrigation modules to Irrigation Control Deck 3, ensuring the deck supervisor removes these modules prior to your departure. Once all irrigation modules have been distributed, start delivering the pH monitoring probes by evenly assigning three probes each to Analysis Station Beta and Analysis Station Gamma, and delivering the final two probes to Analysis Station Delta; at each analysis station, wait until all delivered probes are fully unloaded and verified by resident staff before proceeding. After the last probe has been received at Analysis Station Delta, return to Storage Warehouse Alpha and remain there until directed by site management for your next assignment.

Begin at Maintenance Bay 1 to collect four repair toolkits that need to be delivered to various production line posts throughout the factory floor. Travel first to Assembly Line Station Delta, drop off one repair toolkit, and wait there until the maintenance supervisor confirms receipt. Next, proceed to Packaging Hub Beta to deposit another repair toolkit; after the packaging technician removes the toolkit, wait three minutes on site to ensure any additional questions can be addressed. Then continue to Quality Control Lab Gamma and leave the third toolkit, remaining at the lab for two minutes to allow for an initial equipment check. Finally, bring the last repair toolkit back to Maintenance Bay 2 for immediate use by the on-duty mechanic, but do not depart until you receive direct confirmation that the mechanic has started working with the delivered toolkit. Once this confirmation is received, return to Maintenance Bay 1 to stand by for further instructions.

At the Storage Yard Loading Dock, retrieve a pallet containing 19 automotive batteries destined for the assembly line stations. Begin by transporting the pallet to Assembly Line A and deliver 7 batteries, waiting until the battery technician confirms all 7 batteries have been safely removed before proceeding. Next, drive to Assembly Line B with the remaining 12 batteries, and offload 6 batteries there; before continuing, pause at Assembly Line B for precisely 2 minutes to allow the quality control inspector to finalize their checks. After the waiting period and once all 6 batteries have been taken, proceed to Assembly Line C to deliver the final 6 batteries, but divide this delivery into two steps: first, supply 3 batteries and wait for confirmation from the line supervisor that these have been secured, then deliver the last 3 batteries and remain at Assembly Line C until removal is acknowledged. Only after all 19 batteries have been distributed and every confirmation is received, return to the Storage Yard Loading Dock to complete your route.

Start from the Storage Hangar near Access Road 2 and retrieve a container filled with twenty-four sealed nutrient packs. Make your first stop at Irrigation Hub West, and distribute nine nutrient packs by placing them inside the intake locker, then remain at the hub for five minutes while the automated dosing system verifies the batch; only depart when verification is complete. Continue to Hydroponic Bay Gamma and deposit eight nutrient packs into the receiving chute, pausing until the supervisor signals that the packs have been secured. For the remaining seven nutrient packs, proceed to the Seedling Cultivation Shed at the northern perimeter, deliver the final batch, and wait until the shed operator inspects and acknowledges receipt of all packs before leaving the area. After all deliveries and associated verification or waiting periods have been completed, return directly to the Storage Hangar and await further deployment instructions.

instruction: Start by proceeding to the Harvest Loading Dock and collect a shipment of ten fertilizer bags intended for distribution. Transport four fertilizer bags to Greenhouse One, and wait until the greenhouse manager confirms all four bags have been unloaded and are ready for use. Next, deliver three fertilizer bags to Orchard Block South, pausing there for five minutes to ensure proper offloading and to assist with stacking. The remaining three fertilizer bags must be taken to the Vineyard Storage Shed; after arrival, wait there until the vineyard supervisor removes all bags and provides removal confirmation. Once all fertilizer bags have been successfully distributed and accounted for at their respective locations, return to the Harvest Loading Dock and await further deployment instructions.

Begin your route at the Main Maintenance Bay by collecting a crate containing nine replacement gearboxes. Drive directly to the Packing House Loading Dock and deliver four gearboxes, but do not leave until the dock supervisor confirms the payload is correct. Once the four gearboxes have been entirely unloaded, continue to Field Station Alpha and offload another three gearboxes; after this, wait for exactly five minutes to give technicians time to inspect each gearbox for integrity. When the inspection delay is complete, proceed to Orchard Shed North with the remaining two gearboxes and wait there until the onsite mechanic retrieves both items. After verifying all gearboxes have been removed at their respective destinations, return to Main Maintenance Bay and remain on standby, ready for further instructions.

Begin your operation at the central fertilizer depot by collecting a total of thirteen nutrient cartridges required for crop enhancement in three specified greenhouse zones. First, bring four nutrient cartridges to Greenhouse Alpha, and remain there until notified by the horticulturist that the loading system is primed. Once confirmed, transport another four nutrient cartridges to Greenhouse Bravo and wait five minutes before entering to comply with contamination control protocols. After the wait, proceed to deliver the cartridges to Greenhouse Bravo. Next, deliver the remaining five nutrient cartridges to Greenhouse Charlie and assist the technician with unloading until all cartridges are accounted for. Only after all deliveries and confirmations at each greenhouse have been completed, return to the central fertilizer depot and remain onsite for decontamination procedures before ending the task.

Begin at the Packing Line Dock to collect a batch of twelve sealed produce containers labeled for distribution, verifying each container against the manifest. Deliver four containers each to Cold Storage Room One, Cold Storage Room Two, and Cold Storage Room Three, but before leaving each Cold Storage Room, remain on site for five minutes to allow automated temperature stabilization and an inspection robot to verify the integrity of the delivery. Only after passing inspection at a given Cold Storage Room may you proceed to the next; if any inspection fails or is delayed, continue waiting and allow for re-inspection until clearance is granted. Once all twelve containers are stored and approvals at every cold storage location are documented, navigate to Quality Control Bay and stay for three minutes while quality assurance logs are updated, then return to the Packing Line Dock to stand by for the next assignment.

instruction: Start at the Main Supply Warehouse and retrieve a full pallet containing nine sealed seed bags designated for distribution. Transport three seed bags each to the North Field Shed, the East Plot Storage, and the South Crop Tent, making sure to deliver the bags to one location at a time. Upon arriving at each destination, wait until the receiving attendant signals that the storage area is ready before unloading the seed bags. After all nine seed bags have been successfully delivered and confirmed at each destination, proceed to the Irrigation Pump House and remain there for 12 minutes to allow system diagnostics to complete before returning to the Main Supply Warehouse for task closure.

instruction: Start by proceeding to Warehouse Entry Point 2 where you must collect a batch of 25 irrigation hose reels prepared for the day’s field work. Once the reels have been loaded and their readiness confirmed, deliver 10 reels to Field Plot Alpha, but after arriving, wait for the field manager to catch up and approve the placement, which may require up to three minutes. Only distribute the 10 reels to Field Plot Alpha after the approval is received, then with the remaining 15 reels, continue on to Greenhouse 7. Here, you must offload 9 reels, but do so in two phases: first, deliver 5 reels and pause at Greenhouse 7 for five minutes to allow the greenhouse team to inspect them, then deliver the next 4 reels and receive confirmation that all 9 have been accepted. The remaining 6 reels should be transported to Remote Maintenance Depot; however, before entering the depot grounds, wait exactly four minutes at the gate to allow security checks to finish. After the wait, deliver all 6 reels to the Remote Maintenance Depot and ensure that depot technicians have removed the entire shipment. Once these steps are complete and all hose reels are accounted for at their destinations, return directly to Warehouse Entry Point 2 and await further cargo assignments.

Begin at the Central Machine Shop and retrieve the spare hydraulic hose reels stacked near the maintenance supply cabinet, preparing a total of eight reels for dispatch. For the first trip, transport three hose reels to Field Maintenance Station North, then remain on site until a technician affirms that all three have been removed from your carrier and staged. Once this confirmation is received, return to the Central Machine Shop to collect the next batch of three hose reels and deliver them to Equipment Shed 5 at the Western Crop Zone; after the drop-off, wait at Equipment Shed 5 for four minutes to allow on-site handling and inspection. After the waiting period, proceed back to the Central Machine Shop for the final two hose reels, transporting them to Tractor Bay 3 adjacent to the fueling depot. Deliver both remaining reels there, then do not leave the vicinity until you observe a supervisor confirming their delivery is complete. Only after all eight hydraulic hose reels have reached their respective destinations and receipt acknowledgements have been obtained at each, return once more to the Central Machine Shop to log your delivery activity records before undertaking additional assignments.

instruction: Start at the Packing Dock and pick up the batch of nine sealed vegetable crates along with the delivery manifest. Depart the Packing Dock and make your first stop at Retail Outlet West, where you will unload four vegetable crates, waiting until each crate has been confirmed as received and logged by the outlet staff. Once all four crates have been removed and documented, continue to Restaurant Supply Entrance to deliver another three vegetable crates; remain at Restaurant Supply Entrance until their kitchen manager signs off on the manifest. Following a three-minute wait to allow pallet jacks to clear the drop-off zone, transport the final two vegetable crates to Community Center North, where you will wait until the entire remaining shipment is offloaded and the manifest is countersigned. After every delivery location has completed their handoff and paperwork, return the fully signed delivery manifest to the Packing Dock administration office, submitting it directly to the logistics coordinator before awaiting the next assignment.

Starting at the Central Storage Depot, load twelve calibration toolkits designated for equipment maintenance. Proceed first to Maintenance Shed Alpha and deliver three calibration toolkits to the technician there, waiting until the technician confirms removal of the items before continuing. Next, drive to Maintenance Shed Beta on the east grounds and transfer another five calibration toolkits, pausing for four minutes to allow the inspection device to register each toolkit as it is received. For the remaining four calibration toolkits, travel to the Remote Field Workshop near the south boundary and place the kits in the secured locker, then wait an additional six minutes to ensure all items are logged into the inventory system. Once every delivery and required waiting period has been completed, return directly to the Central Storage Depot and dock at Loading Bay 3 to conclude the task.

instruction: Start at the Warehouse Loading Bay and collect one crate of replacement drone batteries and eight sealed containers of antifungal spray. Transport first the entire crate of drone batteries to the Drone Hangar, delivering it directly and remaining at the hangar until a technician confirms that each battery has been successfully unloaded and logged into inventory. Once the crate is empty, leave the Drone Hangar and proceed with the eight containers of antifungal spray to distribute them among Silo 3, the Orchard Storage Shed, and Field Station Alpha, allocating three containers to Silo 3, three to the Orchard Storage Shed, and the remaining two containers to Field Station Alpha. For each stop, wait for the local supervisor to verify receipt of the correct quantity before departing. Following completion of all deliveries, wait outside Field Station Alpha for exactly six minutes to allow for system recalibration required due to environmental exposure, then return without delay to the Warehouse Loading Bay, ensuring all containers and the crate have been properly delivered and accounted for according to protocol.

Begin the operation by traveling to the Main Tool Storage Facility to retrieve a batch of fourteen robotic harvest arms packed in a designated crate, confirming that the full count is ready for transport. Next, bring five harvest arms to Harvesting Field A South and await the harvest manager’s signal to begin transfer; do not leave until all five units have been removed from your payload and their serial numbers recorded. Once this first delivery is complete, immediately head to Maintenance Bay 3 to deliver another five harvest arms, where you must stay for four minutes after staff begin unloading in order to allow for initial diagnostics to be performed. For the remaining four harvest arms, proceed to Remote Orchard Node C and deliver these to the technician on duty; should any of the locations decline their full allocation or be unavailable, automatically reroute the unclaimed arms to Backup Storage Silo West and hold there until further instructions. Only after all successful drop-offs have been confirmed or rerouted and appropriate time has elapsed at Maintenance Bay 3, return to Main Tool Storage Facility to log the completion of all assigned deliveries and remain available for a follow-up task at that site.

Begin at the loading dock of Processing Plant A and pick up six sealed pallets containing harvested wheat. Make your first delivery to Silo 2 by transporting and offloading two pallets there; after the Silo 2 staff have removed both pallets, remain on standby for exactly 3 minutes in case a quality inspection is required. Once this waiting period is complete, proceed to Grain Storage Facility B and deliver another two pallets, waiting again for the staff to finish unloading before moving on. Finally, take the last two pallets to Packaging Area 1, but if any of the previous locations were unable to receive their entire allotted amount due to space constraints, ensure you bring any leftover pallets to Packaging Area 1 as well. After all wheat pallets have been completely distributed and removed at each site, navigate to Maintenance Bay 5 and wait there for further maintenance tasks or instructions.

instruction.location: loading dock of Processing Plant A
loading dock of Processing Plant A

instruction: Start at Loading Bay 3 and collect six pesticide containers required for the morning spraying cycle. Transport two containers to Orchard Control Station East and wait until the site supervisor signals that both containers are ready for use before departing. After the containers are received, continue to Vineyard Operations Base, deliver another two pesticide containers, and remain parked for three minutes to allow the site monitoring team to log inventory. Once the wait period is complete, move to the Citrus Grove Maintenance Shed and drop off the final two pesticide containers; do not proceed with this delivery until confirmation is received from Vineyard Operations Base that their monitoring is finished. If any location reports storage capacity issues before receiving its allotted containers, skip that drop-off and redistribute its undelivered containers evenly among the remaining destinations, pausing three additional minutes at each affected location to report the revised allocation to on-site personnel.

Begin by proceeding to Fertilizer Depot Alpha and load five nutrient refill canisters onto the robot. Head first to Greenhouse Section A and deliver two canisters, but do not attempt to unload until horticulture staff at Greenhouse Section A indicate readiness; if they signal a delay lasting longer than four minutes, wait for those four minutes and then attempt delivery once more. After completion, move to Crop Field Plot 3 to offload another two canisters, and only release the canisters once the monitoring system at Crop Field Plot 3 confirms soil sensors are calibrated—if calibration fails or is incomplete after six minutes, remain stationary until successful notification is received. With the final canister, proceed to Nursery Shed Central, but postpone the handover until a payload transfer checklist is completed and verified by the Nursery Shed Central supervisor. Once all deliveries are concluded and acknowledgment receipts from each destination have been obtained, pause at Fertilizer Depot Alpha for a seven-minute system cooling period before resuming your next assignment.

Begin your task at Storage Facility North, where you will retrieve a shipment containing twenty-one fertilizer packs designated for three agricultural zones. Head first to Field Section Bravo and allocate a precise count of seven fertilizer packs there; wait until the field supervisor confirms that every pack has been manually removed from the robot. Proceed next to Greenhouse South with another seven fertilizer packs, but after arrival, pause on-site for three minutes before any unloading begins to allow climate control systems to adjust and stabilize. Once the waiting period lapses, offload the fertilizer packs and confirm their collection. Deliver the final seven packs to Orchard Lot East and remain at that location until the orchard manager completes a visual inspection and formally acknowledges receipt of the fertilizer. After all fertilizer deliveries have been completed and verified at each destination, return straight to Storage Facility North and await further instructions for subsequent distribution cycles.

Start at Greenhouse Loading Dock and collect nine crates of nutrient substrate. Deliver three crates to Crop Research Block A, but wait at Crop Research Block A for two minutes after unloading each crate so that the laboratory staff can test the nutrient quality before accepting the next one. Once all three crates for Block A are confirmed received, proceed to Hydroponics Lab West with another three crates, where you must wait until the hydroponics lead technician verifies that each crate’s seal is intact before moving on. After all verifications at Hydroponics Lab West are complete, transport the remaining three crates to Outdoor Grow Plot C. At Outdoor Grow Plot C, wait until the agricultural supervisor indicates that processing equipment is ready for unloading before you drop off each crate; if the supervisor signals a delay, continue waiting until clearance is provided. After distributing all nine crates, make a final stop at the Greenhouse Loading Dock, but only return after confirming with all three destination sites that the crates have been accepted and logged in their respective inventories.

Begin by proceeding to Grain Silo Alpha to collect a batch of 23 nutrient additive canisters, ensuring all canisters are secured before departure. Once you have obtained the full batch, transport 8 canisters to Eastern Crop Plot and, upon arrival, remain there until the canisters have been completely transferred to the field staff. Next, continue to Southern Field Mixing Station with 7 canisters, waiting on-site for three minutes after the drop-off to allow workers to safely integrate the additives into the mixing process. With the remaining 8 canisters, make your way to Western Fertilizer Dock; after delivery, do not leave until a dock supervisor verifies that all canisters have been offloaded and issues a verbal confirmation of receipt. Only once all additive canisters have been distributed to their respective locations and the necessary waiting and confirmation steps are completed should you proceed to Irrigation Control Cabin to await further transportation directives from the operations manager.

Begin at Warehouse Terminal 5 to load a shipment of twelve battery modules, all destined for field equipment spread across three locations. Deliver five battery modules to Tractor Station South and remain until field operators have removed and acknowledged all five modules. Once this is done, proceed to Irrigation Control Room and transfer another four battery modules, but wait precisely five minutes to allow the irrigation staff to test-install one module before leaving. Next, transport the final three battery modules to Drone Hangar East and wait there until the hangar crew has documented and removed all remaining modules from your cargo hold. After verifying that the entire battery module delivery is finished at all locations, navigate to Robot Recharging Pad and remain docked for twenty minutes to permit a full battery top-up, then return to Warehouse Terminal 5 to await further deployment.

Begin at Central Parts Depot where you will collect a shipment of twelve replacement hydraulic actuators designated for urgent repair tasks in three separate areas. Proceed first to Tractor Workshop West and deliver five actuators; remain at the workshop until the maintenance crew signals that all five have been secured in storage. Once cleared, navigate to Harvesting Drone Service Hangar and offload the next four actuators, waiting at the hangar for six minutes to allow technicians to verify serial numbers and document receipts. After the interval, head to Irrigation Control Room and deliver the final three actuators, but do not leave until the facility supervisor provides confirmation that their backup systems have been properly shut down prior to receiving the new parts. Only after all delivery confirmations and waiting periods are complete, return to Central Parts Depot for final inventory reconciliation and to await further deployment instructions.

instruction: Initiate operations at the North Loading Bay and retrieve a total of nineteen sealed seed crates. Begin by delivering seven seed crates to Soy Field Block C, then pause at Soy Field Block C until the agricultural technician confirms all crates are unloaded and removed. Proceed to Wheat Plot F with the next six seed crates and, upon arrival, wait while the logistics supervisor at Wheat Plot F removes every crate. Carry the remaining six seed crates to Orchard Zone Epsilon; if there are surplus seed crates left after distributing evenly, ensure that the extra crate is left at Orchard Zone Epsilon along with the regular allocation. Once staff at Orchard Zone Epsilon have completed removal, pause for two minutes to allow field inspection. After all seed crates have been distributed and confirmed removed at every location, navigate to the South Maintenance Garage and remain there for ten minutes prior to initiating any return trip to the North Loading Bay for debrief and resupply procedures.

Start by moving to the Packing Plant Receiving Area and collect a total of thirteen boxed engine components. Next, travel to Loading Dock One and deposit four boxed engine components, waiting until you are notified that the dock crew has finished documenting their arrival before proceeding. Then, continue to Loading Dock Two and deliver another four boxed engine components, but remain there for three minutes to allow the conveyor system to clear before moving on. Afterward, head to Loading Dock Three to distribute four additional boxed engine components, and wait until the station manager confirms the removal of all boxes from your carrier. Finally, take the thirteenth and last boxed engine component to the Quality Inspection Bay, remaining at the bay for two minutes so the inspection team has sufficient time to perform their preliminary checks; only then may you return directly to the Packing Plant Receiving Area to conclude your assigned route.

Begin by traveling to Container Depot C at the central yard to collect eighteen seedling trays labeled 'Spring Lot 7', confirming tray integrity before departing the depot. Divide the eighteen trays evenly among Greenhouse 2, Propagation Shed 1, and Horticultural Lab West: specifically, deliver six trays to Greenhouse 2 and wait until nursery personnel have finished removing all trays from the delivery platform before proceeding. Next, bring another six trays to Propagation Shed 1, but upon arrival, pause for five minutes to allow staff members to sanitize the shelving unit before transferring the trays. After delivering the trays and awaiting their full removal, transport the final six trays to Horticultural Lab West, ensuring that any accidental excess or shortfall resulting from previous removals is included with this last delivery; at Horticultural Lab West, wait for a technician's signal confirming receipt of all remaining seedling trays. Only after all trays have been delivered and removed at each destination should you return directly to Container Depot C, where you must wait for ten minutes outside the loading bay as a safety inspection is performed before concluding the assignment.

instruction.location: Container Depot C at the central yard
Container Depot C at the central yard

instruction: Initiate the operation at Cold Storage Bay Alpha, where you will receive a consignment of fifteen fresh produce crates prepared for local distribution. Begin by transporting six crates to Farmers’ Market Loading Dock and wait at the dock until the market staff have completed the removal and verification process for each of the six crates. Once all six crates are confirmed as received, proceed to Hospital Cafeteria Receiving and deliver another five crates; remain in the cafeteria's service area for three minutes to allow dietary personnel to inspect and record each new delivery. Following this, carry the remaining four crates to School Kitchen Entrance, but do not leave immediately—wait until the kitchen supervisor has individually collected all four crates from your payload compartment. After every crate has been delivered and acknowledged at their designated sites, route yourself to Vehicle Maintenance Hangar and stand by for eight minutes while your cargo hold is sanitized and restocked by maintenance staff before returning to Cold Storage Bay Alpha to close out the assignment.

Begin at Maintenance Depot Alpha to load twelve harvest tool kits, confirming that each kit is complete and contains no damaged parts. Transport four tool kits to Vineyard Hill South and remain on-site while the vineyard technician inspects and removes each tool kit individually, ensuring every inspection has occurred before departing. Next, bring five of the remaining tool kits to Orchard Service Bay West, but after arriving, wait for three minutes prior to drop-off so the service crew can prepare their work zone; deliver the tool kits only when the crew gives explicit clearance. For the final three tool kits, proceed to Crop Research Laboratory Delta, making sure to arrive after all prior deliveries are documented and confirmed received; do not unload the last kits until the laboratory supervisor has verified that completion forms from Vineyard Hill South and Orchard Service Bay West are archived. Finally, upon finishing at the Crop Research Laboratory Delta, head back to Maintenance Depot Alpha and remain there for five minutes, enabling maintenance personnel to inspect your vehicle for tool kit residue or remaining inventory.

Begin your route at the Central Maintenance Garage and confirm that the four replacement hydraulic pumps are fully loaded and secured onto the robot platform. Once all pumps are in place, travel first to Assembly Line A in the Production Hall and deliver one hydraulic pump; wait for maintenance personnel to completely remove the pump and signal completion before proceeding. Next, move to Assembly Line B and deliver another hydraulic pump, but after unloading, remain at Assembly Line B for five minutes to allow engineers to perform compatibility checks before leaving. Following this, continue to Assembly Line C and transfer a single hydraulic pump, waiting until it is fully accepted by the technical staff. Bring the final replacement hydraulic pump to Equipment Calibration Bay, hand it over to the calibration specialist, and wait for confirmation that the transfer is finished. Only after all four hydraulic pumps have been distributed to their designated locations, with each removal and required waiting period completed, should you return to the Central Maintenance Garage to conclude the delivery route.

instruction.location: Assembly Line A in the Production Hall
Assembly Line A in the Production Hall

instruction: Start your route at the Seed Storage Silo and load nine genetically tagged seed trays onto the transport platform. Distribute these trays as follows: deliver four trays to Field Plot Delta, three trays to the South Meadow Planter Hub, and allocate the remaining two trays to the Experimental Hydroponic Tunnel, ensuring none of the destinations are skipped. For each delivery location, do not begin offloading until a site-specific sensor confirms that the receiving bay is unoccupied; if the bay is currently occupied, wait at the site for 180 seconds and re-check sensor status before attempting delivery again. Once all seed trays have been delivered and removal acknowledged by local staff at each destination, proceed directly to the Machinery Maintenance Annex and remain there for 300 seconds to allow system diagnostics to complete before heading back to the Seed Storage Silo for possible additional tasks.

Start at the Central Storage Depot and retrieve a set of thirteen calibrated drone batteries. First, go to Drone Hangar Alpha and transfer five batteries, confirming that the maintenance crew at Drone Hangar Alpha has collected every battery before departure. Next, deliver four drone batteries to Charging Station Delta, but wait at Charging Station Delta until the technician completes the battery swap and signals readiness. Transport the last four batteries to Mobile Patrol Unit Outpost; do not leave Mobile Patrol Unit Outpost until all batteries have been unloaded and acknowledged by the outpost supervisor. After batteries have been distributed to all three destinations and removal has been confirmed at each, remain at Mobile Patrol Unit Outpost for four minutes to allow post-transfer diagnostics to complete before you proceed to Battery Recycling Hub for end-of-mission power cell recycling operations.

Start at the Parts Storage Facility and pick up a tray containing 22 replacement air filters designated for three separate tractor sheds: North Shed, East Shed, and West Shed. First, deliver 7 air filters to North Shed, and remain on-site until the equipment supervisor confirms that all filters have been offloaded. Proceed to East Shed with the next 7 air filters, waiting there for four minutes before unloading to allow the staff to complete their inventory check, then wait until all filters are removed. With the remaining 8 air filters, continue to West Shed, distribute 7 filters, and wait until the receiving mechanic retrieves them; finally, deliver the last air filter from the tray to West Shed as well and wait for its pickup. After all sheds have received their allotted air filters, proceed to the Central Wash Bay and wait five minutes to allow a cleaning cycle before concluding the route at the Parts Storage Facility.

Begin at the Feed Distribution Hub and load a total of nineteen high-nutrient feed sacks onto the cargo bay. First, deliver seven feed sacks to Barn 1, ensuring that all seven are unloaded and the barn manager has acknowledged receipt of the full allocation before proceeding further. Next, transport six feed sacks to Goat Shed C, but wait for a full three minutes after arrival to allow for feed storage preparation before initiating the offload process. Once offload is complete at Goat Shed C, move directly to Cow Enclosure 5 with the remaining six feed sacks; however, distribute only five feed sacks here, and after receiving confirmation from the enclosure supervisor, transport the final single feed sack to Poultry Zone South. Do not finalize your delivery cycle or depart from Poultry Zone South until the poultry caretaker confirms the removal of the last remaining feed sack, and then return to the Feed Distribution Hub to await the next assignment.

Arrive at Fertilizer Storage Shed 4 to collect a total of thirteen drums of liquid nitrogen fertilizer, confirming that all drums are properly secured before departing. Divide these drums as evenly as possible between Field Zone North, Field Zone East, and Field Zone South: transport four drums to Field Zone North and remain there until the field technicians have removed all four drums from your cargo bay; next, deliver another four drums to Field Zone East, again waiting onsite for unloading completion. Move on to Field Zone South with the remaining five drums and stay until every drum has been offloaded and accounted for. After you have finished distributing all drums, proceed directly to the Central Wash Station and initiate a mandatory cleaning cycle, waiting at least 5 minutes to ensure decontamination is completed before returning to Fertilizer Storage Shed 4 for further assignment updates.

Begin at the Central Seed Vault and carefully load nine sealed containers of experimental wheat seeds, confirming that each container’s identifier matches its designated research plot. Your first destination is Field Plot A, where you must deliver and await the removal of four seed containers by the agronomist assigned to the site. After the handover at Field Plot A is verified as complete, wait ten minutes for environmental stability checks before proceeding to the next site. Next, navigate to Field Plot B to transfer three seed containers to the on-site technician, remaining stationary until all three containers have been acknowledged as received. Following this, transport the final two seed containers to Field Plot C, where the research coordinator will retrieve them; do not move on until both containers have been taken. Once all deliveries are concluded, return directly to the Central Seed Vault, remain there for seven minutes to allow for decontamination processes, and await final clearance instructions from the facility supervisor.

instruction: Starting from the Central Storage Hangar, retrieve a crate of fast-germinating carrot seeds containing 23 individual seed packets. Transport this crate to the Silo Distribution Yard, where you must divide the seed packets as follows: deliver 7 packets to Greenhouse Alpha, 7 packets to Greenhouse Beta, and 7 packets to Orchard Plot Gamma, handing off exactly 2 remaining packets to the Field Supervisor's Mobile Office for late-season planting. After you complete the last packet drop-off, wait at the Field Supervisor's Mobile Office for precisely 6 minutes to allow for documentation and confirmation of all deliveries. Once the wait is over, return to the Central Storage Hangar to receive your next dispatch instructions, ensuring all locations received their correct seed allocation before departing.

instruction: Start by collecting nine maintenance kits from Warehouse 3, then proceed to Maintenance Bay Alpha and deliver three maintenance kits, pausing at Bay Alpha until each kit has been fully unloaded. After this is complete, head to Maintenance Bay Gamma and similarly unload three maintenance kits, but after unloading, wait at least 120 seconds to give technicians time to verify receipt of all maintenance kits. Next, deliver the remaining three maintenance kits to Maintenance Bay Delta; however, if the handover at Gamma is delayed or incomplete, reroute directly to Warehouse 3 and suspend further deliveries until you receive explicit clearance. Once all deliveries and confirmations at Alpha, Gamma, and Delta have been successfully completed, return to Warehouse 3 and remain on standby for any additional maintenance requests.

Commence at the Vineyard Equipment Shed, picking up nine irrigation sensor units destined for installation across three monitored grape fields. Travel first to Grape Field Alpha and drop off three sensor units; wait until the field technician has removed each sensor before traveling onward. Proceed to Grape Field Beta where another three sensor units must be delivered, again waiting on the technician to remove all before departing. The remaining three sensors are to be brought to Grape Field Gamma, and after all three have been taken by the technician, remain at Field Gamma for a five-minute interval to allow post-deployment calibration. Only upon completion of this rest period should you proceed to the Eastern Maintenance Hangar for end-of-mission inspection and reporting.

Start by navigating to Storage Depot 3 and collecting a batch of 17 engine coolant drums, making sure all drums are properly loaded before moving. Transport 5 drums to Maintenance Workshop A and remain on-site for 4 minutes so that technicians can prepare their refilling equipment. After the 4-minute wait and only once Workshop A technicians have finished unloading their 5 drums, proceed with 6 drums to the Agricultural Machinery Service Bay; upon arrival, wait for confirmation from the lead engineer that the delivery is accepted before continuing. Take the remaining 6 drums to the North Field Equipment Shed, but do not leave this location until a field supervisor is present to remove all 6 drums and provides verbal confirmation of receipt. When all coolant drums have been delivered and each requisite confirmation or wait interval has been observed, return to Storage Depot 3 and remain available for your next assignment.

Commence your route at the Central Seed Repository and collect an order consisting of fifteen bulk seed bags along with a diagnostic toolkit. Deliver the diagnostic toolkit first to Maintenance Bay 12 and remain on-site until the maintenance engineer confirms receipt and initiates a system check, which will signal when you may proceed. Next, partition the fifteen seed bags for delivery to Field Plot A, Field Plot B, and the East Ridge Seed Hopper: distribute six seed bags to Field Plot A and five to Field Plot B, unloading the specified quantity at each plot and waiting there until the assigned crew member at each location acknowledges full transfer. Transport the remaining four seed bags to the East Ridge Seed Hopper, unloading them while waiting 120 seconds for the automated loader to properly integrate the new seed stock. Only after confirmation from all three drop points that the deliveries are complete should you return directly to the Central Seed Repository, ensuring your cargo compartment is empty and ready for reassignment.

Initiate your route from the Feed Depot, collecting the bulk bag of grain mixture and three sacks of protein supplement. Proceed first to Cattle Pen A, deliver one sack of protein supplement, and remain until the pen supervisor confirms the unloading is complete. Afterward, head to Cattle Pen B to drop off the second sack, again waiting until you receive the supervisor’s acknowledgment. Continue to Cattle Pen C with the third and final protein supplement sack, staying until removal has been confirmed. Once all protein supplements have been distributed, navigate to the Central Silo; after arrival, wait five minutes to allow grain augers to become available, then transfer the bulk bag of grain mixture into the silo’s input hopper. As soon as the unloading process is finished and the area is clear, return to the Feed Depot and await further instructions.

Start at Storage Depot Delta and secure a bundle containing eight irrigation valves. Make your first delivery at Field Section South; transfer three irrigation valves there, and remain until the field supervisor confirms all three valves have been collected. Once this is accomplished, head over to Crop Research Lab, deliver another three irrigation valves, and wait for scientists to pick up these components completely. After both Field Section South and Crop Research Lab have received their allotted irrigation valves, proceed to Water Pump Station to drop off the final two irrigation valves, and wait on site until the pump technician has finished removing the last valve from your cargo. Following successful completion and confirmation of all three deliveries, continue to the Equipment Calibration Hangar and remain there for a period of 10 minutes before departing, in case additional calibration parts need unloading. Do not depart the Equipment Calibration Hangar until the entire waiting time has elapsed.

Start at Maintenance Depot B and pick up six replacement hydraulic pressure filters, ensuring each filter barcode matches the scheduled maintenance manifest. Transport three of these filters to Service Bay 1, where you must wait until the bay technician completes retrieval of all three filters before continuing. After this pickup is confirmed, remain on-site at Service Bay 1 for five minutes to accommodate a required safety system recalibration. Next, head to Storage Shed Zeta with two hydraulic pressure filters and wait there until both filters are removed by the inventory manager. Once the exchange at Storage Shed Zeta is finished, deliver the final filter to the Far East Equipment Pad, staying at the pad until the maintenance chief signs off on removal. After completing all deliveries, travel directly back to Maintenance Depot B to prepare for the next maintenance round.

Start from Maintenance Garage 2 and retrieve nine replacement hydraulic filters earmarked for field equipment servicing. Proceed to Tractor Depot Alpha and deliver three hydraulic filters, but wait at the depot for seven minutes to allow technicians to install the filters and confirm successful installation via the maintenance terminal. After receiving confirmation, move to Harvesting Zone West with another three hydraulic filters; deliver them and remain at the edge of the field until a designated field engineer removes the last filter from your cargo before departing. Deliver the final three hydraulic filters to Combine Shed Delta, but do not initiate unloading until you receive notification from Harvesting Zone West that their delivery is complete—if this confirmation is not received, continue waiting at the entrance of Combine Shed Delta. Once all filters are distributed and unloaded according to these dependencies, return to Maintenance Garage 2 to conclude the service cycle.

instruction: Start at the Central Seed Storage facility and load a container holding eleven premium seed packets scheduled for distribution. Navigate first to Nursery Plot One and deliver four seed packets there, but do not depart the plot until a horticulturist signals that the seed loading is complete. Next, travel to Greenhouse Row B and distribute another four seed packets, waiting for three minutes after arrival to allow greenhouse staff to prepare the planting trays. After the waiting period and successful confirmation of the delivery, proceed to Experimental Plot Gamma and allocate the remaining three seed packets. You must remain at Experimental Plot Gamma until the research team has verified proper receipt of the seeds. Only after all eleven premium seed packets are accounted for at their respective locations, with each step contingent upon the previous delivery or confirmation, return to Central Seed Storage to finish the distribution run.

instruction: Start at Maintenance Bay Delta and pick up twelve replacement filter cartridges clearly labeled for greenhouse use, confirming that each one has passed quality control before moving on. Deliver four filters first to Environmental Control Room Epsilon, remaining there until facility staff members have completed removing all four cartridges and signaling their readiness for installation. Next, proceed to Greenhouse Omega and supply another four cartridges, but after arrival you must wait on-site for three minutes to allow for the completion of airlock decontamination procedures before making the transfer; upon transfer, wait further until a greenhouse technician confirms via removal acknowledgment. Finally, head to Storage Locker Zeta with the last four cartridges; if, and only if, the total number of cartridges successfully removed at the previous two sites was less than eight due to any discrepancies, adjust and deliver all remaining cartridges to Locker Zeta, confirming with the inventory supervisor that each unit is removed. Once all deliveries are completed and each batch is formally removed at their respective locations, return immediately to Maintenance Bay Delta and wait for two minutes to sync updated delivery logs with the central system before requesting new tasks.

instruction: Begin at the Agricultural Equipment Shed and collect a shipment of eleven freshly serviced irrigation valves. These valves must be delivered in batches to three separate field outposts: East Field Drop Point, North Slope Station, and West Terrace Depot. Allocate four valves to East Field Drop Point, three valves to North Slope Station, and deliver the remaining four valves to West Terrace Depot; if at any point the batch cannot be divided evenly, ensure North Slope Station receives the fewer units. After unloading the designated valves at each location, wait for the on-site technician to signal that the valves are ready for removal before proceeding. Display patience at West Terrace Depot by remaining stationary for six minutes after the technician’s confirmation to allow system calibration to finish before returning to the Agricultural Equipment Shed, thus concluding the delivery route.

Begin at the Parts Receiving Dock and collect a shipment containing twelve hydraulic actuator cylinders. Proceed to the Heavy Equipment Repair Zone and distribute four cylinders there, waiting until each cylinder has been acknowledged and removed by the repair technician. Then, transport another four cylinders to the Automated Forklift Maintenance Station and wait until the maintenance chief confirms the cylinders have been unloaded. Next, deliver the final four cylinders to the Spare Parts Storage Bay and remain there for 5 minutes to allow for parts inventory processing. After completing the 5-minute wait, travel to the Operations Control Office only if technicians at both the Heavy Equipment Repair Zone and the Forklift Maintenance Station have issued confirmation receipts. Upon arrival at the Operations Control Office, wait for notification that all hydraulic actuator drop-offs have been successfully logged in the system before leaving for your next scheduled task.

Begin at Warehouse Dock 2 and wait until a batch of nine replacement battery packs is ready for loading. Once the battery packs have been secured, transport three battery packs to Maintenance Bay Alpha, where you must remain until all three battery packs have been retrieved by the onsite technician. Following this, deliver three more battery packs to Maintenance Bay Beta, waiting there for the battery packs to be fully unloaded before proceeding. With the final three battery packs still aboard, proceed to Charging Station Central, but pause for 4 minutes before allowing offloading to commence, giving station personnel time to prepare the facility. After all battery packs have been delivered and removed from the robot at Charging Station Central, travel to Recycling Center 1; upon arrival, wait for 7 minutes for a final inspection and waste bin collection process before finally returning to Warehouse Dock 2 to complete the assignment.

Begin your route at the North Seed Storage Facility and collect a shipment of fifteen bags of certified wheat seeds. Distribute five bags to Sowing Field Alpha, then continue to Sowing Field Beta to allocate another five bags, waiting at each field until the field supervisor verifies removal of all seed bags. With the remaining five bags, deliver two to Sowing Field Gamma and three to Sowing Field Delta, explicitly confirming with the respective supervisors that all assigned bags have been collected before you leave each field. Once all fields have received the correct number of seed bags, proceed to the Farm Equipment Shed and remain there for three minutes to complete a system calibration check, only returning to the North Seed Storage Facility after the calibration wait has finished.

Begin at Equipment Storage Area B and retrieve a shipment consisting of seven replacement hydraulic filters, confirming that all seven filters are secured before leaving. Proceed first to Greenhouse Alpha and deliver two hydraulic filters to the maintenance supervisor, waiting at the drop-off point until both have been acknowledged and accepted. Next, travel to Harvesting Shed Delta to deliver three hydraulic filters; after arrival, actual unloading of the filters may only begin once the plant operator indicates readiness, so remain at Harvesting Shed Delta until the signal is received, then ensure all three filters are transferred before departing. From there, go to Tractor Repair Bay and supply the remaining two hydraulic filters directly to the lead mechanic, waiting until both have been physically removed from your payload. Once the final delivery is complete and all filters have been distributed among their destinations, move to the Logistics Office, pause for exactly ten minutes to allow for paperwork processing, and, after the wait, return to Equipment Storage Area B to finalize the assignment.

Start at Crop Storage Barn 4 and wait until a shipment of twelve seedling trays labeled 'Spring Wheat' is ready for transport. Once the seedling trays are available, take four trays directly to Greenhouse 1, remaining at Greenhouse 1 until the on-site horticulturist confirms all four trays have been unloaded. Next, deliver another four seedling trays to Greenhouse 2; after those trays have been fully removed by greenhouse staff, wait an additional five minutes at Greenhouse 2 to allow for soil preparation activities. Proceed to Greenhouse 3 with the final four seedling trays and wait at Greenhouse 3 for staff to complete the unloading process. Once all trays have been delivered to the three greenhouses and unloading confirmations are received, return promptly to Crop Storage Barn 4, ensuring the division and delivery of seedling trays across all three greenhouses occurs without delay or misallocation and that all waiting times and sequential handoffs are fully observed.

Begin by traveling to the Harvest Depot near Silo 3 to collect a shipment of twenty fresh produce crates labeled for redistribution. Next, head to Market Loading Dock West and offload seven of the produce crates, waiting until a dock operator signals that all crates have been moved onto the transport ramp. Afterwards, proceed to Cold Storage Facility South, where you should deliver eight more produce crates; remain at the Cold Storage Facility South for five minutes while their cooling system runs an intake cycle for quality assurance. Then, transport the remaining five crates to the Neighborhood Food Pantry Auxiliary Building, but do not attempt delivery until confirmation is received from Cold Storage Facility South that their intake cycle is complete. Upon arrival at the Neighborhood Food Pantry Auxiliary Building, unload the last five crates and wait on site for a staff member to provide verbal acknowledgment of receipt. After all produce crates have been distributed and verified at their destinations, return promptly to the Harvest Depot near Silo 3 to log route completion and prepare for the next assignment.

instruction: Start from Charging Station Alpha and collect a total of seven soil nutrient sampling kits. First, proceed to Field Plot North and deliver three sampling kits to the agronomy technician stationed at the edge of the crop rows, staying until each kit has been individually acknowledged as received. Next, visit Field Plot East and supply two sampling kits to the lead botanist, waiting for confirmation of readiness before departing. Then, travel to Field Plot South and provide the remaining two sampling kits to the research coordinator; remain at Field Plot South for ten minutes to support any urgent resupply requests. Once all nutrient sampling kits are distributed and each drop-off and waiting period is completed, return to Charging Station Alpha to report the end of the distribution round.

Begin at Maintenance Bay Two and collect a set of twelve replacement hydraulic filters. Distribute these filters among three target locations as follows: deliver five filters to Tractor Shed (West), four filters to Combine Harvester Garage, and the remaining three filters to Equipment Lot North, ensuring that all filters are correctly matched to their respective equipment types during each stop. Make the initial delivery to Tractor Shed (West) and wait until the on-site mechanic has completed removal of all five used filters from the tractors. After confirmation that the old filters have been removed at Tractor Shed (West), proceed to the Combine Harvester Garage and transfer four new filters, remaining at the garage until each filter is received and logged into inventory. Once the transaction at the garage has finished, pause operations at this site for eight minutes to allow for post-installation equipment diagnostics before departing. Following the waiting period, transport the final three hydraulic filters to Equipment Lot North and wait until the field technician has verified receipt and installation readiness. Once all twelve filters have been distributed, all dependencies completed, and post-installation checks concluded, return to Maintenance Bay Two and prepare for the next batch of maintenance deliveries.

Start your shift at Parts Depot 2 and load ten high-temperature-resistant gearbox components onto the payload rack. Your first destination is Maintenance Bay 1, where you must deliver three gearbox components and wait until the on-site technician confirms full removal of the components from your rack. After this verification, continue to Maintenance Bay 3 to offload another three components, again remaining at the bay until the technician there completes their removal affirmation. Next, proceed to Maintenance Bay 5 to supply another three gearbox components, following the same protocol and waiting for explicit confirmation that all components have been unloaded. Transport the final remaining gearbox component to the Prototype Testing Lab, but before entering, pause for 2 minutes outside the lab to allow the testing crew to prepare their receiving station. Only after this waiting period should you proceed inside and await confirmation of successful transfer. Once all payloads have reached their respective destinations and removals have been confirmed, return directly to Parts Depot 2 to await further assignment.

Commence operations at Bulk Seed Storage Facility where you will load a pallet containing sixteen high-yield rye seed bags for distribution to three planting fields. First, deliver five seed bags to Field Alpha and remain at Field Alpha until the on-site planting manager verifies the storage bin has received all five bags and sends confirmation. After verification, proceed to Field Beta to deliver another five seed bags; upon arrival at Field Beta, wait for two minutes to allow dust suppression measures to take effect before unloading the bags, ensuring Field Beta also confirms all five bags have been properly received. For the remaining six seed bags, travel next to Field Gamma; however, if either Field Alpha or Field Beta reports an incomplete or delayed delivery via automated status update, divert instead to the Maintenance Shed for four minutes of system diagnostics before attempting delivery to Field Gamma again. Once all seed bags have been successfully transferred to the respective fields and every confirmation has been received, return directly to Bulk Seed Storage Facility for routine cleaning and to await restocking orders.

Start at Loading Dock Bravo and await the preparation of nine sealed reagent crates designated for the chemical processing line, ensuring all labels are visible before departure. Transport three crates at a time to Quality Testing Lab Sigma, Process Reactor Hall Gamma, and Supply Depot Theta in separate back-to-back trips, following this distribution order exactly; after each delivery, remain at the drop-off site for four minutes to allow on-site staff to inspect and remove the crates, only departing once all crates for that destination have been confirmed removed and the area cleared. If at any location staff are unable to remove all allocated reagent crates within the four-minute window, record the number of crates left and, after your final scheduled drop at Supply Depot Theta, return to each affected site in the original delivery order to offer a second removal window—waiting an additional two minutes at each such site for any remaining crates to be retrieved. Once all reagent crates have been accounted for and removed at every site, proceed directly to Waste Management Bay Epsilon for end-of-shift sanitation procedures before returning to Loading Dock Bravo to stand by for evening instructions.
