instruction: Start at Storage Dock A and pick up a batch of fourteen packaged soil analysis kits, then travel first to Field Office East to deliver five of the kits, waiting until the field supervisor at Field Office East has finished documenting their receipt before leaving. Once documentation is complete, proceed to Crop Plot Gamma to distribute four soil analysis kits, staying at Crop Plot Gamma for exactly seven minutes while researchers prepare the soil samples for collection, and ensuring that any unused kits are properly accounted for. After this seven-minute interval, head next to Irrigation Control Room South with the remaining five kits, deliver them, and wait for confirmation from the irrigation manager that all kits have been safely stored. Only after receiving this confirmation should you return to Storage Dock A to report completion of the soil kit distribution round and await further instructions for subsequent tasks.

object.description: confirmation that all kits have been safely stored

instruction: Start your mission at Maintenance Bay Alpha by loading eight new hydraulic filters onto the transport platform. Next, deliver three filters to Harvest Tractor Station 2 and remain there until the maintenance lead removes all three filters and gives a clearance signal. Afterward, proceed to Irrigation Pump Shed B with three additional filters, but before unloading, wait for five minutes to allow technicians to power down the equipment safely; only then begin the offloading process. Once the filters are removed at Shed B, take the remaining two filters to Combine Harvester Storage Lot, ensuring that the storage manager has collected both filters before moving on. Following your final filter drop at the Storage Lot, remain at that location for a full ten minutes to cover emergent maintenance part requests. Do not return to Maintenance Bay Alpha until the full ten-minute interval has elapsed and all filters have been accounted for according to each site’s allocation.

Start your route at the Chemical Supply Depot by retrieving a shipment of 17 sealed fertilizer packs scheduled for allocation to three different crop fields: North Field, Central Field, and South Field. First, transport 6 fertilizer packs to North Field, waiting on site until the field supervisor has removed all 6 packs from your cargo bay. Next, continue to Central Field, where you will offload 6 additional fertilizer packs, then remain at Central Field for three minutes to allow the irrigation crew to inspect the delivery area. After the inspection wait, move on to South Field and deliver the final 5 fertilizer packs; be sure to stay until all packs have been collected by the field technician. Once South Field has been serviced, proceed to the Farm Control Center, but only depart if each field has received its fertilizer packs and you are fully empty. Upon arrival at the Farm Control Center, wait for ten minutes to allow agricultural managers to log delivery completion before moving to your standby location at the Equipment Garage.

Begin your operation at the Harvest Loading Zone, where twelve crates of fresh vegetables have been staged for transfer. Load all twelve crates, then proceed directly to Packaging Station Alpha and deliver five crates; after delivery, remain at Packaging Station Alpha for two minutes to allow packaging staff to inspect and sign off on the delivery. Once this is complete, transport another four crates to Sorting Facility Beta, but do not leave until staff at Sorting Facility Beta have marked the crates as received and have prepared your cargo platform for the final leg. Move the last three crates to Refrigerated Storage Unit Delta, waiting on-site until the system operator has removed all three crates and logged the transfer. After delivering to all three destinations and only after the final crate has been logged at Refrigerated Storage Unit Delta, proceed to the Maintenance Bay for debriefing and equipment inspection, remaining there until cleared by the maintenance supervisor.

Begin your operation at Processing Station Alpha by collecting twelve vacuum-sealed protein packages. Evenly allocate these packages among Freezer Bay 1, Freezer Bay 2, and Freezer Bay 3 by transferring four packages to each bay in separate trips, ensuring each batch is delivered only after the prior bay's confirmation that their cooling systems are stable and ready for new storage. For every freezer bay, after you have finished delivery and staff have removed all four protein packages, pause at the loading area for 90 seconds to allow for data recording before heading to the next destination. Once the deliveries to all three freezer bays are complete and pauses observed, proceed directly to Sanitation Chamber C, wait there for a continuous eight-minute sanitation cycle to finish, and do not return to Processing Station Alpha until the full sanitation timer has elapsed.

object.description: stable and ready cooling system confirmation
stable and ready cooling system confirmation
stable and ready cooling system confirmation

instruction: Begin at Grain Silo Central, where you will be tasked with collecting fourteen seed bins for distribution. Evenly allocate four seed bins each to Soybean Field 7, Corn Field 3, and Barley Plot East, addressing the total of twelve bins; deliver the remaining two seed bins to Wheat Test Plot 5. For each destination, after arriving and before unloading a seed bin, you must wait for the field supervisor at that location to confirm the planting machinery is ready to receive seeds; this may involve waiting additional time if a supervisor indicates a delay, and you must not proceed until explicit approval is given. Once all bins are dropped off and accepted at the four respective sites, return to Grain Silo Central, but pause for five minutes at Wheat Test Plot 5 before departure to allow the test plot data logger to synchronize its inventory records, ensuring all handovers have been digitally logged before concluding your mission.

Begin your route at Storage Depot West and retrieve a shipment of nine diagnostic sensor modules. First, head to Quality Control Lab A, where you are to deliver three sensor modules to the quality inspection bench; once there, wait until the laboratory technician verifies and removes all three sensor modules from your cargo. Next, proceed with the remaining six sensor modules to Assembly Zone Delta. At Assembly Zone Delta, allocate two sensor modules to each of the following areas: Robotic Arm Station, Conveyor Integration Station, and Calibration Booth, ensuring that all stations receive their modules sequentially. For every station, after delivering the assigned two sensor modules, wait ten minutes on site to allow on-site staff to complete immediate setup and provide acknowledgement before moving to the next station. Once all six sensor modules are distributed and confirmed received at the three Assembly Zone Delta stations, return to Storage Depot West, but if at any point a station is not ready for delivery, remain at the current location until explicit staff authorization is communicated before proceeding to the next drop-off.

instruction: Begin at Maintenance Bay 2 and await readiness notification for a set of six diagnostic toolkits to be deployed for scheduled preventative inspections. As soon as the toolkits are available, transport two toolkits first to Pump Station Alpha and wait until the maintenance team confirms complete removal of both toolkits. Afterward, proceed to Generator Control Room with two additional diagnostic toolkits and remain there for three minutes, allowing the technicians to prepare their work zone before confirming complete removal of the toolkits. Next, deliver the remaining two toolkits to Cooling Tower Access Level, but only after verification that the toolkits have been removed from Generator Control Room. Upon arrival at Cooling Tower Access Level, wait until the onsite crew finishes unloading both toolkits, then return directly to Maintenance Bay 2. Ensure that each toolkit pair is delivered sequentially, that all required waiting periods and confirmations from recipient teams are observed at each step, and that movement to each subsequent location is dependent upon full removal of the previous delivery.

Begin your route by traveling to the Chemical Storage Facility and collecting a total of seven sealed pesticide canisters. Next, proceed to Greenhouse One and deliver three pesticide canisters, remaining at the greenhouse until the safety officer confirms all three canisters have been safely unloaded. After receiving confirmation, move on to Greenhouse Two and offload another two pesticide canisters, but wait at this location for four minutes to allow the greenhouse staff to complete their mandatory ventilation procedures. Then, transport the remaining two pesticide canisters to Greenhouse Three, where you should stay until the facility manager notifies you that all canisters have been removed from your cargo. Once all pesticide canisters have been delivered and confirmation has been received from each greenhouse, return directly to the Chemical Storage Facility; upon arrival, wait for two additional minutes before concluding your assignment, to ensure that any post-mission decontamination process can be initiated if necessary.

Begin your task at Tractor Depot 2 and collect a set of fifteen seed dispersal canisters intended for distribution across three agricultural fields: Crop Field Alpha, Crop Field Beta, and Orchard Plot Zeta. Allocate five seed dispersal canisters to each field, but if any canisters remain due to unexpected shortages, ensure that all surplus canisters—if any—are brought to Equipment Shed Lambda at the end. Start by proceeding to Crop Field Alpha and deliver five seed dispersal canisters, remaining on site for two minutes to verify that the field technician acknowledges completed placement before continuing. Next, travel to Crop Field Beta with the next batch of five canisters and, after drop-off, wait for three full minutes to grant the irrigation crew leader time to finish setup and confirm readiness for seeding. Then, deliver the last five canisters to Orchard Plot Zeta, where you must wait patiently until the orchard steward collects the canisters and signals removal is complete. Only once you have explicit confirmation from each location that their seed dispersal canisters have been received and removed should you proceed to Equipment Shed Lambda with any leftover canisters, if applicable. After ensuring all deliveries are complete and excess canisters are stowed at Equipment Shed Lambda, return immediately to Tractor Depot 2 to await further assignment.

Begin your route at Central Parts Storage where 17 harvested crop sample crates require distribution. Once all 17 sample crates have been confirmed as ready for loading, your first stop is Testing Lab A; deliver 6 sample crates there and wait until the lab technician verifies and removes each crate before proceeding. Next, transport 5 sample crates to Quality Control Station South, but before unloading, remain at the station for a two-minute decontamination period as mandated by safety protocols. After the wait, permit the Quality Control team to remove the 5 crates one at a time. Finally, take the remaining 6 sample crates to the Research Silo; upon arrival, deliver 3 sample crates immediately and then pause on site for a four-minute analytical preparation interval before handing over the last 3 crates for removal by research staff. After ensuring that all 17 crop sample crates have been fully distributed and accounted for, return to Central Parts Storage to conclude your delivery sequence.

Start at the automated fertilizer depot located adjacent to the East Tractor Garage, where you must load ten standard fertilizer drums onto your transport. Your first task is to deliver three fertilizer drums to the South Wheat Plot, waiting at the field's access gate until the field technician confirms removal of all three drums. Once confirmation is received, continue to the North Greenhouse Station to offload four more fertilizer drums, and after unloading, wait at the station for exactly three minutes to allow for ventilation procedures to complete. Following the elapsed time, transport the remaining three fertilizer drums to the West Corn Field. However, if you detect that the prior ventilation procedure at the North Greenhouse Station was interrupted or incomplete, divert to the Emergency Response Bay for immediate reporting and stay there until a supervisor authorizes continuation. After successfully completing all deliveries and verifying that every fertilizer drum has been removed, return to the East Tractor Garage and wait for further instructions.

instruction.location: automated fertilizer depot located adjacent to the East Tractor Garage
automated fertilizer depot located adjacent to the East Tractor Garage

instruction: Begin at the Battery Charging Station and collect a total of twelve sensor calibration modules. Deliver four calibration modules each to the following locations in this order: Maintenance Bay 1, Equipment Storage Building, and the Southern Drone Hangar. At each destination, wait until the technical operator at that location signals that the calibration modules have been detached from the robot. Only after all twelve modules have been distributed, proceed to the Quality Assurance Laboratory, and remain there for a continuous duration of ten minutes to allow laboratory staff to verify successful deployment across all sites. Do not leave the Quality Assurance Laboratory or return to the Battery Charging Station until this waiting period has ended, and staff have confirmed that there are no missed modules or rejected deliveries.

object.description: confirmation that there are no missed modules or rejected deliveries

instruction: Begin at Storage Dock A where you must wait until a shipment of fourteen seed packets is ready for dispatch; once available, transport the seed packets to Field Plot East and deliver exactly five seed packets, pausing at Field Plot East until all five seed packets have been completely unloaded. After successful delivery at Field Plot East, continue immediately to Field Plot West and distribute four seed packets, waiting at the location until the full removal of the delivery is confirmed by the field supervisor. The remaining five seed packets should be transported to Greenhouse South; however, before proceeding, you must wait at Field Plot West for an additional 180 seconds to allow soil preparation activities to conclude at Greenhouse South. Once the 180-second interval has elapsed, go to Greenhouse South and wait until all five seed packets have been removed by the horticulture team. Only when delivery and removal verifications at each destination—Field Plot East, Field Plot West, and Greenhouse South—have been completed in the sequence described, return to Storage Dock A to be on standby for any urgent restocking orders or further distribution requests.

Initiate your route at Warehouse Zone 3 and wait until ten fertilizer sacks have been loaded and are declared ready for transfer. Your first assignment is to deliver four fertilizer sacks to Vegetable Plot Alpha; after arriving there, remain until a field technician has completed the full removal of all four sacks from your cargo. Following this, you are to proceed directly to Orchard Station and unload three fertilizer sacks, waiting onsite until the station assistant has confirmed receipt of each sack. Once both Vegetable Plot Alpha and Orchard Station have received their designated quantities, pause at Orchard Station for a mandatory five-minute interval to provide time for soil integration tests to commence at the next destination. After the five-minute delay, resume your journey to Compost Facility Gamma with the remaining three fertilizer sacks; upon arrival at Compost Facility Gamma, remain in place until the maintenance crew has finished completely offloading all sacks. Do not return to Warehouse Zone 3 until every single sack handoff and waiting period at each location—including the initial loading at the warehouse and the intermediate soil integration wait at Orchard Station—have been duly completed in the prescribed order.

Begin at the Supply Depot and load eight irrigation filter cartridges slated for routine replacement. First, drive to Pump Station East and install three cartridges, but do not depart until the local technician confirms the old filters have been removed and the new ones are properly seated. Once the Pump Station East operation is verified, proceed to Field Irrigation Hub North and deliver another three cartridges; after unloading, wait at the hub for five minutes to allow the irrigation crew to conduct a system flush before leaving the site. For the remaining two cartridges, proceed to Main Reservoir Access and remain there while the maintenance engineer removes both cartridges from your payload, documenting the completed transfer. Only when all eight cartridges have been individually replaced and confirmed at their respective locations should you return to the Supply Depot for end-of-shift logging and storage recharge.

instruction: Start at the Central Loading Dock and acquire a total of nine maintenance toolkits labelled for urgent repair use. Distribute these toolkits in rounds as follows: transport and deliver three toolkits to Wind Turbine Station 1, then proceed to Wind Turbine Station 2 with another three toolkits, and finally deliver the remaining three toolkits to Wind Turbine Station 3. At each station, do not depart until the on-site engineer confirms through a digital interface that the toolkits have been properly unloaded and inspected; specifically, after the toolkit handover at Wind Turbine Station 2, pause on site for an additional five minutes before heading to Wind Turbine Station 3, to give the maintenance crew sufficient time to clear the unloading area. Once all three stations have received their respective toolkits and confirmation has been recorded at each stop, return directly to the Central Loading Dock to complete your task cycle.

instruction: Begin the route at Loading Dock A and wait until fifteen sealed crates of harvested maize have been placed in your compartment and marked as ready by the dock supervisor. Once the crates are ready, transport five crates to Silo North and remain at Silo North until each of the five maize crates has been confirmed removed by the silo operator. After the removal is complete, travel to Silo East with another five crates, depositing them there and waiting until the Silo East supervisor verifies all five have been offloaded. With the remaining five crates, proceed to Silo South, but before starting the unloading process, pause at Silo South for three minutes to allow for fumigation protocols to finish. After the waiting period, complete the delivery by offloading the final five maize crates at Silo South, ensuring confirmation of crate removal by the staff. Following successful delivery and wait intervals at all three silos, immediately return to Loading Dock A to conclude the shift, regardless of whether the original supervisors are available upon your return.

Start your route at Equipment Shed Gamma and load a batch of nine replacement irrigation valves, confirming that each valve has passed the latest pressure test. First, transport three valves to Field Irrigation Junction North and wait until the irrigation supervisor verifies that all three valves are correctly identified before initiating transfer. After the supervisor finishes and all three valves have been removed, continue to Workshop 2A to deliver four more irrigation valves; upon arrival, remain idle for four minutes to allow technicians to clear workspace, and transfer the valves only when the head technician gives approval. For the final two irrigation valves, proceed to Greenhouse Bay East, ensuring you do not depart Workshop 2A until confirmation arrives that both Field Irrigation Junction North and Workshop 2A deliveries have been logged in the maintenance system. Upon successful drop-off and explicit acceptance by the greenhouse manager, wait for an additional three minutes at Greenhouse Bay East to allow for a post-delivery inspection. Finally, complete your round by returning to Equipment Shed Gamma and waiting five minutes to facilitate record updates and vehicle sanitation before ending the assignment.

Begin your route at Field Operations Center A, where you will collect a batch of eleven calibrated soil sensor modules needed for distributed deployment. Transport four soil sensor modules to Vineyard Edge Node West, placing them at the specified drop-off zone and stay on-site until the supervising agronomist removes all four modules from your payload. Once this step is complete, wait an additional three minutes at Vineyard Edge Node West to allow environmental stabilization before leaving. Next, deliver another four soil sensor modules to Remote Plot South; upon arrival, wait for the research assistant to complete retrieval of these four modules, then proceed only after receiving explicit handover clearance. Finally, carry the remaining three soil sensor modules to Greenhouse Service Gate 2 and remain there until the greenhouse manager confirms removal and verifies the module serial numbers. When all deliveries, removals, and required waiting intervals at each location are fully concluded, return promptly to Field Operations Center A to finalize the deployment report and prepare for secondary site assignment.

Begin at Material Depot South and secure a shipment of eleven high-capacity battery modules, confirming that each module matches the inventory manifest before leaving. Deliver five modules to Packing Station Omega, ensuring upon arrival that the station supervisor completes the required intake forms before you allow unloading; remain at Packing Station Omega until all five modules have been verified and removed. Once unloading is complete, make your way to Loading Dock 3 to deliver another four modules, but after your arrival you must wait eight minutes to permit completion of prior loading activities before beginning module transfer; only begin unloading upon receiving the explicit readiness signal from the dock foreman. After all four modules have been removed at Loading Dock 3, transport the remaining two battery modules to Assembly Line 6B, but do not depart from Loading Dock 3 until you receive confirmation that both prior deliveries—Packing Station Omega and Loading Dock 3—have been electronically logged in the central inventory system. At Assembly Line 6B, wait until all defect checks on the battery modules are completed and acknowledged by the assembly manager before releasing the final two modules. Once the last delivery is concluded and all modules have been properly distributed, proceed to the Service Corridor and remain stationary for a period of six minutes to enable system diagnostics and handover protocols before returning to Material Depot South to close out your assignment.

Begin your mission at Packaging Warehouse 2, where you are to load fifteen sealed vegetable crates designated for outbound shipping. Transport six crates directly to Dock 1 and remain at Dock 1 until the loading crew signals that all crates have been removed. After completion of this transfer, proceed to Dock 2 and deliver five more crates, waiting for three minutes to allow for automated weight verification before departing. For the remaining four crates, head to the Quality Control Lab situated adjacent to Dock 3, unload the four crates, and wait at the lab until every crate has been officially scanned by the inspection system. Only after all crates have been removed and each required waiting period at Dock 2 and the Quality Control Lab is finished should you return to Packaging Warehouse 2 and park at Bay Door 4 to complete your round.

instruction: Begin your operation at the Central Maintenance Bay and receive six diagnostic toolkits slated for deployment to Workshop A, Workshop B, and Workshop C. Transport two diagnostic toolkits to Workshop A located at the northern factory wing and, upon arrival, wait until both toolkits are collected and the technician confirms successful handoff has occurred. Proceed next to Workshop B, situated along the eastern machinery corridor, where you must deliver another two diagnostic toolkits and remain on site until all items are fully removed by the maintenance engineer. After both previous drops are explicitly confirmed, shuttle the last two diagnostic toolkits to Workshop C at the southern assembly annex, and after unloading, wait exactly four minutes so that the system diagnostics process can begin without interference. Following this wait at Workshop C, move directly to the Exterior Operations Depot by the facility perimeter and stay there for further instructions, ensuring that all toolkits have been distributed as specified before departure.

instruction: Begin your route at Supply Depot Alpha to collect a batch of 19 labeled fertilizer canisters, ensuring all canisters are securely attached before moving forward. First, deliver 7 canisters to Greenhouse A and wait until the greenhouse technician finishes extracting all 7 canisters before departing; then continue to Irrigation Control Shed and allocate 6 additional canisters, pausing there for 4 minutes to allow the system to recalibrate after the deposit. Bring the final 6 canisters to Crop Plot Delta, but if a nutrient application vehicle is actively servicing the field upon your arrival, wait until the vehicle has cleared the drop-off zone before you proceed with the transfer; once the Crop Plot Delta staff remove the remaining canisters, remain in place for an extra 2 minutes to record the transaction. After all deliveries and requisite waiting periods are finished, proceed back to Supply Depot Alpha, stopping briefly at Exterior Charging Station 3 for at least 5 minutes of battery recharge before ending your mission at the depot entrance.

Start at Central Storage Dock, where you must collect a shipment of seventeen sealed fertilizer containers, verifying that all containers are present and intact before loading begins. Evenly distribute these fertilizer containers across three different locations: deliver six containers to Crop Field West and wait until the dispatch supervisor at Crop Field West has finished unloading all six containers before proceeding, then transport another six containers to Orchard Supply Depot North, where you must wait for seven minutes after unloading begins to permit chemical composition checks before moving on to your next delivery. The remaining five fertilizer containers are to be brought to Greenbelt Zone B Storage, where you must remain on site until all five containers have been removed and officially logged by the facility manager. Upon completion of every delivery and after confirming that the required holding period at Orchard Supply Depot North has passed, return to Central Storage Dock and stay available there for post-distribution maintenance tasks until further directed.

Start at the Materials Handling Dock to retrieve a set of 15 packaging crates, verifying that all crates are loaded and secured. Distribute these crates among Storage Room B1, Pallet Staging Zone F, and Processing Area C3, allotting 5 crates to each location for an even split. For each destination, once you arrive, wait until the on-site sensor confirms payload readiness before offloading the assigned crates; after completing the transfer at each stop, remain there for 90 seconds to finalize inventory checks. Before proceeding to the next location, ensure that the previous drop-off is fully acknowledged. After all packaging crates have been delivered and verified, return to the Materials Handling Dock, but pause for 4 minutes at the dock to allow operations staff to input delivery data; only once this waiting period is completed may the task be considered fulfilled.

Begin at the Spare Parts Warehouse by collecting 23 motor units designated for allocation among the Engine Repair Bay, Main Assembly Line, and Quality Assurance Lab. First, transport 8 motor units to the Engine Repair Bay and wait until each unit has been thoroughly removed by the mechanics, ensuring none remain onboard before proceeding. Once complete, deliver the next 8 motor units to the Main Assembly Line, but after arrival, remain at this location for a full 5 minutes to allow technicians to program and test the incoming stock. After this waiting period, travel to the Quality Assurance Lab to deliver the remaining 7 motor units; only depart after all units have been collected by the inspection staff. Following delivery to all three locations and ensuring your cargo is empty, return to the Spare Parts Warehouse, but wait at the entrance for 3 minutes so that warehouse personnel can document the completion of the allocation process prior to your return to standby status at the Charging Station.

Begin your route at Supply Dock C where a shipment of thirteen fertilizer bags must be distributed between Field East, Storage Shed North, and Field West. First, load all thirteen fertilizer bags at Supply Dock C, but wait at the loading area until the supervisor at Supply Dock C provides clearance that all bags are accounted for and properly secured. Next, deliver five fertilizer bags to Field East and remain until the agricultural crew has removed each bag from your cargo platform. Once Field East is fully supplied, carry the next four fertilizer bags to Storage Shed North; on arrival, if Storage Shed North’s unloading zone is occupied with another delivery, wait at the designated holding marker for six minutes before attempting transfer. Upon completion at Storage Shed North, proceed to Field West with the final four fertilizer bags. Wait until Field West personnel remove all four bags from your cargo area, and only then return directly to Supply Dock C. After returning, remain parked at Supply Dock C for ten minutes to allow for final inventory auditing and vehicle status check-in by dock staff before scheduling your next task.

Start at Equipment Maintenance Bay 1 and wait until the maintenance supervisor certifies that 13 hydraulic repair kits are prepared for delivery. Once the repair kits are loaded, go to Tractor Lot West, delivering 4 hydraulic repair kits and remaining there until each kit is individually removed and accounted for by the lot technician. Once this transfer is finished, continue to Seeder Storage Complex, but upon arrival, remain at Seeder Storage Complex for two minutes to allow personnel to clear the unloading zone before transferring 5 hydraulic repair kits; wait until the storage staff confirms removal of all 5 kits. For the last segment, bring the remaining 4 hydraulic repair kits to Field Implements Shed; upon reaching Field Implements Shed, deliver the first 2 repair kits as soon as you arrive then wait for three minutes before releasing the final 2 kits to the shed attendant. After verifying that all 13 hydraulic repair kits have been successfully distributed and signed off at their destinations, return directly to Equipment Maintenance Bay 1 to finish the assignment.

Start at Seed Storage Facility A and retrieve a batch of twenty seed crates assigned for three planting fields. Transport eight seed crates to Field Alpha first, and once you arrive, allow the field crew five minutes to organize the unloading area before the transfer of crates begins. After Field Alpha has received all eight seed crates and the crew confirms receipt, proceed to deliver seven seed crates to Field Beta; upon arrival at Field Beta, ensure you wait until the irrigation system at the site has been fully shut down before allowing the seed crates to be unloaded, a process which may take up to three minutes. After delivery to Field Beta is complete and confirmation is received from the field supervisor, transfer the remaining five seed crates to Field Gamma. Upon reaching Field Gamma, wait for two minutes so that the planting equipment can be repositioned, and only then initiate unloading procedures. Do not leave Field Gamma until all five seed crates have been signed off as received. Once distribution to all planting fields is verified and each site has acknowledged safe receipt, navigate to Maintenance Garage 4 for a scheduled post-delivery inspection and remain on standby until further instructions are provided.

Begin by proceeding to Warehouse A, where you are to retrieve a batch of twenty-four electronic component crates for dispatch to assembly points. Allocate eight crates to Assembly Line Red, nine to Assembly Line Blue, and deliver the final seven crates to Assembly Line Green, ensuring none of the lines are bypassed. Upon arrival at Assembly Line Red, await confirmation from the shift supervisor that the unloading bay is cleared of debris before transferring any crates; at Assembly Line Blue, wait five minutes upon arrival before initiating crate unloading, allowing the previous delivery to be fully processed. After all crates are removed from your robot at Assembly Line Green, immediately return to Warehouse A, but only depart once the Assembly Line Green supervisor confirms receipt of the full delivery. Finally, report to the Maintenance Bay and remain there for twelve minutes to accommodate diagnostic evaluations, departing only after being cleared by the maintenance chief.

object.description: confirmation from shift supervisor that unloading bay is cleared of debris
supervisor confirmation of full delivery receipt

instruction: Start your route at Seed Storage Silo 3, where you are scheduled to collect a total of eighteen fertilizer bags earmarked for spring planting activities. First, transport seven fertilizer bags to Field Plot North and wait at the plot until the field supervisor signals readiness for each individual bag to be offloaded. After every one of the seven bags is confirmed as received at Field Plot North, take the next six fertilizer bags and deliver them to Orchard Block Delta, but remain at the delivery site for five minutes to allow orchard staff to distribute and store the fertilizer bags securely. Proceed with the remaining five fertilizer bags to Greenhouse Loading Ramp, where you must wait until the greenhouse technician finishes inspecting and removing all five bags from your delivery compartment. Following successful deliveries at each destination, travel to the Equipment Cleaning Bay and stay there for ten minutes while the cleaning crew decontaminates your payload area, then return to Seed Storage Silo 3 to complete the operation.

Begin your assignment by proceeding to Harvest Collection Point Alpha to pick up a shipment of twenty-one sealed fruit crates intended for distribution. Once all twenty-one fruit crates are loaded and the Quality Control Team at Collection Point Alpha has confirmed the lot’s integrity, transport eight crates directly to Cold Storage Facility 1, where you must not depart until the receiving agent has verified and fully unloaded all eight crates. Following completion at Cold Storage Facility 1, deliver another eight fruit crates to Cold Storage Facility 2, but before entering the unloading zone, pause outside for three minutes to allow staff to clear a staging area for intake. After this waiting period, proceed with the delivery and confirm full crate removal by Cold Storage Facility 2 personnel. Take the remaining five fruit crates to Research Lab Omega, and only attempt delivery after verifying that both previous storage facility drop-offs have been completed; if they have not, wait at your current location until both removals are acknowledged. Once at Research Lab Omega, wait for lab technicians to finish removing all five fruit crates. Conclude your mission by returning to Harvest Collection Point Alpha, where you must remain stationary for a minimum of four minutes to facilitate post-mission logistics reporting and equipment inspection by site supervisors.

Commence at the Seed Storage Dock and prepare to transport a total of fifteen fertilizer units for distribution across Greenhouse Alpha, Hydroponic Bay 3, and Field Plot 7. First, convey five fertilizer units to Greenhouse Alpha; upon arrival, wait for the greenhouse supervisor to confirm all units are removed from the robot. Next, deliver another five fertilizer units to Hydroponic Bay 3 and again remain until staff at Hydroponic Bay 3 have completed unloading the shipment. Before proceeding to Field Plot 7 with the remaining five fertilizer units, you must remain stationary at Hydroponic Bay 3 for exactly six minutes to allow staff to recalibrate sensors between deliveries. Only after this timed interval, transfer the final batch of five units to Field Plot 7, waiting until field technicians complete the offload and signal completion. Do not initiate the return to the Seed Storage Dock until all fifteen fertilizer units have been distributed and the waiting period at Hydroponic Bay 3 is fully observed.

Start at Maintenance Garage East and collect twelve hydraulic filter cartridges intended for distribution across Tractor Bay North, Harvesting Unit Depot, and Equipment Calibration Suite. Once the hydraulic filter cartridges are secured, proceed directly to Tractor Bay North and deliver four hydraulic filter cartridges, waiting until all four are fully unloaded and acknowledged by the tractor bay supervisor before departing. After Tractor Bay North's delivery is complete, continue to Harvesting Unit Depot with the remaining eight hydraulic filter cartridges, where you must supply five hydraulic filter cartridges and remain there for five minutes to enable maintenance personnel to complete the installation procedure; do not advance until you receive explicit confirmation that installation of these five hydraulic filter cartridges is finished. Once clearance is received, transport the last three hydraulic filter cartridges to Equipment Calibration Suite, delivering all remaining cartridges to the calibration team. Before returning to Maintenance Garage East, wait at Equipment Calibration Suite until notified that all three hydraulic filter cartridges have been properly removed and inventoried, and confirm that both prior drop-off areas finalized their tasks before concluding your mission.

Begin at Central Harvest Processing Dock and wait until the dock supervisor confirms that 31 fruit bins are fully loaded for outbound dispatch. As soon as loading and sign-off are completed, deliver 12 fruit bins to Cold Storage Unit 3, waiting at Cold Storage Unit 3 until all 12 bins have been completely removed by the storage personnel. Once this transfer is complete, proceed to Distribution Outbuilding B with 10 fruit bins and remain at Distribution Outbuilding B for five minutes to allow the quality assurance team to prepare the receiving platform before unloading the bins; ensure that the team confirms removal of every bin before departing. Next, transport the final 9 fruit bins to Market Staging Platform North, but upon arrival, only allow the unloading of the first 4 bins immediately; wait an additional two minutes before offloading the remaining 5 bins to the platform staff, ensuring removal is confirmed for each group. After all 31 fruit bins have been distributed and each site has signed off on their receipts, return without delay to Central Harvest Processing Dock for assignment review.

Begin at Maintenance Depot 2 and await confirmation from the depot supervisor that nine replacement hydraulic hoses have been loaded onto your payload racks. When the hoses are secured and ready for dispatch, first transport three hydraulic hoses to Tractor Repair Bay Alpha and remain there until each hose is individually inspected and removed by a maintenance technician. Once Tractor Repair Bay Alpha has received all three hoses, deliver another three hydraulic hoses to Combine Service Hangar 1, but upon arrival, wait for exactly four minutes to allow the service crew to complete their equipment checks before starting to offload the hoses. Ensure confirmation of removal for each hose at Combine Service Hangar 1 before proceeding to Equipment Storage Shed West with the final three hydraulic hoses. At Equipment Storage Shed West, wait until the inventory manager gives clearance to transfer and remove all remaining hoses. After completing all hose deliveries and receiving sign-off at every site, return immediately to Maintenance Depot 2 to await your next assignment.

Start by navigating to Field Supply Barn 7 and wait until ten bags of fertilizer labeled Spring Blend are fully loaded onto your carrier platform, as confirmed by the barn attendant. Once the Spring Blend fertilizer bags are ready, transport four bags to Orchard Plot South, ensuring at this location that you remain until all four bags have been removed and logged individually by the orchard supervisor. Following this, deliver three more bags to Vineyard Block 2, but after arrival and unloading, stay at Vineyard Block 2 for six full minutes to allow the automated spreaders to clear the staging zone before proceeding further. After the holding period, head to Greenhouse D with the remaining three bags and wait until the greenhouse manager verifies that every bag has been safely transferred to their storage racks. Only after all fertilizer deliveries are completed and each location has provided their respective acknowledgments, return to Field Supply Barn 7 to signal task termination and readiness for subsequent assignments.

instruction: Commence your operation at Storage Bay A, where you must wait until a total of fifteen sealed maintenance kits are verified and prepared by the logistics coordinator. From Storage Bay A, transport five maintenance kits to Water Pump Station North; upon arrival, remain at Pump Station North until all five kits have been fully unloaded and each has been inspected by the maintenance foreman. Next, carry another five kits to Irrigation Control Shed West, but only enter the shed after you receive confirmation that the previous unloading at Pump Station North has been completed. After unloading at the shed, impose a deliberate wait of five minutes at Irrigation Control Shed West to allow for inventory checks before departing. Then, deliver the remaining five maintenance kits to Field Equipment Depot 3, ensuring you stay at Depot 3 until the depot staff have acknowledged complete receipt and removal of all maintenance kits. Once kit transfers and all confirmations are finalized at each destination, promptly return to Storage Bay A to signal completion of the distribution cycle.

Begin by moving to Grain Silo 4, where you must remain until the supervisor verifies that nine sealed grain drums are ready for transport. After confirmation, take three grain drums per trip and deliver them to Field Supply Depot East, Field Supply Depot Central, and Field Supply Depot West, ensuring that each depot receives exactly three drums. For each depot, pause for 120 seconds after arrival to allow staff to complete intake inspections, and only proceed to the next depot after you receive acknowledgment that staff have removed all grain drums from your payload. Once all nine grain drums have been distributed and all waiting periods observed at the supply depots, head to Maintenance Garage B and wait for four minutes to enable system diagnostics before leaving the area or taking further instructions.

Start by traveling to Equipment Staging Zone Delta, where you will wait until twelve new irrigation valves are inspected and marked ready for deployment by the assembly supervisor. Once you receive clearance, divide the twelve irrigation valves as evenly as possible by delivering five valves to Field Plot South, four valves to Field Plot North, and the remaining three valves to Field Plot East; any excess must be directed to the respective plots in this order to ensure no plot receives more than its designated allocation. For each delivery location, you must not leave until all assigned valves have been officially received and removed from your transport compartment by the plot foreperson. After completing all three deliveries, remain at Field Plot East for two minutes to synchronize your timeline with the next maintenance window, then proceed directly to Logistics Hub Gamma Resource Bay and wait there until notified that further deployment orders are finalized for your next shift.

At Materials Intake Dock, collect a total of fifteen seed feed bags designated for distribution to Greenhouse Section Alpha, Greenhouse Section Beta, and Greenhouse Section Gamma, ensuring no section is assigned more than six bags; in the event of extra seed feed bags, assign the remaining bags to Section Alpha first, then Section Gamma. After verifying all seed feed bags are securely loaded, travel to Greenhouse Section Alpha and deliver six seed feed bags, waiting at the location until the site manager confirms all six have been removed and documented. Once you’ve received official clearance, proceed to Greenhouse Section Beta with the remaining seed feed bags and deposit five at this location; remain on site for four minutes to allow greenhouse staff to complete critical restocking protocols. After this time interval and confirmation of successful removal, continue to Greenhouse Section Gamma with the final four seed feed bags, deliver the remaining bags, and wait at Greenhouse Section Gamma until operations control notifies you that inventory recording has concluded for this drop-off. Only after all three deliveries, as well as associated confirmations or time requirements, are fulfilled, return to Materials Intake Dock to conclude your delivery sequence.

Start your route at Parts Depot Alpha where you must collect a batch of fourteen spare hydraulic filters once they are prepared for handover by the depot staff. Distribute these filters evenly between Mechanical Workshop Delta, Tractor Fleet Garage, and Seeder Maintenance Shed so that each location receives four filters; deliver the remaining two filters to Mechanical Workshop Delta to ensure it receives priority for upcoming repairs. At each drop location, wait until the maintenance supervisor confirms that all delivered filters have been removed before continuing to the following site. After all filters have been successfully transferred and confirmed, pause for six minutes at Charging Station 3B for a battery top-up before returning to Parts Depot Alpha for mission completion review.

Begin at the central equipment dock and await notification that three different maintenance kits—labeled Kit A, Kit B, and Kit C—are fully loaded onto the robot for scheduled servicing. Once all three maintenance kits are ready, transport Kit A directly to Greenhouse 4 and wait there until the greenhouse technician completes unloading Kit A from the robot. After confirming Kit A's removal, proceed to the irrigation pump station to deliver Kit B, remaining on station until the site manager retrieves Kit B in its entirety. Following that, bring Kit C to Storage Barn 2, waiting for the barn staff to remove Kit C before taking further action. After all three maintenance kits have been successfully delivered and received at their respective locations, remain at Storage Barn 2 for 8 minutes to provide immediate support in case staff identify any missing components, and only return to the central equipment dock once the waiting period concludes and all maintenance kits have been accepted.

Start your shift at the Central Loading Bay and collect a total of fifteen sealed fertilizer canisters, verifying that all canisters are securely packed before you depart. Travel first to Wheat Field Alpha and unload six fertilizer canisters, remaining on site until the field supervisor confirms full removal. After the Wheat Field Alpha transfer is complete, continue to Corn Field Bravo and deliver another five fertilizer canisters, waiting on location until the unloading process has been acknowledged by the field technician. For the remaining four canisters, head to Soybean Plot Delta and ensure their delivery, staying at the drop-off site until the last canister is removed by the crew. Once all deliveries are finished, pause at Soybean Plot Delta for five minutes to allow field managers an opportunity for onsite inspection; after this interval, return immediately to Central Loading Bay to report the completion of all fertilizer transfers and await your next assignment.

Begin the operation by traveling to the Central Warehouse and await loading of twelve irrigation pump units by facility staff, confirming readiness of each unit prior to departure. From there, deliver four irrigation pump units to North Field Station; remain on site until all four units have been fully unloaded and accounted for by the receiving technician. Next, proceed to East Equipment Depot to deliver another four units, waiting until you receive confirmation of successful transfer and removal of each irrigation pump unit. Transport the final four irrigation pump units to South Farm Workshop, but before starting the unloading, wait an additional seven minutes to accommodate the scheduled safety inspection at the workshop entrance. After completion of the inspection and confirmation from workshop personnel that all remaining units have been removed from the robot, immediately travel to the Recharge Bay for battery replenishment before returning to the Central Warehouse to report route completion.

Begin by traveling to the Warehouse Loading Dock and pick up a shipment of twelve irrigation control modules. Once secured, deliver four modules to the Maintenance Cabin located at the northern orchard and wait at the cabin until the technician confirms receipt of all four modules. After this confirmation, proceed to the Equipment Storage Facility on the southern edge and drop off another four modules, remaining on site until all modules are unloaded and inspected, which may take up to five minutes. Next, take the final four modules to the Greenhouse annex near the eastern plot, but upon arrival, first wait for two minutes outside the annex for the supervisor to signal readiness before proceeding. Only after the signal is received should you complete the delivery to the annex, then return immediately to the Warehouse Loading Dock and wait there for ten minutes for system diagnostics before any further assignments.

instruction: Start at Grain Storage Facility East and collect a shipment of fifteen seed bags labeled for distribution, confirming all seed bags are secured before travel. Transport five seed bags to Field Plot Alpha and wait at the plot until all field staff confirm the removal of the five seed bags from your cargo bay; only proceed once the distribution is complete. After departing Field Plot Alpha, take five additional seed bags to Field Plot Beta, ensuring you remain on-site until the farm crew there has finished offloading all five seed bags. Once deliveries to Field Plot Alpha and Field Plot Beta are fully complete, bring any remaining seed bags—which will be exactly five—to Field Plot Delta; wait at Field Plot Delta until all seed bags have been retrieved by the planting team. Following these drop-offs, stay at Field Plot Delta for precisely six minutes before heading back to Grain Storage Facility East to close out the task.

Start by navigating to the Seed Storage Facility and pick up thirteen seed pallets, confirming that all thirteen pallets are securely loaded onto your vehicle before departing. Head first to Greenhouse Delta and unload five seed pallets there, waiting for a greenhouse worker to acknowledge each individual pallet removal before proceeding to the next. After the Greenhouse Delta delivery is fully confirmed, continue to Crop Test Plot Three and deliver four seed pallets; however, remain onsite for three minutes after unloading to allow on-site sensors to calibrate the planting machinery with the newly delivered seeds. Next, take the remaining four seed pallets to Sprouting Shed Seven, and ensure that, if either Greenhouse Delta or Crop Test Plot Three experienced any acknowledgment delays during their unloading process, you wait an additional ninety seconds outside Sprouting Shed Seven before offloading any pallets. Once all seed pallets have been distributed and every location’s protocols and wait times are satisfied, return directly to the Seed Storage Facility for the final system check and assignment debrief.

Begin by navigating to the Equipment Storage Bay and acquiring 14 diagnostic toolkits, performing a visual quality check on each toolkit to ensure completeness. Evenly allocate these toolkits by delivering 5 to the Maintenance Dock, 5 to the Hydraulics Workshop, and the remaining 4 to the Electrical Calibration Station, explicitly confirming receipt at each location before moving to the next destination. After completing each delivery, wait for two minutes at the respective site to allow maintenance teams to verify the delivered toolkits and for any discrepancies to be reported; proceed with the sequence only once all toolkits at a location have been accepted and cleared. Once all toolkits have been distributed, return to the Equipment Storage Bay, waiting five minutes to allow for end-of-shift logging before powering down for routine battery charging.

Begin your route at the cold storage facility and collect twelve crates of harvested tomatoes slated for processing. First, deliver four crates to the canning building and wait until all four crates are unloaded and an operator confirms their readiness for the next production stage; this confirmation should take no more than 5 minutes. Afterward, transport four more crates to the fresh packaging barn, waiting at the site until the packaging supervisor completes the necessary quality inspection and removes all crates. Then, proceed to the local market distribution shed with the final four crates, but only leave the crates there if you receive a direct authorization signal from the market supervisor confirming available storage space. Should the market supervisor deny or delay authorization, wait at the distribution shed for increments of 3 minutes, checking for authorization after each interval, until the crates can be deposited. Once all deliveries and confirmations are complete, return to the cold storage facility for end-of-shift debriefing.

Begin your task at the Central Maintenance Bay and collect a tool kit that is needed for diagnostics at three separate utility stations. First, travel to Pump Station Alpha and deliver the designated pressure gauge from the tool kit, remaining there for two minutes so the technician can retrieve and verify the gauge. Once the gauge handoff is complete, continue to Generator Shed B and provide the torque wrench, then wait until the technician confirms the wrench has been removed from the robot before departing. After the torque wrench has been successfully delivered, finish the delivery by traveling to Valve Control Point C, where you must wait five minutes before handing over the remaining calibration device, allowing site staff enough time to secure the work zone. After the final device is removed and acknowledged at Valve Control Point C, promptly return to the Central Maintenance Bay and signal your readiness for the next series of assignments.

Proceed to Loading Bay 5 and collect a set of 23 sealed irrigation hoses, confirming readiness of each hose by waiting for the equipment manager's signal before departing. Deliver eight of the hoses to Vineyard Plot Alpha first, waiting at Vineyard Plot Alpha until the onsite crew indicates successful removal of the hoses from your payload. Next, transport another eight hoses to Orchard Section Delta; after completing this drop-off there, pause for five minutes to provide the maintenance team sufficient time to inspect the new hoses. Convey the remaining seven hoses to Crop Storage Facility B, but only begin transferring these hoses once the facility supervisor confirms all previous inventory has been cleared from the intake bay. After ensuring all hoses are distributed and every pause or prerequisite is completed, proceed back to Loading Bay 5 and wait for further provisioning instructions before shutting down for maintenance.

Begin at the central materials depot and collect a shipment of fourteen seedling trays. Next, travel to Nursery Zone A and deliver five of the seedling trays; wait until the nursery staff signals that the trays have been removed before proceeding. Then, drive to Nursery Zone B to distribute another five trays, but remain at the loading area for ten minutes to allow sorting and inspection by the horticulture team. After this waiting period, proceed to Field Transfer Dock Three with the remaining four trays, and wait on-site until the dock supervisor confirms the completion of the unloading process. Only after all trays have been accounted for at their respective zones should you return directly to the central materials depot and park outside Bay 2 for end-of-shift processing.

Initiate your route at Grain Elevator A, where you will pick up a total of thirteen seed bags designated for distribution across remote agricultural plots. Transport and hand-deliver five seed bags to Field 4 North, but pause at Field 4 North for four minutes before each drop-off to synchronize with the planting crew’s schedule; resume your next delivery only when each bag is physically removed by the crew lead. After completing deliveries at Field 4 North, proceed to Field 8 West to offload another five seed bags, again waiting for the field operator to confirm readiness for each transfer and ensuring no more than one bag is transferred at a time following individual confirmations. Lastly, carry the final three seed bags to Field 2 East, but before initiating handover at Field 2 East, wait an additional six minutes to allow soil preparation activities to conclude. Upon confirming that all thirteen seed bags have been distributed to their respective locations and acknowledgments have been logged by each field supervisor, return to Grain Elevator A and stand by for further logistical instructions.

Start at the central storage depot, where you will be tasked with transporting a shipment of twelve 25-kg fertilizer bags. Distribute these bags among the North Field Supply Shed, the East Irrigation Control Room, and the South Equipment Staging Area such that each location receives four bags, ensuring no location receives more or fewer than specified. After delivering the bags to the North Field Supply Shed and confirming with on-site staff that all four bags have been removed from the robot, pause at the shed for five minutes to allow field technicians to assess the supplies for damage. Once the wait is over and the transfer to the East Irrigation Control Room and then the South Equipment Staging Area is complete, verify that bags at each subsequent location are also officially unloaded before proceeding. When all deliveries and confirmations are finished, return the empty robot to the central storage depot and wait for further dispatch instructions.

Begin your task at the Spare Parts Depot, where you will load seven diagnostic toolkits for maintenance purposes. Distribute the diagnostic toolkits among three locations as follows: deliver three toolkits to Robot Repair Station A, two toolkits to Maintenance Hangar B, and the remaining two toolkits to Mechanical Workshop C, making sure that the specified quantity is placed at each destination before moving to the next. After dropping off the assigned toolkits at each location, remain at the respective site for three minutes to allow the on-site technicians to inspect and collect the toolkits; if the toolkits are not collected within the three-minute window, wait for up to one additional three-minute interval before proceeding. Following the completion of all deliveries and confirmed toolkit removal at every location, proceed to the Charging Hub, and stay there for five minutes in readiness for any urgent maintenance requests or additional transport tasks that may arise from the maintenance supervisors.

Commence at the Main Equipment Garage and collect nine sealed replacement air filters for distribution. First, carry three air filters to the West Tractor Shed, waiting there for four minutes after arrival to allow the maintenance manager to inspect the items before deposit. Next, proceed to the North Harvester Hangar; deliver four air filters and remain on site for seven minutes while the on-duty mechanic checks each filter and logs them into their system. After the verification period concludes at the Harvester Hangar, make your way to the East Sprayer Bay with the final two air filters. If the East Sprayer Bay crew confirms that both filters are needed, hand over both at once; otherwise, deliver one filter and wait for six minutes for assessment before transferring the second. When all nine air filters have been successfully distributed and the required waiting periods at each drop-off location have been observed, return to the Main Equipment Garage for further assignment instructions.

Start at the pesticide storage depot by picking up a total of thirteen sealed pesticide canisters for distribution. Transport four pesticide canisters to Crop Field Alpha first, and remain at Crop Field Alpha until the spraying crew finishes their equipment calibration and signals readiness to receive the canisters. Following transfer at Crop Field Alpha, deliver another four pesticide canisters to Fruit Orchard Bravo, pausing outside Fruit Orchard Bravo for precisely two minutes so that orchard staff can prepare the unloading area; after this wait, proceed to deliver the canisters. Finally, convey the last five pesticide canisters to Greenhouse Delta. After completing deliveries to all three locations and once each unloading has been acknowledged, return directly to the pesticide storage depot without delay to complete the route.

Begin at Storage Room A adjacent to the central workshop and pick up a batch of fourteen fertilizer modules. Evenly distribute these modules by delivering five modules to Field North, five modules to Field East, and the remaining four modules to Field South; ensure that no field receives more than its allocation. For each field, wait until the farm supervisor at that location confirms receipt and removal of all modules assigned to that field before departing to the next destination. After the final delivery at Field South, return to Storage Room A and wait for 10 minutes to allow inventory staff to prepare your next payload, remaining on standby until the loading is complete.

instruction: Start at the Central Seed Vault and collect a batch of fifteen certified corn seed bags designated for planting. First, navigate to Field Plot 3A to deliver six seed bags, and remain there until the field operator signals readiness for seeding. Once the transfer is acknowledged, head to the Southern Irrigation Shed to leave four seed bags, waiting exactly two minutes before unloading to allow the site supervisor to complete equipment checks. Afterward, proceed to the Experimental Test Bed area with the remaining five seed bags. Upon arrival, hand over three bags and pause for three minutes as the research team inspects the seed quality before releasing the bags. Deliver the final two bags to the Equipment Sterilization Bay, but do not depart until the sterilization crew removes both bags from the payload compartment. When all deliveries and specified wait intervals have concluded, return to the Central Seed Vault and wait for four minutes in case further planting requests are communicated by the logistics coordinator.

instruction: Start at Maintenance Bay Alpha and wait for the four replacement air filters to be loaded onto your tray. Once loading is verified, travel to Crop Dryer Station West and deliver the first air filter, ensuring it is removed by the technician before you continue. Proceed to Greenhouse Cooling Room, where you will drop off the second filter, and wait for two minutes at the Cooling Room to give staff time to perform a quick installation check. After the waiting period, transport the third air filter to Silo 3 Compressor Shed and deliver it to the equipment rack, then move promptly to Livestock Barn Control Room to provide the final air filter for the ventilation unit. Remain at the Livestock Barn Control Room until all four delivery receipts have been confirmed by the system, and only then return directly to Maintenance Bay Alpha for post-delivery inspection.

instruction: Begin at the Parts Storage Bay and collect a crate containing 19 hydraulic pump components. Deliver 6 components each to Maintenance Bay A and Maintenance Bay B, ensuring that after each drop-off you wait until the maintenance team at each bay confirms receipt and removal of the components from the crate. After these deliveries are completed, transport the remaining 7 components to Maintenance Bay C, waiting there for the crew to signal that all items have been received. Once all three maintenance bays have been supplied, proceed to the Quality Inspection Dock and wait for five minutes to allow the inspection supervisor to perform a brief check of your cargo area before returning to the Parts Storage Bay for the next assignment.

Start from the equipment storage garage, retrieve two sealed toolkits for irrigation repairs and one spare pump unit, and carry all three items to Maintenance Station Alpha on the western field perimeter. Wait at Maintenance Station Alpha until both toolkits have been confirmed as unloaded by the repair crew. After offloading, divide your route to deliver the spare pump unit and carry it onward to Pump House Delta at the northern canal. Upon arrival at Pump House Delta, wait exactly 5 minutes to allow onsite technicians to exchange the old pump. Once the waiting period expires, regardless of whether technicians are finished, proceed directly to the Field Supervisor Trailer beside the main gate to hand over your inspection log before returning to the equipment storage garage for the next scheduled round.

instruction: Start operations at Storage Silo 2 by loading a total of fifteen fertilizer canisters onto your robot for field maintenance duties. Transport six canisters to Field Plot Alpha and wait for the designated technician to signal readiness before unloading the entire allocation; after completing the drop-off, continue with the remaining nine canisters to Field Plot Beta, distributing five of these to the supply depot located at the plot’s southern edge. Once the depot confirms full receipt, proceed with the final four canisters to the green utility shed at Plot Gamma, but wait for three minutes outside the shed to allow workers to prepare their unloading bay. Only after the canisters have been fully removed from your robot at Plot Gamma should you proceed to the northern edge of the Equipment Inspection Zone. There, collect any empty pesticide containers left out for recycling, and return them without delay to Storage Silo 2 for secure disposal. Upon arrival, remain at Storage Silo 2 for eight minutes so that any additional items can be inspected and added to your route if necessary before your next dispatch.

instruction: Start by traveling to the Central Grain Depot and collect eight maintenance part kits, with confirmation from the depot manager that all kits are secure before departure. Transport two maintenance part kits to Silo 7; upon arrival at Silo 7, wait for five minutes to allow for electrical lockout procedures before the maintenance supervisor begins offloading the kits. Once both kits have been removed from Silo 7, continue to Greenhouse Alpha with three more maintenance part kits. At Greenhouse Alpha, supervise the transfer until a technician has verified, one by one, that each kit is present and documented; only proceed after the third kit has been logged. Take the final three maintenance part kits to the Machinery Workshop, but, if a kit remains after delivering evenly to each destination, ensure it is also left at the Machinery Workshop so that all kits are accounted for. Wait at the Machinery Workshop until the lead engineer has completed the checklist for received kits and authorizes you to continue. After all deliveries are confirmed at every site, return directly to the Central Grain Depot and remain there for seven minutes to complete the end-of-mission equipment inspection before undertaking any subsequent tasks.

Begin by traveling to the Parts Storage Warehouse to collect a set of six replacement conveyor belts. Deliver two conveyor belts to Sorting Station A, one belt to Sorting Station B, and the remaining three belts to Sorting Station C, ensuring the distribution matches exactly and no station receives more than specified. At each sorting station, pause until the station technician confirms the old belt has been removed and the replacement belt from the robot is ready for installation. Only proceed to the next station after receiving confirmation for the current delivery. Once all belts have been distributed and confirmations received from every station, navigate to the Central Charging Dock and wait for 20 minutes, allowing the battery system to recharge fully before beginning any subsequent tasks or returns.

Start by moving to Warehouse 3 and retrieve a set of 34 engine calibration kits designated for outgoing machinery. Once all kits are loaded, deliver 11 kits to Assembly Line A, and wait there until every kit has been fully unloaded by the line operator. After the Assembly Line A drop-off is confirmed, proceed to the Central Maintenance Bay with 12 more calibration kits; upon arrival, you must pause for 6 minutes while technical staff examine the delivery batch for any missing components. With the 11 remaining calibration kits, continue to the Quality Assurance Lab, ensuring that you do not depart until the QA supervisor authorizes removal of all kits, which may take up to several minutes. Only after all deliveries and required waiting periods are complete should you proceed to Docking Station 5 to await the next assignment from the logistics coordinator.

Begin your route at the central fertilizer warehouse, collecting nine nutrient canisters required for crop treatment throughout the East Orchard, Greenhouse Annex, and North Vineyard. First, deliver four nutrient canisters to the East Orchard loading zone, and wait until the orchard supervisor confirms that all four canisters have been removed from your platform. Once this transfer is verified, proceed to the Greenhouse Annex with three more nutrient canisters; upon arrival, pause for two minutes to allow airlock sterilization procedures, after which you must wait for the greenhouse technician to unload all three canisters. Immediately after completing the Greenhouse Annex delivery and unload sequence, transport the remaining two nutrient canisters to the North Vineyard operations shed, but only initiate their removal once the shed manager indicates readiness. Following these staged deliveries and respective handoffs at all three locations, return to the central fertilizer warehouse and await the next set of farm distribution instructions.

Begin at Combine Maintenance Bay 2 and proceed immediately to the Fertilizer Depot, where you will collect fifteen canisters of liquid fertilizer designated for three separate crop test plots. Distribute five canisters to Test Plot North, another five canisters to Test Plot East, and the final five canisters to Test Plot South, ensuring each plot receives its full share with no leftover canisters. After delivering the canisters to each plot, wait for a technician at the respective plot to confirm readiness of the application equipment by signaling completion of the canister removal, then proceed to the next plot. Once all deliveries and technician confirmations are complete, travel to Equipment Storage Shed 7, remain stationary for four minutes to allow data synchronization with the agronomy team, and finally return to Combine Maintenance Bay 2 to complete the assignment.

instruction: Begin by moving to the Central Supply Dock and collect a total of seven sealed seed crates designated for field distribution. Transport three seed crates immediately to Sowing Field East, and wait at the drop-off location until the field crew confirms the crates have been fully removed. Next, deliver another three seed crates to Sowing Field West, this time waiting for five minutes after arrival to allow for any unloading delays or questions from the staff; only depart once the crates have been removed. With one remaining seed crate, proceed to the Remote Plot Outpost and await confirmation of pickup by the outpost supervisor. Once all seven crates have been distributed as described and all crates have been successfully unloaded and acknowledged at their respective locations, return to the Central Supply Dock and stand by for any follow-up distribution requests.

instruction: Begin your route at the Seed Storage Facility and pick up a total of nine fertilizer sample trays. Travel directly to the North Wheat Plot and deliver three sample trays to the agronomy tent, making sure to wait until a field technician confirms the unloading is complete before departing. Next, proceed to the East Orchard Research Station and drop off three additional sample trays at the equipment prep area, pausing there for ten minutes to facilitate calibration of agricultural sensors using the fresh samples. Once the wait time has elapsed, deliver the remaining three trays to the Soil Analysis Laboratory in the main operations building; do not leave until the lab manager signals that all received trays have been successfully catalogued. Only after the final confirmation at the Soil Analysis Laboratory should you return to the Seed Storage Facility to log your completed deliveries and prepare for future dispatches.
