instruction: Begin your assignment at Fertilizer Depot 5 by loading nine sacks of organic compost and two canisters of micronutrient solution onto your payload bay. Proceed first to North Field Plot Alpha and deliver three sacks of organic compost, waiting for the field supervisor’s signal that each sack has been positioned before continuing; if the supervisor requests additional verification, remain at North Field Plot Alpha for two extra minutes before departing. Next, travel to East Orchard Grove to drop off another three sacks of organic compost, ensuring the drop-off occurs only if East Orchard Grove’s storage shed is vacant—if not, wait outside for four minutes before attempting entry again. Deliver any leftover compost sacks, up to three, to the Central Greenhouse, but if there’s an extra sack remaining (in the case of nine not being evenly distributed), allocate the single extra sack to the Central Greenhouse, ensuring no other location receives more. After the compost deliveries, bring one canister of micronutrient solution to South Irrigation Station, wait there until the site attendant confirms delivery and instructs you to continue, and take the final canister directly to the Equipment Maintenance Bay. Once at the Equipment Maintenance Bay, wait for three minutes to allow mechanics to inspect the canister before returning to Fertilizer Depot 5 and signaling readiness for new tasks.

instruction.location: outside East Orchard Grove's storage shed

instruction: Begin your operation at Warehouse Dock A, where you are to gather twelve large irrigation hoses from the shipment area. Evenly distribute these hoses across the three designated deployment points—six hoses to Field Alpha, four hoses to Field Bravo, and the remaining two hoses to Field Charlie—ensuring that each site receives its precise share. After delivering hoses to Field Alpha, pause for eight minutes near the field's equipment shed while site engineers verify the received hoses. Proceed to Field Bravo, where after unloading the four hoses, you must wait until the farm supervisor has removed all four hoses from your transport compartment before moving on. Once Field Bravo’s transfer is complete, deliver the final two hoses to Field Charlie; however, do not leave immediately—instead, remain for five minutes to allow maintenance staff to stage and roll out the hoses. After all three deliveries and associated wait periods are fully finished, return directly to Warehouse Dock A and await additional dispatch instructions.

Begin your route at the North Equipment Shed, where you must collect a crate containing twelve irrigation valves. Travel first to Field Alpha and distribute four irrigation valves, ensuring that the field technician removes each valve from the crate before proceeding. After completing the delivery at Field Alpha, transport the remaining eight irrigation valves to Field Beta, where you will deliver another four valves, again pausing until each valve has been taken by the local maintenance crew. With four irrigation valves left in the crate, continue to the Orchard Service Station, but wait for three minutes upon arrival to allow the crew to clear space for new supplies before any unloading takes place. After the wait period, wait until all four irrigation valves are collected by the Orchard Service team before you leave. Once all deliveries are complete, return the empty crate to the North Equipment Shed and await your next assignment.

Begin at the Seed Storage Warehouse and wait until a batch of eight seed sacks is ready for dispatch. As soon as the seed sacks are ready, transport all eight to the Distribution Hub. At the Distribution Hub, divide the seed sacks by delivering three sacks to Field A Access Point, three sacks to Field B Gate, and the remaining two to the Vineyard Equipment Shed, ensuring that each field receives its designated amount and all sacks are accounted for. After all deliveries are complete, wait for twenty minutes at the Vineyard Equipment Shed to allow agronomy staff to verify the seed sack allocations, and then return directly to the Seed Storage Warehouse to await further instructions.

Begin your sequence at Storage Bunker 2, where you will collect a payload of 27 high-yield fertilizer packets prepared for deployment. Split this load among Field Section Alpha, Field Section Beta, and Field Section Gamma, making sure to deliver 10 packets to Field Section Alpha first; after delivering to Field Section Alpha, remain there for five minutes to allow the field crew to verify proper distribution before moving forward. Once Field Section Alpha's supervisor provides confirmation, proceed to Field Section Beta with 9 fertilizer packets, offload them, and do not leave until all packets have been removed by the field operator. Afterwards, take the remaining 8 fertilizer packets to Field Section Gamma for final deployment, but only initiate unloading after both previous sections have acknowledged receipt. If acknowledgement fails at any section, immediately return the undistributed packets directly to Storage Bunker 2 without attempting subsequent deliveries. When all assigned packets are successfully distributed and acknowledged, head to Equipment Garage 1 and remain onsite to await further operational tasks.

Begin at Storage Warehouse 2 and retrieve twelve soil analysis kits from the south rack, confirming proper labeling for each kit before loading them onto the robot. Travel to Field Plot A and distribute five soil analysis kits along the boundary markers, waiting for a laboratory technician to remove each kit from the payload and confirm successful transfer for each drop-off, one by one. After completing the delivery at Field Plot A, move to Field Plot B to deliver another four kits, but wait exactly 5 minutes upon arrival before permitting transfer, giving time for Field Plot B's supervisor to arrive and authorize the collection. Once the four kits have been accepted at Field Plot B, proceed to Field Plot C with the final three kits; if any kits remain undelivered because field staff are absent, wait at Field Plot C until all three are fully received. Only after all soil analysis kits have been handed off at their respective field plots should you return to Storage Warehouse 2, where you will await further instructions for ongoing field sampling operations.

instruction: Commence your operation at the Grain Elevator, where you will collect a total of twenty-seven sealed wheat sample containers destined for testing. These containers must be distributed among Research Lab Alpha, Quality Control Bay, and the Field Analysis Trailer, allocating eight containers to Research Lab Alpha, ten containers to the Quality Control Bay, and the remaining nine containers to the Field Analysis Trailer; if the total does not divide evenly, ensure that the Field Analysis Trailer receives the highest count. Upon reaching each delivery site, wait until the respective technician confirms the payload transfer is complete before proceeding to the next destination. After you have delivered all samples and obtained confirmation at every location, proceed to Maintenance Hangar 3 and remain stationary for twelve minutes for a scheduled diagnostic check before returning to the Grain Elevator for further instructions.

Initiate the task at Main Greenhouse South, where twelve crates of harvested hydroponic lettuce are awaiting dispatch. First, transport four crates to Cold Storage Bay Alpha, and upon arrival, wait until the refrigeration crew acknowledges readiness to receive before offloading the lettuce crates. As soon as Cold Storage Bay Alpha confirms all four crates have been properly stored, continue by delivering another four crates to the Local Farmers’ Market Loading Dock; at this location, wait for exactly seven minutes, allowing the logistics coordinator to prepare the pallets and attach shipping labels to the lettuce crates before you proceed. With the remaining four crates, proceed to Restaurant Supply Depot B, but make this leg of the trip only after you have confirmed the proper receipt and inspection of the earlier batch at Cold Storage Bay Alpha. Should this confirmation be delayed, remain stationed at the Local Farmers’ Market Loading Dock until you are notified that Cold Storage Bay Alpha has completed their intake. Finally, after all twelve lettuce crates have been delivered in their respective locations and you have verified that no crates remain, return to Main Greenhouse South to await further operational directives.

Start at the central storage warehouse beside the solar panel farm and collect nine sealed feed bags designated for livestock replenishment. Deliver three feed bags each to Barn A, Stable B, and Poultry House C, ensuring that if any remainder occurs, assign the extra bag to Barn A so that Barn A receives four bags, while Stable B and Poultry House C each receive three. At every destination, wait for the respective caretakers to confirm the feed bags are ready for removal before proceeding. After the final delivery at Poultry House C, remain onsite for fifteen minutes to observe for any immediate issues with storage or acceptance before returning to the central storage warehouse for further dispatching assignments.

instruction: Start your route at the Seed Storage Barn and collect a total of fourteen nutrient-enriched seed packs allocated for soil supplementation tasks. First, deliver five seed packs to Wheat Field Alpha on the eastern perimeter, waiting at Wheat Field Alpha until the local agronomist signals that all five seed packs have been retrieved from the robot. Next, proceed south to Corn Field Beta to drop off four seed packs, then remain at Corn Field Beta for a minimum of five minutes to allow the planting crew adequate setup time before you leave. Following this, take three seed packs to Rice Field Gamma, and before departing, confirm that the on-site manager has removed all three seed packs. Bring the final two seed packs to the Edge Pasture Forage Plot, but if the previous drop-off at Rice Field Gamma has not yet been fully confirmed as complete when you arrive, wait at the Edge Pasture Forage Plot entrance until you receive confirmation from Rice Field Gamma; then proceed to deliver the two seed packs and await their removal. After all seed packs have been distributed and removals confirmed, return to the Seed Storage Barn and stay inactive for seven minutes to allow inventory systems to update before accepting a new set of tasks.

Start at the Component Storage Bay and retrieve the electronics kit labeled 'Assembly Kit 42', which contains 15 sensor modules. Transport the entire kit to the Assembly Line North, where you must deliver 7 sensor modules and wait after each handover until the assembly technician confirms the sensor module has been installed. Once the seventh module at Assembly Line North has been delivered, proceed to Assembly Line South, deliver 5 more sensor modules, and pause for exactly 3 minutes between each delivery to allow for calibration and system checks. Following the last delivery at Assembly Line South, carry the remaining 3 sensor modules to the Quality Control Station; after unloading all modules, remain at the Quality Control Station for 6 minutes while quality assurance processes are conducted, and only then return the empty Assembly Kit 42 back to Component Storage Bay and signal readiness for your next task.

instruction: Begin at the Central Loading Bay and collect a batch of twenty-four fertilizer bags. Divide these bags evenly among Orchard A, Orchard B, and Orchard C, allocating eight fertilizer bags to each location. Head first to Orchard A to deliver eight bags, waiting until the orchard attendant has confirmed removal and storage of all bags before departing. Once all bags for Orchard A are transferred, continue to Orchard B and deliver another eight fertilizer bags, pausing for four minutes at Orchard B after unloading to allow for a soil nutrient test; during this waiting period, do not initiate transit to the next site even if the tests conclude early. After finishing at Orchard B, bring the remaining eight fertilizer bags to Orchard C, but if the receiving platform at Orchard C can accommodate fewer than eight bags, leave only what can be stored and return any bags that could not be deposited directly back to the Central Loading Bay for temporary safekeeping. Ensure that every step is sequentially completed, including waiting times and conditional returns, before heading back to the Central Loading Bay to conclude your delivery mission.

instruction: Proceed to Battery Charging Station B to collect a set of twelve high-capacity battery modules destined for various equipment around the facility. Distribute the modules as follows: deliver four battery modules to Automated Harvester Base 2 and wait until the maintenance crew completes unloading each module before leaving the area. Next, transport five battery modules to Irrigation Control Room West, and after arrival, pause for exactly three minutes to allow the systems engineer to perform voltage checks prior to unloading. Finish by bringing the remaining three battery modules to Storage Shed Sigma, waiting there until the inventory supervisor confirms all modules have been received. After all deliveries and confirmations are complete, head to the Facility Operations Center, where you should remain for eight minutes to permit a routine post-delivery inspection before undertaking any further assignments.

Commence activity at Materials Depot West by collecting a total of fourteen battery modules reserved for daily machinery swaps. Deliver five battery modules to Charging Station Alpha and remain on-site until the maintenance technician confirms all five battery modules have been unloaded. Afterwards, transport five additional battery modules to Charging Station Bravo, where you must also wait until the technician has fully removed the modules from your cargo compartment. Take the remaining four battery modules to Charging Station Charlie; after offloading at Charlie, stay for six minutes to allow for any last checks or paperwork by the station supervisor. Progress to the Equipment Service Bay only once you have completed all unloading verifications and the six-minute wait at Charging Station Charlie, and stand by for further dispatch instructions upon arrival.

instruction: Start at Maintenance Bay Alpha and retrieve a batch of nine diagnostic toolkits. For each location, after toolkits are delivered, wait at the site until you receive confirmation that all toolkits have been fully removed and inventoried by the local technician; only proceed to your next destination once this is complete. Once all toolkits are delivered and accounted for, wait at Storage Room Sigma for seven minutes to allow the data synchronization processor to finish updating equipment records, then return promptly to Maintenance Bay Alpha to conclude your assignment.

Commence your operation at Bulk Grain Silo Alpha, where you will collect twelve bags of grain marked for delivery. First, transport five grain bags to Livestock Feeding Station West; once there, wait at the designated drop-off zone while the station operator verifies receipt of all five bags—a process that will require four minutes before you may proceed. Following confirmation at Feeding Station West, carry another four grain bags to Storage Warehouse Delta, waiting for three minutes at the warehouse intake area to allow the automated inventory system to process and record the grain transfer. Finally, deliver the remaining three grain bags to Mill Processing Center Nine, but do not depart until the center supervisor signals that the loading ramp is clear and all bags are securely offloaded; this confirmation is mandatory before you can leave the location. After completing all deliveries and receiving the required time confirmations or supervisor signals at each destination, promptly return to Bulk Grain Silo Alpha and wait on site for seven minutes to ensure no additional transfer requests are pending.

instruction: Start at Supply Depot Bravo and gather fifteen sealed fertilizer canisters along with six irrigation valve actuators. Begin the delivery circuit by bringing five fertilizer canisters to Field Plot East, waiting for a field technician to confirm the canisters are offloaded before continuing. Next, transport another five fertilizer canisters to Field Plot South, again pausing until removal is complete. Deliver the remaining five fertilizer canisters to Field Plot North, where you must wait until a supervisor verifies receipt of all fertilizer canisters. Once all payloads have been distributed and acknowledged at their respective destinations, wait for six minutes at Maintenance Hangar Two to allow for any urgent collection requests before returning to Supply Depot Bravo and awaiting further deployment instructions.

For each delivery location, wait for the respective agronomy crew to confirm full removal and readiness of the canisters before departing; after the final delivery, spend a waiting period of four minutes at Orchard South to complete a post-distribution environmental scan, then return to Central Loading Dock once the countdown is finished. Make sure that all deliveries are performed in the given sequence and that no location is visited before confirming the completion of the previous removal at each stop.

instruction: Start your route at Storage Dock 3, where you will pick up a pallet containing nine bags of granular fertilizer. Once the pallet is secured and all bags are accounted for, head to Field Alpha and deposit three fertilizer bags, waiting at Field Alpha until the field supervisor has confirmed the payload is ready for removal. Following the supervisor's confirmation, proceed to Field Beta with the remaining six bags and deliver three of them to the designated shed, waiting three minutes at Field Beta for the on-site staff to collect the delivery. After the waiting period, take the last three fertilizer bags to Field Gamma and wait until the agricultural team signals that all bags have been fully offloaded and stored appropriately before returning to Storage Dock 3 to complete your task.

Begin by traveling to Fertilizer Storage A to collect a total of 14 sacks of organic fertilizer, ensuring all sacks are properly secured before departure. Distribute the fertilizer among three designated application points as follows: deliver five sacks to Field Plot East, another five sacks to Field Plot West, and transport the remaining four sacks to the Greenhouse Intake Dock, making sure to handle the smaller last batch separately. At each stop, wait for a field supervisor to confirm the sacks have been completely unloaded before proceeding to the next location, and spend three minutes at the Greenhouse Intake Dock after the drop-off to allow for inventory processing. Only after all sacks have reached their assigned destinations and every confirmation has been recorded may you return to Fertilizer Storage A to finalize your delivery documentation and await further assignments.

Start your route at Grain Silo West, where you will collect a payload of 17 soil moisture sensors prepared for distribution. Proceed to Field Plot Yellow, Field Plot Green, and Field Plot Blue in sequence, delivering the sensors such that each field receives five sensors, and after the third field, deliver the two remaining sensors to Field Plot Blue as well. For each field plot, only transfer the sensors once the location's calibration status light indicates it is ready; if the light is red, wait at the entrance until the readiness signal appears before proceeding. After you finish the final transfer at Field Plot Blue, remain in place for a full 4 minutes to allow agronomists to install and check the last batch before you return to Grain Silo West for task completion.

Start at the Central Seed Vault and pick up nine bags of hybrid wheat seeds, then travel first to Field Plot A near the north irrigation channel and deposit three seed bags; after waiting for the field supervisor to confirm removal of all bags, move to Field Plot B bordering the equipment access path and deliver another three seed bags, waiting again for supervisor confirmation. Proceed with the final three seed bags to Field Plot C adjacent to the tree line, and remain until all bags have been offloaded by the agricultural staff. Only after all nine seed bags have been distributed and accepted at their respective plots, continue to the Shaded Equipment Shed at the east end of the property, where you are to wait for a ten-minute interval for any follow-up transport requests before returning to the Central Seed Vault for shutdown.

instruction: Start at the Machine Parts Warehouse and collect eight hydraulic coupling units required for urgent repairs across three separate maintenance bays: Maintenance Bay 1, Maintenance Bay 2, and Maintenance Bay 3. Deliver three hydraulic coupling units to Maintenance Bay 1, and remain on-site until the technicians confirm that they have completed the initial installation of these coupling units. Once installation at Maintenance Bay 1 is confirmed, proceed to Maintenance Bay 2 to deliver another three hydraulic coupling units; after offloading, pause for five minutes to allow for inspection and system pressure testing by maintenance staff. Only after the inspection timeframe has passed, move on to Maintenance Bay 3 with the last two hydraulic coupling units—ensuring that these units are delivered only if both previous delivery and installation confirmations at Maintenance Bay 1 and inspection completion at Maintenance Bay 2 have been received; if not, return any remaining hydraulic coupling units directly to the Machine Parts Warehouse. After all maintenance bays have had their correct allocation confirmed and residual parts, if any, returned, go to the Operations Office to log task completion before ending the mission.

Begin at the Farming Equipment Depot, then travel to the Seed Storage Warehouse to collect five bags of high-yield wheat seed and three nutrient additive canisters, confirming with the warehouse foreman that all items are ready for collection before proceeding. Next, distribute the seed bags and additive canisters evenly between three fields: bring two seed bags and one canister to North Crop Field A, two seed bags and one canister to South Crop Field B, and the remaining seed bag and canister to the smaller East Field C, explicitly noting that East Field C receives the single extra seed bag due to its experimental status. Wait for the field managers at each location to remove their respective items before departing to the next field. After completing all deliveries, remain at East Field C for an exact duration of 10 minutes while the agronomy team initiates soil integration, and then return directly to the Farming Equipment Depot for task closure and reporting.

Starting at the Drone Parts Warehouse, collect six replacement rotor blades and ensure they are securely loaded. Travel first to Assembly Bay 1 and distribute two rotor blades, waiting until the technician at Assembly Bay 1 confirms removal of both blades before proceeding. Next, head to Assembly Bay 2 with another two rotor blades; after arrival, wait five minutes to allow the assembly team to prepare before transferring the parts, ensuring the blades are removed by the team. Finish by delivering the last two rotor blades to Assembly Bay 3—remain there until all blades are taken by the staff. Finally, once all deliveries and removals have been confirmed, return to the Drone Parts Warehouse for inventory reconciliation.

Start at the Main Parts Staging Area and collect eight sealed maintenance toolkits for engine repairs. Distribute the toolkits by delivering three to Engine Bay A, three to Engine Bay B, and the remaining two to Engine Bay C, explicitly confirming at each location that the correct quantity has been allocated—even if this means one bay receives fewer kits due to the total not being evenly divisible. After delivering to each bay, wait for the respective maintenance supervisor to signal that the toolkits have been inspected and removed from your platform before proceeding to the next bay. Between each delivery, pause for five minutes to give technicians time to prepare for unloading and to ensure workspace safety protocols are satisfied. Once all toolkits have been delivered and removal confirmations received at all three engine bays, return directly to the Main Parts Staging Area and remain onsite until further orders are issued.

instruction: Begin at the Central Maintenance Depot and wait until a pallet loaded with 23 gearbox components, labeled 'Transmission Batch A', is declared ready for retrieval. Once these gearbox components are ready, transport eight components to Assembly Station Alpha and wait at Assembly Station Alpha until the assembly supervisor verifies that all eight gearbox components have been removed from the pallet. Immediately after unloading at Assembly Station Alpha, continue with seven gearbox components to Assembly Station Bravo; remain at Assembly Station Bravo until a technician confirms the receipt and removal of these seven components. The remaining eight components must then be taken to the Parts Storage Annex, where you will wait for fifteen minutes upon arrival before unloading begins, allowing storage staff to clear space on the designated rack. Ensure that at each location—Assembly Station Alpha, Assembly Station Bravo, and Parts Storage Annex—the exact quota of gearbox components is delivered, any additional components beyond the standard division are distributed so that no location receives more than one extra component, and the specific sequence of waits and confirmations are strictly followed before proceeding to each subsequent destination. instruction: Start at Storage Depot 7 and collect a thermal coolant canister along with a sealed inspection toolkit. Transport both items to Control Point Delta and deliver the coolant canister to the supply officer; do not release the toolkit at this location. After the successful handoff of the coolant, proceed to Workshop Bay Zeta and wait there for 15 minutes while the on-duty engineer prepares Sectional Robot Unit 4 for inspection. instruction: Start by traveling to the Harvest Storage Facility to collect six sealed seedling crates. Next, deliver two seedling crates to Greenhouse Alpha, another two seedling crates to Nursery Beta, and the remaining two seedling crates to the Perimeter Planting Zone, making sure to evenly distribute the payload. At each stop, wait until the horticulture staff confirms by signaling that the seedling crates are ready for transfer before moving on to the following location. Following the successful drop-off at the Perimeter Planting Zone, remain at that site for seven minutes to monitor for any additional requests from the planting team before finally returning to the Harvest Storage Facility to conclude the delivery route.

Begin at Maintenance Bay 1 and retrieve six diagnostic sensor modules. Transport two sensor modules to Greenhouse Alpha, and remain at Greenhouse Alpha until both modules have been successfully installed by the on-site technician. Once installation is confirmed, proceed to Fertilizer Storage Unit B with three of the four remaining modules, and wait exactly four minutes at Fertilizer Storage Unit B to allow for system calibration after dropping off the modules. Deliver the final sensor module to Equipment Shed C, where you must wait until the module has been removed and checked in by the maintenance supervisor. After all modules are delivered and acknowledged at their destinations, return to Maintenance Bay 1 and await additional deployment instructions.

Initiate the mission at Dock Loading Bay Alpha, proceeding first to the Refrigerated Storage Unit to collect six crates of harvested strawberries. After verifying that all six crates are secured and ready for transit, transport two crates to Packaging Station West and wait until the station supervisor removes both crates for inspection. Next, carry another two crates to Quality Control Lab North and, after confirming crate removal by laboratory staff, remain at the lab for exactly 12 minutes to accommodate rapid batch sampling procedures. Subsequently, deliver the final two crates to Distribution Gate 3, waiting for the dispatch team to take possession. Only after all six crates are successfully delivered and each corresponding removal has occurred, return without delay to Dock Loading Bay Alpha to finalize your delivery report and stand by for subsequent assignments.

Begin your run by moving to the Fertilizer Depot and waiting until the depot manager confirms that a new shipment of twenty-four nutrient packs is ready for dispatch. Then, distribute the nutrient packs in three deliveries: deliver ten packs to Field Block A, ensuring you wait until all ten are removed by the field supervisor; next, bring eight packs to Greenhouse 7, remaining on-site until every pack is unloaded by the greenhouse technician; finally, deliver the six remaining nutrient packs to Orchard Lot 3, staying until the orchard crew verifies receipt and clears you for departure. After all deliveries are complete, remain at Orchard Lot 3 for a period of five minutes to accommodate any reconciliation checks by operations staff before proceeding to the Central Vehicle Maintenance Bay. At the maintenance bay, wait until your transport module is inspected and prepared for the next distribution round.

instruction: Start by collecting four sample water canisters from Storage Unit A at the Processing Bay, then travel to Irrigation Site 1 and dispense one water canister; wait until the field technician has verified removal of the canister before continuing. Next, proceed to Greenhouse Entrance Dock to deliver a second water canister, making sure to wait at least eight minutes after arrival for the environmental sensors to equilibrate before the canister can be removed by the greenhouse staff. After the waiting period and confirmation of canister removal at Greenhouse Entrance Dock, transport a third water canister to Soil Testing Station Z, where you must remain until the station operator removes the canister and provides a clearance signal. The final canister should be taken to Control Hub South, but deliver it only if a signed receipt from Soil Testing Station Z has been obtained; if not, remain at Soil Testing Station Z for five additional minutes and then attempt delivery again. Once all four canisters are confirmed as delivered and removed, return to Processing Bay to await further collection tasks.

instruction.location: Storage Unit A at the Processing Bay
Storage Unit A at the Processing Bay

instruction: Begin by traveling to the Parts Distribution Dock to collect a batch of eleven high-efficiency air filters. These filters are to be allocated among three key facilities in the following manner: bring five air filters to the Primary Ventilation Hub, four to Assembly Line Bay 2, and the remaining two to the Electrical Control Room. At each facility, wait until the maintenance crew has finished removing the assigned air filters before proceeding to the next destination. After all eleven air filters have been delivered and cleared from your cargo, continue to the Autowash Station, where you must remain for exactly ten minutes to complete the mandatory cleaning cycle prior to resuming further operations; arrival at each location must be strictly in the order of Primary Ventilation Hub, Assembly Line Bay 2, and Electrical Control Room, ensuring that all filter drop-offs and waiting protocols are fully observed before beginning the cleaning cycle.

Begin your task at Bulk Storage Warehouse A, collecting a shipment of twelve harvest crates labeled for distribution. Navigate first to Processing Facility X and deliver five of the harvest crates there; after completing the delivery, wait at Processing Facility X for three minutes to allow facility staff to confirm the condition of the crates and to ensure receipt has been registered. Once the confirmation is obtained, proceed with the remaining seven crates to Distribution Dock C, where you must divide them as evenly as possible: deliver two crates each to Packing Line 1, Packing Line 2, and Packing Line 3 at Distribution Dock C, explicitly assigning the leftover one crate to Packing Line 1. Remain stationary at each packing line until the respective line manager signals that the delivery is complete before moving to the next line, progressing sequentially through Packing Line 1, then 2, then 3. Only after all twelve harvest crates have been delivered and the required acknowledgments received at every stop, return to Bulk Storage Warehouse A to notify the coordinator of task completion.

Commence the task at the loading dock of Storage Facility A, collect nine replacement drive belts labeled for the Sorting Line, and then make your way to Conveyor Belt Station 1. Unload and wait for engineering staff to confirm removal of three drive belts at Conveyor Belt Station 1 before proceeding. Next, head to Conveyor Belt Station 2, deliver another three drive belts, and again wait for staff to acknowledge each belt is removed. For the final set of three drive belts, travel to Conveyor Belt Station 3, where you will wait for confirmation of receipt before continuing. After all drive belts have been distributed and verified at their respective stations, proceed directly to the Machine Maintenance Bay and wait there for seven minutes for system diagnostic checks to be completed prior to returning to Storage Facility A for your next instructions.

loading dock of Storage Facility A

instruction: Begin your route at the Seed Packing Warehouse, where you must collect a batch of twelve sealed corn seed crates after verifying with the warehouse manager that the entire batch is prepared for distribution. Divide the shipment by transporting five crates first to Silo Loading Dock 1, and wait on site until the dock workers finish unloading all five crates before proceeding. After confirming complete removal at Loading Dock 1, continue to Silo Loading Dock 2 with four corn seed crates; upon arrival, remain at the location and wait precisely 3 minutes for a safety inspection and removal of the crates by staff. With the final three corn seed crates, make your way to the Field Distribution Shed, delivering them and waiting until the field supervisor confirms that all crates are removed from your vehicle. Only once all crates have been delivered and you have received acknowledgments at each of the three drop-off points, you should head back to the Seed Packing Warehouse and wait there for your next assignment.

Start by collecting a crate of twelve mechanical parts from the maintenance hangar at Depot West and proceed to the Central Tractor Garage, where you must deliver four parts for immediate engine repairs, ensuring the mechanic has confirmed their receipt before continuing. After confirmation, remain at the garage for six minutes to assist with any urgent requests, then take the crate with the remaining eight mechanical parts to Field Workshop North and unload another four parts, waiting until the workshop lead certifies the handover is complete. Finally, transport the last four mechanical parts to the Storage Bay at Administration Block A and only depart the premises once the bay supervisor has finished inspecting and removing the delivered items.

instruction.location: Storage Bay at Administration Block A
Storage Bay at Administration Block A

instruction: Start at the Manufacturing Receiving Bay and collect twelve high-precision bearing cases. Divide the cases so that four are destined for Assembly Line Alpha, another four for Assembly Line Bravo, and the final four for Maintenance Workshop Delta. First, proceed to Assembly Line Alpha and, after arrival, wait until the automated lift system signals readiness before each bearing case is handed over, repeating this process until all four bearing cases are transferred. Upon completion, navigate to Assembly Line Bravo, but pause for three minutes upon entering the area to allow for safety checks prior to unloading; once the time has elapsed, deliver the four bearing cases and wait until line staff confirm full receipt. Following this, head to Maintenance Workshop Delta and remain there until the maintenance supervisor has finished preparing the storage racks; only then may you deliver the last four bearing cases. After all bearing cases have been distributed and confirmations received at each location, proceed to the Decontamination Airlock to undergo a six-minute sanitation cycle before returning to the Manufacturing Receiving Bay.

Initiate your task at the main storage warehouse by collecting a batch of sixteen seed nutrient cartridges, making sure all cartridges are securely loaded before leaving. Head directly to Greenhouse One and distribute seven seed nutrient cartridges there, awaiting confirmation from the greenhouse supervisor that all cartridges have been properly received. Once the delivery to Greenhouse One is complete, proceed to the seedling preparation shed to deliver another five seed nutrient cartridges; do not depart the shed until the crew has finished removing these cartridges and signals readiness. Afterwards, drive to the rooftop experimental garden with the four remaining seed nutrient cartridges, but if the delivery at the seedling shed is delayed for any reason, wait an additional ten minutes at the seedling preparation shed before advancing to the rooftop. Only deliver the cartridges to the rooftop experimental garden after previous removals are acknowledged, then return to the main storage warehouse to conclude your route.

Commence at the Central Grain Silo and load fifteen sealed wheat sample boxes onto the payload platform. Travel first to the North Field Testing Outpost, where you will deliver five wheat sample boxes and wait at the outpost until all boxes are removed by the laboratory staff. Once the transfer at the North Field Testing Outpost is complete, continue to the East River Dock to deliver another five wheat sample boxes; however, before offloading, wait for two full minutes to ensure that dock workers are ready to receive the samples. After the two-minute interval, hand over the boxes and confirm all have been collected. Proceed next to the South Processing Mill with the remaining five wheat sample boxes, but pause outside for four minutes to allow for dust control protocols to be initiated. Only after this waiting period may you transfer the final set of wheat sample boxes to the mill staff. When all wheat sample boxes have been distributed and receipts from each location are confirmed, return directly to the Central Grain Silo to conclude the operation.

Begin by navigating to the Component Storage Room on the west side of the assembly plant to pick up twelve replacement drive belts labeled 'Batch M21'. Once collected, deliver four drive belts each to Machine Station A near the central assembly line, Machine Station B adjacent to the quality control area, and Machine Station C in the east maintenance bay, ensuring an equal split so that every station receives four belts; if any unexpected machine at a station is under repair, wait at that station for five minutes to allow technicians to swap the old belts before you leave. After delivering all twelve belts across the three machine stations, proceed directly to the Maintenance Supervisor's Office located above the north factory floor and wait until the replacement inventory is signed off by the supervisor, which may take up to eight minutes. Once confirmation is received, return to the Component Storage Room to complete your mission, carrying back any empty containers that were previously used for transporting the drive belts from all three machine stations.

instruction: Begin your mission at the Harvest Loading Dock, where you must collect a shipping container holding 17 crates of freshly picked tomatoes. Your task is to distribute these tomato crates among Packing Station Alpha, Packing Station Bravo, and Packing Station Charlie, ensuring that each station receives exactly five crates, while the remaining two crates are to be delivered to Packing Station Alpha first. Upon delivering the crates to Packing Station Alpha, pause for 3 minutes so that the station manager can inspect the crates and remove them individually; once all crates are confirmed removed, proceed to Packing Station Bravo and repeat the same pause of 3 minutes before leaving. After completing all deliveries and ensuring all crates have been removed from your payload, head to the Maintenance Bay for routine diagnostics, where you must remain stationary for 7 minutes while the maintenance crew runs safety checks, before finally returning to the Harvest Loading Dock to conclude the task.

Start at the North Field Supply Shed and retrieve a set of 15 irrigation pipe segments labeled 'Drip Line Batch One'; once these pipe segments are ready, prepare to distribute them across three distinct zones—East Crop Plot, South Orchard, and West Veg Garden. Deliver 5 pipe segments to East Crop Plot and, after waiting for 4 minutes to allow farm staff to inspect and confirm proper offloading, proceed to South Orchard with the next 5 pipe segments. At South Orchard, wait 2 additional minutes before unloading to permit local workers to finish clearing previous equipment from the transfer area. The final 5 pipe segments are to be delivered to West Veg Garden, but you must pause for 3 minutes upon arrival to ensure the irrigation crew is present to accept delivery. After all pipe segments have been successfully distributed, verified, and received in the specified sequence, traverse directly to Machinery Wash Pad and await further cleaning instructions from the equipment manager.

instruction: Commence at the Main Tool Depot to load eight rechargeable battery packs designated for equipment maintenance, then proceed to the North Repair Station, the Central Monitoring Post, and the West Utility Shed to distribute them as follows: deliver three battery packs to the North Repair Station, two packs to the Central Monitoring Post, and three packs to the West Utility Shed. Following each delivery, wait at each location for the resident technician to signal that the battery packs have been safely removed and installed in their respective equipment before proceeding to the next site. Make sure to visit the locations in this specified order, ensuring that no further transfers occur until the removal confirmation at each destination is complete. Once all stations have received their allocated battery packs and all removals have been verified, return to the Main Tool Depot and remain stationed there for ten minutes, allowing any urgent collection requests to be communicated by depot staff before concluding the route.

Begin your operation at the Harvest Loading Dock, where you will await confirmation that eight crates of freshly picked apples are ready for transport. After the crates are prepared, first take three apple crates to Cold Storage Room One and wait there until staff confirm all three crates have been removed from the robot. Next, deliver two crates to Quality Inspection Bay and remain at the bay until all apple crates have been fully unloaded by the inspectors. Transport the final three crates to Packaging Station Delta; after the last crate is removed at Packaging Station Delta, stay at this station for four minutes to allow for the completion of a sanitation cycle before returning to the Harvest Loading Dock to conclude the assignment.

Begin at the Grain Dryer Facility and wait for the sensor unit labeled Moisture Probe Set A to be secured on the robot. Once the Moisture Probe Set A is loaded, proceed to Field Plot 1 and pause until the agronomist retrieves the sensor unit from the robot. As soon as the sensor handover is complete, travel to Fertilizer Shed 3 to collect three sealed fertilizer containers. Divide the containers as follows: deliver one container to Greenhouse Alpha, one to Greenhouse Beta, and two containers—if available—to Greenhouse Gamma, making separate trips for each delivery if the robot can only carry one container at a time; if there are only three containers total, ensure that Greenhouse Gamma receives the third. After each drop-off, wait while the greenhouse staff remove the fertilizer container before proceeding to the next greenhouse. After all deliveries are finalized, return to the Grain Dryer Facility and wait outside for four minutes to allow for environmental contamination checks before re-entering the facility.

Start from the central supply depot and acquire nine irrigation pipe connectors designated for repair work. First, deliver three connectors to the South Orchard Repair Post and wait until the maintenance crew confirms the removal of all connectors before departing. Next, transport three of the remaining connectors to the East Vegetable Plot Tool Shed, again remaining at the location until the entire drop-off is unloaded by staff. For the final part of the allocation, bring the last three connectors to the Northwest Vineyard Pump Station. After unloading and receiving confirmation that all connectors have been collected, wait at the pump station for ten minutes to support possible immediate repairs, then proceed to the maintenance control office to report task completion.

instruction: Start at the West Agricultural Supply Warehouse and pick up a batch of fourteen fertilizer canisters set aside for distribution. Your route will take you first to Orchard Station Alpha, where you will deliver five canisters and wait until the orchard supervisor confirms all items are accounted for. Once confirmation is received from Orchard Station Alpha, travel to Crop Test Plot Bravo and offload another five canisters, then pause exactly three minutes to allow farm staff sufficient time for inventory registration. Bring the remaining four canisters to Greenhouse Pad Charlie and await the technician’s removal of the final payload. Do not depart Greenhouse Pad Charlie until the technician indicates that all canisters have been unloaded. Only after all fertilizer canisters have been delivered, acknowledged, and the required waiting period completed should you return directly to the West Agricultural Supply Warehouse to close out the delivery manifest.

Begin your route at Grain Silo West to collect a total of seven soil analysis sample kits. First, proceed to Cornfield North and deliver three sample kits to the field analysis team, ensuring you wait at Cornfield North until all three sample kits have been confirmed as received and removed from your payload modules. After the removal is complete, head south to Irrigation Control Station and supply two more soil analysis sample kits, but remain at this station for four minutes to enable system calibration with the new samples. Once four minutes have passed, continue to the Experimental Crop Enclosure to hand over one soil analysis sample kit and wait for explicit confirmation from the enclosure staff that the kit has been securely received. Finally, bring the last remaining sample kit to the Orchard Test Plot and await its removal; only after all seven sample kits have been delivered and accounted for at their sites should you return to Grain Silo West, where you must wait for two minutes before initiating any further outbound trips.

Begin at the Harvest Depot next to the east entrance and collect nine crates of freshly picked apples intended for processing. Evenly distribute these crates among the three designated Processing Stations—Processing Station A, Processing Station B, and Processing Station C—by delivering three crates to each location sequentially. After delivering each batch of three crates to a station, wait at that station until a staff member confirms that all crates have been removed. After all nine crates have been delivered and confirmed removed, drive to the Disinfection Bay located beside the central control tower and remain stationary for four minutes to undergo mandatory sanitation procedures before returning to the Harvest Depot for the next assignment.

instruction: Begin your route at Maintenance Bay X, where you must retrieve a set of twenty replacement hydraulic fittings. Distribute these evenly among Packing Station A, Conveyor Access Point 9, and Sorting Facility West by delivering six fittings to each location; for the remaining two fittings, take one to Quality Control Room and the final one to Machine Shop 5. At each primary destination—Packing Station A, Conveyor Access Point 9, and Sorting Facility West—wait precisely two minutes upon arrival to allow the resident technician to prepare for offloading before transferring the designated fittings, and after each handoff, do not depart until the on-site supervisor has acknowledged removal of the items. Following the delivery of the extra fittings to Quality Control Room and then to Machine Shop 5, remain at each of these secondary destinations for exactly ninety seconds to await confirmation from technical staff that the single fitting has been successfully received. After all fittings have been delivered and acceptance confirmed at every location, return immediately to Maintenance Bay X, but pause there for five minutes to allow record updates and route debriefing before concluding your assignment.

Starting at the Warehouse Loading Dock, load twelve irrigation hose reels onto your transport unit, guaranteeing all reels are securely fastened before you leave. Proceed first to Greenhouse Sector 1 and unload five hose reels; wait until the greenhouse supervisor signals that all reels have been detached from the unit and logged into inventory. Following confirmation, navigate to the Orchard Supply Shed with four additional hose reels—upon arrival, wait three minutes to allow supply staff to prepare for receipt, then facilitate the transfer of the reels, documenting each handoff. Finally, transport the remaining three hose reels to Vineyard Equipment Bay, but only initiate unloading once the equipment bay attendant verifies available space for storage; after all three reels have been successfully transferred, remain at Vineyard Equipment Bay for two minutes to provide assistance in equipment organization if needed, concluding your assignment after that period.

Begin the fertilizer distribution operation at Supply Shed West, where you will collect a total of twenty-four sealed fertilizer bags designated for the main cultivation fields. Evenly divide the fertilizer bags for delivery by bringing eight bags each to Field A North, Field B East, and Field C South, and if any remainder exists after dividing the bags, ensure the final two bags are delivered to Field D Annex. After you have dropped the correct number of bags at each field, pause for five minutes at Field D Annex to allow the agronomy crew to inventory and confirm the full reception of all bags. Only after inventory confirmation from every field, proceed directly to Irrigation Control Station and remain there for ten minutes while your onboard system updates the supply manifest and sensors are recalibrated for the next deployment round.

Start at the Parts Inventory Room inside the Central Workshop and retrieve twelve sensor modules designated for upgrade work across three remote monitoring towers. Transport four sensor modules to Monitoring Tower 1 near the eastern fence line, and after arriving, wait there until all four sensor modules have been individually removed by the tower supervisor. Once Monitoring Tower 1 confirms full reception, proceed to Monitoring Tower 2 at the north hill and deliver another four sensor modules, but pause for exactly three minutes after unloading to allow the local safety team to de-energize the equipment before any modules are handled. After this mandatory waiting period and confirmation, take the final four sensor modules to Monitoring Tower 3 on the southwest ridge. If at any point notification is received of a missing sensor module at any previous tower, detour to the Mobile Command Unit for a system status check lasting two minutes before attempting to complete the delivery route. Upon successful delivery and explicit confirmation from all three monitoring towers, return to the Parts Inventory Room to report task completion.

instruction: Begin at Central Loading Dock and collect a set of 14 pesticide canisters prepared for field distribution. After the readiness of the canisters is confirmed by the supervisor, transport the first 5 canisters to Orchard Sector B; upon arrival, wait until Orchard Operator #3 has fully collected all 5 canisters, then proceed to Vineyard Block F with the next 5 canisters. Once at Vineyard Block F, wait precisely two minutes to allow the vineyard lead to clear a staging space before transferring the canisters. Following offloading in Vineyard Block F, deliver the remaining 4 canisters to Crop Research Plot Delta, and wait for the principal researcher to inspect and remove all canisters before departing. Do not proceed to any subsequent step until the current location's canisters have been completely retrieved. After confirming that all 14 canisters have been offloaded and acknowledged at their respective locations, travel directly to Central Maintenance Garage and remain there until further deployment instructions are received.

Begin your mission at Supply Warehouse Delta by retrieving eleven packets of calibrated planting sensors from Storage Rack 2. First, proceed to Seed Field Alpha and deliver four planting sensor packets to the Field Sensor Node, remaining at Seed Field Alpha until the onsite supervisor has confirmed removal of all four packets. Next, travel to Processing Shed Gamma and hand over another four packets to the Processing Station Input Desk, waiting until you receive confirmation that each packet has been received by Process Shed Gamma staff. Afterward, continue to Nursery Sorting Area Bravo with the remaining three packets and place them on the designated Sorting Table, waiting for the inventory manager at Nursery Sorting Area Bravo to collect all three packets. Once all pickups are acknowledged at each destination, remain at Nursery Sorting Area Bravo for exactly eight minutes for system recalibration before returning to Supply Warehouse Delta to conclude your delivery cycle.

instruction: Begin at the Central Depot and collect six pesticide canisters designated for regional field operations. Deliver two canisters to Field Alpha, and wait until the field supervisor removes both canisters from your payload. After this removal is confirmed, proceed with two more canisters to Field Bravo, again waiting until the respective crew completes the unloading process. For the final allocation, transport the last two canisters to Field Charlie and remain on-site until technicians have taken possession of both canisters and signal completion. Only after all canisters have been distributed and the unloading at Field Charlie is acknowledged should you proceed to the Wash Station, where you must wait for 5 minutes while the vehicle undergoes a decontamination wash, before returning directly to the Central Depot.

Begin by moving to the Seed Storage Facility and loading fifteen irrigation sensors, making sure that all sensors are accounted for before departure. Head directly to South Field Plot A and deliver five sensors, pausing at South Field Plot A until the agronomist confirms that all five sensors have been removed from the robot. After leaving South Field Plot A, proceed to East Field Plot B and distribute another six sensors; if the field technician at East Field Plot B cannot accept the entire batch, deliver only what can be accepted and immediately redirect any sensors left over to the Spare Equipment Shelter before proceeding. Once the deliveries to both South Field Plot A and East Field Plot B are complete, wait for a full three minutes at the Spare Equipment Shelter to comply with safety protocols. Finally, carry the last four sensors to North Field Plot C, remain there until the field operator confirms receipt and installation readiness of all four sensors, and only then return to the Seed Storage Facility for debriefing and to await further orders.

Commence operations at the Central Packing Warehouse and collect a total of nine labeled produce crates earmarked for distribution. Deliver three crates to the Eastern Loading Dock, waiting for personnel to confirm the crates have been fully removed from the vehicle before proceeding. Next, transport an additional three crates to Orchard Gatehouse C, but remain on site for a period of 5 minutes after arrival to allow the quality inspector to complete checks prior to transfer. Finally, bring the last three crates to Greenhouse Storage Zone 7; if all previous deliveries have been confirmed, immediately transfer these crates, but if any prior destinations experienced a delay, wait at Greenhouse Storage Zone 7 until notified that all prior crates have reached their intended recipients. Once all nine crates have been distributed and acknowledged at each site, return to Central Packing Warehouse to submit a distribution completion report.

instruction: Begin at the Raw Materials Depot and verify that a batch of fourteen seed packs is ready for transport. Evenly distribute the seed packs by first proceeding to Field Alpha and dropping off five seed packs, requesting that the field supervisor removes them before heading to the next site. After Field Alpha is supplied, travel to Field Beta and transfer another five seed packs; again, make sure the packs have been fully removed by the local crew. Once both Field Alpha and Field Beta have received their shares, take the remaining four seed packs to Field Gamma. After delivering the final seed packs at Field Gamma and confirming all have been offloaded, wait at Field Gamma for ten minutes to allow field staff to inspect the delivery; only return to the Raw Materials Depot when the waiting period has elapsed and all deliveries are complete.

Start your task at the Loading Dock near the Main Storage Facility and load a shipment of twenty-seven fertilizer bags, making sure all bags are properly secured for transit. Head first to Silo Alpha and deposit nine fertilizer bags, waiting for two minutes after unloading to allow for inventory logging by the dock supervisor. After finishing at Silo Alpha, continue to Silo Beta, where you are to deliver another nine fertilizer bags; while at Silo Beta, remain at the unloading area for exactly 90 seconds so staff can verify the bag count matches the manifest. With nine more fertilizer bags remaining, proceed to Silo Gamma; if and only if the facility manager at Silo Gamma signals that the intake system is ready, then unload the final bags and wait an additional three minutes to support the automated storage process. Upon successful completion at all three silos and after all waiting periods have elapsed, return to the Loading Dock to report mission completion and await further orders.

instruction.location: Loading Dock near the Main Storage Facility
Loading Dock near the Main Storage Facility

instruction: Start at the main harvest storage silo and wait until the loading operator confirms that a total of ten bins of freshly picked apples are ready for collection. Once loaded, initiate the first delivery run by transporting four apple bins to Packing Shed North and remain on-site until all bins have been removed by the reception staff. After finishing the north delivery, proceed directly to Juicing Facility East with another three apple bins and, upon arrival, wait for a mandatory six-minute quality inspection before handing over the bins to the processing team. Once the inspection is complete and the bins are offloaded, deliver the final three apple bins to Cold Storage Unit West. At Cold Storage Unit West, wait for refrigerated storage readiness confirmation before allowing removal of the apple bins. When all deliveries are finalized and each location has received and removed its designated bins, return to the maintenance station adjacent to the main silo and remain there for further updates.

instruction.location: maintenance station adjacent to the main silo

instruction: Start your task at the Main Equipment Shed by picking up a full toolkit case and three replacement hydraulic pumps. Deliver the toolkit case to Maintenance Bay A first, and remain until the maintenance supervisor confirms all required tools from the case have been removed. Once the removal is verified, proceed to the Tractor Hangar and drop off one hydraulic pump, waiting outside until the old faulty pump is retrieved and installed by the mechanics. Next, go to Field Edge Station and supply the second hydraulic pump; however, after handoff, wait at Field Edge Station for exactly five minutes to allow operators to run mandatory system checks using the new pump before continuing your route. Deliver the third and final hydraulic pump to the Drone Launch Pad, and after unloading, pause until a launch pad technician indicates the spare part has been stowed appropriately. If all three hydraulic pumps and the toolkit case have been delivered and acknowledged at their respective destinations, return directly to the Main Equipment Shed to await your next assignment.

Begin your route at the Harvest Storage Shed and retrieve a batch of 17 freshly packed carrot crates. Make your first stop at Sorting Line Alpha, where you must unload six carrot crates and remain until the sorting staff confirm all crates are properly counted and moved onto the conveyor. Next, drive to Sorting Line Bravo and deliver another six carrot crates; wait for four minutes while staff inspect the batch for quality before proceeding. With the remaining five carrot crates, continue to Sorting Line Charlie—before dropping them off, ensure the processing line supervisor signals that the previous load has cleared the intake buffer. Only release the five crates into Sorting Line Charlie once this confirmation is received. After all 17 crates are successfully delivered and acknowledged at their respective destinations, return directly to the Harvest Storage Shed without any intermediate stops.

instruction: Start at the Main Workshop and prepare to transfer twelve diagnostic toolkits needed for scheduled tractor maintenance. Transport the toolkits in sequential batches of four, beginning by delivering four toolkits to Maintenance Bay Alpha situated near the southern machinery line; after reaching Maintenance Bay Alpha, wait until the head mechanic retrieves all four toolkits before proceeding. Next, take the remaining toolkits in two additional trips with four toolkits each: deliver the second set to Maintenance Bay Bravo adjacent to the vehicle storage shed, but after unloading, remain stationary for 150 seconds to allow system checks before the kits are accepted. Complete the circuit by taking the final four toolkits to Maintenance Bay Charlie at the eastern edge of the compound, ensuring each toolkit is handed over and confirmation is received from the maintenance supervisor before your departure. Once all batches have been delivered and every removal has been acknowledged, return directly to the Main Workshop and do not depart for new tasks until a 3-minute synchronization interval has elapsed.

instruction: Begin your shift at Crop Field West and load fifteen crates of freshly harvested strawberries onto the robot. Next, transport six crates to Cold Storage Facility 2, dropping off the first two crates at Receiving Dock A and the next four crates at Chilled Locker Section B; for each drop-off, wait at the location until facility staff have confirmed crate removal and the handover log is signed. After completing both deliveries, proceed with the remaining nine crates to Packaging Plant Loading Bay. Upon arrival, pause for four minutes before unloading to give packaging line engineers time to prepare the offloading equipment. Once four minutes have passed, transfer the nine crates to the Packaging Plant Loading Bay and remain on site until all are confirmed received by the supervisor. After all crates have been delivered, return immediately to Crop Field West and stay there for further harvesting assignments, confirming your cargo compartment is empty before accepting a new task.

Begin at the Parts Warehouse and load seven battery modules intended for different operational sites. Your route starts by delivering two battery modules to Maintenance Dock 1, where you must remain until the technician removes both modules and signals that the dock's battery inventory is updated. After confirmation, continue with three battery modules to Charging Station B and wait for five minutes after arrival to allow existing depleted modules to be disconnected before unloading the new modules; you are to hand over all three modules only after the charging supervisor grants clearance. With the remaining two battery modules, proceed to Emergency Backup Room Delta, but do not enter unless both Maintenance Dock 1 and Charging Station B deliveries have been fully offloaded and documented by the respective site managers. Once inside Backup Room Delta, stay for two minutes while the facility supervisor verifies correct placement and logs the replenishment. Finally, return to the Parts Warehouse and await further deployment instructions for at least three minutes to allow cooling of your internal powertrain before any subsequent assignments.

Initiate your task at Assembly Line Gamma by collecting a set of twelve precision gearboxes and nine high-torque servo arms scheduled for distribution. Deliver four precision gearboxes each to Quality Control Lab Delta, Robotics Testing Room Omega, and Spare Parts Storage Bay Hermia, ensuring any remainder is handled by placing the final gearbox at Staff Workshop Theta. For every drop-off, wait two minutes immediately after arrival to allow verification of the consignment by on-site staff before continuing to the next destination. Once all gearboxes have been distributed and all associated waiting periods completed, proceed to Deliveries Dock Zeta with the nine high-torque servo arms, but only unload these if the dock supervisor confirms the receiving area is clear; if confirmation is delayed, wait outside for up to five minutes. After the entire servo arm payload has been transferred to the dock, return promptly to Assembly Line Gamma and remain for a period of five minutes, awaiting further instructions or possible task reassignment.

object.description: confirmation from dock supervisor that receiving area is clear

instruction: Begin at Loading Bay Gamma and confirm that ten fertilizer bags are ready for dispatch. Load all ten fertilizer bags and proceed to Cornfield North, where you will distribute three fertilizer bags; remain at Cornfield North until the field operator verifies all three bags have been received and positioned. Next, carry the remaining seven bags to Wheatfield South, allocate four fertilizer bags at this location, and wait until the agronomist completes the registration of the delivered bags. Take the remaining three fertilizer bags directly to Orchard Center, but before entering the storage zone, hold at the Orchard Center gate for four minutes to allow the storage clerk to finish organizing previous stock; after the four-minute waiting period, enter and deliver all three remaining fertilizer bags, pausing at Orchard Center until each bag has been officially logged and acknowledged as received. After completing these tasks and verifying that every fertilizer bag has been placed and confirmed at its assigned destination, return to Loading Bay Gamma and remain on standby for five minutes to await post-distribution inspection or further instructions from the logistics coordinator.

Begin your operation at Silo Entry Gate Alpha and proceed to Grain Reserve Bunker 2, where eight sealed barrels of wheat require transport to three destinations: Bakery Loading Bay, Animal Feed Mill Depot, and Cereal Packaging Center. At Grain Reserve Bunker 2, wait until the storage supervisor verifies the barrels are ready for transfer. Transport three barrels to the Bakery Loading Bay and wait for the bakery staff to remove each barrel from your hold before proceeding. After the Bakery Loading Bay is fully unloaded, carry three additional barrels to Animal Feed Mill Depot and pause for five minutes at the dockside to permit on-site personnel to clear unloading space. Once the pause is complete and the depot crew has removed all three barrels, deliver the final two barrels to the Cereal Packaging Center. Remain at the Cereal Packaging Center until the packaging staff removes both barrels before returning directly to Silo Entry Gate Alpha for debrief and assignment check-in.

Begin at Loading Dock 3 and collect a crate of ten precision toolkits destined for the maintenance bays. First, deliver four toolkits to Maintenance Bay Alpha and wait for the on-site engineer to remove them from the robot. Once the removal is confirmed, proceed to Maintenance Bay Beta and drop off three more toolkits, again waiting for the assigned technician to complete unloading. The remaining three toolkits must be taken to Maintenance Bay Gamma, where you must wait for two minutes to allow for supervisor inspection before the removal process begins. After the toolkits are received at all locations, return to Loading Dock 3 and await further instructions from the logistics coordinator.

Begin your assignment at the Packing Shed, where you will collect a crate containing eleven harvested apple bins. Transport the full crate to Cold Storage Room A and deliver four apple bins, waiting at Cold Storage Room A until the handling crew completes removal of these bins before moving to the next location. Next, take the remaining seven apple bins to Storage Dock B, but first deliver three bins and wait for 5 minutes to allow the dock supervisor to arrange stacking. After that, transfer the final four bins to Packing Line 2, ensuring that all bins are accounted for and wait until the conveyor system is ready for intake before departing. Only after all apple bins have been successfully delivered to their respective destinations may you return the empty crate to the Packing Shed to conclude your route.

Begin your mission at the Grain Storage Silo and collect twelve seed distribution canisters, verifying that all canisters are securely loaded. Next, make your way to the North Field Seeding Point and deliver five canisters, remaining in position until the seeding supervisor confirms that every canister has been removed from your payload compartment. Once this transfer is fully completed, travel to the West Meadow Seeding Station with another five canisters and again wait until the site staff have collected the full batch. Finally, proceed to the Southern Marshland Plot and deliver the last two canisters, ensuring that they are acknowledged and unloaded by the local planting crew. After all distribution points have received their seed canisters and removals are verified, remain at the Southern Marshland Plot for seven minutes to assist with contingency supply needs, and only after this waiting period return directly to the Grain Storage Silo to conclude your delivery circuit.

Begin the assignment by driving to Central Warehouse 3 and securing a shipment of eleven pallet boxes containing fertilizer mix. For the first part of the delivery route, transport four pallet boxes to Field Plot North and wait at the drop-off point until all four pallet boxes have been unloaded by the field technicians. Once this transfer is verified, proceed to Orchard Supply Station 2 with another four pallet boxes, remaining in place until all four have been fully removed by the orchard crew. Next, take the final three pallet boxes to Hydroponic Tent Cluster E; however, before any handover occurs, you must wait at least eight minutes for the area to be cleared by safety staff. If clearance is granted within the eight-minute window, complete the delivery as soon as possible; if not, maintain your wait until explicit approval is received and then finalize the transfer. After all pallet boxes have reached their respective destinations, relocate to Equipment Charging Dock B and allow a ten-minute recharge period before shutting down for maintenance review.

Start at the Main Loading Dock and secure nine insulated crates containing temperature-sensitive vaccines for livestock. Distribute these nine vaccine crates among Animal Barn 1, Animal Barn 2, and Animal Barn 3, delivering three crates to each barn; if any barn declines delivery of one or more crates due to overstock, redistribute those particular crates in equal measure among the other barns, ensuring no crate is left undelivered. At each barn, wait until the responsible staff at that location unloads their assigned crates before proceeding to the next barn. After all deliveries are complete and crates are acknowledged by staff at the barns, proceed to the Cold Storage Monitoring Room and remain there for eight minutes to transmit delivery logs and await remote confirmation from the veterinary supervisor, only returning to the Main Loading Dock after the full eight-minute wait and log transmission are concluded.
