instruction: Begin at Storage Bay 7 and pick up a shipment of fifteen fertilizer canisters, ensuring each canister is securely latched. Transport six canisters to Field Sector Blue and wait at Field Sector Blue for two minutes while the crop manager tests the distribution method, then transfer the canisters only after receiving confirmation. Next, carry five of the remaining canisters to Field Sector Gold, but before delivery, pause outside the field gate for seven minutes to allow Field Sector Gold technicians to calibrate their dispenser, and deliver the fertilizer canisters only when calibration is complete. The final four canisters are destined for Hydroponics Station Gamma; however, proceed there only after receiving documented handovers from both Field Sector Blue and Field Sector Gold. At Hydroponics Station Gamma, remain until a station supervisor removes each of the four canisters and provides a signed receipt for each. After all canisters have been delivered and documentation is collected, return to Storage Bay 7 and wait for three minutes to allow inventory specialists to audit and close the fertilizer distribution log.

Begin your route at the Central Packing Facility, where you must retrieve a batch of eighteen sealed seed pouches intended for three separate experimental test plots: Plot Red, Plot Blue, and Plot Green. Evenly allocate six sealed seed pouches to each plot, ensuring no pouches are left unassigned. Head first to Plot Red, deliver the six sealed seed pouches, and wait until the field technician at Plot Red has acknowledged and removed all six pouches from your payload compartment. Afterward, travel to Plot Blue, drop off another six sealed seed pouches, and remain on-site for four minutes to allow researchers to visually inspect the delivery and sign off on receipt. Regardless of when inspection is completed, do not depart early. Once the wait time at Plot Blue has fully elapsed, proceed to Plot Green with the final six sealed seed pouches. At Plot Green, transfer the last six pouches to the agronomy supervisor, but pause and do not exit the area until you receive a direct confirmation from the supervisor that the seed distribution has been logged in their system. Once all three plots have received their allotted seed pouches and all confirmation steps are complete, return to the Central Packing Facility and park at the robot staging area to conclude your delivery session.

instruction.location: Central Packing Facility robot staging area

instruction: Start at the Packing House Loading Dock to collect a pallet containing thirteen crates of harvested apples, making sure the crates are properly stacked for transport. Distribute these crates to three different cold storage zones: take five crates to Cold Room A first, and after the facility manager confirms delivery by inspecting and removing the crates, proceed to Cold Room B with another four crates. Once the Cold Room B operator has received those crates, head to Cold Room C with the remaining four crates, but if at any point a room is not ready to accept crates, wait outside that cold room for four minutes before attempting delivery again. Once all crates are successfully delivered and each cold room has acknowledged removal, return directly to the Packing House Loading Dock to update the delivery manifest and stand by for new instructions.

Start by moving to the Parts Storage Room to pick up eight hydraulic pump modules. Transfer three pump modules to Maintenance Bay 1, ensuring the technician removes all three modules before departure, then proceed to Maintenance Bay 2 and deliver another three modules, again waiting for the technician to confirm removal. With the final two pump modules, travel to Maintenance Bay 3 for delivery, standing by until these last modules are taken by the technician. After all pump modules are distributed to their respective maintenance bays, head to the Quality Inspection Zone, where you must wait for twelve minutes to allow inspectors to prepare outgoing inspection paperwork. Upon receiving confirmation that paperwork preparation has been completed, return immediately to the Parts Storage Room to end this cycle.

Begin by proceeding to Maintenance Bay 3 to collect a set of eight replacement air filters required for multiple greenhouse climate control units across the facility. Once all eight air filters are loaded and secured, make your first delivery by transporting three air filters to the Eastern Greenhouse Entrance and waiting there until the greenhouse technician has removed all three filters from your cargo. After confirmation, continue to the Hydroponics Wing and provide two air filters, pausing at the delivery gate until each filter has been taken by the hydroponics engineer. For the remaining three air filters, move to the Climate Control Center; wait for the chief technician to arrive, unload the final three filters, and confirm their receipt. Only after all deliveries are complete should you return directly to Maintenance Bay 3, but before ending your shift, remain stationary at the bay's access point for five minutes to accommodate any emergency restock requests from the greenhouse management team.

Begin at the Storage Barn and collect nine sealed fertilizer canisters, confirming that all canisters are marked for the current planting cycle. Next, proceed to Field Plot East, Field Plot West, and Field Plot South to distribute the canisters: deliver three fertilizer canisters to Field Plot East, three to Field Plot West, and the remaining three to Field Plot South, ensuring each plot receives exactly three canisters. For each plot, after arriving, wait for the farm technician at the respective location to complete the canister unloading process and signal readiness before transporting the next batch to the following location. Once all nine canisters have been successfully delivered and acknowledged at their destinations, wait at Field Plot South for ten minutes to allow nutrient sensors to record baseline data prior to returning directly to the Storage Barn for your next assignment.

Start your route at the main feedstock warehouse and load nine crates of hydroponic nutrient solution onto the transport rack. Deliver three crates to the West Lettuce Grow Bay and wait until the bay manager completes inventory before proceeding. Next, transport another three crates to the South Tomato Tunnel, but after depositing these crates, you must stay in place for five minutes to allow lab technicians to test the nutrient samples on site. Once the waiting period is over, carry the remaining three crates to the Rooftop Herb Garden; upon arrival, do not offload the crates until receiving notification from the irrigation lead that the previous batch has been fully dispensed. After all destinations have received the correct number of crates and confirmations are complete, return empty racks to the main feedstock warehouse and await the next delivery assignment.

Start your route at the Central Tool Depot and collect a pallet containing nine replacement hydraulic hoses and a single diagnostic tablet. Your primary task is to distribute these nine hoses to the North Field Equipment Shelter, the East Orchard Maintenance Shed, and the South Tractor Garage, dividing them evenly so that each site receives three hoses; if the number of hoses is not divisible by three, first allocate any surplus to the North Field Equipment Shelter, then to the South Tractor Garage, ensuring that neither location receives more than one additional hose relative to the others. Once all hydraulic hoses have been fully delivered and confirmed at each destination, transport the diagnostic tablet to the West Control Room; you must not enter the West Control Room until all hose deliveries have been acknowledged by each site supervisor. After successfully delivering the diagnostic tablet and waiting for its acceptance, remain at the West Control Room for six minutes to support remote system calibration in case any immediate fault is detected with the newly installed hoses. Only after this time interval has elapsed should you make your way directly back to the Central Tool Depot and await further dispatch instructions, making certain that all dependencies and timing requirements throughout the delivery circuit are strictly observed.

Commence the task at Grain Storage Silo A by collecting a total of eight maintenance toolkits, then proceed directly to Tractor Barn 3 and deliver three toolkits, waiting at the barn until the mechanic has fully removed the items from the robot. Following successful removal at Tractor Barn 3, continue to Pesticide Mixing Station and drop off another three toolkits; if the technician is not present to receive the toolkits at the mixing station, pause there for four minutes before attempting to deliver again. Once both Tractor Barn 3 and Pesticide Mixing Station have received their allocations, take the remaining two toolkits to Field Irrigation Pump House, handing them over to the supervisor after confirming they are available; if necessary, wait for two minutes to allow the supervisor to arrive. After all toolkits have been distributed and no payloads remain on board, proceed back to Grain Storage Silo A and await further deployment instructions.

Proceed first to the Main Parts Storage to retrieve a pallet containing twenty-one replacement drive belts for the assembly line. You must then distribute these drive belts across three stations as follows: deliver seven drive belts to Station A and remain at Station A until all belts have been unloaded by maintenance personnel. Afterward, take another seven drive belts to Station B; upon arrival at Station B, wait for four minutes before the belts are removed, allowing the station’s safety systems to be disabled. Once the four-minute interval has elapsed and all drive belts are confirmed to be unloaded, transport the final seven drive belts to Station C. If, during either of the previous deliveries, fewer than seven belts were successfully removed, any excess belts must be added to the delivery for Station C so that all twenty-one belts are distributed by the end of the route. At Station C, wait for a signal from the shift supervisor confirming that the entirety of the pallet’s contents has been received and accounted for. Only after all deliveries are complete and all acknowledgments and waiting periods are satisfied should you return the empty pallet directly to Main Parts Storage and remain there for five minutes so that inventory staff can inspect for remaining packaging material before dismissal.

instruction: Begin at the Parts Warehouse South, where you must retrieve eight replacement hydraulic actuators and verify the identification labels on each actuator. Next, distribute the actuators among three destinations in the following manner: deliver three actuators to Tractor Maintenance Bay 1 and remain there until the maintenance crew has confirmed removal of all three actuators; then proceed to Harvester Repair Zone and drop off another three actuators, waiting for four minutes after arrival to allow the crew to prepare their workbenches. The final two actuators are to be transported to Field Service Trailer East, but only depart for this location after both the Tractor Maintenance Bay 1 and Harvester Repair Zone deliveries have been completed. At Field Service Trailer East, stay until a field engineer has inspected and signed off on receipt of both actuators. Once all deliveries and confirmations are complete, promptly return to Parts Warehouse South to conclude your route and be ready for further deployment.

Begin by moving to the Central Fertilizer Depot and retrieving a pallet loaded with twelve fertilizer sacks. Next, transport the pallet to Wheat Field Sector A and deliver five fertilizer sacks; remain on site for 4 minutes while the agricultural crew confirms successful offloading and placement. After this step, proceed to Corn Plot B and distribute four fertilizer sacks, but wait for explicit confirmation from the plot supervisor that the previous delivery to Wheat Field Sector A is complete before unloading, then pause for 2 minutes to ensure proper distribution. Take the remaining three fertilizer sacks to the Orchard Entrance, ensuring the sacks are not unloaded until both earlier drop-offs have been verified, then stay an additional 7 minutes at the Orchard Entrance to assist the orchard team with positioning. Once all sacks from the initial pallet have been delivered and each location’s staff have completed their verification and handling tasks, return to the Central Fertilizer Depot and await further loading instructions.

Start at the Packaging Warehouse and retrieve a batch of nine sealed produce crates destined for three grocery delivery docks: Dock A, Dock B, and Dock C. First, transport three crates to Dock A, and upon arrival, wait for the dock manager to confirm that all three produce crates have been removed before proceeding. Next, bring another three sealed produce crates to Dock B, again pausing until you receive confirmation that Dock B has finished unloading the crates. After the second delivery, pause for a mandatory five-minute cooldown interval beside Dock B to allow for crate sanitization procedures. When the interval is complete, deliver the final three sealed produce crates to Dock C and remain there until their removal is acknowledged. After every produce crate has been distributed and all removals are confirmed at each dock, return directly to the Packaging Warehouse and await further instructions from the operations coordinator.

Begin at the maintenance supply dock and acquire six replacement drive belts intended for vehicle repairs across multiple maintenance bays. First, proceed to Mechanical Bay 1 and deliver two drive belts to the onsite technician, waiting until both drive belts are confirmed ready for removal. Next, continue to Mechanical Bay 2 and provide another two drive belts, again pausing while the corresponding technician completes the removal process. Then, travel to Mechanical Bay 3 to drop off the final two drive belts, ensuring you wait until the removal is finished by the bay's assistant. After all drive belts have been removed from the robot at each location, navigate to the central diagnostics station and remain there for five minutes to synchronize maintenance logs and await any urgent service requests before returning to the maintenance supply dock to conclude the task cycle.

instruction: Start your route at Harvest Processing Center and load exactly 40 harvested apple crates onto your cargo platform, ensuring the loading is complete before departure. Transport all 40 apple crates first to North Storage Silo, where you must unload exactly 13 apple crates and wait 5 minutes to allow sorting staff to verify inventory; after the waiting period, continue to West Packing Dock with 27 apple crates. Upon arrival at West Packing Dock, unload 13 additional apple crates, then remain on-site until dock personnel confirm that all crates have been cleared from your platform. Finally, transport the remaining 14 apple crates to South Cold Storage, wait until confirmation of full offloading by the cold storage manager, and only then return to Harvest Processing Center to prepare for your next assignment.

Start at the central Fertilizer Depot and collect a batch of twenty-one sealed fertilizer containers. Distribute these containers across the North Field, East Orchard, and West Vineyard by delivering seven containers to each location, ensuring no containers are damaged during transport and that each site receives only its assigned amount. Begin deliveries at the North Field, waiting until confirmation is received that all seven containers are offloaded and staged for application. After the North Field has acknowledged receipt, continue to the East Orchard, transfer its seven containers, and pause for five minutes to allow the orchard staff to inspect and position each container as needed. Proceed to the West Vineyard with the final seven containers, and wait for the vineyard manager to confirm all containers have arrived and are ready for distribution. Do not return to the Fertilizer Depot until all sites have received their designated shipments, required wait times have elapsed, and confirmations have been logged at each location.

First, navigate from the west maintenance garage to the main spare parts depot to receive a batch of twelve replacement hydraulic actuators. Once all twelve actuators are secured, the robot must deliver them to three different service bays across the facility: bring five actuators to Service Bay Alpha, then wait until technicians have confirmed removal of all five units before proceeding. Next, transport another four actuators to Service Bay Bravo and remain onsite for three minutes to assist with inventory logging. Finally, deliver the remaining three actuators to Service Bay Charlie. Only after the full batch at Bay Charlie has been unloaded and the crew has provided an all-clear should the robot return to the west maintenance garage to complete the cycle. This process ensures sequential delivery with appropriate waiting periods and accurate allocation of parts to each service bay.

Start from Central Parts Storage and confirm availability of a set containing sixteen irrigation valve modules. Your first task is to deliver six modules to Maintenance Bay 2; once you arrive, wait until a technician removes all six modules. After confirmation, remain stationary for 120 seconds to allow system checks before continuing. Next, take five modules to Greenhouse Supplies Window and wait for the greenhouse attendant to retrieve the complete batch; after their removal, pause for sixty seconds at the window exit for auditing purposes. Proceed to Pump Station Annex with the last five modules; ensure the annex operator has collected all five, then remain in place for three minutes to give staff time for equipment installation verification. As soon as the final wait at the Pump Station Annex is complete and all modules are accounted for, return to Central Parts Storage to await new distribution assignments.

Begin at the Seed Storage Shed and load nine fertilizer packs into the cargo compartment. First, deliver four packs to Field Plot A and wait on site until the field manager signals that the fertilizer packs have been offloaded, but do not wait longer than five minutes. Next, head to Field Plot C to distribute another three fertilizer packs, remaining at Field Plot C until the application crew confirms that all three packs have been successfully received. Proceed then to Field Plot D with the two remaining fertilizer packs, and after arrival, wait for two minutes to allow the crew to prepare their equipment before offloading the fertilizer packs. Once the distributions to all three fields have been completed, return directly to the Seed Storage Shed and wait outside for further dispatch instructions. If, at any location, the intended recipient is not present or fails to confirm receipt after the specified waiting period, immediately retain the undelivered fertilizer packs and contact the operations supervisor upon returning to the Seed Storage Shed.

Start at the Central Receiving Dock, where nine sealed drums of fertilizer are prepared for distribution. Load all nine drums, then proceed to Field A and unload three drums onto Pallet Zone 1; after depositing the drums, wait at Field A for five minutes to allow for chemical safety checks by the field manager. Once cleared, transport another three drums to the Greenhouse Complex, and remain at the greenhouse entrance until the greenhouse supervisor confirms the drums are ready for placement. Upon confirmation, deliver the final three drums to the Fertilizer Storage Shed, but do not depart until the operator has fully removed all drums from the transport rack. After all drums have been distributed and removal has been verified at the Fertilizer Storage Shed, return to the Central Receiving Dock where you should remain until assigned your next route.

Start by collecting twelve fresh water sampling kits from the laboratory dock, then proceed to distribute these kits among field sites Alpha, Bravo, and Charlie. Deliver four water sampling kits to field site Alpha, wait at the site until all four kits have been removed by the environmental technician, then move to field site Bravo and unload another four water sampling kits, again remaining at the drop-off point until the Bravo crew retrieves them. Finally, bring the remaining four kits to field site Charlie, but before departing, remain for three minutes at Charlie to allow technicians time to prepare the kits for immediate use. Once all deliveries are verified and waiting periods are observed at every site, return directly to the laboratory dock for debriefing.

Start at Loading Dock Bravo, where you must retrieve four crates labeled 'Precision Tools' and three bins marked 'Replacement Bearings'. Deliver two crates and one bin to Maintenance Bay 1; after the Maintenance Bay 1 technician removes the bin, remain onsite for six minutes to inspect unloading procedures. Then, proceed to Maintenance Bay 2 to drop off the remaining two crates and deliver the last two bins. Wait until both Maintenance Bay teams have finished removing all items before heading to Warehouse Storage C, where you will wait for four minutes to ensure electronic inventory records are updated before the next assignment.

Maintenance Bay 2 all items removed confirmation

instruction: Begin at Workshop Bay 2 and retrieve four diagnostic data drives from the storage locker, making sure all drives are accounted for before proceeding. Head first to Conveyor Station North, where you will transfer one data drive and then wait up to three minutes for the station supervisor to upload system logs and signal completion. After confirmation, continue to Packaging Dock East to deliver the second data drive, pausing there for 90 seconds while the automated arm extracts the drive. Next, proceed to Sorting Area South to distribute the remaining two data drives; if both Sorting Line Alpha and Sorting Line Beta are operational, alternate the deliveries by depositing one drive at each, ensuring delivery to both lines even if you must wait up to 2 minutes for unrestricted access at each drop point. Once all data drives have been delivered and each recipient location has acknowledged removal, travel to Control Center West to obtain final clearance, but only after remaining stationary outside the center for 4 full minutes to allow for random spot-checks by onsite personnel.

Start your route at the Parts Storage Facility and verify that nine replacement hydraulic valves are ready for collection before loading them onto your platform. Head first to Maintenance Bay A and deliver three hydraulic valves, ensuring you wait until the maintenance technician finishes removing all three before leaving. Next, proceed to Maintenance Bay B with another three hydraulic valves; after unloading them, remain at Maintenance Bay B for six minutes while scheduled repairs are initiated. Once the waiting period concludes and all valves have been acknowledged as delivered, travel to Maintenance Bay C with the last three hydraulic valves, but only begin the drop-off if you have already completed the waiting time at Maintenance Bay B. After all hydraulic valves have been distributed and received at each bay, return immediately to the Parts Storage Facility to complete your circuit.

Start at Silo Yard Alpha and collect a total of fourteen seed sacks. Distribute the seed sacks among Field Plot North, Greenhouse Annex, and Orchard Station according to the following plan: deliver five seed sacks to Field Plot North, four to Greenhouse Annex, and four to Orchard Station, then take the remaining single seed sack to Lab Shed 2 for soil testing. For each of the three main destinations—Field Plot North, Greenhouse Annex, and Orchard Station—wait at each location for three minutes before beginning to unload the assigned seed sacks, allowing the respective planting teams to confirm field readiness, then proceed to hand over the designated number of sacks; only depart each site once the field supervisor confirms complete receipt of the payload. After completing the main deliveries, take the final seed sack to Lab Shed 2 and remain there for two minutes while the laboratory technician inspects and removes the sack. Once all seed sacks have been successfully delivered and confirmed at every location, return directly to Silo Yard Alpha and wait there for six minutes to provide an opportunity for follow-up transport requests before concluding your route.

Start at the Packing Dock adjacent to Warehouse 2 and collect twelve crates of harvested tomatoes, ensuring they are properly loaded and secured. Proceed to Cold Storage Room Alpha and deposit five tomato crates, waiting until the Cold Storage supervisor verifies the correct count and signals approval before moving on. Afterward, transport the next four crates to Processing Plant Line 3 and, upon arrival, remain on-site for a mandatory three-minute sanitization period before any crates may be offloaded; once the timer has elapsed, wait until the plant operator completes the intake process for all four crates. Carry the remaining three crates to the Packaging Zone at Dock B, but only deliver the crates if both previous drop-offs have been confirmed as successful—if either location has not provided confirmation yet, remain at Dock B until updates are received. Upon successful completion of all crate deliveries and verifications, return directly to Warehouse 2 for routine decontamination procedures.

Initiate your task by moving to the Main Tool Depot and collecting a total of six calibration kits intended for equipment tune-ups. Split the delivery of these calibration kits by transporting two kits each to the Engine Room, the West Machine Bay, and the Northern Storage Annex, in that order. Upon arrival at each site, after placing the two calibration kits, wait for four minutes to allow site personnel to inspect and verify the kit contents before proceeding to the subsequent location. Once all six kits have been distributed and verifications completed across all three sites, proceed to the Loading Dock, and remain stationed there until notified of your next assignment.

Begin your assignment at the Seed Inventory Vault and wait until a batch of fifteen fertilizer canisters is ready for collection. After you have confirmed the fertilizer canisters are loaded, make your way to Crop Field Alpha and deliver six fertilizer canisters there; wait on-site until the field supervisor removes all six canisters. Once the delivery at Crop Field Alpha is complete, proceed to the Vineyard Irrigation Station and unload another five fertilizer canisters, then remain at the site for four minutes while the irrigation staff verifies the stock, even if collection is already completed. With the last four fertilizer canisters still aboard, head towards Orchard Supply Depot and distribute them, waiting until the depot attendant confirms complete removal. After all canisters have been delivered and acknowledged at each destination, return directly to the Seed Inventory Vault to conclude your route.

Begin at Assembly Line Entry Point A and wait until the set of nine sealed toolboxes is ready for collection. After verifying that all nine toolboxes are loaded, proceed directly to Packaging Bay and drop off three toolboxes, standing by until packaging personnel have removed all three units. Without delay, deliver another three toolboxes to Storage Warehouse 4, remaining on-site until each of the three toolboxes has been taken by the warehouse staff. The remaining three toolboxes must be transported to Quality Check Station; however, upon arrival, wait for five full minutes before allowing the quality inspectors to begin removal, ensuring all safety checks are completed first. After all three toolboxes at Quality Check Station have been removed, return immediately to Assembly Line Entry Point A and remain there until new delivery tasks are assigned.

Begin at Packing Station Zeta to collect a set of sixteen sealed fertilizer bags that are to be distributed across the North Cornfield, South Wheat Plot, East Rice Terrace, and West Sunflower Row. Deliver five fertilizer bags to the North Cornfield first, then wait until all bags are unloaded by the field supervisor before moving to the next location. Next, bring four fertilizer bags to the South Wheat Plot, but pause for three minutes before unloading to allow for calibration of the soil sensors by the agronomist; once the time has elapsed, ensure the bags are received by the wheat plot technician. Proceed to the East Rice Terrace to deposit four more fertilizer bags, waiting for a readiness signal from the irrigation crew before releasing the payload. Finally, transport the remaining three fertilizer bags to West Sunflower Row for immediate deposit, after which you must wait for two minutes while field workers clear the drop-off zone. Once all bags have been successfully delivered and all waiting periods and signals have been observed, return to Packing Station Zeta to report task completion.

Begin by moving to the greenhouse supply room and retrieving nine bags of nutrient pellets designated for planting. Divide these evenly by delivering four bags to the North Plot feeding station and another three bags to the Central Irrigation Shed, making sure that two remaining bags are reserved for the East Orchard mixing area. Once each delivery point is reached, wait for confirmation from the local crew that the corresponding bags have been safely unloaded before proceeding to the next destination. After the final two bags have been dropped off at the East Orchard mixing area and removal is confirmed by the orchard technician, remain stationed there for fifteen minutes so any urgent restock requests can be addressed, then return to the greenhouse supply room to complete your task cycle.

instruction: Start at Maintenance Bay Alpha, loading a sealed tool crate and four diagnostic tablets into the robot's cargo module. Navigate first to Field Drip Station 4, where you must deliver the tool crate to the irrigation specialist and remain until all required equipment checks are acknowledged as complete. After confirmation, proceed to Sensor Node Grid West and wait for two minutes to allow for the arrival of the field technician before handing over two diagnostic tablets. Once the tablets have been successfully removed by the technician at Sensor Node Grid West, move to Greenhouse Corridor North to deliver one diagnostic tablet, but only do so after verifying the removal of all previous items from your cargo. Carry the final diagnostic tablet to Pump House Delta and wait until the systems analyst signals readiness before presenting the last tablet. Ensure that you remain at Pump House Delta for five minutes post-delivery to assist with any immediate troubleshooting requests, and only then should you return to Maintenance Bay Alpha for docking and recharge.

instruction.location: Field Drip Station 4 with irrigation specialist

instruction: Begin your route at Equipment Dock Alpha by collecting one canister each of calibration fluid and hydraulic oil, then proceed to Mechanical Service Bay 1 where you must wait 4 minutes for the maintenance technician to prepare and load the calibration fluid onto the robot. Once the calibration fluid has been confirmed loaded, advance to Hydraulic Service Bay 2 and remain stationed until the maintenance crew retrieves the hydraulic oil from the robot. After both payload deliveries are complete, head to Storage Annex Delta to pick up three replacement filter cartridges and shuttle one cartridge each—first to Combine Repair Pad, then to Loader Repair Pad, and finally to Harvester Repair Pad. At each pad, wait until the current filter cartridge is removed before proceeding to the next pad. Once all filters are delivered and the last one has been removed, return directly to Equipment Dock Alpha to complete your assignment.

Begin at Machinery Charging Bay and collect nine hydraulic fluid cartridges for urgent redistribution across the operational zone. First, travel to Grapevine Sorting Facility and deliver three hydraulic fluid cartridges, then wait at this location until the sorting supervisor sends an electronic confirmation that all three cartridges have been unloaded. Once you receive this confirmation, proceed to Orchard Irrigation Hub and deliver another three hydraulic fluid cartridges; after delivery, remain onsite for five minutes while irrigation technicians perform safety checks before removing the cartridges. For the final portion, transport the last three hydraulic fluid cartridges to Packing Line Assembly Room, but if access to the Assembly Room is restricted for maintenance, wait exactly eight minutes before retrying entry and completing the delivery. Once all nine cartridges are confirmed as transferred or the time has elapsed for a maintenance delay, return directly to Machinery Charging Bay to complete the redistribution circuit.

Start at Storage Shed 1 and wait until a pallet containing twenty fertilizer bags is fully loaded aboard the robot for scheduled distribution. Once the entire pallet of fertilizer bags is secured, transport it to Field Plot Alpha and evenly distribute nine fertilizer bags there, staying at the field until the agricultural technician confirms receipt of all nine bags. After confirmation, proceed to Orchard Zone B with seven fertilizer bags, but do not begin unloading until five minutes have elapsed to allow for the arrival of orchard personnel; once the wait is complete, deliver all seven bags and await removal verification. Next, take the remaining four fertilizer bags to the Hydroponics Greenhouse, wait for the greenhouse manager to remove each bag, and confirm acceptance of the entire batch before returning to Storage Shed 1 to report task completion and prepare the robot for its next assignment.

Start your operation at Storage Silo Delta, where you will pick up a batch of fifteen fertilizer drums designated for redistribution. Your first destination is Orchard Plot 1, where you must deliver six of the fertilizer drums and wait for the field operator to finish unloading before proceeding. After this, make your way to Orchard Plot 2 and transfer another five fertilizer drums, remaining at the site until the agricultural technician confirms drum removal. Bring the final four fertilizer drums to Orchard Plot 3, where you should wait for three minutes to allow for safety checks prior to the unloading process. Once all fifteen drums have been successfully delivered and acknowledged at their respective plots, continue on to the Central Equipment Wash Bay and remain there for five minutes to complete a mandatory decontamination cycle before returning directly to Storage Silo Delta for your next assignment.

Start at Loading Dock 1 with a batch of twenty freshly fabricated circuit boards destined for assembly. Initially, bring six circuit boards to Assembly Line A and wait there for a supervisor to confirm arrival. Once supervision is complete, move to Assembly Line B and deliver seven circuit boards, waiting in place for 4 minutes while automated handlers test the equipment with the new delivery. After time elapses, proceed to Assembly Line C with the remaining seven circuit boards; if there is a leftover circuit board, ensure it is also added to Assembly Line C. Finally, after dispatching all boards, remain at Assembly Line C until a technician verifies that all deliveries are accounted for before proceeding to the Maintenance Bay for your scheduled inspection.

Start at Storage Warehouse C and gather ten spare irrigation pumps designated for urgent repairs. Deliver three irrigation pumps to Maintenance Shed East, two to Water Control Bay South, and four to Field Service Outpost Delta in that exact order, leaving the final remaining pump at Storage Warehouse C if it cannot be distributed due to space constraints. For each stop except Storage Warehouse C, after offloading the assigned irrigation pumps, wait a full four minutes to allow the on-site staff to inspect the delivered equipment and confirm the pumps are functioning. If at any location, staff are unable to receive the full allocation and ask for fewer pumps, immediately adjust the count at that stop and ensure remaining pumps are subsequently redistributed according to available capacity at the next locations. After the final delivery and the completion of each required wait period, return to Storage Warehouse C to recheck for any undelivered pumps and remain there until the maintenance coordinator sends further dispatch instructions.

Begin at the Seed Storage Facility and pick up a total of nine labeled Seed Packs—specifically, four 'CornHybrid-A', three 'Soybean-Green', and two 'CanolaPremium'. First, travel to Field Zone 1 and deliver three 'CornHybrid-A' seed packs, waiting until the planting supervisor confirms their removal before proceeding. Next, head to Field Zone 2 and distribute the three 'Soybean-Green' seed packs, again waiting for explicit acknowledgment of pack removal by local staff. After this, proceed to Field Zone 3 to drop off the remaining one 'CornHybrid-A' seed pack along with both 'CanolaPremium' packs, ensuring that all items are claimed by the field crew; if any seed pack remains undelivered at this point, bring it directly to the Seed Storage Facility Quarantine Area for inspection. Following all drop-offs, remain at Field Zone 3 for precisely five minutes to allow soil settling, and then return to the Seed Storage Facility for system updates. Ensure each subsequent delivery only commences after confirmation of the previous payload's removal and handle any outstanding seed packs according to inspection protocol.

Start at the Chemical Storage Shed to collect twelve sealed fertilizer containers, confirming the integrity of each before departure. Transport three containers to Field Plot A, where you must wait until the planting crew signals that all containers have been offloaded and staged near the east boundary. Next, proceed to Orchard Entrance and deliver five fertilizer containers, remaining on site while the orchard manager verifies proper storage and removes each container one by one. After the Orchard drop-off, continue to the Equipment Dock adjacent to Irrigation Well 7 to unload the remaining four containers, but you must pause for exactly five minutes after arrival before the containers are taken, allowing safety checks to be completed. Only after all fertilizer containers have been distributed and each respective location has acknowledged their receipt, return to the Chemical Storage Shed and await further tasks.

Equipment Dock adjacent to Irrigation Well 7
Equipment Dock adjacent to Irrigation Well 7

instruction: Start at the Equipment Loading Dock where you will collect a total of nine irrigation pipe segments, making sure all segments are securely fastened for transport. After confirming the complete load, drive to the East Orchard Valve Station and unload three pipe segments, not departing until the groundskeeper has inspected and removed each segment from your carrier. Then proceed to the Central Vineyard Junction to deliver another three pipe segments, again waiting until the site technician has acknowledged and taken all three pipes. Once both prior drop-offs are completed, continue to the Remote Hillside Pump House with the final three pipe segments and remain there until all have been removed by the repair crew. After all equipment has been transferred and confirmed received, stay at the Remote Hillside Pump House for a full five minutes to assist with any last-minute part positioning before returning to the Equipment Loading Dock to complete your assignment.

Start at the Maintenance Bay and retrieve the diagnostic toolkit along with two charging units and a sealed coolant container. Deliver the diagnostic toolkit to the Engineering Platform at Wind Turbine No.2, and wait for the maintenance technician to indicate the toolkit has been unpacked. After confirmation, transport both charging units to Charging Dock Alpha and Charging Dock Beta, dropping off one unit at each dock in sequence. Once both docks have received their charging units, wait at Charging Dock Beta for three minutes to allow system checks to complete. Afterwards, proceed with the coolant container to the Thermal Storage Facility and wait until the facility operator signals readiness for coolant transfer. Following transfer confirmation, return promptly to the Maintenance Bay to complete your operational cycle.

instruction.location: Engineering Platform at Wind Turbine No.2
Engineering Platform at Wind Turbine No.2

instruction: Begin at the central storage bay and pick up fifteen sealed fertilizer containers. First, transport seven containers to Silo 5 at the eastern field, and once you arrive, wait until the field supervisor at Silo 5 confirms the containers are ready for offloading. After a confirmation is received and the containers are removed, proceed to the old barn to deliver five more containers. Allow a ten-minute waiting period at the old barn to accommodate for inventory scanning before containers are unloaded. With the last three containers, head directly to Irrigation Station Delta in the south orchard, but only deliver these remaining containers after a signal from the orchard foreman indicates the previous scheduled maintenance at Irrigation Station Delta is complete. Once all containers have been distributed to their respective locations and confirmation or signaling is received as specified, return immediately to the central storage bay to complete your mission.

instruction.location: Irrigation Station Delta in the south orchard
Irrigation Station Delta in the south orchard

instruction: Start at the maintenance bay to load three sets of replacement conveyor belts onto the mobile platform. Proceed to the assembly plant’s main conveyor line and await clearance from the plant supervisor before transferring the first set; the clearance may take up to 7 minutes, and you must not begin unloading until it is officially received. Once the first set is delivered and installed, travel to the packaging warehouse to deliver the second set, remaining at the site until the warehouse technician completes the installation and signals readiness for operational testing, which requires a maximum waiting period of 5 minutes. Afterward, bring the final set to the outbound shipping dock, but only unload if the shipping dock manager confirms that the old belts have been fully removed—if not, wait at the dock for intervals of 2 minutes and recheck with the manager after each interval, repeating this process until removal is verified. When all conveyor belt sets have been installed at their respective locations, return to the maintenance bay to finalize the service log with the equipment coordinator.

Start by proceeding to the Parts Storage Room located adjacent to the vehicle bays, where you must collect eight new air filters for the fleet maintenance cycle. Deliver three of the air filters to Maintenance Bay 1, three air filters to Maintenance Bay 2, and ensure the remaining two filters are transported to the Mobile Repair Trailer stationed by the east access gate, explicitly handling each batch separately with no mixing between destinations. After each delivery, wait until a maintenance technician at the respective location confirms the air filters have been fully received before departing to the next site. Upon completing the last drop-off at the Mobile Repair Trailer, remain there for five minutes to accommodate any urgent follow-up requests from the technicians before making your return to the Parts Storage Room to report completion of the distribution task.

Parts Storage Room located adjacent to the vehicle bays

Mobile Repair Trailer stationed by the east access gate
Mobile Repair Trailer stationed by the east access gate
Parts Storage Room located adjacent to the vehicle bays

instruction: Start at the Central Chemical Warehouse and load a total of thirteen crop treatment canisters onto the delivery unit. The first delivery requires that five canisters are brought to Processing Plant 2, where you must wait until the site foreman verifies the exact count and marks each canister as received; only proceed if all five have been accepted. Next, continue to Storage Barn North to deliver four crop treatment canisters, but if any canisters remain undelivered at Processing Plant 2, reduce the number being delivered to Storage Barn North accordingly and make an immediate report upon arrival; in either case, wait for three minutes at Storage Barn North after offloading to allow inventory staff to store the delivered canisters. Afterward, transport the next three canisters to Packing Shed 7, remain on-site until the supervisor at Packing Shed 7 signals commencement of unloading, and then, regardless of the prior outcome, take the final canister (or any remaining at this stage) to the Field Research Annex. At the Field Research Annex, wait outside for four minutes to accommodate a scheduled safety inspection before returning directly to the Central Chemical Warehouse to log the completion status, making detailed notes for any canisters not delivered according to plan.

object.description: verification and receipt marking by site foreman

instruction: Start at the Farm Equipment Shed and collect a set of eight replacement seed drill parts. First, take three parts directly to Maintenance Bay Alpha, and upon arrival, wait for the maintenance chief at Maintenance Bay Alpha to inspect and remove the delivered items before departing. After Maintenance Bay Alpha delivery is complete, proceed to Greenhouse 2 with another three replacement seed drill parts; upon reaching Greenhouse 2, wait for a minimum of seven minutes to allow the technician there to finish prepping the seed drills for installation before offloading your payload and waiting for confirmation of removal. With the remaining two seed drill parts, travel to Crop Field East, but wait five minutes at the field edge before entering to ensure harvesting machines have cleared the zone. Then, deliver the last two parts to the Crop Field East supervisor, and remain until the supervisor signals that both items are received. Once you have finished all three deliveries and all parts have been successfully removed from your payload, return to the Farm Equipment Shed and remain available for subsequent dispatches.

Start at the Seed Distribution Center and collect a total of 25 seed nutrient canisters, confirming that all canisters are prepped and loaded securely before departure. Begin by delivering 9 canisters to Field Plot Alpha; once at Field Plot Alpha, unload all 9 canisters and remain until the agronomy technician verifies their correct placement and signals completion. Next, head to Field Plot Beta with 8 canisters, but prior to unloading, wait exactly three minutes to synchronize with the irrigation schedule, then transfer the 8 canisters and wait for removal confirmation from the field crew. Then, proceed to Field Plot Gamma with the final 8 canisters; at Field Plot Gamma, wait until any old or empty nutrient canisters are fully removed from the drop-off site before unloading your cargo. Ensure that at each field, the specified number of canisters is delivered, pausing as described, and that all confirmation and dependency steps are fulfilled. Once all 25 canisters are delivered and verified across the three field plots, return immediately to the Seed Distribution Center for assignment closeout.

Start your mission inside the Equipment Charging Station, where you must first collect three diagnostic sensor probes and a calibration toolkit. When all payloads are secured, proceed to Greenhouse Block A to deliver one sensor probe; after confirming the greenhouse technician has completed their preparatory work, wait for 4 minutes before handing over the probe, allowing the technician to finalize environmental stabilization. Once the transfer is complete, continue to the Drone Launch Platform and drop off the calibration toolkit, but only do so if the Greenhouse Block A delivery is confirmed. Afterward, travel to Hydroponics Storage Bay and deliver the second sensor probe, waiting for the storage supervisor to remove the old probe before providing the replacement. Finally, take the last sensor probe to Compost Processing Center and remain on site until the center operator has completed their intake log—for no less than 3 minutes—before making your final handover. Following the delivery sequence, head to the Maintenance Wash Area for a compulsory stand-down of 5 minutes while general cleaning is performed before returning to the Equipment Charging Station.

Commence at Spare Parts Depot and collect a shipment container labeled 'Irrigation Pump Components.' Proceed to Maintenance Bay 2 and wait until the technician signals that the shipment container has been unloaded; after completion, initiate a four-minute waiting period to allow for equipment validation. Once the wait period concludes, retrieve six filtered water canisters from Maintenance Bay 2 and distribute them as follows: deliver three filtered water canisters to Greenhouse North, two filtered water canisters to Pasture Irrigation Outpost, and one filtered water canister to Remote Weather Station. At each drop, ensure the respective site supervisor confirms receipt of the water canister before leaving for the next destination. After all water canisters have been distributed and confirmations received at Greenhouse North, Pasture Irrigation Outpost, and Remote Weather Station, return promptly to Spare Parts Depot to finalize the delivery report and standby for the next directive.

Start by collecting fifteen crate boxes of harvested tomatoes from the Southern Packing Dock, ensuring all crates are ready for transport. Next, deliver five crate boxes each to three different destinations: first, take five crate boxes to the Fresh Markets Loading Bay, placing them in the assigned holding area and remaining on site for exactly eight minutes while offloading is supervised by the market manager. After completing delivery at the Fresh Markets Loading Bay, bring another five crate boxes to the Cold Storage Warehouse; upon arrival, wait if the refrigeration bay is occupied, and only proceed with unloading once it becomes available. When the Cold Storage Warehouse transfer is finished, transport the final five crate boxes to the Canning Facility Receiving Dock; however, if less than five crate boxes remain for any reason—such as damaged goods—equally split the available quantity between the Canning Facility Receiving Dock and the Central Bakery Entrance, awarding the extra crate, if there is one, to the Canning Facility. After all crate box deliveries are completed at their respective locations, return directly to the Southern Packing Dock and wait there for three minutes before officially concluding the round.

Begin at the Maintenance Hub and wait until a batch of eight lubricating oil canisters is fully prepared and marked as ready for pickup. Once the oil canisters are confirmed ready, transport three canisters to Tractor Bay Alpha, two canisters to Combine Station Bravo, and two more canisters to the Utility Shed Delta, ensuring that if any canisters remain, the final canister is allocated to Tractor Bay Alpha to prioritize its servicing needs. After each delivery, wait for the mechanics or technicians at each location to remove their respective canisters before proceeding to the next destination. Upon successful completion of all distributions, stay at Utility Shed Delta for nine minutes to monitor equipment startup procedures, and only when the elapsed time has passed return directly to the Maintenance Hub to report task completion.

Start at Water Tank Depot to collect twelve irrigation filter cartridges, then travel to Irrigation Station Alpha and unload five cartridges, waiting at the station until a technician confirms the filter replacement is complete before proceeding. Move next to Irrigation Station Bravo to offload four cartridges, again waiting for technician confirmation regarding successful installation. For the final three cartridges, continue to Irrigation Station Charlie and repeat the unloading and confirmation process. After all stations have received their respective filters and acknowledgment of installation is received from each, proceed directly to the Diagnostic Maintenance Bay and remain stationed there for exactly fifteen minutes to allow sensor recalibration before undertaking any new deployment.

Start at the Equipment Depot and load the repair bin with a total of ten solar inverter modules, clearly labeling them for destination. Deliver four inverter modules to the Solar Array East and remain on site until the maintenance technician has acknowledged removal of all four modules from the repair bin. After completion, proceed directly to Solar Array South and offload three additional inverter modules, awaiting a two-minute interval upon their removal to allow for diagnostic checks to be completed on site before you continue. Then, advance to Solar Array West, deliver the final three inverter modules, and stay until confirmation is received from the local crew that all modules are unloaded and accounted for. Once the last inverter module has been removed at Solar Array West, remain at that location for another five minutes to enable the robotics supervisor to input final system updates before returning the now-empty repair bin to the Equipment Depot for post-mission inspection.

Begin your route at the Parts Warehouse by collecting a crate containing twenty-one replacement hydraulic filters. Transport the crate first to Maintenance Station East and deliver seven filters, then remain at Maintenance Station East for five minutes to allow the maintenance team to install the new filters. Once the installation period is complete, continue to Maintenance Station West and deliver another seven hydraulic filters, but do not leave Maintenance Station West until each filter has been acknowledged as received by the station's automated inventory system. When all seven filters have been successfully received and logged at Maintenance Station West, take the final seven filters to Maintenance Station North, distribute them to the staff there, and wait until the senior technician provides confirmation that the filter count matches the expected delivery. After all three maintenance stations have received their filters and you have received the necessary confirmations and waited out the required intervals, return to the Parts Warehouse and pause there for six minutes to allow your cargo compartment to be inspected and cleared before making yourself available for the next assignment.

Begin your route at Main Storage Silo, where you must collect a total of seven sealed vegetable crates intended for restocking. Transport and deliver two crates to Harvest Collection Shed; following this, wait at the shed for three minutes while quality inspectors verify the produce and confirm acceptance of the delivered crates. Only after receiving confirmation that the crates at Harvest Collection Shed have been accepted, proceed to Delivery Dock 2 and offload three more vegetable crates. If Delivery Dock 2 is occupied and unavailable, advance immediately to Market Preparation Area to drop off the remaining two crates, ensuring careful tracking of which crates are delivered to each destination. Once access to Delivery Dock 2 becomes available or after all other deliveries are completed, return to complete unloading any undelivered vegetable crates in the original drop-off sequence. At the end of all deliveries, remain at your final drop-off point for six minutes to allow staff to scan and log the crates, then return to Main Storage Silo to await instructions for the next batch.

Collect seven pesticide canisters from Chemical Storage Shed B, and immediately proceed to Greenhouse North Entrance. At Greenhouse North Entrance, deliver two pesticide canisters, staying on site until both canisters have been completely offloaded by the greenhouse staff. After confirmation, take three pesticide canisters to Orchard Equipment Staging Area; do not leave until you receive notification that all three canisters have been removed. Transport the remaining two pesticide canisters to Vegetable Field Gate. At Vegetable Field Gate, wait until the unloading crew has removed both canisters. Once all pesticide canisters have been delivered and their removals confirmed, wait at Vegetable Field Gate for six minutes to ensure all safety checks are completed before returning directly to Chemical Storage Shed B to finalize the task sequence.

Start at the agricultural supply depot and collect seven bags of starter fertilizer labeled 'Lot A'. Transport three bags to Field Plot Alpha and wait until all three bags of fertilizer have been offloaded by the planting crew. After completion, proceed directly to Field Plot Beta to deliver another two bags of starter fertilizer, waiting there until removal is verified by the agronomist. Next, carry the remaining two bags to Greenhouse Section 4, and stay on site until both bags have been unloaded by the greenhouse staff. Once all deliveries are complete, proceed to the central weather monitoring station and remain stationary for a period of eight minutes to allow for sensor calibration as instructed by the remote supervisor. When the waiting interval ends, return to the agricultural supply depot and await the next assignment.

instruction: Begin at the packaging warehouse and collect a batch of twenty-four harvested produce crates. Distribute the crates as evenly as possible by delivering eight crates to Sorting Station Alpha, seven crates to Sorting Station Beta, and the remaining nine crates to Sorting Station Gamma, visiting each sorting station in that specific order. At each station, after unloading the assigned crates, wait for the station supervisor to issue a confirmation signal indicating completion of the unloading before proceeding to the next destination. Once all crates have been delivered and confirmations received at Sorting Stations Alpha, Beta, and Gamma, return to the packaging warehouse and stand by at Dock 4 for further instructions.

Start at the Seed Warehouse and load ten bags of corn seed onto your platform. Proceed first to Field Alpha and deliver four bags, waiting until the planting supervisor has removed all four bags before moving on. Next, travel to Field Beta and drop off three bags, again pausing until the field crew confirms all bags have been unloaded. Head to Field Gamma with the remaining three bags, and wait on site for 180 seconds while the agricultural technicians verify the seed quantity. After completing deliveries to all three fields, return to the Seed Warehouse and remain there for five minutes to allow for inventory reconciliation before your next assignment is dispatched.

Begin at the Central Equipment Depot and retrieve the drone battery crate, intended for distribution across multiple monitoring outposts. First, transport the crate to Monitoring Outpost Alpha and unload five batteries, remaining onsite until the attending technician verifies and removes all five batteries from the crate. Once this is done, proceed to Monitoring Outpost Bravo and deliver another four batteries, again staying until confirmation of battery removal is received from the Bravo field engineer. The crate will now hold three batteries—carry these to Monitoring Outpost Charlie for final delivery, ensuring the Charlie supervisor has collected the entire remaining allocation before departing. After all drone batteries have been distributed and verified at their respective outposts, return the now-empty crate to the Central Equipment Depot, and remain docked there for ten minutes before advancing to the Maintenance Bay for routine inspection.

Begin your mission at the Parts Storage Depot, where you will load a batch of twenty-two replacement hydraulic valves onto the transfer module. Navigate first to the Assembly Line A receiving dock and deliver eight hydraulic valves; before proceeding, remain at the dock until the Assembly Line A supervisor inspects and verifies the receipt of all eight valves. Once this is completed, travel to Maintenance Area South and offload another seven hydraulic valves, but you must wait for four minutes after arrival to allow for secure handoff authorization by the maintenance crew leader. Proceed next to the Quality Control Lab with the remaining seven hydraulic valves; offloading here is contingent upon receiving confirmation that both Assembly Line A and Maintenance Area South have completed their intake procedures for their respective shipments, so you may need to wait until notifications from both locations are received. If, at any time, you encounter an access denial or are instructed to halt delivery at any stop, promptly return all remaining undelivered hydraulic valves to the Parts Storage Depot before closing your task, ensuring each destination receives only its intended allotment unless instructed otherwise due to operational restrictions.

Proceed to the Harvest Collection Point to gather a set of eight sensor calibration kits needed for quality control across the southern agricultural zone. Your first stop will be the Greenhouse Control Hub, where you must drop off three calibration kits and remain until the system technician completes the acceptance check. Next, travel to the Irrigation Pump House to deliver another two calibration kits, but if the pump operator is occupied, wait in place for three minutes before making the transfer; resume your route immediately once the kits are accepted. Continue next to the Seed Preparation Facility and provide the final three calibration kits there, waiting for the site supervisor to clear removal before departing. After all eight kits have been delivered and confirmations received at all destinations, travel to the Solar Charging Pad and remain docked for seven minutes to complete a partial recharge before returning to the Harvest Collection Point to conclude your operation.

Begin your route at Packing Dock 1, where you will load a shipment of fifteen sealed fertilizer bags. Proceed immediately to Field Plot Omega and deliver four fertilizer bags, waiting for the field manager at Field Plot Omega to confirm each bag's barcode before continuing. Next, divert to Greenhouse Sector B to offload six fertilizer bags; once all six have been deposited and inspected, pause for 90 seconds to allow the greenhouse crew to redistribute the bags internally. After completing these two stops, transport the remaining five fertilizer bags to Orchard Lane Delta, ensuring that after each fertilizer bag is handed over at Orchard Lane Delta, you wait for explicit notification that the recipient has removed the fertilizer bag from your payload compartment. Only return to Packing Dock 1 after all fertilizer bags have been successfully distributed and all waiting periods at Greenhouse Sector B and Orchard Lane Delta have been observed in full.

Initiate your route at Supply Dock 1 and load a total of seven 'Hybrid Crop Seed Pallets' onto your platform. Distribute these pallets as follows: deliver two pallets each to Greenhouse Alpha, Storage Shed Northwest, and Planting Plot 7B, and reserve the final seventh pallet for Seed Research Lab East, explicitly handling the uneven allocation. After each pallet drop-off at Greenhouse Alpha, Storage Shed Northwest, and Planting Plot 7B, remain at the unloading zone for three minutes per location to allow operators to scan the received pallet and sign off the inventory log; these waits must occur before proceeding to the next destination. Only after the pallet has been accepted at Planting Plot 7B and the three-minute scan is completed, transport the last remaining pallet to Seed Research Lab East. Once all designated pallets are delivered and every time-gated confirmation period completed, return directly to Supply Dock 1 and remain stationed there until all delivery records are verified by the dock supervisor.

Begin at the Fertilizer Storage Depot and collect twelve units of potassium-enriched fertilizer, confirming that each unit is properly secured before departing. First, deliver five fertilizer units to Crop Field West, but only unload the full amount if the field supervisor reports adequate soil moisture; otherwise, wait for ten minutes to allow for irrigation before proceeding with the offload. Next, take four units to Crop Field South, and wait for the agricultural drone operator to finish a sensor sweep—this may take up to twelve minutes—before transferring all four fertilizer units. For the final three fertilizer units, proceed to Crop Field East and wait until at least two farm workers are present at the drop-off site, at which point the robot should remain until all units are removed by the crew. Once the fertilizer has been distributed to all three fields and removal at Crop Field East is complete, immediately return to the Fertilizer Storage Depot to receive post-mission decontamination protocols.

Start at Fertilizer Storage Facility Alpha and load a total of nine sealed fertilizer bags intended for Field Block 3, Irrigation Pumping Station, and Orchard West. Evenly allocate three fertilizer bags to each of these three locations, taking care to deliver only the designated quantity per trip. After dropping off fertilizer bags at Field Block 3, wait for exactly four minutes to allow on-site crew to verify delivery and signal that the area is safe for the robot to proceed. Following the verification wait, deliver the next batch of three fertilizer bags to the Irrigation Pumping Station, and again wait four minutes for clearance before moving on to Orchard West with the final three bags. Once all nine bags are successfully distributed and each verification process is complete, return to Fertilizer Storage Facility Alpha and wait for staff to confirm any empty or damaged bag pickups. If any such empty or damaged bags are present, collect them and transport these directly to the Waste Processing Dock, where you must wait until all items are offloaded before concluding the mission.

Begin by traveling to Wheat Silo 7 and retrieving a set of 11 seed sample crates for distribution to three laboratory facilities. First, transport four crates to Lab Testing Room Alpha, immediately waiting until laboratory personnel signal that the crates are ready to be unloaded; only then hand off the crates, and remain at the site for a mandatory seven-minute decontamination hold. After this interval and confirmation, proceed with another four crates to Pathogen Analysis Suite Beta, but do not initiate crate removal until you have received digital notification from Suite Beta that their airlock cycle is complete. Once this confirmation is received and the four crates have been deposited, take the remaining three crates to Genetics Research Lab Gamma. If GenLab Gamma is currently occupied, wait for five minutes before attempting another delivery; continue this timed wait until the lab is available and the three crates can be offloaded. After all crates have been distributed and each lab’s acceptance protocol observed, return directly to Wheat Silo 7 and dock at the automated cleaning station before initiating any further tasks.

Begin by traveling to Parts Storage Bay A to pick up a batch consisting of nine hydroponic nutrient canisters. After confirming the canisters are secured, proceed to Vertical Farm Tower 3 and prepare to deliver three nutrient canisters, but do not allow the transfer until Operations Supervisor Ito has verified the intake pumps are running; wait until she signals the pumps are operational, and once all three canisters have been removed, continue. Next, make your way to Crop Research Lab South, where another three nutrient canisters must be offloaded, but first wait for Lab Assistant Chao to complete preliminary sample logging, which may require several minutes. Upon receiving clearance that the logging is finished and the canisters have been accepted, head directly to Maintenance Hub Beta with the remaining three nutrient canisters. Wait for Senior Technician Morales to remove the final three canisters. After all deliveries have been finalized and the robot is empty, remain at Maintenance Hub Beta for eight minutes to allow a mandatory system integrity check by the diagnostics crew before proceeding to your subsequent assignment.

Start by proceeding to Receiving Dock C to load a pallet of fifteen sealed chemical reagent drums designated for laboratory use. These drums must be distributed among three locations: deliver six drums to the Pharmaceutical Synthesis Laboratory, five drums to the Microbiology Research Unit, and the remaining four drums to the Hazardous Waste Processing Zone, ensuring the correct allocation without surplus at any site. For every location, wait until laboratory staff or waste technicians have completely removed all drums from the robot before heading to the next assigned destination. Once all deliveries are complete, navigate to Equipment Maintenance Bay 2 and wait exactly 7 minutes while a technician runs a full sensor calibration check on the robot; only after receiving a completion signal from the technician may you proceed back to Receiving Dock C to finalize the delivery manifest and stand by for further instructions.
