instruction: Start at Maintenance Bay 4 and load five replacement filter cartridges designated for the Harvesters Fleet. Transport two filters to Field Harvester Alpha, parked at North Field Station, and wait nearby until the maintenance team has finished removing both cartridges from the robot. After confirming removal, drive to South Field Station with two more filter cartridges for Field Harvester Bravo; pause for 6 minutes before permitting drop-off to allow for ongoing calibration checks. Once both preceding deliveries have been completed and all four cartridges are confirmed as removed, bring the final filter to Workshop Storage Annex. If either North or South Field Station reports an incomplete cartridge removal, remain at Workshop Storage Annex and await confirmation from both field sites before releasing the last filter for storage. After all five filter cartridges have been delivered and verified, return to Maintenance Bay 4 for task debriefing.

instruction: Start by picking up a pallet containing twelve hydroponic nutrient tanks at Receiving Bay Two of the supply warehouse. Your next task is to distribute these twelve nutrient tanks across three separate destinations as follows: deliver five tanks to Greenhouse East first, where you must wait until the inventory crew completes unloading and confirms removal of all five tanks. After this, continue to Research Annex South and drop off four additional nutrient tanks, but only once the ongoing chemical mixing operation has concluded—stand by outside the annex for up to four minutes if necessary until you receive a release signal. Finally, the remaining three nutrient tanks should be transported to Crop Field West, and you must wait there until all tanks have been offloaded by the field team, confirming completion before departing. Once every location has received its designated number of tanks and after all unloading confirmations have been received, return to Receiving Bay Two to report your task completion and prepare for subsequent instructions.

instruction: Proceed to Fertilizer Depot South and wait until twelve sealed fertilizer bags are prepped for pickup. Once all twelve fertilizer bags are secured, begin distribution by taking four fertilizer bags each to Field Plot A, Field Plot B, and Field Plot C, but if the bag count is not divisible evenly, allocate the remainder starting with Field Plot A; for this scenario, deliver the first four fertilizer bags to Field Plot A, then Field Plot B receives the next four, Field Plot C receives the next four, and if there is any extra fertilizer bag because of miscount, return it to the depot. At each field plot, remain until a field hand confirms the removal of their respective fertilizer bags. After completing these deliveries and ensuring all bags are accounted for, proceed to the Equipment Maintenance Bay and stay there for fifteen minutes while the maintenance crew conducts a systems check, waiting until the full time has elapsed and you receive clearance before leaving.

Proceed to the Chemical Supply Depot located adjacent to the south machinery shed and collect six canisters of crop fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer first to Field Plot Alpha, where you will unload two canisters and wait for the field technician to signal that both canisters have been safely removed from the robot. Afterward, deliver another two canisters to Field Plot Bravo, remaining at that location until the unloading is confirmed complete. For the last two canisters, head to Field Plot Gamma and transfer the remaining payload; ensure that if any location is temporarily unavailable, proceed to the next designated field and return to the skipped plot once accessibility is restored. Following the final drop-off, stay at Field Plot Gamma for five minutes to monitor for any immediate application issues, then return to the Chemical Supply Depot for further instructions.

instruction.location: Chemical Supply Depot located adjacent to the south machinery shed
Chemical Supply Depot located adjacent to the south machinery shed

instruction: Begin your operation at Storage Dock B by collecting a pallet containing twenty-one fertilizer sacks. Navigate first to Field Section Alpha and deliver eight fertilizer sacks, remaining on site until the field crew has confirmed removal of all sacks. After delivering at Field Section Alpha, proceed to Field Section Bravo, where you must await the completion of the fertilizer sack hand-off from the previous field before delivering another eight sacks. Once both fields have received their allocations, bring the remaining five fertilizer sacks to Field Section Charlie; if any sacks are still left after these three deliveries, transport them directly to the Farm Equipment Garage as emergency reserve, but only after a five-minute holding period at Field Section Charlie to check for urgent supply calls. At the end of the delivery rounds, return to Storage Dock B and pause for three minutes to ensure accurate inventory logging and to receive any new routing instructions before ending your shift.

Begin at the western loading bay and collect fifteen sealed crates containing harvest monitoring sensors. Start by transporting six crates to Orchard Block A, where you must wait for the site technician to confirm that all six crates have been removed before proceeding. Then, deliver five crates to Agricultural Experiment Plot C, but after arrival, wait at least four minutes to allow the installation crew to prepare the transfer point, and only release the crates for removal once the crew signals their readiness. Afterwards, take the remaining four crates to the Northern Equipment Shed; at the shed, do not begin unloading the crates until you have verified the contents with the inventory supervisor and waited an additional one minute for documentation. Once all crates have been distributed to the three destinations and each location has acknowledged receipt and removal where required, promptly return to the western loading bay and wait for a further two minutes before accepting any subsequent dispatches.

instruction: Begin at Maintenance Station Alpha with a set of nine replacement air filters intended for the grain silos. Move first to Silo 1 near the southern field edge, and wait until a technician is present before distributing three air filters there. After all three have been installed and the technician clears the area, proceed directly to Silo 2 adjacent to the equipment yard and deliver another three air filters, but remain on site for five minutes to observe for any installation issues. Once the five-minute observation period concludes, continue to Silo 3 next to the northeast storage barn to deliver the final three air filters. Wait here until the maintenance supervisor confirms that all filters from this batch have been removed from your storage compartment. Only after receiving this confirmation, return to Maintenance Station Alpha and await further tasks, ensuring all filter compartments are empty upon arrival.

instruction: Begin at the Parts Distribution Center and pick up a batch of fourteen engine assembly kits destined for morning shift production. Proceed first to Assembly Line Zone One, where you must drop off five engine assembly kits at the parts intake area and remain onsite until the line supervisor verifies all five kits have been received and logged. Once cleared, move to Maintenance Bay Three and transfer another five engine assembly kits to the designated delivery stand, and again, do not depart until the maintenance technician signals that all five kits are present; if confirmation takes longer than expected, remain in place for up to twelve minutes before proceeding. Deliver the last four engine assembly kits to Quality Control Station B, but only approach the offloading zone after confirming that the previous vehicle’s parts have been cleared from the intake tray. After delivery, wait at Quality Control Station B for a further five minutes to allow for initial inspection, then return to the Parts Distribution Center to complete the task cycle, ensuring no assembly kits remain on your payload platform.

instruction: Start at the Raw Material Storage Area and collect twelve seed bags labeled for spring planting. Evenly distribute the seed bags by delivering four seed bags each to Field Alpha, Field Beta, and Field Gamma; if twelve cannot be divided perfectly, any remainder should be delivered to Field Gamma after completing deliveries to Field Alpha and Field Beta. At each field, wait for the respective field manager to confirm successful receipt of the seed bags—if confirmation is delayed at any location, remain at that field and wait an additional three minutes at a time until the acknowledgment is obtained. Once all fields have received their assigned seed bags and all confirmations have been obtained, proceed immediately to the Equipment Cleaning Bay and wait for six minutes to allow for a mandatory sanitation process before returning to Raw Material Storage Area to report task completion. If at any point three successive waiting periods pass at any field without receiving confirmation, cease further transports and remain at your current field location until contacted by the operations supervisor.

instruction: Begin at Maintenance Bay Delta and collect four sealed toolkits from the equipment rack, then deliver one toolkit each to Pump Station North, Valve Junction East, and Control Room Gamma in sequence, waiting at each location for three minutes so that onsite technicians can verify receipt and inspect the toolkit contents. Retain the remaining toolkit until after all initial deliveries are complete, then deliver the final toolkit to Storage Locker Beta—but only if you have received confirmation from Control Room Gamma that all scheduled calibration tasks have finished; if not, circle back to Control Room Gamma and wait outside for up to five minutes until the confirmation arrives before proceeding. Once the last toolkit has been deposited in Storage Locker Beta, return immediately to Maintenance Bay Delta and await further maintenance assignments.

Start by navigating to the Main Warehouse and load a total of seventeen spare tractor parts, ensuring that the payload includes all specified components. Your first destination is Maintenance Bay North, where you must deliver six tractor parts; wait until the maintenance supervisor verifies that all received parts have been unloaded before moving forward. Next, transport five tractor parts to Maintenance Bay South, and remain at the bay until the technician has confirmed complete removal of the payload. Take the remaining six tractor parts to Farm Equipment Shed 3, and wait for the shed manager to acknowledge receipt of the entire delivery. Once all drop-offs have been confirmed, pause operations at Equipment Shed 3 for a period of ten minutes to accommodate scheduled diagnostic calibration of newly installed parts. Only after this waiting period should you return to the Main Warehouse. Ensure that at every stage, the next delivery or movement only commences following explicit confirmation of the previous delivery0s completion.

Start your operation at Maintenance Bay 7 by picking up a set of 14 replacement drive belts designated for the on-site combine harvesters. Move first to Equipment Shed Alpha and offload five drive belts to the belt storage rack, ensuring to remain in place until the maintenance supervisor has confirmed the removal of all five drive belts. After this confirmation, proceed to Field Depot Beta and deliver another five drive belts to the depot service counter, waiting for a depot technician to complete the removal before continuing. Then, travel to Barn Gamma and deliver the remaining four drive belts to the barn's tool area; again, await confirmation from the barn staff that all four drive belts have been removed from the robot. Once all belts have been delivered and their removals confirmed, remain stationed at Barn Gamma for eight minutes to provide support for diagnostic testing. When the waiting period concludes, return straight to Maintenance Bay 7 to finalize the task log.

instruction: Start by proceeding to Fertilizer Storage B and acquiring a total of 14 nutrient canisters intended for greenhouse replenishment. Transport exactly five canisters to Greenhouse East, unload them only after receiving a readiness signal from the greenhouse supervisor, and then wait at Greenhouse East for three minutes to allow staff to inspect the delivery. Next, take five more canisters to Greenhouse West, where you must wait until the automated unloading equipment indicates readiness before transferring the canisters to the facility. For the remaining four nutrient canisters, deliver two to Plant Nursery South and two to Vertical Farm North; if either location is currently at capacity upon arrival, wait for five minutes at that specific destination, and reattempt offloading after each interval until space is available. Once all nutrient canisters are properly distributed and confirmation is obtained from every recipient site, return without delay to Fertilizer Storage B and standby at the outbound loading bay until further tasks are assigned.

instruction.location: Fertilizer Storage B outbound loading bay

instruction: Begin your route at the Fertilizer Storage Depot situated between the Equipment Loading Dock and Silo 2, where you must collect five bags of granular fertilizer marked for urgent deployment. Distribute these bags evenly among the Wheat Plot A, the Vegetable Field C, and the Orchard Row 5: deliver two bags to Wheat Plot A, two bags to Vegetable Field C, and the remaining single bag to Orchard Row 5, making sure to perform each drop-off sequentially. After placing fertilizer bags at each location, wait for confirmation from the respective field managers—if any manager is unavailable, remain at that field for precisely four minutes before proceeding to the next delivery. Once all fertilizer bags have been delivered and confirmations or waiting periods are concluded for all three sites, navigate directly to the Equipment Loading Dock and remain onsite for ten minutes to support post-delivery inspection, ensuring no return trip to the storage depot until the inspection interval has elapsed.

instruction.location: Fertilizer Storage Depot situated between the Equipment Loading Dock and Silo 2

instruction: Start at Storage Facility Omega and collect nine spare actuator modules as soon as the modules are confirmed to be packed and ready for transport. Your first destination is Assembly Line Station 3, where you will deliver three actuator modules, remaining on site until a technician removes each module individually from your payload. After these modules are removed, proceed directly to Maintenance Bay 2, but before offloading the next three actuator modules, pause for four minutes to allow the maintenance team to clear the docking area. Deliver all three modules at Maintenance Bay 2 and wait until all have been collected by staff. Then, continue to Quality Control Lab Epsilon with the final three actuator modules, but note that you must wait for explicit authorization from the lab supervisor before the handover; only once authorization is received should you allow the removal of the modules. After confirming all nine spare actuator modules have been successfully offloaded at the intended destinations, return to Storage Facility Omega and remain at the designated checkpoint for two minutes to complete system diagnostics and report any transport anomalies discovered during your route.

Retrieve a set of fourteen calibration weights from the Maintenance Shed and verify each weight is tagged for this week's silo inspections. Navigate first to Grain Silo A, then to Grain Silo B, and finally to Grain Silo C, distributing the weights as follows: deliver five weights to Grain Silo A, five weights to Grain Silo B, and the remaining four weights to Grain Silo C to account for the requirement difference. After each delivery, remain at the respective silo for three minutes to provide technicians sufficient time to check the received weights and recalibrate their measurement systems. Once the final delivery to Grain Silo C is confirmed and the waiting period has elapsed, head immediately to the Quality Control Bay and wait there until notified by the inspection supervisor that all calibration checks have been logged and no additional items are needed for the current maintenance cycle.

Begin at the Central Grain Mill Loading Dock and collect a pallet containing nine feed supplement packages. Head to Poultry Shed A and unload three feed supplement packages; wait for the on-site handler to complete their inventory check before leaving the shed. Afterward, deliver the next three feed supplement packages to Livestock Barn B, but only proceed to unload if all packages have been removed from your cargo and accounted for at Poultry Shed A. Once you confirm the removal, continue to Dairy Pen C with the final three feed supplement packages. At Dairy Pen C, drop off the remaining supplements and wait for seven minutes so the dairy staff can perform quality control. When the waiting period is over and all supplement packages have been completely removed, return the empty pallet back to the Central Grain Mill Loading Dock to complete the task.

Begin at Storage Shed 1 to collect a batch of ten irrigation valve units designated for system repairs, then proceed directly to Pump Station North to deliver four valve units; wait at this station until all four valves are confirmed as unloaded by the maintenance engineer. After confirmation, continue to Water Distribution Hub 2 with three additional valve units, pausing for eight minutes upon arrival to allow the repair crew to complete an urgent diagnostics check before taking receipt of the payload. Once the three hub valve units have been received, transport the final three valve units to Greenhouse 7, waiting at Greenhouse 7 until the horticulturist confirms valve unit removal. After completing all deliveries and receiving removal confirmations at every stop, return to Storage Shed 1 to await further servicing instructions.

instruction: Begin your route at Central Packaging Depot and collect a total of ten fertilizer sacks, verifying that all bags are secured before moving. First, travel to Rice Field Alpha, where you must unload and leave three fertilizer sacks at the marked drop-off point, remaining on-site until the field foreman confirms the sacks are in place. Next, proceed to the Storage Barn North and deposit four fertilizer sacks; however, only initiate this transfer after you have received notification from Rice Field Alpha that all their sacks have been removed. At Storage Barn North, wait five minutes after offloading to allow barn staff to complete a safety inspection. Finally, with the remaining three fertilizer sacks, visit Greenhouse 7 and deliver them to the greenhouse technician; if Greenhouse 7 is not ready to accept the shipment due to ongoing equipment checks when you arrive, wait outside for up to eight minutes before reattempting delivery. Should all deliveries be completed and confirmed, return to Central Packaging Depot without delay to conclude your assignment.

Begin at the Central Seed Storage Facility and load a total of twenty-five seedling trays designated for distribution. First, deliver eight trays to Field Plot Alpha, and remain there until the automated planting system completes loading, which will trigger a green status signal and may require up to five minutes for all trays. Immediately after, transport another eight trays to Field Plot Beta, but wait for seven minutes on arrival to allow the irrigation system to finish its pre-watering cycle before offloading the seedling trays; make sure the system operator confirms readiness before proceeding. Deliver eight additional trays to Field Plot Gamma; however, if either the delivery at Field Plot Alpha or Beta was delayed by more than ten minutes combined, skip Field Plot Gamma and proceed directly to the Greenhouse Maintenance Bay. For any remaining seedling tray—this will occur due to the division of twenty-five trays by three plots—deliver the leftover single tray to the Experimental Microplot, ensuring to notify the agronomist on arrival and remain until a successful payload transfer is acknowledged. After all trays have been distributed as outlined and you have received clear confirmations at each site, return to the Central Seed Storage Facility to complete your route and upload your delivery logs.

Start your route at the Central Packing House by loading nine crates of freshly harvested apples onto your cargo platform. Your first stop is at Cooling Room 1, where you will deliver three crates and remain until the warehouse manager has confirmed all three crates have been removed. After the confirmation, proceed to Cooling Room 2 to deliver another three crates; however, you must wait for five full minutes outside Cooling Room 2 before unloading the apple crates to allow for interior sanitization after the previous shipment. Once the apples have been dropped off at Cooling Room 2, transport the remaining three apple crates to the Quality Inspection Bay, but if you find that one or more crates remain unclaimed after ten minutes of waiting, transfer any unclaimed crates to Overflow Storage Area D for temporary holding. At the completion of your deliveries, return directly to the Central Packing House and wait for two minutes to complete the post-delivery inspection check before you may conclude your route.

Begin at the Seed Storage Barn and collect eighteen packages of drought-resistant corn seed reserved for current planting operations. Divide these seed packages among four fields as follows: deliver six packages to Field Alpha on the east side, five packages to Field Bravo in the central plot, four packages to Field Charlie along the western boundary, and allocate the remaining three packages to Field Delta near the southern stream. For each field, wait until the foreman signals that all assigned seed packages are ready to be offloaded, then wait an additional two minutes to allow for inventory confirmation before moving on to the next field. Strictly maintain the order of deliveries—Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, then Delta—and, after all seeds have been delivered and confirmations received, proceed to the Equipment Wash Station and remain there for five minutes for required decontamination before returning to the Seed Storage Barn to finalize the operation.

instruction: Starting at Maintenance Bay Alpha, proceed to Parts Storage Central and wait until the pallet of replacement gears is confirmed ready for transport. Once the gears are available, take the entire pallet containing 17 gear units and deliver 5 units each to Assembly Line 1 and Assembly Line 2, ensuring to wait at each line until a technician has acknowledged the removal of all delivered gears before moving to the next location. The remaining 7 gear units are to be allocated to Machine Shop Delta; however, upon arrival at Machine Shop Delta, wait for three minutes to allow the shop staff to prepare their unloading area before offloading the gears, then remain until the gears have been fully accepted. After completing all gear deliveries and receiving confirmation of receipt at each site, return immediately to Maintenance Bay Alpha and wait for two minutes so that your loading bed can be inspected for residual debris prior to the next dispatch.

Begin your run at the Farm Workshop and collect four sealed toolkits required for emergency repairs. Head first to Tractor Station Alpha and deliver one toolkit, remaining at the station until the on-site mechanic signs off on receiving it. Once acknowledged, continue to the Greenhouse Operations Center with two additional toolkits, but make sure to wait five minutes outside the entrance to allow for airlock depressurization before proceeding indoors; after the five minutes, hand over both toolkits to the greenhouse supervisor and await confirmation of successful receipt. Take the final toolkit to the Remote Irrigation Pump House, where you must remain until the pump technician completes unloading it, after which you should immediately return to the Farm Workshop and dock in the charging station for recharging.

Begin at Maintenance Bay 3 and collect the battery replacement kit before heading to Solar Array A for the first service stop. Once there, wait until the technician signals that the array is powered down—this may take up to 7 minutes—before proceeding to replace the power module. After completing service at Solar Array A, distribute three spare battery modules: deliver one module to Wind Turbine Control Shed, another to Equipment Depot 2, and the last one to Field Operations Post, ensuring each location confirms receipt before continuing. For the return phase, if the original battery replacement kit is now empty, pause for 2 minutes at Maintenance Bay 3 to allow the crew to restock your payload before moving to Calibration Station 1 to await further instructions for the next task.

Start at the Central Grain Silo to load a total of twenty-one labeled grain sample cassettes for laboratory analysis. Transport seven cassettes each to Test Lab A, Test Lab B, and Test Lab C, ensuring that in the event any cassettes remain after dividing evenly, you deliver all leftover cassettes directly to the Quality Assurance Office. After every delivery at a test lab, wait for precisely three minutes to allow lab personnel to check the sample integrity before continuing to the next location or backtracking for any additional drops. Once all initial deliveries and waiting periods are completed, visit each lab again in the same order—A, then B, then C—to collect signed sample-receipt forms from their reception desks, and deliver all the forms together to the Lab Coordination Suite. Only after all forms are handed off and acknowledged at the Coordination Suite should you return to the Central Grain Silo and remain there for five minutes to synchronize any potential route adjustments before concluding the task.

Start by heading to the Component Storage Facility to collect a shipment of fifteen hydraulic pump units. Distribute these units by delivering six hydraulic pump units to Assembly Line Alpha, then wait at Assembly Line Alpha until all six units have been unloaded and verified by the line supervisor. Once unloading is completed, proceed to Maintenance Bay Bravo and deliver five hydraulic pump units, but only release these units after confirmation is received from Assembly Line Alpha that their delivery process has fully concluded. Wait for three minutes at Maintenance Bay Bravo for inspection after unloading. Take the remaining four hydraulic pump units to Final Testing Lab, where you must wait until both Assembly Line Alpha and Maintenance Bay Bravo have finished their verifications before transferring the units, and remain at the lab for eight additional minutes after delivery to support the calibration team. Do not proceed to any other assignment until the full set of distributions and corresponding waiting periods have been completed as described.

Begin at the Central Seed Storage Facility, where you will collect a bundle containing twenty-one fertilizer sachets and verify with the storage attendant that all sachets are securely loaded. Proceed directly to Field Plot West and evenly distribute seven sachets onto the fertilizer distribution mat, waiting until the field operator signals that all seven sachets at Field Plot West have been removed. Afterward, continue to Field Plot North, depositing another seven sachets on the supply tray; remain onsite until confirmation is received from the agronomist that these sachets are fully transferred. Move then to Field Plot East, deliver the remaining seven sachets, and delay departure until the planting supervisor at Field Plot East confirms that all sachets have been cleared from the robot. Only after you have positive acknowledgments from all three field plots for complete sachet receipt, return to the Central Seed Storage Facility to conclude your delivery sequence, ensuring that each field’s confirmation is obtained before returning.

Proceed to the Seed Distribution Center to collect a load of seventeen seed sample containers, and prepare to allocate them across the test fields by splitting the load into three nearly equal batches: deliver six seed sample containers to Field Alpha and remain at Field Alpha until each container has been unloaded by the agronomy team, then travel to Field Beta with another six seed sample containers and wait for the unloading process to finish before departing. Bring the final five seed sample containers to Field Gamma, and upon arrival, wait for ten minutes to allow the soil scientists at Field Gamma to perform on-site calibration and verify receipt of all samples. Once all seed sample containers have been distributed and confirmed at every field, return to the Seed Distribution Center and stand by inside the vehicle charging bay until further routing instructions are issued.

instruction.location: Seed Distribution Center vehicle charging bay

instruction: Collect six replacement air filters from the Central Storage Locker, then proceed to Maintenance Bay 1 and deliver two air filters, waiting until both have been removed by the maintenance supervisor. Once Maintenance Bay 1 has received its filters, travel to Maintenance Bay 2 with the remaining four air filters; upon arrival, wait for five minutes to allow engineers to make space before unloading. After the waiting period, ensure that two air filters are collected by the Maintenance Bay 2 staff before you continue. With two air filters now left, take these last filters to the Garage Annex, but only initiate unloading once the Garage Annex team confirms their readiness. Once both filters have been removed at the Garage Annex, return any empty containers to the Central Storage Locker and stand by for further loading instructions.

Commence at Storage Depot Sigma to retrieve twelve maintenance toolkits assigned for distribution to the Tractor Service Station, Harvester Equipment Yard, and Drone Hangar Omega. Deliver five toolkits to the Tractor Service Station first, waiting until every toolkit is acknowledged as received by the station's chief technician before proceeding. Next, bring four toolkits to the Harvester Equipment Yard; upon arrival, pause for exactly five minutes to allow the machinery to be safely powered down, then transfer the toolkits and confirm all have been removed by the yard supervisor. Finally, deliver the remaining three toolkits to Drone Hangar Omega, but do not begin unloading until any previously issued toolkits have been collected and cleared from the drone prep area; after the supervisor completes removal, report to the Central Control Dock and wait for fifteen minutes for post-delivery debrief and inspection before accepting further assignments.

Initiate the sequence at Maintenance Bay Delta by picking up six equipment diagnostic modules, verifying with the technician that all modules are prepped and ready. Head to Wind Turbine Tower A and deliver two equipment diagnostic modules, waiting until wind turbine staff have completely removed both modules. Once removal is confirmed, continue on to Wind Turbine Tower B to drop off two additional diagnostic modules, again pausing until staff at Tower B remove every module. After both tasks are complete, travel to Wind Turbine Tower C with the remaining two diagnostic modules; after the modules have been fully removed, remain stationed at Tower C for four minutes to allow for an immediate system calibration by field engineers. After the waiting interval, return directly to Maintenance Bay Delta to report module delivery status and receive further maintenance instructions.

Begin your route at Maintenance Bay 4 and collect nine diagnostic toolkits labeled 'Sensor Calibration', ensuring none are missing from the manifest. Transport three toolkits each to Testing Lab A, Experimental Reactor Chamber, and Quality Assurance Office, making sure to keep each drop-off batch completely separate for inventory tracking. After the delivery at Testing Lab A, wait five minutes to allow technicians to conduct initial diagnostics; only after receiving confirmation that the tests have started should you proceed with the remaining toolkit deliveries. Once all toolkits have reached their destined locations, return directly to Maintenance Bay 4, but pause for an additional two minutes at the entrance if any toolkit delivery was delayed for more than ten minutes, as flagged by the remote monitoring system, before proceeding inside to report task completion at the status terminal.

Begin your route at the fertilizer storage warehouse where you are to pick up twelve sealed bags of nitrogen fertilizer. Proceed to Field Plot Alpha and deliver four fertilizer bags, then wait for the field supervisor at Field Plot Alpha to confirm the unloading is completed. Next, continue with another four bags to Field Plot Beta, and again wait until the field supervisor at Field Plot Beta has verified receipt. After these drop-offs, take the remaining four fertilizer bags to Field Plot Gamma; if any bags remain beyond this allocation (for example, surplus or damaged bags found upon inspection), ensure these are delivered to the Agricultural Supplies Return Dock. After every delivery to a field plot or the return dock, allow for a five-minute pause to account for inspection and paperwork preparation by staff on site. Once all deliveries and waiting periods are concluded, collect any empty fertilizer packaging from each plot in the same order—Alpha, Beta, then Gamma—and carry all of these to the Waste Management Zone, only departing once the packaging has been completely unloaded and a waste clerk has signed off on the transfer. Afterward, return directly to the fertilizer storage warehouse to await further instructions.

object.description: surplus or damaged bags of nitrogen fertilizer

instruction: Begin at the automated produce packing station and retrieve a total of fifteen stacked apple containers intended for outbound shipment. Shuttle five apple containers to Shipping Dock A, five to Shipping Dock B, and the remaining five to Shipping Dock C, delivering them in consecutive trips and ensuring each dock receives their allotment even if the containers must be carried in separate loads due to space constraints. For each delivery, wait exactly three minutes at the respective dock to allow for quality inspection and confirmation by the shipping supervisor before proceeding to the next dock or returning for more containers, repeating this process until all fifteen apple containers are fully distributed across the three shipping docks. Once all apple containers have been delivered and verification has been received from each dock supervisor, proceed directly to the pallet return bay adjacent to the produce cooling room, and remain there until new loading instructions are communicated to you by the logistics coordinator.

instruction.location: pallet return bay adjacent to the produce cooling room
pallet return bay adjacent to the produce cooling room

instruction: Start at the Main Grain Silo, where you will collect nine quality-assurance sampling pouches from the storage manager, ensuring each pouch is properly sealed and ready for field analysis before proceeding. Once the samples are accounted for, distribute the pouches in the following manner: deliver three to the Research Plot East, three to the Remote Soil Test Station, and three to the Central Crop Monitoring Shed, pausing at each station to await confirmation from the assigned technician that the pouches have been fully received and logged before traveling to the next site. Once all sample deliveries are verified, proceed directly to the Data Uplink Station, where you must wait for six minutes while upload technicians synchronize the sampling data with the farm’s central server. After this waiting period, continue on to Equipment Maintenance Bay 7 for routine system calibration and await further deployment instructions.

Start at Maintenance Supply Warehouse where you will load twelve sealed coolant packs onto the transporter. Take four coolant packs to Greenhouse Cooling Unit 1, deliver them, and remain until the greenhouse manager at Greenhouse Cooling Unit 1 has acknowledged full receipt of the packs. After this confirmation, proceed to Hydroponics Facility B to distribute four additional coolant packs; if Hydroponics Facility B’s storage bay is occupied upon arrival, wait for three minutes before attempting the delivery again. Following the successful transfer at Hydroponics Facility B, bring the remaining four coolant packs to the Central Processing Shed, but only unload them once an engineer at Central Processing Shed verifies the prior drop-offs were completed in both previous destinations. When the engineer confirms, wait at Central Processing Shed for two minutes to allow inventory logging, and then proceed without delay to Maintenance Supply Warehouse for status reporting and preparation for the next round of deliveries.

Begin at Storage Locker 2 near the central warehouse and proceed to the Seed Sorting Facility to collect a batch of nineteen individually sealed seed packets labeled for export. Distribute these nineteen seed packets as evenly as possible across the Greenhouse Loading Bay, North Field Shed, and East Processing Conveyor, ensuring that Greenhouse Loading Bay and North Field Shed receive six packets each while East Processing Conveyor receives the remaining seven; conduct the distribution sequentially, delivering each location’s full share in separate trips. After completing the packet deliveries to all three sites, wait precisely four minutes at East Processing Conveyor to allow sorting staff to scan and log the incoming packets before you leave. Once the four-minute window concludes, return directly to Storage Locker 2 and remain positioned outside the locker until a supervisor assigns your next retrieval duty, but do not initiate contact or further movement until instructed.

instruction.location: Storage Locker 2 near the central warehouse

instruction: Begin the task by traveling to Storage Hangar 7 and collecting nine containers of liquid pesticide. These containers must be distributed as follows: deliver four containers to Orchard A’s main access point, three containers to Orchard B’s service shed, and the final two containers to Orchard C’s equipment pad, making sure that each orchard receives the correct number of containers and none are left behind. Once you have delivered the four containers at Orchard A, wait for ten minutes at the edge of Orchard A while the quality inspector confirms the contents and approves the drop-off. Afterward, proceed to Orchard B and drop off the three containers; only proceed to the next location once the orchard manager has removed all three containers from your cargo bay. Conclude the distribution by delivering the remaining two containers to Orchard C’s equipment pad, and immediately after delivery, pause there for six minutes to allow the maintenance crew to prepare application equipment. When all containers have been correctly distributed and all allocated waiting periods and removal confirmations are complete, return to Storage Hangar 7 for route closure and final check-in.

Begin your mission at Maintenance Bay North, where you must collect three different diagnostic toolkits: Toolkit Red, Toolkit Blue, and Toolkit Yellow. Proceed first to Harvesting Field East and deliver Toolkit Red; remain at Harvesting Field East for exactly four minutes to allow the on-site engineer to complete initial equipment checks using Toolkit Red. Once the allotted time at Harvesting Field East passes, continue directly to Storage Silo 5 to deliver Toolkit Blue, but only do so if you have observed the engineer at Harvesting Field East successfully remove Toolkit Red from your payload. If the removal of Toolkit Red is delayed for any reason, stay at Harvesting Field East until the operation is complete before moving on. After Toolkit Blue is delivered at Storage Silo 5 and removed by the mechanics team, wait for their confirmation and then take the last remaining Toolkit Yellow to Tractor Shed 3. Deliver Toolkit Yellow to Tractor Shed 3, and remain there until a minimum of six minutes has passed to support an extended diagnostics session. Should any of the diagnostic toolkits not be removed at their intended location, immediately return all undelivered toolkits to Maintenance Bay North. Upon completion of all deliveries and after the waiting period at Tractor Shed 3, return to Maintenance Bay North for debriefing.

Head to Grain Storage A to pick up twelve sensor modules, confirming with the storage attendant that all modules are loaded. Deliver the first five sensor modules to Field Plot 7, and after all five modules are offloaded and signed off by the field engineer, stay at Field Plot 7 for three minutes to allow the modules’ calibration routines to complete. Next, proceed to Irrigation Controller Station Omega with four sensor modules; once the modules are dropped off and removed by staff, remain for two minutes to accommodate necessary staff verification. Transport the remaining three sensor modules to Fertilizer Depot 3; after offloading, wait for sixty seconds for depot personnel to run a security check on the inventory. Do not return to Grain Storage A for your final report until all sensor modules have been delivered and all waiting periods at the delivery stations have concluded.

Begin your duties at the Supply Dock and retrieve a batch of fifteen irrigation valves, making certain that each valve is securely stowed before departure. Deliver the first six valves to Field Section Delta, and remain there until the Section Delta supervisor signals that the unloading process is fully complete. Only once the Field Section Delta supervisor has confirmed removal, continue by transporting five valves to the Pump House West and wait on-site for three minutes to allow maintenance personnel to perform an initial inspection. With the remaining four valves, proceed to Storage Shed 3, but before offloading, check if Shed 3 is unlocked and staff are present; if either condition is not met, pause for up to seven minutes for access and staff availability before retrying the delivery. After all valves have been distributed and confirmed at their destinations, return without delay to the Supply Dock to prepare for further instructions.

Begin your operation at the Central Supply Depot, where you will be issued twelve soil nutrient containers labeled for distribution. Travel first to Greenhouse A and drop off four containers, waiting there until the greenhouse manager has inspected and acknowledged receipt of the delivery. Continue to Greenhouse B and Greenhouse C, delivering four nutrient containers to each location; if any nutrient containers remain after these deliveries, proceed directly to the Fertilizer Storage Room and deposit the remaining nutrients there. After each greenhouse delivery, pause for six minutes to provide time for inventory reconciliation by local staff before proceeding to the next greenhouse. Once all nutrients have been delivered and accounted for, navigate to the Field Monitoring Station and retrieve the daily sensor calibration kit. Only after the calibration kit is onboard, proceed to Monitoring Tower West to drop off the kit, then wait for ten minutes in case field engineers request any urgent returns. Conclude the route by returning to the Central Supply Depot for debriefing and readiness check.

Start at Warehouse Entrance Delta and wait for a single large shipment of 25 specialized irrigation sensors to be fully loaded; after verifying sensor integrity, divide the sensors as evenly as possible between Field Alpha, Field Beta, and Field Gamma, with each field receiving 8 sensors, and deliver the extra remaining sensor to Field Alpha as the first priority. Proceed to Field Alpha and deliver 9 sensors, awaiting confirmation from the field technician that all sensors have been removed before moving forward. Next, continue to Field Beta with 8 sensors and wait for the local operations manager to complete the payload removal process. Then, travel to Field Gamma with the final set of 8 sensors, and again wait until the supervisor verifies the full removal. After completing all deliveries, wait in Field Gamma for 6 minutes to monitor for deployment issues, and only once this period has elapsed and no further requests are made, return to the Warehouse Entrance Delta to report the finalized distribution and sensor status.

Begin by navigating to the Grain Receiving Dock to wait until the grain inspector certifies that a batch of fifteen sealed grain sacks are ready for collection. Divide these fifteen sacks for delivery such that Silo Storage Bay 1 receives six sacks, Silo Storage Bay 2 receives five sacks, and Silo Storage Bay 3 receives the remaining four sacks, ensuring the distribution covers the total amount with remainders handled explicitly. After depositing each designated set of sacks at its respective Silo Storage Bay, pause there for four minutes to synchronize inventory records with the bay’s automated tracking system. Once all sacks have been distributed and the final synchronization at Silo Storage Bay 3 is completed, proceed to the Fueling Station for a mandatory safety inspection, remaining at the Fueling Station until the inspection technician clears the robot for further operation before concluding the task.

Start your mission at Assembly Bay 2 by collecting eight diagnostic sensor modules. Navigate first to Maintenance Hub Alpha and distribute three sensor modules, remaining at Maintenance Hub Alpha until an engineer has removed all three modules from your cargo. Following this, proceed to Calibration Center Bravo and deliver another three sensor modules, but only unload the modules after the calibration technician signals readiness; if the technician is not ready upon your arrival, wait for five minutes before attempting to deliver again. Once Maintenance Hub Alpha and Calibration Center Bravo have each received their sensor modules, transport the remaining two modules to Research Lab Delta. At Research Lab Delta, wait until both modules have been removed by the lead researcher. After all eight diagnostic sensor modules have been successfully delivered and the last module has been removed from your cargo, return to Assembly Bay 2 and remain there for three minutes to allow the logistics supervisor to perform a final equipment check before completing your mission.

Begin by proceeding to Field Supply Shed 2 to retrieve a total of sixteen fertilizer canisters earmarked for distribution. Once all sixteen fertilizer canisters are loaded, travel to Irrigation Station Alpha and deliver six fertilizer canisters, remaining at Irrigation Station Alpha until you receive confirmation from the station attendant that all six canisters have been safely removed. After this confirmation, head to Equipment Maintenance Bay and offload another five fertilizer canisters, waiting there for four minutes to permit the maintenance crew to organize the supplies and clear the unloading area. As soon as the waiting period concludes and the space is cleared, proceed to Crop Storage Barn D with the next four fertilizer canisters, waiting at Crop Storage Barn D until the barn supervisor acknowledges receipt of the entire batch. Finally, take the single remaining fertilizer canister to Field Plot 7, where you must wait until a designated agronomist signals that the canister is ready for application; once this signal is observed, return directly to Field Supply Shed 2 and stand by until the next allocation of fertilizer canisters is made available.

Start by moving to Manufacturing Loading Dock 3 and waiting until five sealed tool crates are loaded onto the robot. Next, deliver these five tool crates to Assembly Zone A, Assembly Zone B, and Assembly Zone C; allocate two crates each to Assembly Zone A and Zone B and deliver the remaining one crate to Assembly Zone C, ensuring the exact quantity is distributed to each zone. After dropping off tool crates at Assembly Zone A, pause for seven minutes to allow the assembly supervisors to check and inventory the delivery, proceeding only after inventory confirmation. Continue on to Assembly Zone B, but if Assembly Zone B’s intake bay is occupied upon your arrival, wait there for three minutes before attempting to deliver the tool crates. Once the crates are accepted and removed in Assembly Zone B, head to Assembly Zone C and deliver the final crate, waiting beside the equipment rack until the crate is officially removed from your cargo bay. After all tool crates have been successfully distributed and individually removed at the appropriate locations, return immediately to Manufacturing Loading Dock 3 for post-mission debriefing and system status verification.

Start at the maintenance bay and collect twelve replacement hydraulic pumps, carefully securing all pumps onto your transport. Next, proceed to Greenhouse 1 and deliver five hydraulic pumps, waiting until Greenhouse 1 staff have removed all five pumps from your vehicle before moving on. After this, transport four hydraulic pumps to Tractor Shed A, where you must remain for exactly seven minutes for inspection of the delivered pumps; do not leave until the timer elapses, even if the inspection ends sooner. Finally, take the remaining three hydraulic pumps to the Irrigation Control Room and wait there until all three pumps are removed by technicians. Once you have verified that every pump was successfully delivered and unloaded at its destination, return directly to the maintenance bay and park at the Equipment Charging Station until further deployment orders arrive.

Begin your operation at the Parts Inventory Room and collect a total of fourteen coolant cartridges designated for the automation assembly line. Deliver five coolant cartridges to the East Conveyor Belt Station first, and wait at this station until the maintenance chief verifies the correct inventory has arrived and signals that the coolant cartridges have been removed. After receiving the go-ahead, proceed to the Central Robotics Workshop and unload another five coolant cartridges, remaining on site until the lead technician confirms all cartridges are accounted for and offloaded. With four coolant cartridges left, travel next to the Assembly Inspection Bay, deposit the remaining cartridges, and then remain there for eight minutes to accommodate system recalibration prompted by the new coolant supply. Once the wait period concludes, return promptly to the Parts Inventory Room to complete your assignment.

instruction: Begin the operation at the charging station outside Vehicle Maintenance Bay, then proceed to the Seed Supply Depot to retrieve a tray containing sixteen specialty seed canisters. Next, transport five seed canisters to Field Plot 1 adjacent to the north windbreak, and wait until farm personnel notify you that all five canisters have been offloaded. After the departure from Field Plot 1, bring six seed canisters to Field Plot 2 located along the central access lane, remaining in place until each of the six canisters has been individually removed by the planting team. Once unloading at Field Plot 2 is confirmed, carry the remaining five seed canisters to Field Plot 3 near the east pond, but upon arrival, wait ten minutes before allowing any offloading to begin, so irrigation checks can be performed. Once the ten-minute interval has passed, stand by until all five canisters are removed from the tray. After every seed canister has been delivered and all waiting periods completed, return directly to the charging station outside Vehicle Maintenance Bay and await further instructions.

instruction: Begin your route at the Fertilizer Depot, where you must collect fifteen nutrient canisters designated for field application. Once all canisters are secured, distribute them evenly among Field Alpha, Field Beta, and Field Gamma by delivering five canisters to each field, completing each delivery run and confirming the field supervisor has removed all canisters before proceeding to the next. If any canisters remain undelivered due to uneven division, transport the remaining canisters to Field Delta as the final stop. After the final delivery is completed and the Field Delta staff have removed any leftover canisters, head to the Vehicle Wash Station and pause there for eight minutes to allow soil decontamination procedures to complete. Once the decontamination interval concludes, make your way to the Charging Dock and remain stationed there until you receive further deployment instructions.

Begin by retrieving a pallet containing 61 assembled circuit boards from Production Line Four in Manufacturing Hall A. Transport this pallet to the Main Packaging Dock, where you must sort and allocate the circuit boards by distributing 20 boards to Packing Zone Red, 20 boards to Packing Zone Blue, and 20 boards to Packing Zone Green; any remaining board (there will be 1) should be delivered separately to Quality Control Station Omega for additional inspection. After the final board is dropped off at Quality Control Station Omega, wait there for 4 minutes to allow the quality inspector to complete initial checks. Once the waiting period is finished and confirmation from the inspector is received, proceed directly to Maintenance Bay West for system diagnostics, but only enter Maintenance Bay West if all packing zones have acknowledged receipt of their correct circuit board allotments. If confirmation from any packing zone is still pending, remain outside Maintenance Bay West for an additional 3 minutes before re-attempting entry.

Production Line Four in Manufacturing Hall A

instruction: Start at the Central Grain Elevator, where you will need to pick up four sealed feed pallets. Deliver one pallet each to the Cow Shed, the Poultry Barn, and the Sheep Enclosure in any order, ensuring that for every destination you wait until the livestock caretaker removes the pallet before proceeding to the next building. The fourth and final pallet must be transported to the Feed Mixer Facility; upon arrival, wait exactly 5 minutes to allow the blending crew to inspect the delivery and confirm the safe transfer. After all four deliveries and confirmation of pallet removal at each location, return directly to the Central Grain Elevator for debriefing and the next assignment schedule update.

Start at Maintenance Bay Alpha and wait until five replacement battery packs for harvest drones are ready for transport, as confirmed by the supply technician. Once the battery packs are prepared, proceed to Charging Station Delta and deliver two battery packs; wait at Charging Station Delta until the maintenance engineer verifies the removal of both battery packs. After this confirmation, travel to Equipment Shed Bravo to drop off another two battery packs, remaining at Equipment Shed Bravo for exactly five minutes to allow the site manager to inspect and register the new stock before moving on. Once those five minutes have passed and the handover is complete, bring the final remaining battery pack to the Field Operations Command Post, waiting at the post until the operations lead acknowledges removal of this last battery pack. Only after all battery packs have been delivered and each location has confirmed complete handover, return without delay to Maintenance Bay Alpha and wait for three minutes to allow the logistics control desk to close out the delivery log.

instruction: Start at Central Maintenance Bay and collect fourteen replacement fuel filters designated for the Harvest Combine fleet. Distribute these filters among four different combine refueling stations as follows: deliver four filters to North Refuel Point, four filters to East Refuel Point, three filters to South Refuel Point, and three filters to West Refuel Point—if the original number of filters does not divide evenly, ensure that North and East Refuel Points receive any extra units. At each refueling point, wait until the on-site technician signals that the handoff of all assigned fuel filters is complete before navigating to the next location. After finishing the final delivery at West Refuel Point, proceed to Equipment Washdown Station and wait there for nine minutes to permit a mandatory post-delivery decontamination cycle before returning to Central Maintenance Bay, but do not enter until the bay supervisor grants explicit clearance following their readiness check.

object.description: bay supervisor clearance after readiness check

instruction: Begin your assignment at Main Warehouse Bay 4 and load ten crates of replacement tractor filters. Deliver three crates to Maintenance Garage A first, where you must wait until the chief mechanic has removed the previous shipment—if the old inventory is not cleared within four minutes, continue waiting in additional two-minute increments until the storage rack is available. Once Maintenance Garage A receives their crates and confirms storage, travel to Garage B to deliver another three crates, but only proceed if confirmation from Garage A was received; repeat the same waiting protocol for removal of old filters. After Garage B, transport the remaining four crates to the Workshop Annex, unloading them only if both preceding garages acknowledged receipt. If even one earlier delivery is delayed or incomplete, wait at the Workshop Annex for up to ten minutes for further direction before returning all undelivered crates to Main Warehouse Bay 4.

Begin the operation at Maintenance Bay 4 by confirming a batch of nine replacement air filters is prepared for deployment. Distribute these air filters among three different tractors as follows: deliver three filters to Tractor Unit Red in Field North, another three filters to Tractor Unit Blue in Field South, and the final three to Tractor Unit Green in Field East. Start by transporting three filters to Tractor Unit Red, waiting on site until the field technician has removed all three filters from the delivery cart. Only once the technician from Red Tractor Unit has cleared the delivery, travel to Field South to service Tractor Unit Blue, but upon arrival pause for four minutes to allow the technician to complete ongoing engine diagnostics before the air filters can be accepted and removed. After successful transfer to Tractor Unit Blue, continue with the last three filters toward Field East for Tractor Unit Green, maintaining position at the tractor until all filters have been acknowledged as received and removed. Following the completion of deliveries and dependency checks at every location, return to Maintenance Bay 4 and wait for five minutes for an end-of-mission inspection from the lead mechanics team before standing down from the task.

Start at Fertilizer Storage Zone F and load a batch of fifteen nutrient bags intended for supplementation. Distribute the nutrient bags across Orchard South, Vineyard East, and Berry Field West such that Orchard South receives five bags, Vineyard East receives another five bags, and Berry Field West receives the remaining five, with each group delivered in a separate trip and drop-off completed before proceeding to the next field. After delivering all fifteen nutrient bags, navigate to Machinery Maintenance Bay M to pick up a replacement filter kit; wait there for two minutes for the maintenance technician to prepare the filter kit, and then transport it directly to Tractor Station 3. Once the filter kit is removed by the operator at Tractor Station 3, remain at Tractor Station 3 for four minutes to verify that all additional support needs are addressed, and finally return to Fertilizer Storage Zone F to conclude the assignment.

Begin at Charging Dock 1 and retrieve a pallet containing fifteen sealed nutrient canisters intended for the seasonal crop rotation program. Your first stop is Fertilizer Distribution Shed A, where you must deliver five of the nutrient canisters and wait until the distribution manager signals that each canister has been logged into their inventory system. Once this verification is received, continue to Storage Silo 6 and deposit the next five canisters, pausing there for three minutes to give the silo operator adequate time to inspect the seals and transfer the contents. With ten canisters delivered, transport the remaining five canisters to Agrochemical Depot West, but only proceed with the offload after you have received confirmation—either at Shed A or Silo 6—that all previous deposits are complete and acknowledged. Wait at the depot until all five canisters have been individually removed by the depot technician. After all deliveries are completed and confirmed at each location, travel immediately to the Vehicle Wash Station and remain stationary for nine minutes while automated cleaning cycles remove field residue from your chassis before ending the task sequence.

object.description: inventory logging signal for 5 nutrient canisters

instruction: Start at the Main Equipment Shed and wait until three replacement drive belts are ready for pickup. Once the drive belts are secured, travel to Conveyor Belt Station A and deliver one replacement drive belt, waiting until maintenance staff confirm complete removal of the belt before proceeding. Next, bring another replacement drive belt to Conveyor Belt Station B; after delivering and waiting for the crew at Station B to finish removing the belt, continue immediately to Conveyor Belt Station C with the final replacement drive belt, and remain at Station C for six minutes while the repair process is underway—even if the belt is taken sooner. After all stations have received their designated replacement drive belts and all required waiting periods have elapsed, return to the Main Equipment Shed to await your next set of assignments.

Begin at Storage Depot West and collect nine fertilizer bags labeled 'Spring Mix 2024' for distribution. Travel first to Greenhouse 1, and deliver three fertilizer bags; remain at Greenhouse 1 until all three bags are unloaded by the horticulture staff. After the fertilizer has been confirmed as received, continue to Orchard Block C, deliver another three fertilizer bags, and wait for five minutes to allow the orchard supervisor to inspect the bags for moisture or damage. Once inspection approval is received at Orchard Block C, proceed to Vegetable Plot E and deliver all remaining fertilizer bags, which should be three, ensuring equal allocation across the outer planting beds. After the final delivery at Vegetable Plot E, wait for the area manager to remove the delivery slip from the robot, then return to Storage Depot West and stand by for the next set of instructions.

Start by traveling to Fertilizer Silo 2 and request a load of fourteen bags of nitrate fertilizer, verifying each bag is secured and ready for transit before departing. Transport the fertilizer in batches, first carrying six bags to Wheat Field 7 and remain there until all six bags have been removed by the field crew. After the delivery at Wheat Field 7, return to Fertilizer Silo 2, then take four bags to Corn Plot 3, again waiting for the farm staff to unload each bag before leaving. For the final trip, retrieve the remaining four bags still at Fertilizer Silo 2 and deliver them to Orchard Lane 1. Upon arrival, wait for confirmation that all four bags have been removed, then remain at Orchard Lane 1 for an additional five minutes so the orchard workers can disperse the fertilizer before you leave. Finally, once the waiting period at Orchard Lane 1 is complete, return to Fertilizer Silo 2 and signal that your delivery task cycle has concluded.

Begin at the Seed Storage Facility and collect a batch of 17 pesticide cartridges. Proceed first to Orchard Block A and deliver 6 cartridges, waiting until the on-site staff signal that the prior pesticide tanks have been fully emptied before offloading. Next, continue to Vineyard Hilltop, where you must deposit 5 more cartridges; if Vineyard Hilltop has not yet removed their spent cartridges, wait at that location for 10 minutes before reattempting the drop-off. For the final 6 cartridges, split them evenly by delivering 3 to the Berry Patch Outpost and 3 to Greenhouse Annex; ensure that each site is visited in any order, but only unload cartridges at each location after confirming the staff have prepared the pesticide sprayers to receive new supplies. After all pesticide cartridges have been distributed according to these requirements, return directly to the Seed Storage Facility and remain near the entry dock until new transport tasks are issued.

Begin your route at the Harvest Loading Dock and collect a total of eleven crates of fresh produce and two drums of cleaning solution. First, deliver five crates of fresh produce to Retail Distribution Bay 1, waiting until the receiving clerk has confirmed all five crates have been unloaded before continuing. Afterward, bring four crates to Retail Distribution Bay 2, where you must remain until you receive removal confirmation from the bay supervisor. Proceed next to Retail Distribution Bay 3 with the last two crates, pausing on site until the unloading has been verified by staff. Once all produce crate deliveries are complete, head to Packaging Zone Alpha and drop off both drums of cleaning solution; stay on site for four minutes to allow the staff to sanitize their equipment before you are cleared to leave. Only after both cleaning drums have been removed and the wait is over, return to the Harvest Loading Dock and standby for further orders.

Start your mission at Materials Depot Bravo by collecting seven sealed chemical sampling kits designated for soil quality checks. Proceed first to Orchard Plot X and deliver two chemical sampling kits, but wait until a field technician confirms the correct soil area has been identified before allowing the transfer to occur. After successful handover at Orchard Plot X, continue to Vineyard Lot Z to distribute three additional chemical sampling kits; remain at Vineyard Lot Z for four minutes following delivery to enable initial sample processing before departing. Deliver the final two chemical sampling kits to Crop Research Plot Q, but only if a technician at Vineyard Lot Z has already completed processing, and upon arrival at Crop Research Plot Q, wait for explicit confirmation that the kit payload has been fully removed before leaving the area. Once all chemical sampling kits have been delivered and every required confirmation period and wait is observed, return directly to Materials Depot Bravo to complete your mission, ensuring your storage is empty before reporting task completion.

Begin at the Central Storage Dock and collect a batch of nine sealed produce crates. Your task is to distribute the crates as follows: deliver three crates to Cold Storage Unit 1, three crates to Cold Storage Unit 2, and the remaining three crates to Cold Storage Unit 3, ensuring that each unit receives an equal number. For each cold storage unit, wait until the site attendant confirms that the previous crate drop-off has been processed before continuing to the next delivery at that location. After all nine crates have been delivered and verified at their destinations, proceed to the Quality Inspection Area. Once you arrive at the Quality Inspection Area, remain stationed there for eight minutes to allow inspectors to finalize their intake procedures before returning to the Central Storage Dock for your next assignment.

Begin by proceeding to the Seed Storage Facility at the southern end of the farm and collect fifteen sealed seed crates for spring planting distribution. Deliver five seed crates to Field Plot A by the irrigation pump and wait until local crew members confirm the removal of every crate before leaving; if confirmation is not received within three minutes, remain at Field Plot A until explicit notification is given. After successful transfer at Field Plot A, bring another five seed crates to Greenhouse Complex 3, but do not depart until a three-minute period has elapsed to allow the greenhouse staff to complete their intake inventory. Only after both Field Plot A and Greenhouse Complex 3 have accepted their allocations, transport the remaining five seed crates to Storage Shed West and wait for the shed supervisor to declare all crates have been offloaded. Once all deliveries are complete, return directly to the Seed Storage Facility and remain stationary for five minutes to allow the farm manager to complete a distribution audit before concluding your shift.

Afterward, travel to Field Charlie and deliver another three bags, remaining onsite until a field technician retrieves them. Once all fertilizer bags have been distributed and confirmed received at each location, drive to the Equipment Refueling Station and wait for sixty seconds before powering down to complete your route.

instruction: Begin at Packing Station Alpha and collect twenty-four sealed cases of bottled apple juice. Proceed to Loading Dock 1 and deliver eight cases to Dock Worker Team A; wait for Dock Worker Team A to confirm that all eight cases are removed before continuing. Afterwards, drive to Loading Dock 2 and deliver another eight cases, again waiting until Dock Worker Team B has fully unloaded the cases into the cold storage container. Finally, navigate to Loading Dock 3 to deliver the remaining eight cases to Dock Worker Team C; if there are any unexpected leftover cases due to discrepancy, allocate those equally to Loading Dock 1 and to Dock 2, but ensure no dock receives more than nine total. Once all deliveries are confirmed as complete and the last case is removed, wait for six minutes at Loading Dock 3 to allow staff to sanitize the unloading area, and then return to Packing Station Alpha for your next assignment.

instruction: Begin your route at Maintenance Hub C, where you will collect six diagnostic toolkits designated for use across the farm's equipment. Distribute the toolkits by delivering two each to Tractor Garage North, Combine Harvester Bay, and Sprayer Dock South, ensuring that in the event of an uneven toolkit count, Sprayer Dock South receives the additional unit if any remain. After each drop-off, pause for two minutes at the respective location, allowing on-site mechanics time to inspect and verify the delivery of toolkits before moving on to the next stop. Once all toolkits have been distributed and verified, return to Maintenance Hub C, but only depart from Sprayer Dock South if you confirm that all toolkits have been removed and signed off by the dock supervisor—this sign-off is required before the return journey. Upon arrival back at Maintenance Hub C, remain at the designated standby area for a five-minute interval in case further dispatches become necessary.
