instruction: Begin at Maintenance Bay 1 and collect a total of fifteen spare hydraulic hoses designated for three different repair sites: Repair Site Alpha, Field Equipment Shed Bravo, and Tractor Garage Zulu. Deliver five hydraulic hoses to Repair Site Alpha first, and wait at the site until the on-site technician has finished removing all five hoses from the robot before proceeding. After this, continue to Field Equipment Shed Bravo and deposit another five hoses there; remain at the shed for a minimum of six minutes to allow the maintenance crew to inspect and confirm the hose delivery. Once the pause at Field Equipment Shed Bravo is complete, transport the final batch of five hydraulic hoses to Tractor Garage Zulu. Do not leave Tractor Garage Zulu until the supervisor notifies that the hoses have been fully transferred. Only after all fifteen hoses are delivered and confirmation has been received at all sites, return empty to Maintenance Bay 1 to await further dispatch instructions.

Begin at the Central Storage Hall and collect a total of 29 bags of fertilizer, ensuring each bag is loaded securely for transport. Proceed to distribute these bags among Orchard Plot East, Orchard Plot West, and Orchard Plot South, allocating 10 bags each to Orchard Plot East and Orchard Plot West, and delivering the remaining 9 bags to Orchard Plot South so that all fertilizer bags are utilized. At each orchard plot, after unloading the assigned fertilizer bags, wait 6 minutes at that location to allow the agricultural staff to perform quality inspections on the delivery before moving on to the next plot. Once every bag of fertilizer has been successfully offloaded and all inspection periods have elapsed at Orchard Plot East, Orchard Plot West, and Orchard Plot South, return to Central Storage Hall and await the supervisor’s confirmation for the next task cycle.

Initiate the operation by traveling to the Main Storage Hangar and wait until six maintenance tool kits are confirmed ready for dispatch. Once the tool kits are prepared, take three of the tool kits and proceed to Machine Bay Alpha, where you must wait for the technician to remove all three tool kits from your payload before continuing. Next, collect the remaining three tool kits from Main Storage Hangar and deliver two of these tool kits to Machine Bay Beta, awaiting confirmation that both have been removed by the assigned engineer. Finally, take the last remaining tool kit from Main Storage Hangar directly to Maintenance Workshop One, and after ensuring the last tool kit has been removed by the supervisor, wait at Maintenance Workshop One for five minutes to provide standby assistance for immediate follow-up tasks before returning to Main Storage Hangar for new instructions.

Start at the Maintenance Depot and wait for the technician to load a shipment of nine sealed engine filter cartridges onto the robot. Once the loading is complete, travel first to Machine Bay Delta to deliver three engine filter cartridges, staying at the bay until all three cartridges have been removed and logged by the maintenance crew. Afterward, proceed directly to Machine Bay Echo and distribute another three engine filter cartridges, remaining at the site for five minutes to allow the maintenance staff time to inspect and install the cartridges. Then, continue to Machine Bay Foxtrot with the remaining three engine filter cartridges and wait until the crew there has verified and removed the final batch. Only after all cartridges have been fully distributed and acknowledged at each machine bay should you conclude by returning to the Maintenance Depot for the next maintenance cycle briefing.

Begin at Storage Warehouse B and load twelve sealed crates labeled 'Component-X' intended for different production zones. Navigate first to Assembly Line 2 and leave five of the Component-X crates with the station supervisor; only after receiving confirmation that Assembly Line 2 has fully received all five crates, proceed to Quality Control Bay. At Quality Control Bay, offload another four Component-X crates, but pause for six minutes to allow the inspection protocols to run on those crates before moving forward. Once inspection at Quality Control Bay is cleared, deliver the final three Component-X crates to Final Packaging Dock, but if the dock is currently occupied, remain on standby at the dock until the area is free and then hand over all remaining crates. After each batch of Component-X crates is verified as received at its respective destination, and all specified wait times and conditions have been met, return directly to Storage Warehouse B and await further assignment.

Begin your task at Loading Dock 2 and collect eleven feed bags designated for livestock distribution. Transport three feed bags to Dairy Barn Alpha first, ensuring that you wait until the barn supervisor confirms all three bags have been unloaded before moving on. Next, deliver four feed bags to Equine Stable B and remain at Equine Stable B for 120 seconds after the last bag has been removed to allow staff to arrange storage. Once the wait at Equine Stable B is complete, bring another three feed bags to Poultry Coop 7 and only proceed once a designated poultry technician has signaled that these feed bags have been received. The eleventh feed bag must be delivered to Maintenance Bay C: you should not begin this final delivery until you have received acknowledgements from Dairy Barn Alpha, Equine Stable B, and Poultry Coop 7 confirming all their feed allocations have been fulfilled. After the final handoff at Maintenance Bay C, return to Loading Dock 2 and wait there for 60 seconds to complete post-distribution logging before ending your route.

instruction: Start your mission by proceeding to Raw Materials Depot Alpha and retrieving nine sealed seed containers intended for field deployment. Transport four seed containers to Irrigation Zone C and remain there until all four containers have been unloaded by field technicians. Once this is confirmed, bring three seed containers to Tractor Station 5; however, pause for two minutes before allowing removal so that calibration teams can prepare to receive the containers. After the two-minute wait, stay on site until tractor staff have completed the unloading process. Only after every seed container has been successfully distributed, with confirmation of receipt from each location, proceed to Recharging Bay South and remain there for seven minutes so that system diagnostics can be performed before commissioning new tasks.

instruction: Start at the Supply Dock and wait for the warehouse supervisor to load seven units of liquid fertilizer containers onto the robot. Once all containers are secured, proceed to Field Plot North and deliver two fertilizer containers, remaining onsite until the field manager confirms their removal. Head next to Crop Storage Shed 3 and drop off another two fertilizer containers, waiting for three minutes to allow the storage assistant to properly log the delivery. Carry the final three fertilizer containers to Orchard Block East; if the orchard supervisor is present, wait until all containers have been offloaded and documented before departing. Only after all fertilizer containers have been distributed and acknowledged at their respective destinations should you return to the Supply Dock to prepare for the next assignment.

Start at the Central Workshop and proceed to Loading Dock A to collect a shipment of twenty-four precision toolkits designated for scheduled equipment servicing. Begin delivery by making your way to Greenhouse 1 and offload seven toolkits, ensuring you wait on site until all units are confirmed received by the maintenance engineer. Following that, transport eight toolkits to the Irrigation Control Shed, but wait for six minutes upon arrival before unloading, allowing technicians to complete preparations for tool storage; only release the toolkits after this period has finished and an all-clear notification is provided. Next, bring five toolkits to Drone Charging Station West, waiting for a signal from the station supervisor before permitting removal. Carry the remaining four toolkits to Field Gate South, hand them over to the service technician immediately, and then wait for four minutes to accommodate safety checks in the area. Begin at the North Logistics Hub where you will pick up twelve sealed nutrient bags intended for three separate crop fields: Orchard Plot A, Hydroponic Greenhouse 5, and Open Field Delta. Split the payload by transporting four nutrient bags to each location in the following sequence: deliver to Orchard Plot A first, halting there for ten minutes to allow agricultural staff to calibrate dosing equipment before they remove any bags. Wait at Open Field Delta for five minutes to accommodate final quality checks, then return immediately to the North Logistics Hub and stand by there until the regional coordinator completes the return manifest review and gives you clearance for your next task.

Once all canisters are accounted for, make your way to Refueling Pad Z, and remain on-site for two minutes before returning to Maintenance Shed X for inspection and task closure.

Begin your run at Central Parts Storage by collecting nine hydraulic pump units destined for Manufacturing Line A, Manufacturing Line C, and the Quality Assurance Lab. Deliver three hydraulic pump units to Manufacturing Line A first, but only offload the units after confirming the station leader at Manufacturing Line A has acknowledged readiness. Once the three units are verified as received, continue to Manufacturing Line C and attempt to deliver another three pump units; however, if the Manufacturing Line C supervisor has not yet cleared space for new components, wait for four minutes before making the delivery. After the supervisor at Manufacturing Line C confirms receipt of all three pump units, proceed to the Quality Assurance Lab with the final three hydraulic pump units, and pause until each unit has been inspected and signed off by lab personnel prior to complete offloading. Start at the Grain Storage Facility and pick up a batch of twenty-four soil sampling kits, ensuring all kits are securely loaded before departure. Next, drive to Field Plot B to deliver another eight sampling kits, remaining stationary until the field supervisor finishes collecting all kits from your payload. Then, take the final seven kits to Field Plot C, where you must wait for ten minutes to allow the research team to prepare for unloading; only after the specified waiting period may you permit removal of the sampling kits by the research staff. Once all sampling kits have been distributed and acknowledged at each field location, return to the Grain Storage Facility for debriefing and maintenance checks.

Start at the Harvest Packing Shed and collect twelve sealed berry crates scheduled for dispatch to three distribution points: Downtown Market Pickup, Riverside Cold Storage, and the Eastern Farmstand. Allocate the berry crates so that Downtown Market Pickup receives five crates, Riverside Cold Storage receives four crates, and deliver the remaining three crates to the Eastern Farmstand, handling each transfer in sequence without skipping a destination. For each location, upon arrival, unload the assigned number of berry crates, then wait exactly three minutes to allow quality assurance personnel to inspect and clear the delivery before continuing to the next checkpoint. After all berry crates have been delivered and checked at their respective destinations, proceed directly to the Equipment Wash Bay and remain there until the sanitation team has removed all delivery totes from the payload compartment, signaling the end of your delivery cycle.

Begin your operation at Docking Station Echo and collect nine sealed nutrient additive containers designated for field deployment. Finally, deliver the last three additive containers to Greenhouse Theta, but if there are any containers left unremoved at the prior two destinations for any reason, adjust and deliver all remaining containers to Greenhouse Theta instead, waiting on-site until the greenhouse automation system signals that payload removal is complete. Once deliveries and removals at each location are confirmed, return directly to Docking Station Echo and stand by for ten minutes to allow software to update your deployment status before undertaking new assignments.

After completing deliveries to each orchard, travel to Maintenance Bay 1, wait for 8 minutes to allow technicians to inspect and recalibrate your dispensing equipment, and then return to the Bulk Fertilizer Shed for your next assignment. Once you have verified that all nine bags of fertilizer have been distributed and cleared from your load at their respective destinations, immediately return to Storage Warehouse 3 to complete your route.

Begin the operation at the Central Harvest Depot and collect nine sacks of harvested corn, ensuring each sack is clearly labeled for tracking. Transport and allocate three sacks of corn to each of the following storage silos in this sequence: Silo A, Silo B, and Silo C; if for some reason not all nine sacks can be distributed equally, deliver any leftover sacks to Silo C after the first two silos have received their full portion. After unloading the corn sacks at each silo, wait until the respective silo attendant verifies and signals that the goods have been properly stored, remaining on-site and waiting an additional five minutes for every delayed verification until the confirmation is received or a total of twenty minutes have elapsed. Once all confirmations from the silo attendants are complete, return to the Central Harvest Depot and remain stationed there for four minutes to allow for post-mission inspection before proceeding to Maintenance Station 1 for routine diagnostics. If cargo verification at any silo is not completed within twenty minutes, skip deliveries to all remaining silos and head directly to Maintenance Station 1, but document which silos received their deliveries.

instruction: Start your route at the Materials Storage Dock, where you must collect a set of fifteen maintenance toolkits earmarked for three assembly lines: Conveyor Belt Alpha, Robotic Arm Bay, and Quality Control Station Zeta. Deliver the toolkits in batches of five, beginning with Conveyor Belt Alpha, where you must wait for a supervisor sign-off before you can release the toolkits; if this sign-off is not completed within eight minutes, proceed to the next step regardless, leaving the toolkits in a holding area. Continue to Robotic Arm Bay with the next five toolkits, but pause there for exactly six minutes, allowing maintenance staff to remove any hazardous materials from the drop-off zone before you unload the toolkits. After successful drop-off or once the waiting period lapses, proceed to Quality Control Station Zeta with the last five toolkits, and wait at the bay until each toolkit has been individually checked and cleared by the station technician; only after this confirmation is received can you return to the Materials Storage Dock. At the end of your journey, remain at the dock for four minutes to allow the shift manager to verify your cargo manifest and log your completed delivery.

Begin at Fertilizer Depot Alpha and collect a load of sixteen nutrient pods designated for crop treatment. Divide the delivery as evenly as possible among three separate fields: transport and drop off five nutrient pods at Wheat Field North, six nutrient pods at Corn Field East, and the remaining five nutrient pods at Soybean Field South, ensuring that each field receives notification of the precise count. After delivering the nutrient pods to Wheat Field North, wait until the field supervisor transmits a digital confirmation of complete offloading before proceeding to Corn Field East; following the delivery at Corn Field East, remain onsite for a mandatory pause of eight minutes to permit the field crew to arrange storage, then complete the drop off at Soybean Field South, again requiring a supervisor’s confirmation. Only after all fields have accepted the correct quantities and acknowledged receipt should you return to Fertilizer Depot Alpha, confirming that the delivery manifest is marked complete.

instruction: Start at Equipment Maintenance Bay 2 and wait until the replacement hydraulic actuator is ready for transport. Once prepared, deliver the actuator to Harvester Unit Alpha located in Field Sector 6, then wait until the field technician confirms complete removal of the old actuator from Harvester Unit Alpha. Next, leave Field Sector 6 and travel to Workshop Storage Area C to collect two sealed lubricant canisters. Deliver one canister to Pump Station Delta and the other to Irrigation Substation Beta; at each site, wait for five minutes after arrival to allow staff to inspect the delivered canister before proceeding. After completing both lubricant deliveries, return to Equipment Maintenance Bay 2 and remain there until further task updates are provided.

instruction: Start at the Central Storage Depot and load nine fertilizer canisters, confirming each canister’s serial number as you do so. Initialize your deliveries by bringing four canisters to Wheat Field North, waiting at this location until farmhands have completely removed all four fertilizer canisters. After this drop-off, proceed to Orchard Supply Shed to deliver three more canisters, and once at the shed, wait exactly 7 minutes to allow the orchard staff to safely calibrate their equipment before you permit unloading of the canisters. The remaining two fertilizer canisters should be delivered to Vineyard Pumping Station, but only initiate this delivery after both the Wheat Field North and Orchard Supply Shed transfers are complete. At Vineyard Pumping Station, wait until a vineyard operator signals that the unloading is finalized. Once all canisters have been distributed and confirmed at every site, return directly to Central Storage Depot to report mission readiness for further assignment.

Start by picking up a load of thirty-six seed bags from the Central Supply Dock in the early morning, then proceed to Irrigation Plot Delta to deliver twelve seed bags; after delivering, wait until you receive confirmation from the plot supervisor that all bags have been unloaded before continuing. Next, bring the subsequent twelve seed bags to Greenhouse Station B, but before you offload the bags, wait for four minutes at the station to ensure its internal robot arms complete calibrations—only upon receiving a ready signal from Greenhouse Station B should you deliver the seed bags. Transport the final twelve seed bags to Orchard Lot Seven, and if you find that any of the locations have refused partial delivery due to storage issues, return any leftover seed bags directly to the Central Supply Dock. For each delivery—including potential returns—wait for local staff to physically remove all seed bags from your payload platform before moving to your next destination. Once all deliveries and possible returns have concluded, head back to the Central Supply Dock and stay there until further dispatch orders arrive.

object.description: ready signal from Greenhouse Station B

instruction: Begin at Seed Storage Facility Alpha and collect a total of nine temperature-sensitive seed crates, making sure that each crate is properly labeled for destination tracking. First, transport four seed crates to Greenhouse Block 3, and remain there until all four crates are safely offloaded and verified by the greenhouse supervisor; following this, wait an additional four minutes on site to allow the seeds to acclimate to the ambient environment before leaving. Next, deliver three seed crates to Nursery Shed Delta, waiting until the horticulture manager confirms the removal of all three crates. For the remaining two crates, proceed to Research Plot HQ and remain until both crates have been received and signed off by the research lead. Once all seed crates have been distributed and acknowledged at their respective locations, return to Seed Storage Facility Alpha and await further assignment instructions from logistics control.

Begin the operation at Fertilizer Loading Bay 1 and secure nine fertilizer sacks, which must be distributed to three different crop fields: North Cornfield, East Wheat Plot, and South Soy Enclosure. Allocate the sacks as evenly as possible by delivering three to each field; in any event where North Cornfield’s drop-off is unexpectedly delayed, remain at that location and only proceed once all three sacks have been acknowledged as fully unloaded. After leaving the Cornfield, transport three sacks to East Wheat Plot, pausing for six minutes once you arrive to allow irrigation equipment to clear the drop zone before unloading. For the final three sacks, proceed to South Soy Enclosure, but if any fertilizer sack takes over three minutes to be removed, skip that sack and return for it after completing your main circuit of deliveries. Upon finishing all deliveries or returning for missed items, navigate to Central Service Kiosk and wait for twelve minutes for the agricultural engineer to conduct a routine calibration, only departing for Fertilizer Loading Bay 1 after the calibration process is verified as complete.

Begin your route at the Central Harvest Warehouse, where you must wait for the batch of produce crates to be tagged and ready for distribution. Once the 11 produce crates are loaded, travel to Sorting Station East and deliver 3 crates, pausing at Sorting Station East until all crates are removed by the sorting crew. Proceed next to Packaging Shed South with 4 produce crates, but upon arrival, wait for 5 minutes to allow the packaging team to sanitize the receiving platform before beginning the offloading process, and then remain at Packaging Shed South until all 4 crates have been collected. The final 4 crates must be delivered to Cold Storage Dock West; after arriving at Cold Storage Dock West, wait until a dock worker signals that the chiller is operational before unloading the last 4 crates. Once all deliveries are confirmed and every crate has been accepted at its destination, return directly to the Central Harvest Warehouse and wait there for three minutes to allow a supervisor to check the cargo bay for any missed items before closing out your task.

Start your mission at Maintenance Hub 1, where you must confirm readiness of three replacement hydraulic filters and six battery modules for delivery to Assembly Line Red, Painting Booth Green, and Welding Station Blue. Collect all nine maintenance items and distribute them as follows: deliver two hydraulic filters and two battery modules to Assembly Line Red, three battery modules and one hydraulic filter to Painting Booth Green, and the remaining one hydraulic filter and one battery module to Welding Station Blue, ensuring each station receives its required components. After delivering to Assembly Line Red, remain on site until you receive confirmation from the assembly supervisor that the items have been fully installed and removed from your payload. Next, proceed to Painting Booth Green; upon arrival, wait precisely four minutes to allow the ventilation system to complete its cycle before presenting your maintenance items for transfer, and verify that the booth operator has accepted all components. For your last stop at Welding Station Blue, pause outside the bay until a technician notifies you that all previous equipment has been cleared, waiting up to six minutes if necessary, and, once granted permission, complete the handoff and confirm receipt. Upon finishing all deliveries and confirming all items have been properly handed over, return to Maintenance Hub 1 and wait in the diagnostics zone for seven minutes to complete a system self-check before you conclude your route.

Begin your operation at the Seed Storage Warehouse by retrieving a total of seven seed crates, then proceed to distribute these seed crates among Field Plot A, Field Plot B, and Field Plot C, ensuring that Field Plot A and Field Plot B each receive two crates and Field Plot C receives the remaining three crates to account for allocation remainders. After delivering each batch of seed crates to its respective plot, pause at the location and wait until the field supervisor at that plot confirms the crates have been unloaded before proceeding to the next plot. Once all seed crates have been distributed and receipt confirmed at each plot, travel immediately to the Equipment Cleaning Bay; upon arrival, wait for five minutes to allow cleaning staff to prepare decontamination of your cargo bay before beginning your return trip to the Seed Storage Warehouse, ensuring the cycle is complete and debris risk is managed between critical steps and locations.

Begin by retrieving twelve sealed crates of seed packets from Storage Warehouse A and ensure that the labels are verified for the correct planting season. Distribute the crates evenly among Field Plot North, Field Plot East, and Field Plot South, delivering four crates to each location; in the event of any excess crates due to a discrepancy in the count or labeling, ensure that the extra crates are first delivered to the Field Plot North as a priority destination. After each delivery at a field plot, wait until the designated plot manager has removed the delivered crates before proceeding to the next plot. Once all seed packet crates have been delivered and confirmed removed from the cargo hold, make your way to Central Tool Depot and remain there for eight minutes to allow for exterior cleaning of the robot. Upon completion of the cleaning process, return to Storage Warehouse A and stand by for further sampling or loading tasks as instructed by the operations team.

Begin at Loading Bay West in Factory Complex 2 to acquire a shipment of twelve electronic control modules, verifying that the modules have been properly secured before departure. After the modules are loaded, transport the full shipment directly to Testing Laboratory C; upon arrival, wait outside the laboratory until a technician has finished unloading all electronic control modules from your payload bay. Once the payload bay is cleared, proceed to Maintenance Shed Delta, where you must pause for exactly six minutes while the maintenance crew inspects your navigation sensors to ensure they’re functioning correctly following exposure to the electromagnetic fields near the laboratory. As soon as inspection is complete, return to Loading Bay West, retrieve eight empty packaging crates, and distribute them in batches of three, three, and two to Storage Area 5, Storage Area 6, and Storage Area 7 respectively, making independent drops at each location in sequence, and waiting at each storage area until the staff confirms successful removal before moving to the next. When all empty crates have been delivered, report back to the Factory Control Office for your next assignment.

instruction: Start at Loading Dock B and pick up a sealed crate containing twelve irrigation valve kits, each distinctly marked for its destination. Once this acknowledgment is received, proceed to Field Section Delta and offload four additional valve kits; after unloading, remain for three minutes to allow the installation team to verify model compatibility before moving on. For the final leg, travel to Field Section Gamma to deliver the last three valve kits and wait there until the maintenance lead removes a receipt tag from the empty crate. instruction: Begin at Grain Mill Loading Bay and collect a total of seven seed sample crates, verifying that all crates are properly secured before departure. Next, proceed to Test Field Alpha and deliver three of the seed sample crates to the research plot drop zone, then pause for five minutes to allow the research supervisor to inspect and sign off on the delivered crates; do not leave Test Field Alpha until this confirmation is obtained. Afterward, transport the remaining four seed sample crates directly to the Greenhouse Processing Station, but split these crates between the North Bench (receiving two crates) and the East Bench (receiving the other two), ensuring that each delivery is acknowledged by the greenhouse technician prior to finalizing the drop-offs. Once all seed sample crates have been delivered and verified at their respective locations, move to the Central Workshop Charging Station and remain there for ten minutes to recharge, resuming scheduled maintenance rounds only after this period has elapsed.

Start at the Central Equipment Depot and pick up twelve replacement battery modules labeled for urgent drone fleet servicing. Evenly distribute these battery modules by delivering four modules each to Charging Station East, Charging Station West, and the Field Drone Hangar; at each destination, wait until all modules handed over are confirmed as logged and cleared from your payload by the technical specialist. Upon completing the deliveries to all three destinations, proceed to the Outdoor Diagnostics Pad and remain there for eight minutes while system checks are performed on your navigation sensors by the diagnostics team. After the eight-minute waiting period and verification from the team, return to the Central Equipment Depot and await further deployment instructions, ensuring that no subsequent route is initiated until every previous module drop-off and diagnostics process has been fully concluded.

instruction: Begin by traveling to the Chemical Storage Depot to collect twelve pesticide canisters, ensuring you wait for the safety officer to confirm all canisters are properly sealed and safe for handling. Next, go to the North Field Spraying Station and deliver five of the pesticide canisters, and remain at the station until the field supervisor completes the unloading and signs off on the inventory. Proceed with the remaining seven canisters to the Western Orchard Block, unload four canisters there, and wait for orchard staff to remove them fully before leaving. Take the last three canisters to the Maintenance Bay, where you must wait until the technical team signals that all three canisters have been successfully offloaded and properly stored. After every delivery is finished and all confirmations are received, wait at the Maintenance Bay for 2 minutes to provide availability in case any immediate retrieval or adjustment is requested by the maintenance supervisor, then return to the Chemical Storage Depot and stand by for further deployment instructions.

Initiate your route at Loading Dock A, where you are to collect a batch of fifteen boxed fertilizer units once the dock foreman confirms that the entire batch is ready for loading. Your delivery sequence should begin at Orchard Plot 7, where you will transfer five fertilizer units and wait for a confirmation signal from the orchard supervisor indicating successful receipt. After completion at Orchard Plot 7, travel to Greenhouse North; if the greenhouse staff can take fewer than five fertilizer units due to storage constraints, deliver the maximum possible there and direct any undelivered units in your batch to Crop Field Delta. At each stop, wait an additional three minutes post-unloading to allow time for staff inventory checks and barcode scans to be completed before moving to your next destination. Upon finishing all deliveries and ensuring the entire consignment has been distributed, proceed back to Loading Dock A and stand by for further instructions.

Begin your task by moving to the Fertilizer Storage Shed to collect a batch of twenty-three fertilizer bags reserved for upcoming crop enhancement at three different farm plots. Once all twenty-three bags are loaded, head first to Field Delta's western entrance and drop off nine fertilizer bags for the irrigation team, only proceeding after verifying that every bag has been completely removed from your platform. Next, navigate to Field Echo's main service gate to deliver another seven fertilizer bags to the distribution crew, waiting until you receive their signal confirming the removal of the seven bags before departing. Allocate the final seven bags to the Greenhouse Supply Depot, but if the unloading process at the depot is not initiated within five minutes of arrival, wait an additional three minutes before contacting depot staff to prompt the unloading process. After the complete offload at each site and all verification steps are fulfilled, remain for six minutes at the Greenhouse Supply Depot to allow for a post-delivery inspection of your payload area, and then promptly travel back to the Fertilizer Storage Shed to complete your cycle.

Start at the Seed Storage Facility and wait for the batch of 17 fertilizer bags to be loaded onto your platform. Immediately proceed to Crop Field Alpha and deliver 5 fertilizer bags, waiting at Crop Field Alpha until the on-site crew has completely removed all 5 bags. After this delivery, continue to Crop Field Bravo with 6 fertilizer bags; upon arrival, pause for 4 minutes to allow irrigation equipment to be safely shut down before offloading the 6 bags, at which point you must also wait until all bags are removed by the field team. The remaining 6 fertilizer bags should be transported to Crop Field Charlie; upon reaching Crop Field Charlie, deliver all 6 bags evenly and do not leave until the last bag has been taken by the ground staff. Once every delivery has been successfully completed and all fertilizer bags have been offloaded at their respective fields, return promptly to the Seed Storage Facility and remain there for 2 minutes so a quality assurance inspector can verify that the cargo area is empty before you conclude your assignment.

Initiate the task by traveling to the Loading Dock and waiting until six sealed crates of fertilizer become ready for transfer. Once the crates are available, distribute them in a specific sequence: deliver two crates to Greenhouse 1, two crates to Tomato Plot B, and the remaining two crates to Orchard Shed 3, ensuring that no site receives more than two crates. After each delivery, wait for two minutes at the respective location to allow on-site sensors to confirm the receipt of the crates before continuing to the next destination. Following the final delivery at Orchard Shed 3, proceed directly to the Vehicle Charging Station, but remain there for exactly ten minutes to allow your battery systems to recharge sufficiently before initiating any subsequent operations, making sure not to break the sequence of crate deliveries and associated waiting periods at each stop.

Start your task at Dock 7 within the Processing Plant, and collect a batch of 22 sealed chemical drums labeled 'Batch CL-09'; make certain that these drums are securely loaded before proceeding to allocate them across Warehouse Alpha, Warehouse Bravo, and Packaging Area 2. Begin by delivering 7 chemical drums to Warehouse Alpha and wait for 5 minutes after arrival to ensure that the hazardous materials safety inspection is completed. Once Warehouse Alpha has received their allocation, transport the next 7 drums to Warehouse Bravo, and allow a waiting period of 3 minutes to accommodate inventory staff in conducting a reconciliation check. Proceed to Packaging Area 2 with the remaining 7 drums, but before unloading, wait for 6 minutes to allow the ventilation system to reach safe ambient levels, as confirmed by the area supervisor. In the event that there is one extra drum following distribution, deliver this drum directly to the Hazardous Waste Containment Bay and wait there for 4 minutes to supervise initial containment procedures before leaving the vicinity. After the last drum has been handled and all mandatory waiting intervals have elapsed, immediately travel to Vehicle Charging Station 3 and remain there until your onboard power level reaches full capacity, after which you may await your next assignment.

instruction: Start your task at the Fertilizer Depot, where you are to pick up a total of nine fertilizer sacks, carefully labeled for three different locations. Make your first delivery run by transporting three fertilizer sacks to Orchard Lot 5, waiting up to three minutes after arrival for the orchard manager's signal confirming that storage space has been cleared. Once accepted, return to the Fertilizer Depot to collect the next batch and deliver three fertilizer sacks to Vineyard Block 2, where you must wait for a minimum of four minutes to ensure the field crew is ready to receive the sacks and has donned proper safety gear. For the final batch, carry the remaining three fertilizer sacks to Crop Research Plot D, but only release the delivery after the research supervisor confirms all prior deliveries have been completed for the day at that location; continue waiting at Plot D if this confirmation is delayed. After the last sacks have been delivered and all wait periods have elapsed, proceed without delay to the Vehicle Charging Station for a scheduled battery recharge and await further deployment instructions.

Start at the Cargo Loading Dock with a shipment of fourteen seedling trays, each intended for greenhouse propagation. First, deliver five seedling trays to Greenhouse A, waiting at the unloading zone until all five trays are acknowledged and manually removed by the horticulture technician. Next, travel to Greenhouse B with another batch of five seedling trays, but only proceed with unloading once the greenhouse manager confirms that space in the receiving racks has been prepared; if confirmation is not received within three minutes, wait an additional two minutes before checking again. After both Greenhouse A and Greenhouse B have been restocked, take the remaining four seedling trays to the Propagation Laboratory, where you must wait exactly six minutes outside the laboratory entrance to allow the airflow system to complete a sterilization cycle before any trays are transferred. Once the laboratory environmental controls are cleared and the trays are successfully delivered to Propagation Laboratory staff, return directly to the Cargo Loading Dock and remain in position for the final sign-off by the logistics supervisor before concluding the operation.

instruction: Start at Maintenance Bay East and wait until ten new battery packs are loaded onto the robot. After all battery packs are secured, proceed to Solar Field Zone 1 and deliver three battery packs to Technician Group Alpha, waiting until all three battery packs have been removed and installation is confirmed. Once the transfer is complete, continue to Wind Turbine Array 4 and deliver another four battery packs, remaining at the site for three minutes to allow the engineering crew to inspect the shipment before removal. Take the remaining three battery packs to Pumping Station North; if Pumping Station North is running an active system flush, remain on standby and wait up to five minutes or until notified that the bay is accessible, then deliver and wait for the removal of all remaining battery packs. Upon successful drop-off at each site, return directly to Maintenance Bay East and wait for further servicing instructions from the lead technician.

Begin your route at the Seed Inventory Dock and collect a batch of 13 treated seed bags designated for distribution. Make your first stop at Greenhouse Alpha to deliver five seed bags, then proceed to Greenhouse Beta and provide four seed bags, ensuring staff at each greenhouse remove their allocation before you move to the next destination. The final four seed bags should be delivered to the Outdoor Test Plot, but only after waiting for six minutes at the entrance for the test plot supervisor to complete site preparation and confirm readiness for the drop-off. Once all deliveries are complete, travel to the Equipment Wash Station, wait there for three minutes during the mandated decontamination cycle, and finally return to the Seed Inventory Dock to finalize the transfer log with on-site personnel.

Initiate your route at Maintenance Bay 1 and pick up eight replacement solenoid valve kits, clearly labeled for greenhouse operations. Head first to Greenhouse Section A and deliver three valve kits, then wait for the technician to complete their installation check, which requires 7 minutes. After this confirmation, proceed to Greenhouse Section B and drop off another three valve kits; in this area, you must wait up to 10 minutes for the automated loader to finish removing the previous faulty components. Next, take the final two valve kits to Greenhouse Section C; before transferring them, wait until the site manager signals that the section’s irrigation system has been fully de-pressurized, which may take a while depending on workflow but is critical for safety—do not unload the valve kits until this is confirmed. Once all valve kits have been distributed and acknowledged at their destinations, return directly to Maintenance Bay 1 and stand by for further deployment instructions.

instruction: Begin at the main supply garage and collect four sealed toolkits intended for equipment maintenance throughout the facility. First, deliver one toolkit to Maintenance Bay Alpha and wait until the head technician confirms its receipt before proceeding. Once both toolkits have been offloaded and acknowledged by the crew at Maintenance Bay Beta, take the final remaining toolkit to the Remote Power Station on the western perimeter. instruction: Start at the Fertilizer Storage Depot and load a total of seventeen compost nutrient sacks onto your transport frame. Distribute the sacks as follows: deliver six sacks to the South Orchard Plot, five sacks to the Central Greenhouse, and the remaining six sacks to the North Vineyard Hill, making sure no location receives more or less than its allocated amount. At the Central Greenhouse, after you have arrived and unloaded the five sacks, wait for three minutes to allow the greenhouse operator to perform a quality check on the nutrient sacks before departing. For the North Vineyard Hill delivery, if the weather station near the drop-off point is reporting high humidity, pause operations for four minutes prior to unloading to prevent moisture exposure. Only after all assigned sacks have been correctly distributed to each intended destination and all required wait periods have elapsed should you return to the Fertilizer Storage Depot to complete your operational cycle.

Begin at Storage Locker Delta to collect six sealed replacement filters and a coolant diagnostic kit, then proceed to Engine Room B where the coolant diagnostic kit must be released; wait until confirmation is received from the maintenance crew that the diagnostic process has begun before continuing. Next, take the six sealed replacement filters to distribute evenly among Hydrogen Generator A, Diesel Backup Shed, and Solar Inverter Room, delivering two filters at each station in the specified order. At every delivery site, pause for three minutes to allow staff to remove and inspect the filters before proceeding to the next site. Once the last set of filters has been removed and inspected at the Solar Inverter Room, navigate to Quarantine Materials Bay, remaining there for five minutes before returning to Storage Locker Delta to await further assignments.

Start by proceeding to Loading Dock Alpha to prepare for the collection of a shipment containing sixteen boxed seedling trays earmarked for delivery to three separate destinations: Hydroponics Lab, Storage Shed Delta, and Plant Nursery Pavilion. Distribute the shipment by delivering seven seedling trays to Hydroponics Lab, five trays to Storage Shed Delta, and the remaining four trays to Plant Nursery Pavilion, ensuring no destination is missed, with the higher allocation going to the Hydroponics Lab as prioritized by the distribution order. For each stop, after you have arrived and prior to unloading, wait until the site supervisor at that location has signaled that their indoor climate controls are operational to ensure seedling safety; only then offload the designated number of trays. After departing each site, insert a 90-second pause before continuing to the next destination to allow the facility staff to complete initial inspections, and wait for confirmation that all trays have been successfully removed from your payload before proceeding. Once all seedling trays have been delivered and the corresponding confirmations received from each location, return to Loading Dock Alpha and remain parked at the loading bay for two minutes to allow for record reconciliation before ending the task.

Begin at the Central Farm Storage and await readiness of eight water-testing sample kits from the supply counter. Once all eight sample kits are ready, systematically distribute the kits across the various water bodies: deliver three kits to the North Irrigation Reservoir, three kits to the Southeast Lake, and the remaining two kits to the West Channel Outpost, making sure that every location receives its assigned quantity. At each water site, after placing the sample kits, wait five minutes to allow the site supervisor to confirm receipt before departing for the next destination. Following the completion of all deliveries, immediately return to the Central Farm Storage and wait there for fifteen minutes to provide any necessary handover briefing to the quality control engineer, ensuring all location-based drop-offs and site waiting periods are strictly followed in order.

Begin at the main warehouse and retrieve a pallet containing seventeen fertilizer bags. Transport the full pallet to Distribution Dock 1, then distribute the fertilizer bags among Greenhouse Alpha, Greenhouse Beta, and Greenhouse Gamma by delivering six bags to Greenhouse Alpha, six to Greenhouse Beta, and the remaining five to Greenhouse Gamma, ensuring that the odd bag is explicitly assigned to Greenhouse Gamma to handle the remainder. At each greenhouse, wait until the respective greenhouse supervisor has signaled that all delivered fertilizer bags have been offloaded before proceeding to the next destination. Once each fertilizer drop-off is confirmed complete and the pallet at the last greenhouse is empty, return directly to the main warehouse and await instructions from the inventory manager.

Distribute these canisters as follows: deliver three canisters to Irrigation Node West, two to Irrigation Node Central, and three to Irrigation Node East, making sure to deposit the remaining three canisters at Irrigation Node South, clearly handling any leftover units if the total cannot be split evenly. instruction: Begin at Storage Depot Alpha and verify the availability of eight sealed fertilizer canisters. Once all canisters are ready, collect them and proceed to Field South. Deposit three fertilizer canisters at Field South and remain on site until the field supervisor has confirmed removal of each canister. After completion, head to Orchard East with three additional canisters and wait there for two minutes to allow the irrigation team to prepare the distribution equipment before handing over the fertilizer, making certain that each transfer is acknowledged. Deliver the remaining two canisters to Greenhouse Gamma, but only perform the canister handoff if confirmation has been received that the previous drop-offs at both Field South and Orchard East were successfully completed. Stay at Greenhouse Gamma until the greenhouse manager reports that all canisters have been safely stored. Finally, return to Storage Depot Alpha and remain for three minutes to allow for inventory reconciliation before proceeding with further tasks.

Load eight labeled coolant canisters from the Parts Storage Room and proceed directly to Engine Test Station Alpha, where you must unload three coolant canisters and wait until engineering staff finish connecting all three to the test rigs. Once staff confirm all canisters are in use, continue to the Central Maintenance Hub with the remaining five coolant canisters, depositing four of them and remaining at the hub for three minutes so maintenance personnel can initiate their system checks. After receiving clearance from the hub supervisor, deliver the last coolant canister to Generator Bay Two, waiting there until the generator operator signals the canister has been installed. Upon successful completion of all deliveries and verifications, return to the Parts Storage Room to stand by for your next assignment.

Start your mission at Warehouse Gate 2, where you will load fifteen water purification cartridges onto the transport sled. Deliver five cartridges to Irrigation Pumping Station West, five to Irrigation Pumping Station East, and allocate the remaining five in single units to each of the following stations—Field Hydration Node 1, Node 2, Node 3, Node 4, and Node 5—ensuring each location receives exactly one cartridge. Once you have completed the drop-offs at both Pumping Stations, pause for six minutes at Pumping Station East to allow operators to synchronize system settings and confirm cartridge installation. Only after receiving this confirmation should you proceed with deliveries to the Field Hydration Nodes. After distributing cartridges to all destinations and acknowledging the last delivery at Node 5 with the site manager, return to Warehouse Gate 2, but remain outside the entry bay for an additional four minutes if you encountered any issues with cartridge access or delayed confirmations along your route, to allow for further maintenance checks before concluding your shift.

Begin by going to the Main Fertilizer Depot to load twelve fertilizer canisters, then proceed to deliver the fertilizer canisters in batches among the three designated zones: deliver five canisters to Orchard West, four canisters to Vineyard North, and three canisters to Greenhouse Central. For each location, wait until the grounds crew at that site confirms that all fertilizer canisters have been removed before departing to the next zone. Once the final delivery is accepted in Greenhouse Central, remain on site for 10 minutes to allow for system calibration and air quality checks; only after completing this wait period should you return to the Main Fertilizer Depot. If any destination is inaccessible and canisters remain undelivered, return directly to the Main Fertilizer Depot with the undelivered canisters before ending your shift.

Start at the Central Supply Depot and collect a shipment of nine nutrient sensor modules earmarked for distribution across three experimental plots. Travel first to Plot North and deliver three sensor modules, remaining at this location for four minutes while agronomy staff install and activate each module. Proceed next to Plot East with another three modules for delivery, again pausing for four minutes to support installation activities as directed by the field team. Bring the remaining three modules to Plot South; after completing the final transfer, wait for two more minutes to allow the research team to calibrate the deployed sensors. Once the waiting period in Plot South concludes, immediately return to the Central Supply Depot and await confirmation from the project coordinator that all modules have passed activation tests before powering down for maintenance.

Start at Maintenance Bay Delta and wait until two palletized seed dispensers are declared ready for transport by the equipment technician. Upon confirmation of readiness, move both seed dispensers to the Harvesting Equipment Garage. Once at the garage, unload one seed dispenser and remain on site until the garage supervisor signs off that the dispenser is properly installed. Transport the remaining seed dispenser to Field Plot 7A, then pause for three minutes before entering the field station to give the local crew time to finish previous equipment setup. After the three-minute waiting period, deliver the seed dispenser to Field Plot 7A and wait until the planting machinery operator confirms the delivery is complete. Only after both seed dispensers have been received and acknowledged at their separate destinations should you proceed to return to Maintenance Bay Delta, where you will remain for seven minutes to allow the maintenance chief to review your transport log before you are cleared for your next assignment.

Start at the Maintenance Garage and collect nine containers of lubricant fluid, ensuring each container is securely prepared for transit. Next, proceed to Pumping Station West and deliver three containers directly to the supply bench, where you must wait to confirm all three containers have been removed by the maintenance team before moving forward. After this confirmation, travel to Field Machine Shed Bravo to drop off another three containers at the machinery servicing area; remain on-site until these are acknowledged as fully unloaded by the equipment supervisor. The final three remaining containers should then be transported to Wind Turbine Base Station, where you will wait for the turbine engineer to validate complete removal before leaving. Once all containers have been distributed and removal confirmations received at each of the three destinations, return to the Maintenance Garage and remain idle for a total of five minutes so garage staff can perform intake checks on your internal storage compartments before new tasks are assigned.

instruction.location: supply bench at Pumping Station West
machinery servicing area at Field Machine Shed Bravo

instruction: Begin your assignment at the Central Storage Bay by retrieving a pallet containing twenty-one greenhouse monitoring sensors bound for three separate research sites. Your first destination should be Field Lab West, where you will deliver eight sensors and stay until the field engineer physically removes each sensor from the pallet and provides verbal confirmation. Following this, proceed directly to Nursery Station South to drop off seven of the remaining sensors, but before moving on to the final site, wait at Nursery Station South for five minutes to allow the technical staff to perform initial diagnostics on the inventory. After the waiting period ends and all seven sensors have been received, transport the final six sensors to Crop Trials Facility East; at this location, wait until all sensors have been fully removed from the pallet and the facility manager authorizes your departure. Only after all sensors are distributed, acknowledgments are obtained, and time requirements are met at each stop, return to the Central Storage Bay to complete your delivery cycle.

Starting at Loading Bay 3, acquire twelve seedling trays destined for this morning’s greenhouse allocation. Your first stop is Greenhouse A, where you are to deliver five seedling trays to the horticulture supervisor; stay onsite until each tray has been removed for inspection. Once Greenhouse A’s delivery is complete, navigate to Greenhouse B and provide four seedling trays to the nursery technician—after arrival, remain idle for four minutes to allow climate stabilization in the receiving area before payload transfer, then confirm removal of all trays. The last three seedling trays are allocated to Greenhouse C; proceed there, deliver the trays, and remain at Greenhouse C for six minutes to accommodate any urgent planting instructions from the agronomy staff. After all seedling trays are distributed, and each waiting period and confirmation step has been fulfilled, return directly to Loading Bay 3 to await your next horticultural task.

Start by making your way to Grain Processing Dock 3 to collect a bundle containing seventeen precision-weigh crop samples needed for laboratory testing. After securing the bundle, travel directly to Agricultural Lab Entrance and deliver the first six crop samples, then pause at the lab’s intake desk and remain there for four minutes to enable technicians to log and process the incoming samples. Following this wait, proceed to Storage Room Alpha with the remaining eleven samples, where you will split them by depositing five samples into Locker A and six samples into Locker B, ensuring each drop is completed before proceeding to the next. Once all samples are stored in their respective lockers, return to Grain Processing Dock 3 to confirm with the dock supervisor that the empty bundle has been returned properly, then remain at the dock for six minutes to accommodate potential transport container checks before concluding your shift.

Start your task at Seed Warehouse 2 and wait for the inventory controller to confirm that a total of 19 seed supply crates are prepared and secured for transfer. Once all crates are loaded, proceed directly to Crop Test Plot Alpha, where you are to offload 6 seed supply crates, remaining at Crop Test Plot Alpha until a field technician has recorded and removed each crate individually. Immediately after, go to Precision Planter Station, unload 7 seed supply crates, and wait an additional four minutes to allow staff to verify the planter compatibility of each crate before leaving the site. Transport the remaining 6 seed supply crates to Nursery Expansion Area; upon your arrival, deliver 4 seed supply crates straightaway and then wait until the nursery manager verifies storage space is available before offloading the final 2 crates. If at any destination a staff member refuses a crate due to discrepancy or storage limitation, reroute any undelivered crates to Seed Warehouse 2, unload them there, and inform the inventory controller. Once all seed supply crates are distributed or returned and each site’s staff completes their respective intake process, return to Seed Warehouse 2 and await further deployment orders.

Start your task at Storage Shed Alpha, where you will collect a set of eight spare hydraulic pumps scheduled for distribution to three separate repair stations: Workshop Delta, Equipment Ramp Bravo, and Field Outpost Echo. Distribute the pumps by delivering three to Workshop Delta, three to Equipment Ramp Bravo, and the remaining two to Field Outpost Echo, ensuring that Field Outpost Echo receives the smaller share if the pumps cannot be distributed evenly. After delivering each batch of pumps, remain on-site for four minutes to provide maintenance crews adequate time to unload and log receipt before departing to the next station. However, only proceed to Field Outpost Echo after all six pumps have been confirmed as removed from both Workshop Delta and Equipment Ramp Bravo; if pumping unloading at either site is delayed, extend your waiting period in increments of two minutes until notification of completion is received, then continue. After your final delivery at Field Outpost Echo is complete and all pumps have been recorded as received, return to Storage Shed Alpha and stay at the staging area for eight minutes, awaiting potential urgent redeployment instructions from dispatch.

Start at the Western Loading Dock and collect six drums of liquid fertilizer, making sure each drum is securely fastened for transit. Proceed to Distribution Silo 7 and unload two fertilizer drums, remaining until the site supervisor confirms both have been received and logged. Next, travel to Crop Plot Beta to deliver three fertilizer drums, waiting on site until the field manager finishes inspecting and removing all three drums from the robot. After completing these handoffs, wait for six minutes at Crop Plot Beta to monitor for potential leakage or immediate repurposing needs. Finally, transport the last remaining drum to Maintenance Bay Gamma, where you must wait until the maintenance crew finishes removing the drum for equipment servicing before returning to the Western Loading Dock for debrief and refueling.

Start at the Seed Preparation Shed and acquire nine fertilizer cartridges slated for distribution. Travel straight to Field Sector West, where you will deliver three fertilizer cartridges, waiting on-site until the agronomist has confirmed their receipt and documented the delivery. Once acknowledged, continue to Crop Plot South and offload another three fertilizer cartridges; however, after placing these cartridges, remain at Crop Plot South for eight minutes to allow soil sensors to recalibrate before proceeding. Afterwards, make your way to the Center Pivot Control Hub with the last three fertilizer cartridges, and only deliver these remaining cartridges once the irrigation system engineer signals that all control valves have been locked down. As soon as every cartridge has been successfully distributed and location-specific confirmations obtained, return to the Seed Preparation Shed without delay to log final status updates.

object.description: delivery confirmation and documentation by agronomist
all control valves locked down by irrigation system engineer

instruction: Begin at the Packing Dock and collect nine harvested produce crates scheduled for distribution. First, transport three crates to Cold Storage Unit 1, but do not unload until refrigeration staff are present and signal readiness for payload removal. After all three crates have been removed at Cold Storage Unit 1, wait for two minutes on-site to verify that storage conditions are optimal before resuming. Next, shuttle another three crates to Cold Storage Unit 2; after you arrive, wait for five minutes to allow personnel to sanitize the intake area prior to crate handoff, then proceed with the delivery once staff remove the crates. Deliver the final three crates to Cold Storage Unit 3, but if the intake area is occupied, remain in position and attempt delivery only after receiving clearance from the logistics supervisor. Once every crate has been delivered and the removals at all three Cold Storage Units are fully confirmed, return immediately to the Packing Dock and report the successful completion of produce distribution.

Start by proceeding to Harvest Warehouse A to collect a total of eleven sealed seed crates allocated for rotation between Greenhouse Zone East, Planting Plot North, and Orchard Boundary West. First, deliver four seed crates to Greenhouse Zone East, waiting until the staff operator has finished transferring all four crates from the robot before continuing. Next, bring another four seed crates to Planting Plot North and pause for exactly 5 minutes at the edge of the plot, giving the planting crew enough time to prepare the equipment for immediate seeding. After the waiting period, deliver the crates and ensure the planting supervisor signals completion of the transfer before departing. Finally, transport the remaining three seed crates to Orchard Boundary West; explicitly wait at this location until all three crates have been offloaded and an orchard manager has acknowledged the delivery. With all eleven seed crates distributed and confirmations received at each destination, return to Harvest Warehouse A to await instructions for your next assignment.

instruction.location: Planting Plot North - edge of the plot
Planting Plot North - edge of the plot
Planting Plot North - edge of the plot

instruction: Begin at Maintenance Facility Central, where you will retrieve nine diagnostic toolkits scheduled for inspection rounds across Engine Testing Bay 1, Automated Assembly Line 3, and Robotics Calibration Area 2. First, carry three diagnostic toolkits to Engine Testing Bay 1, remaining there until an engine technician signals that all three toolkits have been collected and the initial maintenance check completed. Once this handover is finalized, continue by transporting another three toolkits to Automated Assembly Line 3; immediately upon arrival, wait for six minutes, allowing the assembly team to halt the machinery for safe transfer. When the six-minute interval has elapsed and the team indicates readiness, deliver the toolkits and proceed. For the remaining three diagnostic toolkits, head to Robotics Calibration Area 2, but only do this once you receive confirmation that Automated Assembly Line 3 has finished receiving their batch. Should there be any delay in this confirmation, remain at Automated Assembly Line 3 until the notification comes through. At Robotics Calibration Area 2, stay until all three toolkits are successfully offloaded and acknowledged by a calibration supervisor. Following the verified completion of all diagnostic toolkit deliveries, return to Maintenance Facility Central and stand by for subsequent duties.

Start by moving to the Maintenance Bay to collect three distinct diagnostic kits labeled Kit A, Kit B, and Kit C, confirming with the bay supervisor that each kit is properly calibrated before departure. Transport Kit A directly to Vehicle Dock 2 and remain there for three minutes to enable the maintenance crew to offload and verify Kit A. After Kit A has been removed, travel to Harvest Field 7 with Kit B, but do not begin unloading until the field monitoring team confirms via radio that the equipment zone is cleared, which may involve a waiting period on site. Once Kit B is successfully delivered and acknowledged, proceed with Kit C to Control Room Delta; however, if the release of Kit C is delayed due to ongoing system checks at Control Room Delta, wait at the entrance for up to five minutes before attempting to complete the handover. Once all three diagnostic kits have been delivered and each drop-off procedure including any conditional waits is complete, finish the sequence by returning to the Maintenance Bay and await further deployment orders from technical staff.

At Maintenance Bay 2, pick up a total of nine replacement water pumps, each designated for a different greenhouse system. Begin by delivering three water pumps to Hydroponics Greenhouse West; if the loading bay there is unavailable upon your arrival, wait at the staging area until the previous maintenance operation is complete before transferring the pumps. After delivery to Hydroponics Greenhouse West is confirmed by the system technician, proceed to Soil Greenhouse North and supply another three water pumps; be sure to remain at Soil Greenhouse North for exactly ten minutes to allow the maintenance crew to inspect each pump individually. Once the Soil Greenhouse North delivery is finalized, transport the remaining three water pumps to Glasshouse Complex East, but only proceed with unloading if all prior pump drop-offs have been signed for. Should any water pumps be reported as faulty during the transfer process, redistribute the functional pumps so that each location receives at least two; allocate any extra pump to the Glasshouse Complex East. After completion of all water pump deliveries, return immediately to Maintenance Bay 2, where you must await a verification scan lasting five minutes before initiating new assignments.

object.description: replacement water pump designated for greenhouse system
all prior pump drop-offs signed for

instruction: Start your operation by picking up twelve sacks of seed potatoes from the Storage Barn near the southern boundary. Distribute these twelve sacks as evenly as possible between Field Section 1, Field Section 2, and Field Section 3 by delivering four sacks to each section in consecutive order. For each delivery, remain at the respective field section until a field technician signals that all sacks have been unloaded and accounted for before proceeding to the next section. Once all twelve sacks have been successfully delivered and acknowledged, proceed directly to the Equipment Cleaning Station located adjacent to the Storage Barn and wait for three minutes to complete the mandatory decontamination process prior to starting a new delivery job.

instruction.location: Storage Barn near the southern boundary
Storage Barn near the southern boundary
Equipment Cleaning Station located adjacent to the Storage Barn
Equipment Cleaning Station located adjacent to the Storage Barn

instruction: Begin the task at Loading Bay B, where six engine maintenance kits are awaiting dispatch. Collect the full set of engine maintenance kits and transport them to Maintenance Hangar 3, but before unloading, pause for seven minutes to allow the hangar supervisor to prepare the inspection zone. Once the wait is over, deliver three engine maintenance kits to Maintenance Hangar 3, ensuring the supervisor confirms readiness before unloading each kit. Then, continue with the remaining three engine maintenance kits to Workshop Delta; upon arrival, wait for the workshop crew to signal that their bay is clear before offloading all three kits. If, during either drop-off, any maintenance kit cannot be accepted due to space limitations or inspection issues, reroute those kits to Spare Parts Storage, unload them there, and remain onsite until a storage technician logs all redirected kits. Only after successful confirmation from all receiving locations and storage staff should you return to Loading Bay B and await your next assignment.

Begin the operation at Dockside Loading Bay Bravo, where you must wait for a shipment of 14 sealed nutrient canisters to be prepared and verified for safe handling. Once the shipment is ready, distribute the nutrient canisters among Greenhouse Section 1, Greenhouse Section 2, and Processing Lab Gamma, allocating 5 canisters each to Section 1 and Section 2, while sending the remaining 4 canisters to Processing Lab Gamma. Proceed first to Greenhouse Section 1 with 5 canisters, and after ensuring that all canisters have been unloaded and officially acknowledged by the greenhouse supervisor, move to Greenhouse Section 2 to deliver the next set of 5 canisters, waiting until the Section 2 technician confirms complete removal. Following both deliveries, continue to Processing Lab Gamma with the remaining 4 canisters and await the payload removal confirmation from the lab coordinator. After all canisters have been distributed, remain in Processing Lab Gamma for a duration of 10 minutes to assist in monitoring initial processing performance; if any issues are reported during this period, notify Dockside Loading Bay Bravo for further instructions before returning, otherwise return directly to Dockside Loading Bay Bravo at the end of the monitoring interval to conclude the task.

Start at Equipment Charging Station Alpha and collect three replacement battery modules for delivery. Proceed first to Greenhouse Two and install one battery module, then wait for two minutes while the greenhouse technician performs calibration tests before proceeding. After the wait, continue to Irrigation Control Shed, where you will only deliver a battery module if the current module has been fully removed by the maintenance crew; if the old module has not yet been removed, remain at the Irrigation Control Shed until the maintenance crew finishes, then complete the delivery. The third battery module must be transported to Field Drone Depot, but if Field Drone Depot is undergoing drone launch operations, wait for launch completion before accessing the payload bay and unloading the module. Once all three battery modules have been delivered and each location's staff has confirmed successful installation, return to Equipment Charging Station Alpha to await further tasks.

Commence operations at Central Storage Depot 5 and acquire eighteen processed grain sacks flagged for dispatch. First, navigate to Granary Station Omega and distribute seven grain sacks, staying on site until the inventory manager finishes removing each sack and provides a completion signal. Once this transfer is verified, proceed to Distribution Hub South and deliver another six grain sacks, but do not begin unloading at Distribution Hub South until you receive confirmation that their conveyor system is active and able to receive the load. After these sacks have been fully removed, remain at Distribution Hub South for a mandatory waiting period of five minutes, allowing hub staff to organize inventory and clean the transfer aisle. Next, transport the remaining five grain sacks to Bakery Complex West; only initiate the transfer here if both previous delivery locations acknowledge receipt of their full allocations, and pause at Bakery Complex West until every sack is logged by the bakery inventory system. If, during any stage, a grain sack is flagged as damaged, reallocate one extra undamaged sack to the location with the fewest sacks remaining, ensuring no location receives fewer than five sacks total. After all sacks reach their intended destinations and clearance is given by each facility supervisor, return to Central Storage Depot 5 for final check-in.
