instruction: Begin at the Central Fertilizer Depot and collect a total of sixteen bags of granular fertilizer, ensuring that all bags are accounted for before departure. Once the full load is secured, make your way to Field Plot East and deliver five fertilizer bags, waiting until the field crew has finished unloading and confirmed they are ready for application. After this, travel to Field Plot South to offload another set of five fertilizer bags, but only proceed with delivery if Field Plot East confirms receipt of their bags; otherwise, remain at the depot for two minutes before attempting delivery again. Following the South delivery, continue to Field Plot North with the remaining six fertilizer bags, where you must wait for three minutes once on-site to allow rain showers to pass before staff will accept the fertilizer. Upon concluding all distributions and after receiving clearance from the North field supervisor that the fertilizer drop-off is complete, return immediately to the Central Fertilizer Depot to stand by for vehicle decontamination and post-dispatch checks by the maintenance crew.

Start at Packing Bay 2 and proceed to Storage Area Delta to collect a crate containing twenty-one spare machine parts. Distribute the machine parts across Workshop 1, Workshop 2, and Workshop 3 as follows: deliver seven parts to Workshop 1 first; after all seven machine parts have been removed by the workshop team, continue to Workshop 2 to deliver another set of seven parts and wait until staff there confirm all parts are unloaded. Deliver the final seven parts to Workshop 3, ensuring that the full batch is transferred before proceeding. Once all three workshops have received their machine parts, travel to Quality Inspection Room B and wait exactly five minutes for an inspection crew to certify crate emptiness. Only after receiving confirmation of inspection completion, return immediately to Packing Bay 2 to conclude the operation.

Begin your route at Storage Barn Delta, where you will load a total of thirteen irrigation control modules, then proceed to allocate these modules among three distinct locations, ensuring fair distribution: first, deliver five irrigation control modules to Field Plot Echo, then pause at Field Plot Echo until the local supervisor has removed all five modules and signaled readiness for installation. Once confirmation is received, continue to Greenhouse Bay Foxtrot with four more irrigation control modules, but do not release these modules at Greenhouse Bay Foxtrot until you confirm that Field Plot Echo’s removal is fully completed; after unloading at Greenhouse Bay Foxtrot, remain on site for exactly five minutes to support system integration checks. Next, bring the final four irrigation control modules to Crop Testing Area Gamma, but before initiating the transfer, verify that both Field Plot Echo and Greenhouse Bay Foxtrot have concluded their respective receiving and inspection steps. Once all modules at Crop Testing Area Gamma are delivered, await the signal from the testing crew to ensure integration is progressing, then stay an additional six minutes to facilitate any emergency adjustments before concluding your distribution route.

Start by proceeding to the Central Maintenance Hangar to collect four replacement hydraulic actuators for routine maintenance across the facility. Once the actuators are secured, deliver one actuator each to Machine Bay A, Equipment Bay B, and Tools Lab C, stopping at each location in sequence to ensure that the technician at each bay is ready to receive the part by waiting until the respective bay signals their readiness for the actuator to be unloaded. For each drop-off, do not proceed to the next bay until the current technician has confirmed receipt of the actuator. After all three bays have collected their assigned actuators, wait for ten minutes in the Tools Lab C to allow engineers to inspect your remaining actuator for damage. Only if the engineers approve the last actuator as undamaged, proceed to Diagnostic Station D to deliver it; if it is deemed unsuitable, return the final actuator to the Central Maintenance Hangar for evaluation. Following the successful delivery—either to Diagnostic Station D or back at the Hangar—wait for two minutes before shutting down the transport platform to signal task completion.

Begin your route at the Main Materials Warehouse, where you are to collect a pallet of twelve replacement crop sprayers. Navigate first to Greenhouse Section A and deliver four of the replacement crop sprayers; remain onsite until the greenhouse crew removes all four units and confirms receipt. Afterward, immediately proceed to Orchard Row 5, delivering four additional crop sprayers to the maintenance station, but pause at this location for six minutes to allow safety checks to be completed by the orchard foreman before release of the units from your payload. Next, carry the final four replacement crop sprayers to the Equipment Repair Bay, and wait at this bay until a technician signals that all remaining units have been unloaded from your cargo module. Only after all crop sprayers have been successfully distributed and verified at each site should you return to the Main Materials Warehouse to close out the delivery log for this operation.

Start your route at the Central Feed Stockpile, where you will collect a payload of twenty animal feed bags destined for distribution across three barn locations: Dairy Barn A, Poultry Enclosure West, and Sheep Shed North. Deliver nine feed bags to Dairy Barn A first, and remain at Dairy Barn A until the livestock caretaker confirms the complete removal of these bags. Next, continue to Poultry Enclosure West to offload six feed bags, but before you begin the unloading process, wait for five minutes on-site to allow farm staff to clear a staging area; do not proceed until this interval has fully elapsed and you receive their readiness confirmation. After the feed bags are offloaded and verified at Poultry Enclosure West, move on to Sheep Shed North with the remaining five feed bags, and wait onsite until the shepherd signals that the bags have been stored inside. Once all deliveries are concluded and removal at each location is acknowledged, immediately return to the Central Feed Stockpile for restocking operations, ensuring your cargo bay is empty and ready for the next task.

Begin at the component storage warehouse and load twelve sealed containers labeled 'Sensor Array Type D' for distribution. First, proceed to Assembly Line 1, where you will deposit four sealed containers and wait for one minute to confirm that the line technician has fully integrated the contents of all four containers. Next, travel to Assembly Line 2 and deliver another five sealed containers, but only remain on site until a designated handler has removed every container; if the handler requests fewer than five sealed containers, return any surplus to the component storage warehouse before proceeding. Once Assembly Line 2’s delivery is complete, wait for three minutes before transferring the final three sealed containers to the Equipment Testing Bay. At the Equipment Testing Bay, do not leave until a quality inspector has signaled that all three containers have been unpacked and accounted for. After all deliveries are verified and any unneeded sealed containers are returned to the component storage warehouse, proceed back to your original starting point and remain idle for one minute as a system check before ending your assignment.

instruction: Start at the Equipment Storage Shed and collect four maintenance toolkits needed for repairs across the facility. Transport two maintenance toolkits to the Tractor Repair Bay first; wait onsite until the mechanics confirm both toolkits have been fully received and unloaded. Once this confirmation is obtained, continue to Solar Panel Field Substation B, where you must deliver one maintenance toolkit and remain for one hundred twenty seconds while the electrical crew examines the contents before authorizing removal. After this waiting period and verification, carry the last maintenance toolkit to Field Irrigation Pump Station 3, but only leave the toolkit once the station engineer signals the repair slot is available, which requires an additional two-minute wait if the station is occupied on arrival. Do not return to the Equipment Storage Shed for your final status check until you have delivered all toolkits and received clearance regarding their removal at each location.

Start at Storage Warehouse 2 and collect a total of thirteen irrigation sensor modules, ensuring all modules are accounted for before leaving. Transport four sensor modules to Maintenance Bay A and wait there for three minutes to allow the technician to validate each module as operational; after successful confirmation at Bay A, proceed to Greenfield South and distribute five sensor modules along the designated sensor posts, pausing for one minute at each post while technicians mount and calibrate the modules. Once the Greenfield South delivery is complete, deliver the remaining four sensor modules to Control Tower West, but only unload these modules if all previous deliveries were confirmed; if confirmation from either Maintenance Bay A or Greenfield South has not been received, wait at Control Tower West in two-minute increments for up to six minutes for delivery clearance, returning all undelivered modules to Storage Warehouse 2 if time expires without authorization. After all deliveries are accomplished or appropriately returned, report back to Storage Warehouse 2 and remain there until dispatched for the next assignment.

Begin at Bulk Fertilizer Depot 1 and load a total of 17 bags of granulated potash fertilizer intended for three separate field storage locations. Transport seven bags to East Field Silo and remain on site until the farm operator finishes removing all seven bags from the robot and confirms the inventory. Once this removal is acknowledged, continue to North Field Shed and deliver five bags; wait for four minutes at North Field Shed to allow for fertilizer quality checks before proceeding. Next, deliver the remaining five bags to South Pasture Storage, but if upon arrival any of the doors at South Pasture Storage are closed, wait outside until access is granted by local staff before completing the offload. After the South Pasture Storage delivery is finished, return immediately to Bulk Fertilizer Depot 1 for system inspection and next assignment briefing.

Begin your route at the Bulk Chemical Refill Station and load twelve pesticide canisters earmarked for three field locations. Deliver four pesticide canisters to Field Plot Alpha first; once you have arrived on-site, remain in place until the Plot Alpha supervisor notifies you that all four canisters have been retrieved and accounted for. After the retrieval confirmation, proceed immediately to Field Plot Bravo, but before unloading any canisters, wait precisely two minutes to allow the Bravo field crew to finish their ongoing sprayer system calibration. Unload five pesticide canisters at Bravo and, after they're removed, verify with the field foreman that all items are logged for inventory; only then continue to Field Plot Charlie. Upon arrival at Charlie, deliver the remaining three pesticide canisters, and then wait outside the Charlie maintenance shed for five minutes, regardless of the unloading pace, to give technicians sufficient time to store the canisters safely. When all canisters have been distributed and all prescribed wait times observed at each field location, return to the Bulk Chemical Refill Station and remain stationary until you receive updated routing instructions from the operations center.

Start by going to the Fertilizer Depot to pick up nine sealed bags of organic fertilizer, waiting there until the depot attendant signals all nine have been safely loaded. Then, deliver these bags to three separate Greenhouse wings as follows: deliver three bags to Greenhouse Wing One, three bags to Greenhouse Wing Two, and the final three bags to Greenhouse Wing Three, making sure to pause at each greenhouse until the horticulturists confirm removal of all bags assigned to their location. Once the last bag has been removed from Greenhouse Wing Three, proceed directly to the Washdown Station and wait there for a period of seven minutes to allow the sanitation crew to perform system cleaning and inspection. After this waiting period, return immediately to the Fertilizer Depot and wait for further tasks.

Begin the mission at the Seed Storage Facility by retrieving a total of sixteen bioengineered corn seed boxes, verifying all sixteen are onboard before moving on. Your first destination is Sowing Plot Delta, where you are to deliver six seed boxes and then wait at Sowing Plot Delta until a field supervisor signals that the seed boxes have been fully unloaded and accounted for. Next, travel to Sowing Plot Echo with another five seed boxes; do not attempt to hand over the boxes until planting machinery operators at Sowing Plot Echo confirm their readiness, so remain at the plot as long as necessary to receive this signal before proceeding to unload. For the last five seed boxes, proceed to Sowing Plot Foxtrot, but upon arrival you must wait exactly ten minutes before unloading is authorized to allow the plot's automated planters to finish their calibration; after this time has elapsed, deliver all five seed boxes. After completing all deliveries and receiving confirmation of acceptance at Sowing Plot Delta, Sowing Plot Echo, and Sowing Plot Foxtrot, continue on to the Machine Service Hangar and remain there for precisely five minutes to undergo a required maintenance inspection before returning the unit to standby status at the Seed Storage Facility.

Begin your route at the Main Warehouse and wait until a complete set of thirty-six precision spare parts is loaded onto your cargo unit. Divide these thirty-six parts among the Assembly Dock, Maintenance Bay, and Quality Control Center such that each location receives exactly twelve parts; should any logistics issue arise, ensure no site receives more or less than its allocated batch. Start by proceeding to the Assembly Dock with the first twelve spare parts, pausing at the dock until every part has been carefully offloaded by the assembly crew. As soon as this transfer is confirmed, continue to the Maintenance Bay with the next twelve parts, but before offloading, wait at the Maintenance Bay for seven minutes while equipment in the bay is recalibrated to accept new parts. Once the recalibration period is complete and the twelve parts have been removed, transport the final twelve parts to the Quality Control Center; upon arrival, remain stationary until the Quality Control supervisor provides confirmation that all twelve parts are accounted for and staged for inspection. After all sites have acknowledged receipt of their shipments, and mandatory wait periods have passed, return immediately to the Main Warehouse to complete your assignment.

Depart from the Central Maintenance Bay and proceed to Parts Storage Area B to retrieve eighteen battery units, waiting until the supply technician confirms that all eighteen battery units are ready for pickup. Once loaded, travel to Solar Array Junction 5 and deliver seven battery units, pausing at the delivery site until each individual battery unit is removed by the array technician before proceeding. Next, head to Power Relay Station Alpha to drop off six battery units; after all six battery units have been removed, remain at Power Relay Station Alpha for five minutes to allow system diagnostics and charging interface calibration to complete. With the remaining five battery units, proceed to Remote Sensor Node Q13, but if any delay was encountered during removals at either Solar Array Junction 5 or Power Relay Station Alpha, initiate a two-minute waiting period outside Remote Sensor Node Q13 before unloading. Once all eighteen battery units have been successfully distributed and all specified waiting periods are observed, return directly to Parts Storage Area B for status reporting and system check-in.

Start at Maintenance Bay 3 and collect twelve replacement filter cartridges designated for three different greenhouse zones: Lettuce Greenhouse, Tomato Greenhouse, and Pepper House. First, proceed to Lettuce Greenhouse and deliver five filter cartridges, ensuring you remain at Lettuce Greenhouse until the on-site technician confirms each filter cartridge has been installed. Once all five cartridges are accounted for, move to Tomato Greenhouse carrying another five filter cartridges; upon arrival, wait precisely six minutes to allow the cooling systems to power down before releasing the filter cartridges, and then remain until the greenhouse coordinator provides confirmation that all filter cartridges have been safely transferred. Finally, deliver the remaining two filter cartridges to Pepper House, but only initiate the handoff if status updates from both Lettuce Greenhouse and Tomato Greenhouse confirm their deliveries are complete. Stay at Pepper House until the facility supervisor verifies receipt and installation of both filter cartridges, then return to Maintenance Bay 3 and remain on site for four minutes to run diagnostic self-checks before concluding your operation.

Start your task at Storage Hangar D, where you will prepare to transfer a shipment of nine seed pouches that must be distributed across the Western Crop Field, the Southern Greenhouse, and the Northern Nursery. First, collect all nine seed pouches and proceed to the Western Crop Field, delivering three seed pouches there; once the local supervisor has accepted the delivery, pause for two minutes to allow the field crew to inspect the packaging. After the inspection window is completed, bring four more seed pouches to the Southern Greenhouse, waiting onsite until the greenhouse manager confirms via radio that all pouches are properly cataloged in their inventory system. The remaining two seed pouches are to be delivered to the Northern Nursery, and you are to wait at the nursery entrance for three minutes to ensure nursery staff have successfully integrated the seeds into their secure seed vault. After verifying every location has received the correct number of seed pouches and all wait times have elapsed, return directly to Storage Hangar D and remain near the loading dock area until further instructions are transmitted from the central dispatch office.

instruction.location: Storage Hangar D loading dock area

instruction: Start at Central Greenhouse Depot and collect four seed trays marked 'Variety Z-17.' Next, proceed to Seedling Bed Alpha and deliver one seed tray, confirming that the staff supervisor at Seedling Bed Alpha signals when the tray is ready for removal before releasing it. Immediately after, go to Seedling Bed Beta with two seed trays, waiting for confirmation each time before offloading each tray; if Seedling Bed Beta is not ready when you arrive, wait at the entry point until readiness is confirmed for both trays separately. After both trays at Beta are delivered, continue to Seedling Bed Gamma to deposit the final seed tray, and then remain at Seedling Bed Gamma for six minutes to ensure initial planting procedures are completed. Once the holding time at Gamma concludes, return directly to Central Greenhouse Depot and stand by there until further instructions are given, unless you receive a signal that one of the trays was not received properly, in which case revisit the respective bed for verification before ending your shift.

Start the route at Storage Warehouse Delta where you will load eight maintenance toolkits, and then proceed to Maintenance Bay 1, Maintenance Bay 2, and Control Room Epsilon for distribution. Deliver three toolkits to Maintenance Bay 1, two to Maintenance Bay 2, and the remaining three to Control Room Epsilon, ensuring only one bay or room receives toolkits per trip. After each successful drop-off and toolkit confirmation at a site, wait for six minutes to allow the technicians at that location to perform a quick tools inventory and sign-off before returning to Storage Warehouse Delta to retrieve the next batch for delivery. When all eight maintenance toolkits have been properly distributed and verified at their respective destinations, continue immediately to Central Operations Command and remain there for five minutes to debrief with the shift supervisor and await further deployment instructions before concluding your assignment.

Start by driving to the Seed Storage Warehouse and collect nineteen bags of high-yield corn seed. Your task is to distribute these bags across Field Alpha, Field Bravo, and Field Delta: deliver six bags each to Field Alpha and Field Bravo, and deliver the remaining seven bags to Field Delta to ensure the total is allocated without remainder. At each field, after you arrive and the field technician signals that the bags are ready for unloading, wait for two minutes to allow calibration of the automated seed dispensers. Only proceed to the next field once the previous field's unloading is fully complete and the waiting period has elapsed. After all nineteen bags have been delivered and the calibrations acknowledged at every location, return directly to the Farm Operations Office and remain there until the agricultural engineer retrieves your delivery documents.

Begin your route at the Cold Storage Depot and wait until you receive confirmation that nine insulated containers filled with fresh produce have been securely loaded. After the containers are aboard, drive to Packing Facility A and unload four insulated containers, ensuring to remain on site until all containers have been removed and signed off by the facility manager. Next, proceed to Distribution Center 2 with another three insulated containers, and upon arrival, wait for seven minutes to give the logistics team ample time to perform a quality check before unloading the containers. Finally, deliver the last two insulated containers to Grocery Hub West; if the loading bay at Grocery Hub West is occupied, wait up to six minutes for it to clear, then wait for all containers to be removed by the receiving clerk. With all deliveries complete, navigate to Washdown Station C and wait there for 12 minutes for a full sanitation cycle before concluding your mission.

instruction: Begin your route at the Central Packing Warehouse, where you are to wait until the warehouse manager authorizes release of a batch of fifteen boxed irrigation sensors. Upon release, distribute the sensors among three destinations as follows: deliver five sensors to South Field Node 1, four sensors to West Field Pump Shed, and the remaining six sensors to the North Orchard Shed, explicitly confirming that each location receives its designated quantity. For each delivery, remain on site and wait until a field crew member unlocks and removes all sensors assigned to that stop; defer travel to the next destination until the current location’s removal process is fully complete. When delivering sensors to the West Field Pump Shed, pause for a mandatory two-minute interval before unloading to allow the onsite operator to complete pre-transfer safety checks. Once all sensor deliveries and corresponding handovers have been fully executed, and after observing required wait periods at West Field Pump Shed, return promptly to the Central Packing Warehouse to notify warehouse personnel that deliveries are finished and the robot is ready for re-tasking.

Start at Loading Bay 2 and wait until Maintenance Crew has prepared and staged four sets of diagnostic toolkits for equipment calibration. Once the toolkits are ready, carry one toolkit each to Workshop North, Workshop East, and Workshop West, ensuring that each workshop receives a single set. Deliver the final toolkit to Workshop South only after the toolkit for Workshop North is successfully removed by its supervisor; if removal at Workshop North is delayed by more than three minutes, skip Workshop South and proceed directly to Equipment Storage, otherwise complete the South delivery as planned. After each successful handoff at a workshop, wait two minutes on-site before departing to the next indicated location. After all toolkits have been distributed based on these dependencies and wait periods, return to Loading Bay 2 and remain docked for five minutes to allow maintenance staff to log calibration activities before ending your shift.

Begin your assignment at Maintenance Bay C, retrieving twelve spare drive chains from the storage rack once technician approval is granted. Transport these drive chains to the Assembly Line Hub, but before any unloading, wait exactly five minutes at the staging area for the shift supervisor to complete safety checks. Distribute the drive chains evenly—four each—to Robot Workstation Alpha, Workstation Beta, and Workstation Gamma; if there are delays at any workstation and unloading is prevented for more than two consecutive minutes, immediately return to Maintenance Bay C for further instructions instead of waiting indefinitely. Once all chains are successfully delivered and the unloading at the last workstation is verified by the local operator, proceed to Quality Control Checkpoint Delta, and remain there for a further two minutes to submit a completion report and await possible redeployment orders before concluding your operational loop.

Begin your route at the Central Materials Staging Area and load a crate containing twenty-one mechanical fastener assortments, confirming all items are present before departure. Travel first to the Assembly Hall and deliver eight fastener assortments, then wait until the assembly line technician has fully removed each assortment before moving onward. Next, proceed to the Mechanical Repair Workshop and transfer another seven assortments, pausing until the maintenance supervisor acknowledges complete offloading from the robot. After both deliveries, you must continue to Parts Storage Bay 4, where the remaining six assortments are to be dropped off; however, before permitting removal of these, you are required to wait five minutes as the inventory manager arranges secure storage space. Once Parts Storage Bay 4 confirms all assortments have been received, navigate directly to Charging Dock B for a ten-minute recharge period prior to returning to Central Materials Staging Area to report task completion and await the next assignment.

Begin at the Irrigation Equipment Depot and retrieve twelve replacement sprinkler heads labeled 'Sprinkler_X-2024' for scheduled field upgrades. Divide the sprinkler heads as follows: deliver four to Field Section 5A, another four to Field Section 5B, and the remaining four to Field Section 5C; if there are leftover units due to irregular supply, allocate the extras to Field Section 5C. On arrival at each field section, wait until the maintenance supervisor confirms retrieval is complete before departing. After completing all three deliveries and obtaining confirmation from each section, proceed directly to Workshop Bay 2 and wait for ten minutes for tools resupply. Once the waiting period is over, return to the Irrigation Equipment Depot to report completion and await additional deployment orders.

Begin by moving to Silage Storage Bay 3 to retrieve a shipment of seven nutrient additive drums, confirming that all seven drums are properly positioned on the cargo rack before departing the bay. Transport the first two drums to Pasture Lot West and stay at Pasture Lot West until all two drums have been unloaded by the on-site operator. Immediately after removal is confirmed, proceed with delivering the next three drums to the Fermentation Yard—however, if any issues or delays affected the Pasture Lot West handover, wait for a clear signal from the yard manager at Fermentation Yard before allowing handoff of the drums at that location. For the remaining two nutrient additive drums, bring them to the Dairy Equipment Maintenance Hub; after arriving, remain onsite for five minutes to allow technical staff to inspect and log the drums in their inventory system. Only after all delivery confirmations and waiting periods at each destination have concluded, return directly to Silage Storage Bay 3 to await further instructions, ensuring no premature departures from any location during required inspection or handover intervals.

Start your task at Materials Intake Bay 7, assembling a batch of twenty-four seed treatment canisters, then wait until these canisters have all been declared ready and securely loaded. Once loaded, execute a three-phase delivery: first, transport nine seed treatment canisters to Greenhouse Annex A, where you must stay until all nine canisters have been removed by the annex team. After removal is confirmed, proceed to Experimental Plot Zone B, delivering another eight canisters; wait at Zone B until zone staff have completely retrieved the payload, then pause at Experimental Plot Zone B for an additional two minutes to allow for inventory tallying. Once tallied, bring the remaining seven seed treatment canisters to Seed Storage Facility Omega, but before offloading any canisters at Facility Omega, verify that both Greenhouse Annex A and Experimental Plot Zone B have fully completed removal and tally protocols. Upon completion of the offload at Seed Storage Facility Omega and removal of all canisters, return without delay to Materials Intake Bay 7, but once arrived, remain stationed for four minutes as a mandatory downtime before concluding your shift.

Initiate your mission at Storage Hangar A to collect a batch of twenty-seven package crates labeled 'Produce_Cargo-Current'. The crates must be distributed among Distribution Point North, Distribution Point Central, and Distribution Point East; allocate nine crates to each location. Begin by transporting all crates to Distribution Point North and offload nine crates, remaining there until the distribution clerk verifies all items have been accepted. Once confirmation is secured, proceed with eighteen remaining crates to Distribution Point Central, deliver the next batch of nine crates, and wait for a period of seven minutes to allow for automated inventory registration. After this waiting period, continue to Distribution Point East with the final nine crates, but hold at this location until you have received confirmation of both prior deliveries from their respective clerks; upon receipt of these acknowledgments, complete the final drop-off at Distribution Point East. Finally, once all delivery confirmations have been individually acknowledged, return to Storage Hangar A to await the next assignment in the logistic cycle.

Begin the delivery route at Storage Warehouse Delta, where you must pick up a set of twelve greenhouse nutrient solution packs from the supply supervisor, confirming that all packs are intact and barcoded before departure. Next, allocate the solution packs among four designated destinations: deliver four packs to Vertical Grow Unit 1, three packs to Vertical Grow Unit 2, three packs to Research Greenhouse Beta, and the remaining two packs to the South Experimental Bed, ensuring that each destination receives its specified number. At each drop-off point, wait until a technician signals that all received nutrient solution packs have been properly inventoried before moving on to the next site, and after you have completed the final delivery and all receipts are confirmed, proceed to the Logistics Dock. Once at the Logistics Dock, remain stationary for precisely five minutes while outbound produce pallets are being loaded into transport vehicles, and only after this time has elapsed, return directly to Storage Warehouse Delta to end your shift.

Start by moving to Seedling Storage Facility A to pick up nine trays of tomato seedlings destined for three growing plots in the West Field. Evenly distribute these nine trays by delivering three trays to West Plot One, three trays to West Plot Two, and the last three trays to West Plot Three. After delivering the trays to West Plot One, remain on site until the horticulture technician confirms that all three trays have been removed from the robot. Only after this confirmation, proceed to West Plot Two and deposit another three trays, waiting an additional two minutes to allow the plot supervisor to perform a health inspection of the seedlings. Once the inspection period ends and the supervisor approves, move to West Plot Three, drop off the final three trays, and wait for the farm manager to digitally acknowledge receipt of the delivery. Following successful tray handoffs at all locations, return to Seedling Storage Facility A and await further instructions from the dispatch operator.

Begin your route at Maintenance Bay 1, collecting a total of fifteen diagnostic toolkits intended for daily checks. Proceed to Workshop Alpha and deliver five diagnostic toolkits, waiting for two minutes after each handover to allow technicians to calibrate their equipment before the next transfer. Once all deliveries to Workshop Alpha are finished, head to Engine Testing Hall B with the remaining toolkits—distribute seven toolkits here and pause for three minutes after each drop-off so that engineers can conduct preliminary inspections using the new kits. Any toolkits left after servicing Engine Testing Hall B must be transported to Quality Assurance Station C, but only release these final three toolkits after receiving notification from the station foreman that inventory space has been cleared. Following confirmation of all toolkit deliveries and upon completion of each required waiting interval, return directly to Maintenance Bay 1 to await subsequent assignments. If at any location the full allocated quantity cannot be accepted, immediately redirect the surplus to the next destination on your list, ensuring each station receives its share in the intended order of operations.

object.description: notification from station foreman that inventory space has been cleared

instruction: Start at the Grain Loading Dock and collect fifteen sealed grain samples, confirming readiness with the dock supervisor before proceeding. Deliver five grain samples to Silo A first and wait for the silo manager to sign off on their receipt before moving to the next destination. After Silo A is complete, head to Silo B with another five grain samples, but pause at the entry area for three minutes to allow fumigation procedures to finish before you enter and hand over the samples for unloading. Once Silo B’s samples have been fully removed by the operator, proceed to Silo C with the remaining five grain samples, ensuring to wait at the delivery bay until all samples are offloaded by Silo C’s technician. Only after confirming that all fifteen grain samples have been distributed and received at each destination, return immediately to the Grain Loading Dock and await further assignment from the supervisor.

Start your mission at the Main Maintenance Garage to pick up a set of thirteen replacement hydraulic filters required for field equipment servicing. First, proceed to Tractor Station Alpha and deliver five filters, waiting at least six minutes for the mechanic to swap out the old filters and confirm installation. After the mechanic's confirmation, take the next four filters to Harvester Shed Bravo, but only initiate the drop-off there once Tractor Station Alpha's replacement process is completed. At Harvester Shed Bravo, after delivering the four filters and receiving acknowledgment from the lead technician, bring the final four filters to Planter Depot Charlie. Wait at Planter Depot Charlie for nine minutes to give their staff enough time to prepare the machinery for maintenance and signal that the filters are ready to be installed. Once all delivery and confirmation steps at every location are satisfactorily completed, return directly to the Main Maintenance Garage and remain on standby to receive further deployment instructions.

Begin your shift at Seed Storage Facility A, where you must wait until Warehouse Supervisor signals that nine seed bags of Type Alpha have been fully loaded onto the transport platform. Once all nine seed bags are confirmed ready, distribute these seed bags across Field Plot 1, Field Plot 2, and Field Plot 3; allocate three seed bags to each plot so that every location receives an even share. After completing the delivery to Field Plot 3, pause there for four minutes to allow field technicians to examine the delivered seed bags for integrity issues before moving on. If any of the previous fields reported damaged or missing seed bags during examination, immediately reroute to Equipment Maintenance Shed to notify the onsite inspector and await clearance for your next assignment for up to ten minutes. If, however, all field deliveries were successful and no damage is found, proceed directly to Fertilizer Depot to await further instructions, remaining on standby there for six minutes to account for scheduled inventory reconciliation.

object.description: onsite inspector clearance for next assignment

instruction: Start by proceeding to Seed Warehouse 4 to collect a pallet containing thirteen seed bags pre-labeled for different planting locations. First, deliver five seed bags to Field Plot Alpha; do not depart Field Plot Alpha until the field supervisor has acknowledged receipt and completed removal of all five seed bags. Following this, transfer another four seed bags to Irrigation Node Delta; if Field Plot Alpha reported any discrepancies in bag count upon delivery, pause at Irrigation Node Delta for two full minutes before awaiting removal confirmation from the technician there. Afterward, bring the remaining four seed bags to the Central Storage Silo—once the operator at the Central Storage Silo has removed the seed bags and confirmed the handover, wait for precisely 90 seconds at that location to ensure no forgotten bags or paperwork issues remain. Only upon successful confirmation from all three recipients and completion of the designated waiting time at Central Storage Silo may you return to Seed Warehouse 4 to complete the task cycle, making sure each location’s protocol—including conditional delays and post-delivery waits—is strictly observed.

object.description: seed bags pre-labeled for different planting locations

instruction: Initiate your route by proceeding to Fertilizer Depot, where you will load a batch of twelve 25-kg fertilizer bags designated for distribution to three separate crop sectors: Wheat Row, Corn Patch, and Soybean Plot. Allocate five fertilizer bags to Wheat Row, four bags to Corn Patch, and deliver the remaining three bags to Soybean Plot. After delivering the allotted bags to Wheat Row, wait until the field supervisor signals the completion of removal for all five bags before navigating to Corn Patch. Upon arrival at Corn Patch and after depositing four bags, remain on site for three minutes to accommodate soil test sampling by the agronomist before continuing. Deliver the last three bags to Soybean Plot, and only leave the site after receiving digital confirmation from the crop manager that the fertilizer bags have been removed. Once all sectors have received their designated fertilizer and confirmation of removal has been secured at each, return to Fertilizer Depot and await further deployment orders from the logistics coordinator.

Begin at Distribution Depot Alpha and retrieve twenty freshly sealed seed packets, verifying the batch numbers upon loading. Proceed first to Greenhouse 1 and deliver seven seed packets there, but only initiate the unloading process after the greenhouse manager sends a signal confirming that the planting beds are properly prepped; wait five minutes to allow for this preparation to complete. Once all seven packets are offloaded, continue to Crop Plot Beta with the next seven seed packets, waiting on site until an agronomist confirms removal. Then, transport the final six seed packets to Nursery Shed Omega, and remain at Nursery Shed Omega for ten minutes to permit the horticulture staff to perform a quality assurance inspection before the unloading begins. Only after successful delivery and confirmation of removal at all three locations should you return to Distribution Depot Alpha and remain stationary for three minutes so depot personnel can complete a final container check.

Start your route at Packing Dock A, where a crate containing thirteen insulated coolant packs will be prepared for you; wait until the dock supervisor signals that the crate is fully loaded and secure. Once loaded, distribute the coolant packs as follows: transport five packs to Freezer Cell 1, four packs to Freezer Cell 2, and deliver the remaining four packs to Freezer Cell 3, making sure to prioritize Freezer Cell 1 as your initial stop. At Freezer Cell 1, hold your position until authorized personnel confirm the freezer is at the correct temperature before you proceed to unload all five coolant packs. Afterward, proceed to Freezer Cell 2, and upon arrival, wait three minutes to allow the auto-door dehumidification procedure to complete before transferring the four coolant packs; remain until all packs are removed by the storage assistant. Move on to Freezer Cell 3, but do not attempt to deliver the last four coolant packs until you have received digital approval from the facility manager, then wait until the final pack has been signed for on the digital manifest. Once all thirteen coolant packs are delivered and recorded at their intended freezers, immediately relocate to Maintenance Bay 2 for post-delivery inspection and await technician clearance.

object.description: freezer at correct temperature confirmation by authorized personnel

instruction: Initiate your route at Packaging Dock C, where six sealed nutrient crates are staged for field delivery. Your task is to distribute the crates by transporting two crates to Orchard Plot Alpha, three crates to Hydroponics Bay Delta, and the final crate to Repair Garage 6. Begin by taking the first two nutrient crates from Packaging Dock C to Orchard Plot Alpha, but ensure you remain at Orchard Plot Alpha until the orchard manager confirms the removal of both crates; only after the crates have been cleared may you continue. Next, return to Packaging Dock C, retrieve the next three nutrient crates, and deliver them to Hydroponics Bay Delta, waiting twice as long—four minutes—at Hydroponics Bay Delta to accommodate required unloading procedures before moving on. Only once the Hydroponics technicians have acknowledged successful receipt and removed all three crates, collect the last remaining nutrient crate from Packaging Dock C and transport it to Repair Garage 6. After the crate has been accepted and removed by the facility engineer at Repair Garage 6, remain at that location for a further five minutes to provide standby support. If at any point any location is unable to accept their assigned crates, immediately redirect all undeliverable nutrient crates to Storage Vault Zeta for secure holding before returning to Packaging Dock C and awaiting your next assignment.

Begin your operational cycle at the Seed Storage Barn, awaiting confirmation that a total of twenty-seven hybrid seed crates have been secured for planting season distribution. Once the full load is prepared, embark on sequential delivery trips—first transferring nine crates to Greenhouse A, ensuring the greenhouse staff has completely removed every crate before returning for the next phase. After Greenhouse A’s delivery and crate removal are verified, transport the subsequent nine seed crates to Planting Plot East, but pause for a five-minute interval at Planting Plot East to permit a soil humidity check before unloading. When the five-minute interval has elapsed and the plot workers have removed the crates, deliver the final nine crates to Orchard West. If, upon completing all main deliveries, any seed crates remain due to excess, promptly shuttle the surplus to Research Test Plot, waiting there until all crates have been cleared by laboratory personnel. Immediately after every drop-off is confirmed and no items remain with you, navigate to the Maintenance Hangar for routine diagnostics and remain onsite until the maintenance technician clears you for redeployment.

Start at Equipment Depot 3 and remain at the loading bay until the depot supervisor signals that ten maintenance toolkits are ready for transport. Once clearance is received, collect all ten toolkits and then proceed to allocate them to three separate destinations: deliver three toolkits to Workshop Alpha, four to Machine Bay 17, and the final three to Storage Shed Delta, ensuring these quantities are adhered to exactly. Before each handover, wait for one minute just outside the delivery site to allow local technicians to prepare for the toolkits’ arrival, and do not transfer any toolkits until the facility contact confirms readiness. Begin deliveries with Workshop Alpha and, after all three toolkits have been offloaded and their removal confirmed, continue to Machine Bay 17; repeat the procedure, then move on to Storage Shed Delta for the remaining toolkits. Following successful offloading and verification of toolkit removal at each stop, promptly return to Equipment Depot 3, where you must wait at the receiving area for five minutes before reporting completion of the delivery cycle to operational control.

Begin your mission at Warehouse 7, where you will be responsible for collecting a total of nine sealed coolant containers required for tractor systems at Utility Field Station A, Greenhouse Annex, and Orchard Equipment Shed. Start by transporting four coolant containers to Utility Field Station A and wait on site while the senior technician unloads each of the four containers; only proceed once the technician signs off on the receipt. Next, head to Greenhouse Annex to deliver another three coolant containers, but before departing, remain at Greenhouse Annex for a minimum of eight minutes, allowing the horticulture team to safely store and secure the containers due to hazardous material protocols. Once the wait time has elapsed and confirmation is received, carry the remaining two coolant containers to Orchard Equipment Shed. At this point, do not depart until both containers have been completely removed from your payload and placed into cold storage by the equipment manager, and audio confirmation of storage is received. After finishing all scheduled deliveries and waits at each destination, return to Warehouse 7 to submit inventory records and stand by near the loading dock for end-of-shift inspection.

instruction: Begin at Produce Sorting Facility West and collect fifteen labeled vegetable bins for quality control processing. Deliver six vegetable bins to Packaging Bay 1 and, after confirming that quality inspectors have removed all six bins, proceed to Processing Area B with five bins; however, at Processing Area B, you must wait for three minutes before allowing the removal of the bins so that equipment sanitation procedures can be completed. Following the wait, remain until all five bins are fully unloaded by the processing crew. Transport the remaining four vegetable bins to Cold Storage Unit Z, but if a bin is found to be missing its proper label during transit, reroute that bin to the Inspection Station instead of Cold Storage Unit Z and wait there until the bin is accounted for by a supervisor. After all bins—regardless of their final destination—have been successfully delivered and transferred, proceed to Cleaning Dock Beta and remain stationary for five minutes while the sanitation team performs a full exterior wash before you receive your next assignment.

instruction: Begin your route at Central Tool Depot and retrieve nine crates of hydraulic fluid canisters designated for routine machinery maintenance. These nine crates must be distributed as follows: deliver three crates to Repair Bay Alpha, three crates to Tractor Loading Dock, and the remaining three crates to Combine Workshop. After confirming that the crates are prepared, first travel to Repair Bay Alpha and wait until all hydraulic fluid canisters have been removed by the maintenance supervisor. Once offloading at Repair Bay Alpha is complete, wait an additional four minutes to allow for an equipment status check before departing. Next, proceed to Tractor Loading Dock with three more crates, remaining on site until a technician confirms full receipt and removal of the delivered canisters. After successful offload at the Tractor Loading Dock, continue to the Combine Workshop with the last three crates, waiting until the site manager signals completion of the unloading process. Upon completion of all deliveries, return immediately to Central Tool Depot and remain there for five minutes to conduct an inventory check before completing your assignment.

Begin your route by traveling to Parts Storage Facility Omega to collect a total of twenty-four hydraulic actuator units, confirming that all actuator units are properly packaged for transit before departing. Distribute these actuators across four different manufacturing lines as follows: deliver seven actuator units to Assembly Line One, distribute another seven actuator units to Assembly Line Two, allocate five actuator units to Assembly Line Three, and assign the remaining five actuator units to Assembly Line Four; if, during any delivery, one of the lines is temporarily offline and cannot accept its portion, redistribute its allotted actuator units evenly among the remaining operational assembly lines, explicitly documenting the new allocation at each stop. After each batch of actuator units has been delivered and physically removed by assembly personnel, wait onsite for two minutes to allow for quality checks, not leaving until a technician from that specific line gives verbal confirmation that the components meet intake standards. Once all deliveries and quality confirmations are concluded, proceed directly to Maintenance Bay Gamma to collect three diagnostic sensor packages; if the sensor packages are still undergoing final system readiness flashing, remain at Maintenance Bay Gamma until you receive readiness approval from the maintenance supervisor. Conclude your assignment by delivering all diagnostic sensor packages to Control Room Delta, remaining there until a system engineer verifies successful sensor handoff and provides you with authorization to return to Parts Storage Facility Omega for final check-in.

Begin by traveling to Fertilizer Storage Unit 2 to collect eighteen nutrient injection cartridges. Once all cartridges are loaded, proceed to Greenhouse A and deliver five cartridges, then immediately move to Greenhouse B and deposit seven cartridges. After both deliveries are complete, take the remaining six cartridges to Greenhouse C, ensuring all cartridges at each location are fully offloaded before continuing. Upon completing the final delivery at Greenhouse C, make your way to Central Irrigation Control, where you must wait for exactly five minutes to synchronize with the system update schedule. Only after the five-minute waiting period has elapsed should you check in with the irrigation supervisor to confirm readiness for the next assignment, then return to Fertilizer Storage Unit 2 and remain there until further instructions are provided.

object.description: confirmation for next assignment from irrigation supervisor

instruction: Begin at Central Maintenance Depot and collect a batch of fourteen diagnostic toolkits intended for field machinery calibration; once obtained, distribute these toolkits among three designated sites as follows: deliver five toolkits to South Field Service Bay, four toolkits to Eastern Combine Shed, and five toolkits to North Equipment Hangar, allocating any surplus so that South Field Service Bay always receives one more if there is a remainder. At each location, wait for the respective site engineer at South Field Service Bay, Eastern Combine Shed, or North Equipment Hangar to signal that their calibration bays are ready before offloading any toolkits, and only initiate the transfer once readiness is confirmed. After each drop-off is completed, enforce a three-minute mandatory waiting period at the site to allow for safety checks and inventory logging, remaining stationary before departing to the next destination. Once all toolkits have been successfully handed over and the site engineers have registered receipt at their respective stations, return to Central Maintenance Depot and wait outside its entry bay for six minutes to allow resources to be inventoried and mission data synchronized before concluding the assignment.

instruction: Start your mission at Docking Station North, where you must pick up a shipment of twenty-seven hydroponic nutrient canisters from Loading Bay 3, waiting until the dock crew signals that all twenty-seven canisters are ready for transport. After receiving the clearance, proceed to Greenhouse Chamber A and deliver ten hydroponic nutrient canisters, remaining at the chamber until the chief horticulturist removes all ten canisters; if the removal at Greenhouse Chamber A is delayed beyond the scheduled handoff, once the canisters are finally taken you must spend an additional three minutes recalibrating your dispensing nozzle before the next step. Next, travel to Irrigation Pump House West with eight canisters and leave them at the supply hatch, making sure to wait until the pump operator has retrieved every canister before leaving the area. With the final nine canisters, move to Vertical Farm Tower C and deliver all remaining canisters to the Tower Inventory Station, coordinating with local staff to confirm pick-up of each canister and remaining on site until acknowledgment of the completed delivery. Only after all hydroponic nutrient canisters have been successfully distributed across Greenhouse Chamber A, Irrigation Pump House West, and Vertical Farm Tower C, and all necessary waiting periods and recalibrations have been completed, may you return to Docking Station North to finalize your delivery report.

Tower Inventory Station at Vertical Farm Tower C

instruction: Begin at the Chemical Supplies Depot, where you must collect fourteen fertilizer drums for redistribution. First, transport five fertilizer drums to Field A Loading Dock, place them in the designated drop zone, and wait exactly four minutes to allow agricultural staff to verify chemical labels and secure the load. Once verification is complete, proceed to Field B Supply Point and deliver another five fertilizer drums, remaining there until the site supervisor confirms all drums have been properly received and removed from your robot’s payload. With the remaining four fertilizer drums, travel to Field C Tool Shed, physically transfer all remaining drums, and stay on site for five additional minutes while safety managers conduct a final batch inspection. After all fertilizer drums have been successfully distributed and checked across all fields, navigate to the Depot Maintenance Bay and continue waiting there until a maintenance technician arrives to unload all delivery attachments, indicating your distribution route is fully complete.

Begin at Maintenance Supply Room A to retrieve a shipment of eleven specialized coolant canisters intended for three separate tractor repair bays. Transport five coolant canisters first to Tractor Repair Bay 1 and remain at that location until the maintenance crew has fully unloaded and acknowledged receipt of all five canisters. Once this delivery is confirmed, wait exactly four minutes to allow technicians to perform a preliminary fitting, then proceed to Tractor Repair Bay 2 and deliver another three coolant canisters, pausing there until all three canisters are removed from your cargo. Next, transfer the remaining three coolant canisters to Tractor Repair Bay 3. After all coolant canisters have been successfully removed by the repair crew at Bay 3, continue to Equipment Staging Area C, where you must stay for ten minutes while diagnostics are run on your cargo compartment. Only after this waiting period, return to Maintenance Supply Room A and stand by for your next set of instructions.

Start by navigating to Fertilizer Shed Alpha to collect a batch of fourteen fertilizer sacks and confirm the sacks are loaded securely. Proceed to Field Plot One and unload five fertilizer sacks; wait beside Field Plot One until the field manager has physically removed all five sacks and verified the delivery. After this confirmation, return immediately to Fertilizer Shed Alpha, pick up the next group of seven fertilizer sacks, and then go to Field Plot Two, where you will deliver four sacks, remaining on site until those four fertilizer sacks have been offloaded and acknowledged by the supervisor. For the final trip, return once more to Fertilizer Shed Alpha, retrieve the remaining two fertilizer sacks, and deliver both to Greenhouse Zeta, making sure not to depart until both sacks are collected by the greenhouse attendant. Once all fourteen fertilizer sacks have been distributed and confirmed at their respective destinations, move directly to Equipment Service Dock, await equipment maintenance staff for three minutes for a quick inspection, and finally, once cleared, return the empty carrier to Fertilizer Shed Alpha and log mission completion.

Begin at Silo Entrance Alpha to pick up a batch of 25 seed containers designated for three crop fields: Field A, Field B, and Field C. Allocate the seed containers by delivering 9 to Field A, 8 to Field B, and the remaining 8 to Field C; for each field, approach the corresponding distribution station and wait on-site until all seed containers have been removed from your payload area by the field crew before moving on to the next. Once deliveries are complete at all three fields, head to Agricultural Workshop 4, where you must remain for seven minutes to allow a technician to perform a post-delivery inspection of your seed dispensing module. After passing the inspection, return directly to Silo Entrance Alpha and be ready for the subsequent assignment cycle.

Start your task at Loading Dock 3, where you must wait until the Packaging Crate labeled "Widget Batch 17" is ready for pickup as confirmed by the Operations Supervisor. Once you receive confirmation, transport Widget Batch 17 to Quality Control Station Alpha and remain there until the crate has been removed by quality control personnel for inspection. Only after the crate is fully offloaded, proceed to your next destination: Manufacturing Line Bravo. At Manufacturing Line Bravo, you are to collect four fresh Dispenser Units and distribute them evenly between Storage Room X, Storage Room Y, and Storage Room Z; deliver one Dispenser Unit to Storage Room X and one to Storage Room Y, then allocate the remaining two Dispenser Units to Storage Room Z, since it has higher demand. After handing off the last Dispenser Unit at Storage Room Z, pause in the Storage Room Z area for three minutes to allow systems technicians time to log the arrival and placement of new units. When the waiting period concludes, return to Loading Dock 3 and remain there until you receive further deployment orders.

Begin your mission at Assembly Loading Dock 2 by confirming readiness for seven precision-machined assembly fixtures, waiting for a signal from the dock supervisor that each fixture is securely loaded before continuing. Deliver three of the fixtures first to Manufacturing Line A, remaining at Manufacturing Line A until the service technician confirms successful removal of all three fixtures. Once this is validated, transport another two fixtures to Quality Inspection Cell Q; after notifying the inspection lead of your arrival, wait for a period of four minutes to allow for initial quality checks before releasing the fixtures, and await a go-ahead signal before proceeding further. Next, take the last two fixtures to Tool Calibration Station North but only transfer the fixtures once you receive confirmation that previous calibration tools have been cleared from the station’s intake area. When every fixture has been distributed as outlined and each required waiting period or confirmation signal has been received, return directly to Assembly Loading Dock 2 and await further assignments before powering down for end-of-shift maintenance.

object.description: confirmation that previous calibration tools have been cleared

instruction: Commence your operation at Warehouse Delta, where you will collect a batch of twenty-one sealed fertilizer drums. Deliver nine of these drums to Field Depot A, waiting on site until the farm hands confirm and remove each drum from your transport. Once all nine drums are accounted for at Field Depot A, proceed to the Crop Rotation Zone with the next seven drums, but before unloading, wait for precisely five minutes to allow for ground preparation, then distribute the seven drums and remain until field personnel finish unloading all drums. With the remaining five fertilizer drums, head to the Orchard Service Compound; after arrival, only hand off the drums if the equipment supervisor at the Orchard Service Compound confirms their storage facility is ready, otherwise hold position until readiness is achieved. After verifying that all twenty-one fertilizer drums have been delivered and removed at Field Depot A, Crop Rotation Zone, and Orchard Service Compound, move to Maintenance Hangar B and wait an additional six minutes for a post-delivery inspection before concluding your assignment.

Start at the Fertilizer Storage Depot and retrieve a total of eleven nitrogen canisters, ensuring that all canisters are securely loaded onto your transport compartment. First, proceed to the West Orchard Field and unload four nitrogen canisters, but do not begin the offloading process until the orchard supervisor has signaled that the soil monitoring sensors in the field indicate readiness; only after this confirmation can you deliver the canisters. Once the supervisor has removed all four nitrogen canisters from your transport compartment, drive to the Northern Greenhouse Complex with another four nitrogen canisters, and after arriving, wait precisely five minutes to allow the greenhouse environmental systems team to calibrate their distribution pipelines before presenting the canisters for transfer. Following the wait period and once the team has taken the four canisters from your compartment, continue with the remaining three nitrogen canisters to the East Crop Test Plot. If there is any remainder after dividing canisters among the sites, the East Crop Test Plot must receive the extra canister. Prior to unloading at the East Crop Test Plot, ensure that the test plot agronomist has verified storage readiness; only after confirmation should you release the final set of canisters. After all deliveries are complete and all recipients have acknowledged removal of their respective nitrogen canisters, return to the Fertilizer Storage Depot and remain parked outside for four minutes to finalize delivery logs and synchronize with the central inventory database.

object.description: storage readiness confirmation from test plot agronomist

instruction: Commence your shift at Loading Dock Alpha and collect a stack of sixteen small machine part boxes designated for three different workshop bays. Once the boxes are loaded, proceed to Assembly Workshop One and offload five machine part boxes, ensuring you wait at Assembly Workshop One until their inventory technician scans and removes each box individually from the cart. After confirming all five boxes are received at Assembly Workshop One, advance to Calibration Lab Delta to deliver another six machine part boxes; upon arrival at Calibration Lab Delta, hold position until the calibration supervisor completes an inspection of the delivered boxes and authorizes you to depart. Move on to Maintenance Bay Seven with the last five machine part boxes, but before starting the unload at Maintenance Bay Seven, remain idle for four minutes to safely allow fork-lift operations in the receiving area to finish. Once the four-minute waiting period elapses, unload the remaining machine part boxes at Maintenance Bay Seven, ensuring all five are present and acknowledged by the maintenance foreman. Return any signed delivery paperwork to Loading Dock Alpha after all boxes are distributed and confirmations are received from each location before ending your delivery route.

Begin your operation at Seed Warehouse A by securing a batch of thirteen sealed corn seed crates for field distribution. Set your course for Field 4 South, but pause outside Field 4 South for three minutes to allow the crew leader time to position field unloading equipment; unload five corn seed crates at Field 4 South once the crew leader signals readiness and confirms safe access to the loading zone. As soon as all five crates have been handed over, travel to Field 7 East with the next four corn seed crates, but do not attempt to offload until receiving confirmation from the irrigation system operator that the soil is sufficiently dry for seed placement. Once the operator has indicated safe conditions and taken all four seed crates, proceed to the last delivery stop at Test Field 1Z, where you will distribute the remaining four corn seed crates to the agronomy research team. If any crates were unable to be delivered at a prior stop due to access restrictions or failed readiness checks, reroute to Storage Silo E and deposit those undelivered seed crates for later collection before returning directly to Seed Warehouse A. Upon final return, remain stationary at Seed Warehouse A for six minutes to enable remote backup of the completed delivery manifest before powering down.

object.description: crew leader readiness confirmation and safe access signal
soil dry for seed placement confirmation from irrigation system operator

instruction: Commence your route at Agricultural Supply Center Delta, where you must obtain a consignment of twelve irrigation valve kits once the package has been verified by the dispatch supervisor. Your itinerary is to distribute these valve kits among three locations as follows: first, travel to Greenhouse Block A and deliver four valve kits, ensuring you wait until the Greenhouse Block A manager has individually removed all units from your payload before proceeding. Next, proceed to Orchard Storage Barn and pause for five minutes upon arrival to allow for the assembly crew to prepare the barn site before offloading the next four valve kits; verify that each kit is removed by the crew before you leave. Then, the last four valve kits are to be delivered to Vine Terrace Tool Shed, but only begin the transfer after receiving confirmation from the Tool Shed operator that access is clear and a technician is present on site. Following successful handover at all three destinations, promptly return to Agricultural Supply Center Delta and remain at Docking Bay 3 for a three-minute post-mission maintenance check before you stand by for further instructions.

Begin your route at the Fertilizer Depot and wait until the pallet containing sixty fertilizer bags is ready for collection as confirmed by warehouse staff. Once loaded, undertake a distribution route to deliver these bags to four different orchard storage sheds: allot seventeen bags to Orchard Shed A first, fifteen bags to Orchard Shed B, thirteen bags to Orchard Shed C, and then bring the remaining fifteen bags, explicitly assigning any leftover bags due to indivisible quantities to Orchard Shed D. At each shed, wait until the respective farm supervisor has removed all delivered fertilizer bags before proceeding to the next destination. After all fertilizer bags are successfully distributed and offloaded, navigate to Field Monitoring Station 7, where you must remain for nine uninterrupted minutes to enable post-delivery system diagnostics before finally returning directly to the Fertilizer Depot to complete your delivery cycle.

Begin your route in the Tool Inventory Bay, where you must collect a total of eleven diagnostic sensor kits, each clearly labeled for their specific final location. First, take five sensor kits to Maintenance Station Alpha; upon arrival, wait for the senior technician to prepare the intake area, and only hand over the kits when readiness is confirmed. Once the five sensor kits have been removed at Maintenance Station Alpha, proceed to Calibration Lab 1 with three more sensor kits, pausing outside the lab for two full minutes to allow sensitive calibration equipment to reach the required stabilization temperature before entering and delivering the sensor kits. After these deliveries are confirmed, your final task is to transfer the remaining three sensor kits to Storage Locker Omega, but only if an alert is received that Storage Locker Omega has been cleared of expired stock—this clearance is permissible solely after the prior two deliveries are completed. Following the removal of the sensor kits at Storage Locker Omega, wait there for an additional minute to synchronize your task logs with the central management system before returning to the Tool Inventory Bay to conclude operations for the day.

Begin at Loading Dock Bravo and collect twelve crates of harvested tomatoes that await transfer. Evenly distribute these crates among Packing Station A, Storage Cooler 2, and Quality Control Lab, allocating four crates to each destination so that all twelve crates are accounted for. After delivering crates to Packing Station A, do not leave until the packing supervisor signals that the unloading process is complete. Proceed next to Storage Cooler 2, and remain there for a mandatory five-minute interval to give the refrigeration technician time to inspect the crate temperatures and approve storage. Only after this pause may you advance to the Quality Control Lab. Upon arrival at the Quality Control Lab, wait until the lab manager confirms sample extraction is finished before you unload the final set of crates. Once all crates have been handed off, all wait times fulfilled, and each destination’s protocol completed, return without delay to Loading Dock Bravo and stand by for further tomato harvest transfers.

object.description: unloading completion signal from packing supervisor
sample extraction confirmation from lab manager

instruction: Begin at Supply Depot Delta and collect a total of fifteen crop nutrient canisters, ensuring all canisters are secured for transit. Evenly distribute these canisters by first transporting five canisters to Field Distribution Node A; after each delivery, remain at Field Distribution Node A for three minutes to verify automated injection machinery successfully loads each canister, and proceed only after confirmation is complete. Once all five canisters have been delivered and verified at Node A, continue by taking another five canisters to Field Distribution Node B, but do not begin unloading until the field operator at Node B signals readiness; after unloading each of these five canisters, wait for four minutes to monitor initial nutrient dispersal performance as per protocol. Deliver the final five canisters, one by one, to the Vertical Farm Loading Bay, remaining at the Vertical Farm Loading Bay after each drop-off until the inventory manager removes each canister from your cargo. Upon completing all fifteen deliveries and confirming the removal or successful handoff of each nutrient canister at their respective destinations, proceed directly to the Equipment Maintenance Shed and wait for ten minutes, allowing maintenance staff to conduct post-delivery inspection of your transport platform before concluding your tasks by returning to Supply Depot Delta.

Start your operation at the Loading Dock, where you must pick up a set of twelve diagnostic toolkits intended for distribution to Maintenance Bay A, Maintenance Bay B, and Maintenance Bay C. Deliver five diagnostic toolkits to Maintenance Bay A first, and remain at that bay until the technician confirms removal of all five toolkits. After receiving confirmation at Maintenance Bay A, proceed to Maintenance Bay B and supply it with another four diagnostic toolkits; pause at this location for three minutes to permit the maintenance crew to run initial equipment checks using the delivered toolkits. Once the waiting period is complete, continue to Maintenance Bay C to deliver the remaining three diagnostic toolkits, staying until the bay supervisor acknowledges full receipt and removal. Only after all toolkits have been delivered and acknowledgements from each bay have been received should you head back to the Loading Dock, where you will wait an additional five minutes to support any urgent retrievals before ending your shift.

Begin at Seed Storage Facility A and collect a batch of twenty-three labeled seed packets intended for three field zones. Transport the batch first to Field Zone West, where you will unload eight seed packets and remain on site until the irrigation technician confirms the packets are safely incorporated into the sowing apparatus; this confirmation is required before moving on. Next, proceed to Nursery Building Two to deliver another eight seed packets, but only distribute them after waiting for two minutes to allow nursery staff to prepare their seedling trays. Complete the route by delivering the final seven seed packets to Field Zone South—if the greenhouse supervisor at Field Zone South indicates the receiving tables are occupied, wait five minutes to enable the transfer of prior inventory before proceeding with the packet delivery. After all seed packets have been properly distributed and receipt is acknowledged at each zone, return to Seed Storage Facility A and wait in the departure lane until further instructions are issued.

Begin at the Bulk Seed Storage Facility, where you are tasked with collecting fifteen bags of certified wheat seeds after confirming they are ready for transport. Evenly distribute the seed bags by making three consecutive deliveries: first, transport five bags to Field Plot Alpha and wait there until you receive a signal that local staff have secured the delivery. Proceed next to Field Plot Bravo with another five bags and remain for three minutes after arrival to ensure accurate handoff during an ongoing field calibration process. Finally, deliver the remaining five seed bags to Field Plot Charlie, but stay onsite until the field supervisor confirms removal of all bags from your payload. Once all fifteen wheat seed bags have been properly delivered and acknowledged at their respective plots, promptly return to the Bulk Seed Storage Facility to complete the seed distribution mission.

Begin your round at Seed Storage Vault and collect a batch of sixteen fertilizer bags slated for distribution. First, transport six of the fertilizer bags to Orchard Plot East; upon arrival, wait outside the entry gate for three minutes to allow field staff to prepare receiving the fertilizer, then deliver the six bags and wait for each bag to be removed individually before proceeding. Next, take five fertilizer bags from Seed Storage Vault to Greenhouse Beta, ensuring you do not enter the greenhouse until the ventilation system indicates safe air quality; after system confirmation, deliver all five bags and remain until the greenhouse supervisor confirms full removal. The final five bags are to be delivered to Crop Field North; if Crop Field North’s loading platform is at capacity when you arrive, wait for four minutes before reattempting entry—if still unavailable after this interval, divert the fertilizer bags to Overflow Shed C. Once all fertilizer has been distributed or stored in Overflow Shed C, return to Seed Storage Vault and pause operations for one minute while your cargo platform is inspected for residue or contamination before concluding your assignment.

object.description: ventilation system safe air quality confirmation

instruction: Begin at Central Pallet Depot, where you are scheduled to collect a load of fourteen wooden pallets for redistribution. First, transport five of the wooden pallets to Packaging Hall B, ensuring that upon arrival you wait for a packaging technician to signal readiness before offloading begins; wait at Packaging Hall B until all five pallets have been fully removed by staff. Next, deliver another five wooden pallets to Assembly Platform 2, but after arriving at Assembly Platform 2, remain stationary for four minutes to allow assembly workers to clear space prior to offloading— do not begin pallet removal until this waiting period has elapsed. For the final four wooden pallets, proceed to Maintenance Storage Shed; after reaching Maintenance Storage Shed, distribute all four pallets and wait for the storage attendant to finish his inventory check and remove the pallets from your cargo platform. Once all deliveries are completed and confirmed, return immediately to Central Pallet Depot and await a final clearance from the shift overseer before powering down, which may only occur after confirmation that every destination confirmed full removal of their allocated wooden pallets.

Start from the Equipment Service Garage and prepare to shuttle a total of ten diagnostic sensor modules to three different destinations: Field Maintenance Shed, North Orchard Workshop, and Storage Silo 2. First, take four sensor modules to the Field Maintenance Shed and wait at the location until a technician indicates that all four modules have been removed from the robot. After successful offloading, wait for exactly three minutes to allow staff at the Field Maintenance Shed to perform preliminary calibrations before proceeding. Next, transport another three sensor modules to the North Orchard Workshop, ensuring you remain on site until personnel confirm that all three sensor modules have been removed. Only after both prior deliveries have been fully completed, deliver the last three sensor modules to Storage Silo 2, again waiting until silo operations staff have finished unloading all modules. Once all ten diagnostic sensor modules have been delivered and the mandatory waiting period at the Field Maintenance Shed has elapsed, return directly to the Equipment Service Garage to complete your route.

Begin at Chemical Storage Bay Delta to collect nine containers of fertilizer marked for Field Plot 4, Greenhouse 2, and Vine Nursery 7. Deliver three containers each to Field Plot 4 and Greenhouse 2, dropping off the assigned containers at Field Plot 4 first, then waiting two minutes to allow the farm supervisor to inspect and authorize the offloading. After field supervisor authorization is complete, continue directly to Greenhouse 2, unload three more containers, and remain there for four minutes, giving the greenhouse staff enough time to move the fertilizer into secure storage. Take the final three containers to Vine Nursery 7; however, only offload the containers if the vine technician has finished preparing the storage racks—otherwise, wait at the nursery for up to five minutes for rack preparation before proceeding with the handoff. Once all containers have been delivered and confirmed at their destinations, return to Chemical Storage Bay Delta and wait in standby mode for three minutes to allow for refill or decontamination processes before receiving any new assignments.
