instruction: Starting at the fertilizer mixing shed, collect a container holding sixteen liters of liquid fertilizer and transport it to Field Plot East. Evenly distribute five liters of fertilizer at Field Plot East and wait for the agronomist to verify application completion before leaving. Next, travel to Field Plot North to apply another five liters, but pause for three minutes upon arrival to allow remote sensors to calibrate nutrient absorption rates. After the waiting period, finish distribution at Field Plot North and then proceed to Field Plot South, where the remaining six liters must be delivered. If at Field Plot South the crop maintenance crew has not yet cleared the sprayer docking area, remain on standby until the area is accessible and the container can be fully emptied. Lastly, once all distribution tasks at each plot have been executed and confirmed, return the empty container to the fertilizer mixing shed’s cleaning bay and wait there for further sanitation instructions.

Begin your operations at the Central Harvest Dock by collecting a shipment of twenty-seven nutrient supplement crates to be distributed among the Cereal Grain Silo, the Orchard Fertilizer Shed, and the Livestock Feed Depot. Load all crates and wait until dock personnel confirm the shipment is securely fastened. Deliver nine crates to the Cereal Grain Silo, but after arrival, remain parked for two minutes to allow the silo’s automated lift to stabilize before offloading; do not allow crate removal until this stabilization period has lapsed. Following successful crate transfer, transport nine additional crates to the Orchard Fertilizer Shed, and wait for confirmation from shed staff that prior deliveries have been fully received before permitting removal of this batch. The final nine supplement crates are earmarked for the Livestock Feed Depot, but before offloading, pause for four minutes at the depot entrance to enable the livestock area to be secured; once the area is clear and depot workers provide confirmation, proceed with the crate transfer. After all twenty-seven supplement crates have been delivered and acknowledged at their respective sites, return to the Central Harvest Dock, and remain stationed there for at least five minutes to complete end-of-route diagnostics.

object.description: dock personnel confirmation shipment securely fastened
shed staff confirmation prior deliveries fully received
depot workers confirmation livestock area cleared

instruction: Begin your shift at Workshop Bay C, where you are to retrieve twelve maintenance kits clearly labeled for sector distribution. Proceed directly to Engine Shed 1 and deliver four maintenance kits, waiting there until all kits have been removed by the site engineer before moving to the next step. Next, transport another four maintenance kits to Pump Station East; if the site engineer at Engine Shed 1 identifies any missing or damaged items, remain at Pump Station East for three minutes prior to the technician's removal of the kits to allow for inventory reconciliation. With the remaining four maintenance kits, continue to the Control Tower, where you must wait for explicit confirmation from the supervisor that the location is available before allowing removal of the maintenance kits. After all kits have been successfully delivered and removed at their assigned locations, and all conditional waiting periods are complete, return promptly to Workshop Bay C to mark the task sequence as finalized and await further dispatch orders.

object.description: maintenance kits clearly labeled for sector distribution

instruction: Start at the Loading Bay at Manufacturing Plant B, where a total of twenty-four engine filter modules are prepared for same-day distribution. Collect the full set of filter modules from the Loading Bay, then travel first to Maintenance Garage North and deliver eight filter modules, pausing at the site until each module is verified as received and logged by the shift supervisor. After confirmation at Maintenance Garage North, proceed with the subsequent eight filter modules to Fleet Operations Center 3, but wait five minutes upon arrival to allow the operations crew to organize the intake before starting the offload. After the full delivery is processed and acceptance is confirmed by Fleet Operations Center 3, transport the final eight filter modules to Emergency Equipment Depot East. Ensure that, before unloading the last batch at Emergency Equipment Depot East, you have received confirmation from both prior drop-off locations that their deliveries are complete—if any confirmation is delayed, remain in place at the depot until all acknowledgments are received. Following successful transfer of all filter modules across the three destinations, navigate to the Central Calibration Stand and wait for seven minutes while system diagnostics are performed before concluding your route.

Loading Bay at Manufacturing Plant B

instruction: Start at Central Parts Inventory and collect nine replacement hydraulic valve blocks, confirming the correct count before departure. Transport three valve blocks first to Repair Shed Alpha and remain at the site for two minutes to allow the maintenance crew to remove the faulty units before you transfer the new valve blocks. After the technician at Repair Shed Alpha confirms receipt, proceed to Machine Bay Delta, where you will deliver another three valve blocks; wait for four minutes at Machine Bay Delta while the installation crew completes their preliminary diagnostics. Only once the handoff and diagnostic confirmation at Machine Bay Delta have occurred should you advance to Field Support Post Gamma and provide the final three valve blocks to the field engineers. If confirmation of deliveries at both Repair Shed Alpha and Machine Bay Delta has not been received upon arrival at Field Support Post Gamma, wait there in one-minute intervals, up to a maximum of five minutes, for any missing clearance before returning all undelivered valve blocks to Central Parts Inventory. After every delivery has been confirmed or any undelivered items are brought back, return to Central Parts Inventory and remain there until the logistics coordinator assigns the next task.

object.description: delivery clearance confirmation for Repair Shed Alpha and Machine Bay Delta

instruction: Initiate operations at Storage Facility A, where you are to receive a batch of eleven sealed seed crates—wait until all eleven crates have been verified as loaded onto your transport compartment. Once loaded, travel first to Tractor Maintenance Bay and deliver four seed crates; after the maintenance crew at Tractor Maintenance Bay confirms removal of all four crates, proceed to Greenhouse 7 to drop off another four seed crates, ensuring you remain onsite until each crate is individually logged and removed by the greenhouse technicians. After completing the deliveries to Greenhouse 7, pause at Greenhouse 7 for six minutes to accommodate post-delivery inspection protocols before departing. With the final three seed crates still on board, head to Field Staging Area 3 and deliver the remaining crates; if Field Staging Area 3’s supervisor is unavailable upon arrival, you must remain at the area until the supervisor arrives and authorizes removal. Only after all eleven seed crates have been accepted and logged at their respective destinations should you return directly to Storage Facility A for debrief and unloading, disregarding return until you have proper confirmation from all recipient sites.

Commence operations by traveling to Packing Facility Dock 3 to pick up twenty-one crates of fresh produce labeled for delivery. Each crate must be distributed among three destinations: deliver seven crates to Retail Storefront West, eight crates to Community Food Bank North, and the remaining six crates to School Cafeteria South, ensuring the totals match exactly with no crates left over. Upon arrival at each location, wait until the receiving supervisor signals that the loading bay is ready before proceeding to unload; at the Retail Storefront West, wait four minutes after unloading for final inventory verification before departing. At Community Food Bank North, only advance to School Cafeteria South once all eight crates are confirmed received and you have waited an additional two minutes as requested for quality checks. Upon arriving at School Cafeteria South, if the cafeteria staff are delayed, wait five minutes outside before attempting delivery again. Once all twenty-one crates have been delivered and acknowledged at every destination with their respective timing requirements, return promptly to Packing Facility Dock 3 and wait for the logistics coordinator to confirm you are cleared for your next assignment.

Start at the Seed Distribution Depot and load a shipment of nine precision-sealed seed canisters designated for the upcoming planting cycle. First, proceed to Greenhouse Section A and distribute three seed canisters, then wait five minutes while the horticulture supervisor initiates the automated seeding system and confirms acceptance of all canisters. Next, travel to Greenhouse Section B to deliver another three seed canisters, but do not initiate the handover until confirmation arrives that Greenhouse Section A’s canisters have been fully unpacked; once this is received, wait for the staff manager to remove Section B’s canisters before continuing. For the final three seed canisters, make your way to Open Field Plot #7; upon arrival, pause for two minutes to allow field sensors to prepare, and then release the remaining canisters for field teams. Once all seed canisters have been distributed and their retrieval confirmed at each destination, return to the Seed Distribution Depot for a thorough system diagnostic and refill procedures.

Start at Warehouse Central and collect a total of twenty-seven fertilizer drums labeled for seasonal distribution. First, proceed to Field Station Delta and allocate nine drums; after offloading, remain at Field Station Delta for three minutes to allow soil technicians to connect and test the fertilizer mixers. Once the mixing confirmation is received, move to Field Station Echo with the next batch and deliver nine more fertilizer drums, again pausing for four minutes at their equipment yard to provide time for system integration checks. The remaining nine drums are to be transported to Field Station Foxtrot, but only begin the transfer after verifying that Field Station Echo's delivery is fully confirmed and any empty containers have been removed from the unloading zone. At Field Station Foxtrot, wait precisely five minutes after depositing the drums so water management teams can recalibrate their distribution channels. When all stations have received their drum allotments, return any unused shipping pallets to Warehouse Central before proceeding to the Service Garage to complete your task log for the day.

fertilizer drums labeled for seasonal distribution

fertilizer drums labeled for seasonal distribution

instruction: Start your route at Storage Depot West, collecting a stack of ten seed crates destined for timely distribution among South Field Plot 7, Irrigation Control Hub, North Orchard Lot 2, and the Greenhouse Loading Dock. Make your first delivery by taking three seed crates to South Field Plot 7 and wait there until the field supervisor indicates all crates are unloaded and properly logged. Once departed from South Field Plot 7, proceed to Irrigation Control Hub to deposit two seed crates; after arrival, remain for four minutes to allow hub staff to check crate contents for moisture levels before acknowledging receipt. Next, transport another three seed crates to North Orchard Lot 2, but do not proceed until you receive official confirmation from Irrigation Control Hub that the crates have passed inspection and been recorded in the inventory system—even if delay occurs, hold position at the hub. After notification, head to North Orchard Lot 2, unload the crates, and stay until the orchard manager signals that both receiving and placement are complete. To handle the two remaining seed crates, deliver them to Greenhouse Loading Dock. Upon unloading at the loading dock, wait at least five minutes to allow greenhouse staff time to prep storage space and confirm safe transfer of the seed crates. After all steps are finalized with completion signals from every recipient, return immediately to Storage Depot West and stand by for further assignment.

object.description: official confirmation of inspection and recording
manager's confirmation of receiving and placement

instruction: Begin by collecting a total of sixteen fertilizer bags from Warehouse 2, destined for three key field storage sites. First, transport and deliver seven fertilizer bags to Field Storage Alpha, remaining onsite until all bags have been individually confirmed as offloaded by the storage supervisor. Once this delivery is fully completed, proceed to Field Storage Bravo with five fertilizer bags; upon arrival at Field Storage Bravo, wait for exactly eight minutes to allow the field crew to prepare proper ventilation protocols before any unloading begins, then deliver the five bags and stay until they have all been removed. After Bravo’s handoff, bring the final four fertilizer bags to Field Storage Charlie. After unloading each of these bags at Field Storage Charlie, remain at the site for three minutes to accommodate last-minute inventory checks by the agronomy coordinator. Only after all fertilizer bags have been distributed, all waiting periods observed, and all confirmation steps completed at each field storage area, return directly to Warehouse 2 and await further transportation instructions from the logistics manager.

Begin your route in Packing Area 3 and wait until four boxes of fragile electronics have been prepared by the loading coordinator. Once the boxes are ready, deliver one box each to Assembly Line Alpha, Assembly Line Beta, and Assembly Line Gamma, while the fourth and final box should be taken to Quality Control Lab. For each assembly line delivery, do not depart until a technician at the respective location has physically removed the box from the robot. Following the drop-off at Quality Control Lab, remain on site for five minutes to allow inspectors sufficient time to perform an initial unpacking check before proceeding. After all four boxes have been correctly delivered and their removal acknowledged at all locations, return directly to Packing Area 3, but only conclude your route after reporting to the loading coordinator for a final inventory confirmation.

Begin at Bulk Fertilizer Storage and collect five sealed fertilizer drums labeled 'Type A7.' Travel first to Loading Dock One and offload two fertilizer drums, waiting for the dock attendant at Loading Dock One to signal readiness before leaving each drum; if the dock is temporarily occupied, remain outside for up to three minutes, retrying entry each half-minute, until admitted or until three minutes elapse. After completing the delivery at Loading Dock One, proceed to Irrigation Pump Station Two, where you will deposit another two fertilizer drums, but only after an engineer at Irrigation Pump Station Two verifies acceptance following a visual check; if the engineer is delayed, wait for ninety seconds before attempting to alert station staff again. Finally, transport the last fertilizer drum to Glasshouse Delta, depositing it directly at the marked supply bay, and then stay at Glasshouse Delta for four minutes to assist with any urgent supply requests. Once this holding time ends, return to Bulk Fertilizer Storage, but if any of the previous locations notify that a drum delivery failed, make an immediate return trip to the affected location with a replacement drum if available, otherwise report back and stand by at Bulk Fertilizer Storage for further instructions.

Begin at Loading Bay 3 and await the attachment of the fertilizer container labeled Batch-92. Once Batch-92 is securely mounted, proceed to Field Section East-A and deliver four units of fertilizer; wait until the automated spreader arm removes these units and signals completion. Afterward, continue to Orchard Lot 5 and unload another four units, but pause for five minutes at Orchard Lot 5 to allow soil moisture readings before release. Retain the final two units and travel directly to Meadow Plot Zeta, only unloading the remaining fertilizer units there once remote monitoring control verifies that Plot Zeta’s irrigation cycle is inactive. Following the confirmed drop-off at Meadow Plot Zeta, return to Loading Bay 3 regardless of current workload, waiting at least two minutes before commencing any new assignment.

Begin your operation at the Central Packing Hall where you must collect eighteen sealed produce crates for distribution across three cold storage units: Cold Storage Alpha, Cold Storage Beta, and Cold Storage Gamma. First, make your way to Cold Storage Alpha to deliver seven sealed produce crates; after unloading each crate, remain at Cold Storage Alpha until a quality control sensor signals crate integrity is uncompromised, repeating this process for all seven crates. Once every crate has passed inspection at Cold Storage Alpha, proceed directly to Cold Storage Beta with another six sealed produce crates, but upon arrival, do not initiate unloading until the cold storage controller transmits a readiness alert—once this signal is received, unload the crates, then wait a total of five minutes to allow temperature stabilization within Cold Storage Beta before departing. Finally, transport the remaining five sealed produce crates to Cold Storage Gamma, but deliver these only if digital logs confirm that the full deliveries at both Alpha and Beta are completed and verified; upon unloading each crate, wait for the facility supervisor to confirm removal before handling the next crate. Once all eighteen crates have been delivered, verified, or removed at their respective destinations, return without cargo to Central Packing Hall and remain stationary for six minutes to run post-route cleaning and diagnostic routines before concluding your mission.

Initiate operations at Parts Warehouse A to retrieve seven sealed engine coolant canisters required for the next maintenance cycle. Transport three canisters to Maintenance Bay North as your first stop, then wait until the maintenance lead has verified that all three canisters have been inspected and logged on the bay inventory system before proceeding. After confirmation, deliver two more canisters to Vehicle Garage 3, where you must wait for six minutes to allow garage personnel to unload the coolant and transport them into secure storage; use this time to ensure no canisters remain on your payload. The remaining two canisters should be delivered to Field Service Trailer 5, but only complete the offload if at least one technician is present at the trailer—if not, wait at the location for up to four minutes until a technician arrives to receive the delivery. Once all deliveries are verified, return directly to Parts Warehouse A and remain stationary for five minutes to undergo a mandatory system diagnostic check before any new outbound tasks are initiated.

instruction: Begin at Loader Bay A and collect a batch of seven engine diagnostic kits, ensuring all are accounted for before departure. Transport three diagnostic kits to Maintenance Hangar 5 and remain at the hangar until maintenance staff confirm the removal of each kit from your payload. Once the kits have been offloaded, proceed to Parts Storage Shed C with another three diagnostic kits, but pause on arrival for six minutes to allow the storage supervisors to prepare the intake area before you transfer the kits; if intake remains unprepared after six minutes, check in every one and a half minutes until clearance is received. Finally, deliver the seventh engine diagnostic kit to Mobile Fleet Service Point and wait there until a technician confirms readiness to receive the kit. After all seven kits have been delivered and acknowledged at their respective destinations, continue on to Power Unit Charging Area D and remain docked for twelve minutes to complete a routine recharge cycle before heading back to Loader Bay A for your next assignment.

instruction: Start at the Central Packing Facility and wait until Package Set Bravo is flagged as ready for dispatch. Once Package Set Bravo is available, carry it to Loading Dock One and remain until all hazardous materials within Package Set Bravo are safely removed by certified personnel. After hazardous material removal is acknowledged, deliver the remaining contents of Package Set Bravo to Storage Depot Gamma, where you must wait for twelve minutes to allow for proper inventory logging. As soon as this logging period ends, retrieve the empty containers from Storage Depot Gamma and visit Quality Control Station Six; only proceed if you confirmed that every container is marked as inspected. If any container is not approved at Quality Control Station Six, instead transport only the failed containers to Reprocessing Area Two and remain for five minutes to enable contamination checks. Finally, after all successful containers have been processed—or after failed ones have been left at Reprocessing Area Two—navigate back to the Central Packing Facility to complete the cycle.

instruction: Begin at Storage Silo Delta and wait until twelve sealed grain bags have been loaded onto your cargo platform by the supply technician. After all twelve grain bags are confirmed as secure, sequentially deliver four grain bags each to Feed Mill Station 1, Feed Mill Station 2, and Distribution Shed B, ensuring that any remaining bags beyond exact multiples of four are brought to Distribution Shed B as well. At each Feed Mill Station, wait for the station supervisor to indicate readiness for grain bag removal before you unload the corresponding four bags, and do not leave the station until all the bags have been offloaded by the staff. For Distribution Shed B, pause for two minutes after arrival to allow the dust suppression system to complete its cycle before you deliver the assigned grain bags. Do not depart from Distribution Shed B until the inventory clerk has acknowledged removal of all grain bags allocated for that destination. After all twelve grain bags have been dropped at their designated locations and their removal confirmed, proceed directly to Robot Charging Pad Echo and remain there until your onboard charging cycle reaches 100 percent, as verified by the monitoring system.

instruction: Begin your mission by arriving at Grain Silo #1 to collect a harvest batch consisting of twenty sacks of barley, ensuring that all sacks are ready before departure. Once the entire batch has been loaded and confirmed, transport seven sacks of barley to Brewing Facility Alpha; upon reaching Brewing Facility Alpha, remain on site until all seven sacks are offloaded and a quality control sign-off is received from the supervisor. Next, travel to Feed Processing Unit B with another seven sacks of barley, but wait for five minutes after arrival to allow the processing crew to prepare the intake conveyor system before permitting unloading and confirming the full removal of all sacks assigned to Feed Processing Unit B. After both partial deliveries, proceed with the remaining six sacks of barley to Livestock Enclosure East, and if the animal feed storage area is temporarily inaccessible, wait until storage access is granted, then stay until the staff fully removes and counts the barley sacks. Only once all sacks have been distributed and acknowledgements at each site are complete should you navigate to Fleet Charging Station Zeta, where you must remain docked for nine minutes to complete a full recharge cycle before finishing your task.

Start your mission at the Maintenance Garage, where you will wait until the machine technician has fully prepared three distinct toolkits labeled Tractor Repair Set, Irrigation Fix Kit, and Combiner Adjustment Bundle for transport. Once all toolkits are confirmed ready, proceed first to Tractor Bay 1 and deliver the Tractor Repair Set, remaining on site until the lead mechanic has removed the toolkit. Next, move on to the Irrigation Control Shed to drop off the Irrigation Fix Kit, but upon arrival, wait for 6 minutes to allow for a critical safety inspection to be completed before the technician retrieves the kit. After completing these two deliveries, travel to the Combiner Hangar and deliver the Combiner Adjustment Bundle, ensuring you only hand over the toolkit if the hangar supervisor has finished earlier maintenance—otherwise, wait an extra 8 minutes until the supervisor signals availability. Once all toolkits have been successfully delivered and acknowledged at their respective locations, return immediately to the Maintenance Garage and remain there for 12 minutes to finalize hand-off documentation and receive any follow-up assignments.

Start at the Robotics Loading Bay and retrieve twelve crates of replacement machine parts, confirming each crate is properly scanned for inventory. Proceed first to Fabrication Unit 3 and deliver four crates; after staff at Fabrication Unit 3 confirm receipt via digital signature, continue to Maintenance Workshop Delta with another four crates and wait at least six minutes to allow their technician team to prepare the workbenches before transfer. After the Maintenance Workshop Delta delivery and confirmation, bring the remaining four crates to Assembly Hall Omega, ensuring delivery only after you have received a clearance signal from Assembly Hall Omega’s supervisor. If at any point a location refuses delivery or takes longer than fifteen minutes to issue confirmation, record the failure and reroute any undelivered crates to Central Storage Vault instead, unloading them there only after receiving access permission. Once all crates are either properly delivered or securely stored, return to the Robotics Loading Bay and wait for three minutes for a post-mission systems review before task completion.

instruction: Begin your route at the Seed Storage Warehouse, where you must load twenty-one sealed grain seed crates for multi-location planting preparation. Deliver eight seed crates to Silo Crest Loading Bay in your first trip, then remain at Silo Crest Loading Bay for six minutes to allow on-site personnel to inspect the crate seals and confirm inventory counts before proceeding. After receiving inspection clearance, continue by transporting another eight seed crates to Field Delta Staging Area, staying on site until a field technician completes and records the removal of all eight seed crates from your payload. With the remaining five seed crates, head to the Experimental Plot Access Gate, where you are to transfer the final seed crates and wait an additional five minutes while the research superintendent validates the crate numbers and checks the log entry. Once all seed crates have been fully delivered, inspected, and acknowledged at their respective locations, proceed to the Dockside Cleanup Station and do not leave until sanitation staff have finished unloading all empty delivery trays, signaling the completion of your seed distribution circuit.

Begin your route at the Chemical Storage Warehouse and load exactly fourteen herbicide containers reserved for distribution across three separate paddocks: East Paddock, South Pasture, and West Gully. Deliver the first batch of five containers to East Paddock and, after arrival, wait precisely six minutes to allow the paddock supervisor to validate area safety before releasing the containers. Following confirmation, proceed back to the Chemical Storage Warehouse to retrieve the next batch and take five more herbicide containers to South Pasture; only unload these containers if East Paddock’s delivery has been officially logged as received, and remain at South Pasture until the maintenance crew removes the new containers from your cargo. Lastly, for the final delivery to West Gully, transport the remaining four herbicide containers directly, but if prior allotments have left a remainder, allocate any excess to West Gully as well and note the total delivered. Upon arrival, wait for a minimum of three minutes to ensure field equipment calibration, then release all remaining containers. Once the entire allocation has been completed and all confirmation or wait times have passed, journey to the Equipment Servicing Bay for a comprehensive sensor recalibration before standing by for the next assignment.
